title: HeLoCo: Efficient asynchronous low-communication training under data and device heterogeneity
summary: Distributed Low-Communication (DiLoCo) training reduces communication overhead by allowing workers to perform multiple local optimization steps before sending pseudo-gradients to a global outer update. Its asynchronous variant further improves hardware utilization by removing synchronization barriers, but at the cost of stale pseudo-gradients computed from outdated model states. As a result, these updates can become misaligned with the current global optimization direction, particularly in heterogeneous systems. This issue becomes even more pronounced when data are non-IID, a setting that has not been well studied in asynchronous low-communication training. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{HeLoCo}, a direction-aware correction method for asynchronous low-communication training that uses outer momentum as a reference for the current optimization trajectory and selectively adjusts incoming pseudo-gradients before the outer update. Updates that remain aligned are preserved, while directionally conflicting components are corrected. On multilingual language-model training with heterogeneous workers and non-IID data, HeLoCo consistently improves validation loss. It outperforms existing asynchronous DiLoCo-based baselines by up to 7.5\% at a fixed token budget, exceeds asynchronous momentum look-ahead by up to 3.3\% at a fixed wall-clock budget, and surpasses the synchronous baseline by up to 22.1\% under severe system heterogeneity. Our analysis further shows how staleness, worker speed, and data heterogeneity shape update quality and convergence in highly decentralized and heterogeneous training setups.

AI.tldr: 提出HeLoCo方法，通过利用外部动量作为参考来校正异步低通信训练中的陈旧伪梯度，解决异构系统和非独立同分布数据下的更新方向错位问题，显著提升训练效果。
AI.motivation: 异步低通信训练虽然提高了硬件利用率，但由于工作节点使用过时的模型状态计算伪梯度，导致更新方向与当前全局优化方向不一致。这一问题在异构系统和非独立同分布（non-IID）数据设置下更为严重，而该场景在现有研究中尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.method: 提出HeLoCo（方向感知校正）方法，利用外部动量作为当前优化轨迹的参考，选择性地在执行外部更新前调整传入的伪梯度：保留方向一致的更新分量，校正方向冲突的分量。
AI.result: 在具有异构工作节点和非独立同分布数据的多语言语言模型训练中，HeLoCo持续改善验证损失。在固定token预算下，比现有异步DiLoCo基线提升高达7.5%；在固定墙钟时间预算下，超过异步动量前视方法高达3.3%；在严重系统异构性下，超越同步基线高达22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 陈旧度、工作节点速度和数据异构性共同塑造了高度去中心化和异构训练环境中的更新质量与收敛特性，HeLoCo有效解决了异步低通信训练中的方向错位问题。

title: Augur: Pre-Execution Energy Prediction for Workflow Tasks in Heterogeneous Clusters
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cloud Computing (CLOUD)
summary: Scientific workflows are widely used to process large quantities of data, leading to significant energy consumption and carbon emissions. To reduce this environmental impact, energy and carbon-aware scheduling approaches could be employed. However, such methods require runtime and energy predictions, which are typically only available for workflows that have been executed previously. Meanwhile, scientists may execute new or modified workflows, use workflows with different input data, or run them on alternative infrastructure. To address this critical gap, we propose Augur, a novel method to predict the energy consumption of scientific workflow tasks prior to execution. By efficiently profiling both the available cluster infrastructure and the workflow at hand, Augur is capable of predicting the overall energy consumption of the workflow with a median prediction error of $16.3\pm15.3\%$ compared to Ichnos, an energy estimation method that uses fitted power models, and $18.2\pm14.7\%$ compared to Intel RAPL, as observed in our experimental evaluation on public and private cloud infrastructure. Relying on only minimal historical execution data, Augur outperforms two state-of-the-art methods in predicting both task runtime and total workflow energy, providing a robust foundation for energy-efficient and carbon-aware scientific data analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出了Augur方法，用于在科学工作流执行前预测其任务的能耗，仅依赖最少历史数据即可实现中位预测误差约16-18%，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 科学工作流处理大量数据时产生显著能耗和碳排放，而现有的能耗感知调度方法需要运行时和能耗预测，通常仅适用于已执行过的工作流。科学家常执行新工作流、修改后的工作流、使用不同输入数据或在其他基础设施上运行，这导致了关键的能力缺口。
AI.method: 提出Augur方法，通过高效地对可用集群基础设施和当前工作流进行剖析（profiling），在工作流执行前预测其整体能耗。该方法仅需要极少的历史执行数据。
AI.result: 在公有云和私有云基础设施上的实验评估表明，Augur与使用拟合功率模型的Ichnos方法相比，能耗预测的中位误差为16.3±15.3%；与Intel RAPL相比，中位误差为18.2±14.7%。在预测任务运行时和总工作流能耗方面，Augur优于两种最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Augur为节能和碳感知的科学数据分析提供了坚实基础，能够有效填补新工作流能耗预测的空白，支持更环保的科学计算实践。

title: The Cartan-Topos Protocol: A Unified Geometric and Categorical Framework for Resilient Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: Multi-agent coordination faces a fundamental divide between continuous Euclidean consensus, which fails under non-integrable constraints, and discrete symbolic logic, which collapses under open-world assumptions. This report presents a unified geometric and categorical framework bridging these paradigms. Agent states are modeled on homogeneous manifolds (Lie groups, Grassmannians) with consensus achieved via Riemannian center-of-mass flows. Clifford-algebraic representations (rotors, motors) enable singularity-free SE(3) pose synchronization. Network interactions are formalized as cellular sheaves, where heterogeneous stalks connected by linear restriction maps replace uniform weights; the sheaf Laplacian drives diffusion toward globally consistent sections. The Cartan connection encodes logical holonomy directly into restriction maps. Asynchronous nonlinear sheaf diffusion guarantees linear convergence to Dirichlet energy minimizers under bounded delays. Sheaf-Theoretic Planning (STP) models time as a Grothendieck topos, using intuitionistic logic and abductive repair for resilient temporal reasoning. Applications include discourse sheaves for opinion dynamics and knowledge sheaves for graph embedding. This synthesis establishes geometric consensus as a universal foundation for resilient multi-agent systems across physical, epistemic, and temporal domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一几何与范畴的框架，解决连续共识与离散逻辑在多智能体协调中的根本鸿沟：在齐性流形上通过黎曼质心流实现共识，用Clifford代数避免奇异性，以层论及其拉普拉斯算子处理异质网络与逻辑整体性，并在层论规划中以直觉主义逻辑实现弹性时序推理，从而建立跨物理、认知与时间域的通用基础。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协调存在基础鸿沟：连续欧氏共识在不可积约束下失效，离散符号逻辑在开放世界假设下崩溃。现有方法难以在同一框架中统一处理物理状态同步、异质信息交互与复杂逻辑推理。
AI.method: 将智能体状态建模于齐性流形（李群、Grassmann流形），通过黎曼质心流达成共识；采用Clifford代数表示（旋转子、马达）实现无奇异SE(3)位姿同步。将网络交互形式化为胞层论，用异质茎与线性限制映射替代均匀权重，以层论拉普拉斯算子驱动扩散至全局一致截面；通过Cartan联络将逻辑完整编码进限制映射。提出异步非线性层扩散保证线性收敛。提出层论规划(STP)以Grothendieck拓扑斯建模时间，采用直觉主义逻辑与溯因修复进行弹性时序推理。
AI.result: 建立了统一的几何与范畴框架：在齐性流形上实现共识，在SE(3)上实现无奇异性同步，异步非线性层扩散在有限延迟下线性收敛至Dirichlet能量极小值。应用于观点动力学的论述层与图嵌入的知识层，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该综合框架将几何共识确立为弹性多智能体系统在物理、认知和时间域的通用基础，成功弥合了连续共识与离散逻辑间的鸿沟，为复杂约束、异质信息与开放世界下的协调问题提供了统一的理论基础。

title: ViBE: Co-Optimizing Workload Skew and Hardware Variability for MoE Serving
summary: In distributed Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference, input-dependent token routing interacts with GPU performance variability to create persistent stragglers under synchronized execution, where the slowest GPU determines layer latency. This performance variability is inherent to modern accelerators: manufacturing variation, power limits, and thermal conditions introduce measurable execution-time differences across nominally identical GPUs. The core challenge is that MoE execution-time imbalance arises from the interaction of workload skew and hardware asymmetry. Token routing produces uneven and layer-varying expert loads, while GPU throughput depends on device-specific operating characteristics and workload intensity. Prior work mitigates routing skew but assumes homogeneous hardware, optimizing token balance rather than execution latency. As a result, even balanced token assignments can leave hardware-induced stragglers unaddressed. Thus, we propose Variability-Informed Binning of Experts (ViBE), a hardware-aware expert placement framework that minimizes execution-time imbalance across GPUs. ViBE combines per-GPU performance modeling with expert activation profiling to assign high-load experts to faster devices and low-load experts to slower ones, reducing layer-level stragglers without modifying model semantics or hardware. Because both workload characteristics and effective GPU throughput can shift across serving conditions, ViBE supports lightweight recalibration under workload/performance drift to refresh its routing and performance estimates when needed. Results show that ViBE consistently reduces execution-time imbalance and improves SLO attainment by 14%, while lowering P90 TTFT by up to 45%. We further show that the impact of hardware variability increases at scale, making variability-aware placement important for efficient, high-utilization LLM serving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ViBE框架，通过感知硬件性能差异来优化MoE模型的专家放置，显著减少了分布式推理中的执行时间不平衡，提升了服务效率。
AI.motivation: 分布式MoE推理中，输入相关的token路由与GPU性能差异性相互作用，导致同步执行下持续出现“掉队者”问题，最慢的GPU决定了层延迟。现有工作假设硬件同构，仅优化token负载平衡而忽略了硬件性能不对称，无法解决硬件导致的掉队者问题。
AI.method: 提出硬件感知的专家放置框架ViBE（Variability-Informed Binning of Experts）。该方法结合每GPU性能建模和专家激活分析，将高负载专家分配给较快的设备，将低负载专家分配给较慢的设备。支持在负载/性能漂移时进行轻量级重新校准，无需修改模型语义或硬件。
AI.result: ViBE一致性地减少了执行时间不平衡，SLO达成率提升14%，P90 TTFT降低高达45%。研究还表明硬件差异性的影响随规模增大而增加，验证了变异性感知放置对高效LLM服务的重要性。
AI.conclusion: ViBE是一种有效的硬件感知专家放置方法，通过考虑GPU性能差异性来优化专家分配，显著提升了分布式MoE推理的效率和服务质量，对于大规模LLM服务具有重要价值。

title: SPARQLe: Sub-Precision Activation Representation for Quantized LLM Inference
summary: The rapid growth in sizes of Large language models (LLMs) results in high compute and memory costs during inference. Quantization has been a significant pathway to addressing this challenge. In the quest to push the limits of quantization, weights, which are static, can often be quantized aggressively (e.g. 4 bits), while activations often require higher precision (e.g., 8 bits) to preserve accuracy, forcing hardware to operate with higher-precision datapaths. We leverage the statistical property that a significant fraction of activations are concentrated around zero, resulting in sparsity in the higher-order bits. Our proposal, SPARQLe, is a hardware-software co-design framework that exploits this sub-precision redundancy in any given quantized model. SPARQLe represents each 2k-bit activation tensor as a dense k-bit LSB tensor and a sparse k-bit MSB tensor compressed with a precision bitmap, and proposes a lightweight algorithm to increase MSB sparsity. SPARQLe reduces activation memory traffic and enables efficient computation on k-bit datapaths while preserving 2k-bit activation accuracy. SPARQLe includes an accelerator that operates directly on this hybrid format with minimal control overheads. Across the BitNet 3B, Llama2 7B, and Llama3 8B models, SPARQLe reduces prefill latency by 16-24.3% and decode latency by 13.5-23.4%, with 17-26.7% and 6.5-14.2% lower prefill and decode energy, respectively. SPARQLe demonstrates that sub-precision activation sparsity offers an effective and complementary pathway towards efficient LLM inference.

AI.tldr: SPARQLe是一个软硬件协同设计框架，利用激活值高位稀疏特性，将2k位激活张量分解为稠密k位低位张量和稀疏k位高位张量，在保持精度的同时降低内存流量并实现高效的k位数据通路计算，在多个LLM模型上实现了显著的延迟和能耗降低。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型规模快速增长导致推理时计算和内存成本高昂。虽然量化是解决此挑战的重要途径，但现有方法中权重可以激进量化到4位，而激活值通常需要8位精度来保持准确性，这迫使硬件使用更高精度的数据通路，成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 利用激活值在零附近集中分布导致高位稀疏的统计特性，提出SPARQLe框架：1）将每个2k位激活张量表示为稠密k位LSB张量和用精度位图压缩的稀疏k位MSB张量；2）提出轻量级算法增加MSB稀疏性；3）设计直接操作这种混合格式的加速器，控制开销最小化。
AI.result: 在BitNet 3B、Llama2 7B和Llama3 8B模型上：预填充延迟降低16-24.3%，解码延迟降低13.5-23.4%；预填充能耗降低17-26.7%，解密能耗降低6.5-14.2%。减少了激活值内存流量，实现了在k位数据通路上高效计算同时保持2k位激活值精度。
AI.conclusion: 亚精度激活值稀疏性为高效LLM推理提供了一条有效且互补的途径，证明了在保持模型精度的前提下，通过软硬件协同设计可以显著降低推理成本。

title: Leveraging the Learning Curve: Reusing Existing Architectural Patterns to Design and Implement MAS
comment: Author's accepted manuscript of an article published in IEEE Access. 17 pages, 6 figures. IEEE Access, vol. 13, pp. 45809-45825, 2025. Copyright 2025 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. The final version is available at https://doi.org/10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3546526
summary: Recent advancements in AI have led to the development of specialized systems related to multi-agent systems (MAS). However, the inherently collaborative nature of agents is often overlooked, and many of these specialized systems are used as components by other AI systems. From a software engineering perspective, this context can benefit from aligning the architectural characteristics of distributed systems with the inherently distributed nature of MAS. We propose that introducing a minimal set of agent-related concepts into the Distributed Systems (DS) domain can improve the engineering of modern MAS by leveraging techniques from DS engineering with established agent theory. In this study, we recapitulated the common origins of MAS and DS by drawing architectural parallels to establish a unified engineering approach. We then defined a minimal set of agent concepts to perform two practical studies on leveraging MAS development. First, we incorporated these concepts into a DS architectural pattern to design a distributed MAS. We then used these concepts in a graduate course to teach MAS engineering to students with no prior knowledge of agent theory. The learning outcomes from both courses included successful MAS implementation using DS tools and techniques. Although more than two-thirds of these students had no practical experience in developing distributed systems, the average final grade in both courses was above 80\%, thus validating our approach. Finally, we discuss how this study supports the development of advanced systems using modern AI techniques consistently with established agent-related research while leveraging established DS techniques and concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将分布式系统（DS）架构特性与多智能体系统（MAS）的分布式本质相结合，通过引入最小化的智能体概念集来改进MAS工程。通过设计分布式MAS架构模式和教学实践，验证了该方法的有效性，学生平均成绩超过80%。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统中的多智能体系统（MAS）往往忽略了智能体固有的协作特性，许多专用系统仅作为其他AI系统的组件使用。从软件工程角度来看，将分布式系统的架构特性与MAS固有的分布式特性相结合，可以改善现代MAS的工程开发。
AI.method:
1. 回顾MAS和DS的共同起源，建立架构平行对应关系以形成统一的工程方法；
2. 定义最小化的智能体概念集；
3. 将这些概念融入DS架构模式中设计分布式MAS；
4. 在研究生课程中应用这些概念进行MAS工程教学实践。
AI.result: 两个课程的学习成果表明学生成功使用DS工具和技术实现了MAS。尽管超过三分之二的学生没有分布式系统开发实践经验，但两个课程的平均期末成绩均超过80%，验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究支持使用现代AI技术开发高级系统，这些技术与已建立的智能体相关研究保持一致，同时利用成熟的分布式系统技术和概念，为MAS工程提供了有效的解决方案。

title: GNN-based Online Beamforming Design for HAPS-Assisted NTN
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, Accepted for publication in the IEEE 104th Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC2026-Fall)
summary: In terrestrial networks, especially in urban areas, cell-edge users often face significant capacity limitations due to high path loss, shadowing, and inter-cell interference (ICI). This paper proposes integrating a high-altitude platform station (HAPS) into terrestrial networks, where terrestrial base stations (BS) can alleviate these issues by relaying data intended for cell-edge users via HAPS, thereby leveraging line-of-sight (LoS) links. We formulate an energy-efficiency (EE) maximization problem to jointly design beamforming vectors at the BS and HAPS with the goal of improving cell-edge user performance. Since the resulting problem is non-convex, we develop an online optimization framework based on a graph neural networks (GNN), which effectively captures the network topology. Numerical results show that the proposed HAPS-assisted architecture improves network performance, particularly by increasing the 5th-percentile EE, thereby enhancing service for cell-edge users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将高空平台站（HAPS）集成到地面网络中的架构，通过联合设计基站和HAPS的波束成形向量来最大化能效，并利用图神经网络（GNN）解决非凸优化问题，显著改善了边缘用户的性能。
AI.motivation: 在地面网络特别是城市地区，边缘用户由于高路径损耗、阴影效应和小区间干扰（ICI）而面临严重的容量限制，亟需一种有效方案来改善这些用户的性能。
AI.method: 提出一种HAPS辅助的地面网络架构，地面基站通过HAPS中继数据给边缘用户以利用视距链路；建立能效最大化问题并联合设计基站和HAPS的波束成形向量；针对非凸优化问题开发基于图神经网络（GNN）的在线优化框架以有效捕捉网络拓扑。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提出的HAPS辅助架构能提升网络性能，尤其显著提高了第5百分位能效，从而增强了边缘用户的服务质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了将HAPS集成到地面网络中并通过GNN进行在线优化的有效性，为解决边缘用户性能瓶颈提供了一种有前景的技术方案。

title: Edge-Based QoS-Aware Adaptive Task Placement: A Closed-Loop Control in Multi-Robot Systems
comment: 6 pages, 2 figure, 1 algorithm, accepted as a regular paper on the 24th IEEE International Conference on Industrial Informatics (INDIN), 26-29 July, 2026, Melbourne, Australia
summary: Multi-robot systems (MRS) increasingly offload compute-intensive perception tasks to edge nodes to meet strict time-sensitive Quality-of-Service (QoS) constraints. However, static task orchestration on a shared edge node can severely degrade QoS due to network latency, jitter, and edge-resource contention. We present a pilot edge-centric MRS testbed using Raspberry Pi nodes to evaluate a camera-to-manipulator pipeline under three modes: local execution, static offloading, and a QoS-aware Adaptive Task Placement (ATP) controller. ATP scores candidate placements using a multi-metric cost (normalized latency, CPU utilization, and switching overhead) over two-second control windows. The closed-loop visual servoing testbed is instrumented with sub-millisecond clock synchronization, network emulation, and detailed monitoring of multiple metrics across nodes to capture realistic jitter. Experimental results under compute-stress and network-fault scenarios show that static edge offloading reduces on-board CPU load but amplifies tail latency and deadline misses. In contrast, the QoS-aware ATP controller, by switching task placement based on measured latency and utilization thresholds, consistently lowers deadline violations and tail latency. Overall, the results position ATP as a practical edge-side control primitive for MRS and concrete design guidelines for Cloud-Edge Robotics deployments within the broader cloud-fog automation, while motivating QoS-aware multi-objective workload orchestration for industrial cyber-physical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种QoS感知的自适应任务放置(ATP)控制器，用于多机器人系统在边缘节点的计算卸载。实验证明，相比静态卸载，ATP能有效降低截止时间违约和尾部延迟，为云-边缘机器人部署提供了实用的控制原语。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统(MRS)越来越多地将计算密集型感知任务卸载到边缘节点以满足严格的时间敏感QoS约束。然而，共享边缘节点上的静态任务编排由于网络延迟、抖动和边缘资源争用会严重降低QoS性能，因此需要一种能够动态适应的解决方案。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于树莓派节点的边缘中心MRS测试平台，实现了从相机到机械臂的闭环视觉伺服流水线。提出了QoS感知的自适应任务放置(ATP)控制器，该控制器使用多指标成本函数（归一化延迟、CPU利用率和切换开销）在两秒控制窗口内评估候选放置方案。测试平台配备了亚毫秒级时钟同步、网络仿真和跨节点多指标详细监控功能，以捕获真实的抖动情况。
AI.result: 在计算压力和网络故障场景下的实验结果表明：(1)静态边缘卸载虽然降低了机载CPU负载，但放大了尾部延迟和截止时间违约；(2)QoS感知的ATP控制器通过基于测量延迟和利用率阈值切换任务放置，持续降低了截止时间违约和尾部延迟。
AI.conclusion: ATP被定位为MRS实用的边缘侧控制原语，为云-边缘机器人部署提供了具体的设计指南，同时激发了对工业信息物理系统进行QoS感知多目标工作负载编排的需求。这为更广泛的云-雾自动化领域提供了有价值的参考。

title: BitsMoE: Efficient Spectral Energy-Guided Bit Allocation for MoE LLM Quantization
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Code and models are available at https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, but their deployment remains memory-intensive because all expert weights must be kept resident in memory. Existing MoE compression methods struggle in the ultra-low-bit regime: pruning irreversibly removes model capacity, while coarse-grained quantization fails to allocate bits according to heterogeneous expert and weight-direction importance. We propose BitsMoE, a spectral-energy-guided bit-allocation framework for MoE LLM quantization. BitsMoE decomposes each MoE layer by SVD into a shared basis and expert-specific spectral factors, retaining the shared basis without quantization to preserve common cross-expert structure and using the expert-specific factors as fine-grained quantization units. To determine the bit-width of each unit, BitsMoE formulates spectrum-wise mixed-precision quantization as an activation-aware reconstruction surrogate and solves an integer linear program that minimizes estimated reconstruction loss under a fixed bit budget. Experiments across multiple MoE LLMs show that BitsMoE substantially reduces downstream task accuracy degradation in ultra-low-bit regimes. Under 2-bit quantization on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, BitsMoE accelerates quantization by 12.3$\times$, improves average accuracy by 27.83 percentage points, and increases decoding speed by 1.76$\times$ over GPTQ. Our model and code are publicly available at https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE.

AI.tldr: BitsMoE是一种面向MoE大模型的谱能量引导比特分配量化框架，通过SVD分解保留共享基，对专家特定谱因子进行细粒度混合精度量化，在超低比特场景下显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: MoE大语言模型虽然通过稀疏专家激活降低了计算量，但部署时内存占用依然很高。现有压缩方法在超低比特场景下表现不佳：剪枝会不可逆地损失模型容量，粗粒度量化无法根据专家和权重方向的重要性差异分配比特位。
AI.method: BitsMoE首先通过SVD将每个MoE层分解为共享基和专家特定谱因子，保留共享基不量化以维持跨专家的共同结构，将专家特定因子作为细粒度量化单元。然后将谱级混合精度量化建模为激活感知重构代理问题，通过求解整数线性规划在固定比特预算下最小化估计重构损失。
AI.result: 在多个MoE LLM上的实验表明，BitsMoE在超低比特场景下显著降低下游任务精度下降。在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base上2比特量化时，相比GPTQ加速量化12.3倍，平均精度提升27.83个百分点，解码速度提升1.76倍。
AI.conclusion: BitsMoE通过谱分解和精细化的比特分配策略，有效解决了MoE模型在超低比特量化时的性能退化问题，为MoE大模型的高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: Position Paper: Post-Solve Robustness in Decision Engines: Feasible Regions and Smoothness Under Perturbations
summary: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) decision engines routinely output nominally optimal plans for high-stakes industrial systems. Yet deployment rarely matches solve-time assumptions: small perturbations in costs, demands, or resource availability can invalidate feasibility or trigger discontinuous shifts to qualitatively different solutions. We argue that this post-solve robustness gap is a missing layer in today's optimization pipelines and a missing evaluation dimension for learning-enabled decision systems. Rather than replacing robust optimization or stochastic programming, the proposed layer audits a solved incumbent and returns solver-backed evidence about how far that solution can be trusted. We formalize two central objects: (i) an $ε$-near-optimal feasible neighborhood in parameter space, capturing when an incumbent remains feasible and near-optimal under perturbations, and (ii) solution smoothness in decision space, capturing whether nearby alternatives with small combinatorial edits remain competitive. We then synthesize the most relevant partial answers from sensitivity and stability analysis, robust optimization, neighborhood search, adversarial testing, and learning-based enhancements, and articulate an agenda for a unified post-solve robustness layer. Concretely, we call for certified inner approximations around the incumbent, probabilistic robustness estimation with calibrated uncertainty, adversarial robustness margins, and learning-based prediction and explanation aligned with solver-backed verification. We conclude with a compact reporting template and evaluation protocol that would make robustness a first-class output of decision engines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了在混合整数线性规划(MILP)求解后增加鲁棒性审计层的构想，通过形式化参数空间中的ε-近优可行邻域和决策空间中的解平滑性，为优化方案提供可信度证据。
AI.motivation: 现有MILP决策引擎输出的最优方案在实际部署时，成本、需求或资源可用性的微小扰动可能使解变得不可行或导致解的剧烈变化。这种求解后鲁棒性差距是当前优化流程和基于学习的决策系统评估中缺失的维度。
AI.method: 形式化两个核心概念：(i)参数空间中的ε-近优可行邻域，刻画扰动下解保持可行且近优的条件；(ii)决策空间中的解平滑性，判断组合微编辑后的替代方案是否仍具竞争力。综合敏感性/稳定性分析、鲁棒优化、邻域搜索、对抗测试和基于学习的增强方法，提出统一的后求解鲁棒性层议程。
AI.result: 提出了认证的内近似、带校准不确定性的概率鲁棒性估计、对抗鲁棒性边界，以及与求解器验证对齐的基于学习的预测与解释。开发了简洁的报告模板和评估协议。
AI.conclusion: 该后求解鲁棒性层不是替代鲁棒优化或随机规划，而是审计已求解的方案并返回求解器支持的证据，表明该方案的可信范围，使鲁棒性成为决策引擎的一等输出。

title: Lodestar: An Online-Learning LLM Inference Router
summary: Efficiently serving large language model (LLM) inference tasks is crucial both for user-perceived latency such as time-to-first-token (TTFT) and for GPU utilization. However, LLM request routing, that is, assigning each inference request to a GPU instance, is particularly challenging: execution is highly input-dependent; batching and KV-cache reuse create strong cross-request coupling; and latency responds nonlinearly to context length, model/engine settings, and heterogeneous accelerators. As a result, simple traditional load balancing algorithms, and even heuristics tailored for LLM inference, fail to achieve good performance. We present Lodestar, a novel learning-based request routing system for distributed GPU clusters. Lodestar continuously collects a snapshot of the cluster at per-request level, including real-time instance state, request characteristics, and observed performance, and trains an online reward predictor that it uses to route inference requests to the instance that will maximize given reward (e.g., minimizing TTFT). Lodestar is cloud-native and works seamlessly with existing serving stacks (vLLM). With continuous online adaptation to changing workloads and infrastructure conditions, Lodestar achieves 1.41x lower average TTFT and 1.47x lower P99 TTFT on average (up to 2.15x/1.86x on homogeneous and 4.38x/4.42x on heterogeneous clusters) compared to a state-of-the-art prefix cache and load-aware heuristic, and learns these efficient routing strategies within about 5 minutes, based on experiments in a public cloud GPU cluster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Lodestar，一种基于学习的分布式GPU集群LLM推理请求路由系统，通过在线奖励预测器实现动态路由决策，在异构集群上相比现有方法TTFT降低高达4.42倍。
AI.motivation: LLM推理请求路由面临三大挑战：执行高度依赖输入、批处理和KV缓存重用导致请求间强耦合、延迟对上下文长度和模型配置呈非线性响应。传统负载均衡算法和现有LLM启发式方法均无法实现最优性能，需要更智能的路由策略。
AI.method: Lodestar持续收集集群快照，包括实例状态、请求特征和观测性能，训练在线奖励预测器，用于将推理请求路由到能最大化给定奖励（如最小化TTFT）的实例。系统采用云原生架构，与vLLM等现有服务栈无缝集成，支持针对工作负载和基础设施变化的持续在线自适应。
AI.result: 在公有云GPU集群实验中，Lodestar相比最先进的前缀缓存和负载感知启发式方法，平均TTFT降低1.41倍，P99 TTFT降低1.47倍。在同类集群上最高降低2.15倍/1.86倍，在异构集群上最高降低4.38倍/4.42倍。系统能在约5分钟内学习到高效路由策略。
AI.conclusion: Lodestar证明了基于学习的动态路由方法在LLM推理服务中的有效性，能够自适应处理复杂的工作负载和基础设施条件，显著提升用户感知的延迟性能和GPU资源利用率。

title: Regular-Dead on Arrival: Characterizing and Protecting Against Dead-Entry TLB Misses in GPU Microarchitectures
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to IEEE IISWC 2026
summary: GPU workloads with large memory footprints frequently suffer from redundant L2 TLB misses in which a recently evicted translation is immediately re-walked at full page-walk cost. We characterize these dead-entry misses across 24 GPU workloads, finding they account for up to 99% of L2 TLB misses in the most TLB-sensitive applications, yet their performance impact varies widely depending on memory access structure. Workloads where warps share the same virtual page suffer from burst amplification, where a single eviction stalls many warps simultaneously waiting for one translation to return. In contrast, workloads where each warp accesses a distinct set of pages face a capacity-overflow problem that no replacement policy can resolve, a distinction validated by huge page experiments. Building on this two-class taxonomy, we design DEPOT (Dead-Entry PrOTection), a 1 KB Bloom filter mechanism that prevents recently evicted translations from being displaced immediately upon reinstallation, delivering up to 72% IPC improvement on interference-driven workloads with zero overhead on others, and composing with the state-of-the-art TLB prefetching and compaction mechanism, for 2 to 7% additional gain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEPOT机制，通过1KB的Bloom过滤器保护最近被驱逐的转译条目，解决GPU L2 TLB中的冗余缺失问题，在干扰驱动的负载上实现高达72%的IPC提升。
AI.motivation: GPU负载中存在大量冗余L2 TLB缺失，即最近被驱逐的转译立即被重新遍历，造成完整的页遍历开销。研究发现这类死条目缺失在最TLB敏感的应用中占高达99%的L2 TLB缺失，但性能影响因内存访问结构不同而差异巨大。
AI.method: 首先对24个GPU负载进行特征分析，建立两类分类法：1)warp共享同一虚拟页面的负载遭受突发放大问题；2)每个warp访问不同页面集合的负载面临容量溢出问题。基于此分类，设计DEPOT（死条目保护）机制，使用1KB的Bloom过滤器防止最近被驱逐的转译在重新安装后立即被替换。
AI.result: DEPOT在干扰驱动的负载上实现高达72%的IPC提升，对其他负载零开销；与最先进的TLB预取和压缩机制结合时，可获得额外2-7%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分不同类型的死条目缺失并针对性设计保护机制，DEPOT有效解决了GPU TLB中的冗余缺失问题，与现有TLB优化技术具有良好的互补性。

title: State Machine Guided Multi-Relational Synthetic Data from Logs for Anomaly Detection
summary: Software systems generate massive unstructured logs that record execution behavior, failures, and interactions across components, yet existing log anomaly detection methods treat these logs primarily as flat sequences of templates, overlooking the relational execution structure that governs how events co-occur and evolve over time. We propose a framework that discovers this hidden structure by recovering an execution state machine directly from logs and inducing a corresponding multi-table relational schema connecting traces, events, states, transitions, and parameters. This discovered state machine serves as a generative prior to produce realistic multi-relational synthetic data that preserves structural, temporal, and process constraints while amplifying rare but valid execution behaviors. We assess the fidelity of the generated data through constraint validation, distributional similarity, and process-level metrics, and demonstrate its usefulness by showing that augmenting real logs with the synthetic relational data significantly improves anomaly and bug detection on held-out real datasets compared to sequence-based baselines and naive oversampling. Our results show that execution logs implicitly encode a relational database governed by a latent state machine, and that recovering this structure enables principled synthetic data generation for robust and interpretable anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从日志中恢复执行状态机的方法，并利用该结构生成多关系合成数据，从而显著提升日志异常检测和缺陷发现的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的日志异常检测方法将日志视为扁平的模板序列，忽视了控制事件共现与时序演化的关系执行结构，导致无法充分利用日志中隐含的结构信息。
AI.method: 提出一个框架，从日志中直接恢复执行状态机，并诱导出连接迹、事件、状态、转移和参数的多表关系模式；将该状态机作为生成先验，生成保留结构、时序和过程约束的多关系合成数据。
AI.result: 通过约束验证、分布相似性和过程级度量评估生成数据的保真度；实验表明，将真实日志与合成关系数据结合进行增强，相较于基于序列的基线和朴素过采样方法，在留存的真实数据集上显著提升了异常和缺陷检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 执行日志隐含编码了一个由潜在状态机控制的关系数据库，恢复该结构能够支持有原则的合成数据生成，从而实现鲁棒且可解释的异常检测。

title: KISS: Keeping it Simple and Slotted when Learning to Communicate over Wireless
summary: A long-standing challenge in distributed wireless systems is ensuring efficient and fair random channel access. Existing solutions often address specific constraints related to timing, periodicity, or centralization, but they typically rely on fixed heuristics. Motivated by recent advances in machine learning (ML), we investigate whether ML agents can autonomously learn efficient and fair access strategies, and whether such learning can offer new insights into medium access control (MAC) design. Rather than proposing a deployable protocol, our aim is to examine whether decentralized learning can rediscover or approximate theoretically efficient random-access mechanisms under minimal assumptions. To this end, we deploy an off-policy Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) with Bayesian inference to train agents operating over a slotted channel. The resulting method is fully online (no pre-training), fully distributed (independent multi-agent learners), stochastic (non-periodic), and requires no coordination or explicit communication. Extensive simulations show that the learned strategy adapts to varying network conditions and achieves near-theoretical efficiency while maintaining fairness. Ablation studies further reveal that the learned behavior resembles slotted ALOHA with a dynamically adjusted transmission probability, leading us to refer to the method as KISS: Keeping It Simple and Slotted.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了利用机器学习（特别是DDQN）让分布式无线系统中的智能体自主学习高效且公平的随机信道接入策略，发现学习到的策略在无协调情况下能自适应网络条件并接近理论最优效率，其行为类似于动态调整概率的时隙ALOHA。
AI.motivation: 分布式无线系统中确保高效且公平的随机信道接入是一个长期存在的挑战。现有解决方案通常针对时序、周期性或中心化等特定约束，但大多依赖固定的启发式规则。受机器学习（ML）近期进展的启发，作者希望探究ML智能体是否能自主学习高效公平的接入策略，并由此为MAC层设计提供新的见解。
AI.method: 作者在时隙信道上部署了带有贝叶斯推理的离策略双深度Q网络（DDQN）来训练智能体。该方法具有以下特点：完全在线（无需预训练）、完全分布式（独立的多智能体学习）、随机性（非周期性）、且无需协调或显式通信。
AI.result: 大量仿真表明，学习到的策略能够适应变化的网络条件，在保持公平性的同时达到接近理论最优的效率。消融研究进一步揭示，学习到的行为类似于具有动态调整发送概率的时隙ALOHA，因此作者将其命名为KISS：保持简单与时隙化。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，去中心化的机器学习智能体能够在最小假设下重新发现或近似理论高效的随机接入机制，这证明了ML在MAC协议设计探索和理解方面的价值。学习到的策略本质上是一种动态调整的时隙ALOHA，展现了简洁而有效的接入逻辑。

title: Idleness is Relative: Exploiting Tool-Call Idle Windows for Offloading in Agentic Systems with MORI
summary: Modern LLM serving systems increasingly host agentic workloads, whose sessions issue tens of model invocations interleaved with tool calls, accumulating KV cache that can be reused across steps. As requests' total KV cache size easily exceeds GPU HBM capacity, researchers offload them to CPU DRAM. However, tool-call durations span orders of magnitude, and the cost of transferring KV cache between tiers makes it impractical to re-place entries on every call. We observe that agentic programs exhibit a two-phase structure: busy phases of rapid short tool calls and idle phases dominated by long-running calls. Current eviction policies such as LRU fail to capture this property. A binary busy/idle label also falls short because the ratio of busy to idle programs may not match the hardware's GPU-to-CPU capacity ratio. When it does not, one tier sits underutilized while the other is oversubscribed, wasting memory or forcing unnecessary evictions. We present MORI, an agent serving system that solves the above problem. Our key insight is that idleness is a continuous, relative spectrum. MORI ranks all active programs by idleness, assigns the busiest to GPU HBM and the most idle to CPU DRAM, dynamically shifts the partition boundary to match hardware capacity, and enforces admission control at each memory tier. Evaluated on real coding agent workloads collected from Claude Code across four GPU and model pairs, MORI delivers 20--71% higher throughput and 18--43% lower TTFT than the best baseline with offloading.

AI.tldr: MORI是一个面向代理工作负载的LLM服务系统，通过基于程序空闲度的连续排序动态分配GPU HBM和CPU DRAM资源，相比最优基线提升20-71%吞吐量并降低18-43%的TTFT。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM服务系统中的代理工作负载会话包含数十次模型调用和工具调用交替，累积的KV缓存可能超出GPU HBM容量，需要卸载到CPU DRAM。现有卸载方案面临两大挑战：1）工具调用持续时间跨度大，每次调用重新放置KV缓存的迁移成本过高；2）代理程序呈现繁忙/空闲两阶段结构，但简单的二元标签无法匹配硬件的GPU-CPU容量比，导致某一层利用不足而另一层过度订阅，浪费内存或强制不必要驱逐。现有驱逐策略（如LRU）未能捕捉此特性。
AI.method: MORI的核心洞察是：空闲性是一个连续、相对的谱系。系统将所有活跃程序按空闲度排序，将最繁忙的分配到GPU HBM，将最空闲的分配到CPU DRAM；动态调整分区边界以匹配硬件容量；在每个内存层级强制执行准入控制。这种基于连续空闲度谱系的方法避免了二元标签无法匹配硬件容量比的问题。
AI.result: 在四个GPU和模型配置对上，使用从Claude Code收集的真实编码代理工作负载进行评估，MORI相比最优卸载基线实现：吞吐量提升20-71%，TTFT降低18-43%。
AI.conclusion: MORI证明了将空闲性视为连续谱系而非二元标签的有效性，通过动态调整分区边界匹配硬件容量比，成功解决了代理工作负载中KV缓存的层级放置问题，显著提升了系统性能。

title: DAStatFormer: A Hybrid Multibranch Transformer with Statistical Feature Integration for DAS-Based Pattern Recognitions
summary: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) enables large-scale monitoring through optical fibers, but its high dimensionality and complex spatio-temporal patterns make event classification demanding. Existing deep learning approaches-CNNs, recurrent models, and Transformer variants-either fail to capture long-range dependencies or require processing raw DAS matrices at prohibitive cost. We propose DAStatFormer, a hybrid multibranch Transformer that combines compact multidomain statistical features with Gated Transformer Networks. Instead of raw signals, we extract 24 ANOVA-selected attributes per channel from the temporal, waveform, and spectral domains, reducing data size by orders of magnitude while preserving discriminative information. Each domain is processed via dedicated step-wise and channel-wise attention branches, fused by an adaptive gating mechanism. Experiments on the open $Φ$-OTDR benchmark and a real-scenario DAS dataset show that DAS-tatFormer achieves up to 99.4% accuracy and near-perfect real-world performance, while using significantly fewer parameters and lower inference cost than models such as DASFormer and DeepViT. These results demonstrate its suitability for scalable, real-time DAS-based monitoring. We release our code at https://github.com/MichelD-git/DAStatFormer

AI.tldr: 提出DAStatFormer模型，通过多域统计特征替代原始信号，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低计算成本，适用于实时DAS监测。
AI.motivation: 分布式声波传感（DAS）数据维度高且具有复杂的时空模式，现有深度学习方法（CNNs、循环模型和Transformer变体）要么无法捕获长程依赖，要么处理原始DAS矩阵成本过高。
AI.method: 提出DAStatFormer混合多分支Transformer，从时域、波形和频谱域提取24个ANOVA筛选的统计特征替代原始信号，通过专用步进和通道注意力分支处理各域特征，并使用自适应门控机制融合。
AI.result: 在开放Φ-OTDR基准和真实场景DAS数据集上达到高达99.4%的准确率和近乎完美的实际性能，参数量和推理成本显著低于DASFormer和DeepViT等模型。
AI.conclusion: DAStatFormer证明了其在可扩展、实时DAS监测中的适用性，为大规模光纤传感监测提供了高效解决方案。

title: Emergent Collaborative Deliberation in Multi-Model AI Systems: A BFT-Derived Protocol for Epistemic Synthesis
summary: We present the Consilium Protocol, a Byzantine Fault Tolerance-derived architecture for structured multi-model AI deliberation that treats inter-model disagreement as epistemic signal rather than error. The protocol assigns engineered cognitive personas to language models -- separating what a model is from how it reasons -- and introduces an In-Sample/Out-of-Sample validation framework adapted from quantitative finance to distinguish training-data consensus from empirically grounded conclusions. Across 1,478 deliberation sessions spanning 32 topics in 10 domain categories, we demonstrate that (1) the cognitive persona, not the underlying model, determines epistemic behavior: free edge-inference models costing 0.0002 USD per batch produced comparable analytical output to frontier models costing 10.69 USD; (2) RLHF alignment training creates measurable, domain-specific epistemic blind spots -- contested policy topics exhibit 12.3 percentage points less adversarial challenge than settled science topics, and AI safety topics show asymmetric bias ($Δ$=11.6%) where models challenge claims that AI is dangerous far more vigorously than claims that AI risk is overstated; (3) the protocol exhibits no directional bias of its own (immigration $Δ$=2.3%, renewables $Δ$=1.2%); and (4) out-of-sample evidence retrieval validated 239 claims with 100% evidence retrieval and surfaced 167 blind-spot discoveries invisible to training-data deliberation. Run-to-run reproducibility across randomized model$\times$persona assignments averages $\pm$2.2% standard deviation. Total cost for the complete battery including all overhead: 217 USD. We release the protocol specification under MIT license to enable independent verification.

AI.tldr: 提出了Consilium协议，一种基于拜占庭容错的AI多模型审议架构，通过认知角色分离和样本验证框架，实现了低成本、高可靠性的AI系统，并揭示了RLHF对齐训练导致的认知盲区。
AI.motivation: 现有AI模型在审议过程中存在系统性偏见和认知盲区，且不同模型间的分歧被视为错误而非认知信号。需要一种结构化框架来利用模型间分歧作为认知信号，并区分训练数据共识与实证结论。
AI.method: 提出了Consilium协议，基于拜占庭容错架构，采用认知角色分配将模型身份与推理方式分离，并引入样本内外验证框架（借鉴量化金融）来区分训练数据共识与实证结论。在32个主题、10个领域类别的1,448次审议会话中进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验发现：(1)认知角色决定认知行为，低成本模型（0.0002 USD/批次）与前沿模型（10.69 USD）产出相当；(2)RLHF对齐训练造成认知盲区，争议性政策主题比成熟科学主题少12.3%的对抗性挑战，AI安全主题存在11.6%的不对称偏见；(3)协议本身无方向性偏见；(4)样本外证据检索验证了239项主张并发现167个盲区。运行间可重复性标准差±2.2%，总成本217 USD。
AI.conclusion: Consilium协议成功实现了低成本、高可靠性的AI多模型审议系统，证明了认知角色分离的有效性，揭示了RLHF对齐训练的系统性缺陷，为AI系统偏见检测和改进提供了新方法。协议以MIT许可发布以支持独立验证。

title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference
summary: Modern KV cache management assumes the chatbot workload: prompts arrive once and the cache grows append-only, so prefix caching and forward-only eviction are correct by construction. Agentic LLMs break this assumption. Their conversations evolve through policy-driven editing: failed tool calls are retried, stale outputs dropped, trajectories pivoted. Two distinct cache problems result. First, identical content moves to new positions between turns, invalidating exact-prefix caches even though the underlying KV would still be valid; recent work on position-independent caching for MLA addresses this reuse problem. Second, and this paper's focus, a policy may need to direct the serving system to actively remove or replace a span of cached content and continue without re-prefilling everything that came after. No existing primitive offers this. Production agentic harnesses fall back to re-prefill on every edit, paying full prefix-recomputation cost; kernel-level eviction methods make their own decisions and cannot accept policy directives from outside the kernel. We introduce Leyline, a serving-side primitive that closes this gap. A declarative directive 4-tuple separates what to edit from how to preserve position correctness. The policy declares the edit and its mode (in-place splice or prefix-trimmed re-prefill for semantic forgetting); an architecture-agnostic interface routes to a per-architecture kernel that restores attention math via a closed-form RoPE-rotation correction. The splice kernel lifts replay cache-hit by +11.2 pp and cuts latency by up to 241 ms. A ten-line truncation rule routed through the same interface lifts agentic solve rate by +14.3 pp on debug-gym. The mechanism is open; the policy space it enables is the agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Leyline，一个面向智能体LLM的KV缓存管理原语，解决了策略驱动的对话编辑场景下缓存内容主动删除/替换问题，相比重预填充方案提升了11.2%的缓存命中率并降低高达241ms延迟，在调试任务上将解决率提升了14.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存管理假设聊天机器人工作负载（提示仅到达一次，缓存仅追加增长），但智能体LLM打破此假设：其对话通过策略驱动进行编辑（失败工具调用重试、过时输出丢弃、轨迹转向），导致需要主动移除或替换缓存内容片段。现有方法要么回退到每次编辑时完全重预填充（付出完整前缀重计算代价），要么内核级驱逐方法自行决策无法接受外部策略指令。
AI.method: 引入Leyline服务端原语：采用声明式四元组指令分离编辑内容与位置正确性保持；策略声明编辑及其模式（原位拼接或前缀修剪重预填充用于语义遗忘）；架构无关接口路由到各架构专用内核，通过闭式RoPE旋转校正恢复注意力计算。拼接内核实现缓存内容的高效编辑与重用。
AI.result: 拼接内核将重放缓存命中率提升+11.2个百分点，延迟降低高达241毫秒；通过相同接口的十行截断规则在debug-gym上将智能体解决率提升+14.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Leyline成功填补了智能体LLM场景下策略驱动缓存编辑的空白，为策略空间提供了开放机制，使得生产级智能体系统能够高效处理动态对话编辑而无需完全重预填充，显著提升了系统性能和任务解决率。

title: Regular-Activation Concentration: Characterizing Column-Level Output Sparsity Across Diffusion Model Architectures
comment: 12 pages, 12 figures. Submitted to IEEE IISWC 2026
summary: Recent diffusion accelerators exploit activation sparsity by skipping near-zero GELU outputs, reporting 52--85% element-level sparsity. However, systolic-array hardware processes activations at column granularity, where a single non-zero element forces the entire column to be computed. We present the first systematic column-level sparsity characterization across seven diffusion workloads spanning three workload groups and four modalities. Our measurements reveal that element-level sparsity overstates hardware-exploitable sparsity by up to 78 percentage points and exposes a three-way taxonomy. UNet+transformer workloads exhibit activation concentration with workload-dependent cycle reductions up to 30.6%. Pure-transformer DiT shows dispersion, yielding 12.4%. Motion/dance transformer workloads range from modest reductions to 50.8% for MLD, driven by its extreme token dimension and expansion ratio. Cycle-level simulation on a GDDR6-based accelerator confirms that memory stalls account for up to 84--89% of total cycles and that layout sensitivity tracks the profiling-based taxonomy. A full accuracy sweep across five thresholds reveals that UNet+transformer workloads degrade gracefully, while motion models exhibit an accuracy cliff between the primary operating point and the next threshold. Our characterization shows that workload group and model dimensions jointly determine whether column-level memory layout optimization is beneficial, and element-level sparsity alone is insufficient for that prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散模型中基于列粒度的激活稀疏性特征，发现元素级稀疏性严重高估了硬件可利用的稀疏性（最高相差78个百分点），并提出了三种工作负载分类，为硬件加速器优化提供了关键指导。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散加速器通过跳过近似零值的GELU输出来利用激活稀疏性，报告了52-85%的元素级稀疏性。然而，脉动阵列硬件以列粒度处理激活值，单个非零元素就会强制计算整列数据。本文旨在系统性地表征列级稀疏性特征，揭示元素级稀疏性与硬件可利用稀疏性之间的差距。
AI.method: 对7个扩散工作负载进行了首次系统性的列级稀疏性特征分析，涵盖3个工作负载组和4种模态。通过测量分析激活值在列粒度下的分布特征，并在基于GDDR6的加速器上进行周期级仿真，同时进行了全精度扫描来评估准确性变化。
AI.result: 发现元素级稀疏性比硬件可利用稀疏性高出最多78个百分点；识别出三种分类：(1) UNet+transformer工作负载表现出激活集中，工作负载相关的周期减少高达30.6%；(2) 纯transformer DiT呈现分散特征，收益为12.4%；(3) 运动/舞蹈transformer工作负载从适度减少到MLD的50.8%不等。内存停顿占总周期的84-89%，UNet+transformer工作负载准确性优雅降级，而运动模型呈现准确性悬崖。
AI.conclusion: 工作负载组和模型维度共同决定列级内存布局优化是否有益，仅依靠元素级稀疏性不足以进行预测。这一发现为扩散模型加速器的优化设计提供了重要指导，强调了列级稀疏性分析的重要性。

title: Scaling Behavior of Single LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
summary: The burgeoning field of LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) promises to tackle complex tasks through collaborative intelligence, yet fundamental questions regarding their scaling behavior and intrinsic collective dynamics remain underexplored. This paper systematically investigates how the performance of a homogeneous MAS evolves as the number of agents increases, isolating the variable of collaboration from model or knowledge heterogeneity. We propose the Sequential Iterative Multi-Agent System (SIMAS) framework, a minimalist architecture centered on sequential inter-agent communication, to clearly observe scaling effects. Through extensive experiments across diverse tasks and model scales, we establish that MAS performance does not scale monotonically with agent count but follows a pattern of diminishing returns, governed by a trade-off between collaborative synergy and coordination overhead. Our findings reveal that effective MAS requires a sufficiently capable base LLM, that task type critically modulates the optimal agent count, and that collective intelligence is an emergent property contingent on strategic interaction design rather than a guaranteed outcome of agent plurality. The performance degradation stems coordination overhead rather than merely long-context failure, and the scaling tendency generalizes across interaction architectures like structured debate topologies. This work provides a foundational understanding of MAS scaling laws, offering practical guidance for designing efficient collaborative systems and challenging the prevailing assumption that more agents invariably lead to better performance.

AI.tldr: LLM多智能体系统的性能不会随智能体数量增加而单调提升，而是呈现边际收益递减规律；有效的集体智能依赖于策略性的交互设计而非单纯的智能体数量增加。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于LLM的多智能体系统在处理复杂任务方面前景广阔，但其扩展行为和内在的集体动力学等基本问题仍缺乏探索，尤其是协作如何影响系统性能尚不清晰。
AI.method: 提出了一种极简架构——顺序迭代多智能体系统（SIMAS）框架，以顺序式的智能体间通信为核心，在隔离模型和知识异质性的条件下，系统性地观察智能体数量增加时的扩展效应。
AI.result: MAS性能并非随智能体数量单调增长，而是遵循边际收益递减的模式，由协作协同效应与协调开销之间的权衡决定；任务类型显著调节最优智能体数量，集体智能是依赖于战略性交互设计的涌现属性而非智能体数量的必然产物；性能下降源于协调开销而非仅仅由于长上下文失效。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了MAS扩展定律的基础性理解，指出更多智能体并不必然带来更好性能，挑战了这一普遍假设，为设计高效的协作系统提供了实践指导。

title: AgentxGCore: Agentic AI for Next-Generation Mobile Core Network
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in IEEE Network
summary: To meet the stringent requirements of emerging applications and the increasingly complex network management and operation, the Next Generation Mobile Networks (NextG), or 6G, will adopt an AI-native architecture on the Core Network (CN). In this movement, the Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) has extended the cellular CN with new function as a first step toward integrating analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and machine learning. However, those new functionalities are constrained by a centralized approach and managerial complexity. Furthermore, with the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs), a new era in network orchestration and management begins, leveraging and empowering the Intent-based Networking (IBN) paradigm. In addition, AI agents and Agentic AI integrate Reasoning and Acting (ReAct), enabling the usage of such intents to continuously interact with the network. Unlike state-of-the-art approaches that primarily employ Agentic AI to mitigate deployment and configuration complexity in the CN, this paper introduces AgentxGCore, which leverages an Agentic AI-Native layer to extend the 3GPP architecture and enable a system based on the existing APIs across the Beyond Next Generation Core (xGC) domain. This proposal establishes an AI-driven closed-loop for continuous optimization based on real-time information, enabling self-organization and self-adaptation. Our approach involves a multi-agent specialized system, divided into a network planner agent, capable of visualizing the network state and developing a plan to meet the intents, and a network executor, responsible for criticizing and executing the plan. To validate the proposed solution, an environment was built using an open-source CN, heterogeneous datasets, and different LLMs were employed to demonstrate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentxGCore，一种基于原生Agentic AI的架构，通过多智能体系统扩展3GPP核心网架构，利用大语言模型和意图驱动网络实现核心网的自主优化、自组织和自适应。
AI.motivation: 随着新兴应用需求的增长和网络管理复杂性的提升，6G网络需要在核心网采用AI原生架构。尽管3GPP已在核心网中集成了分析和AI功能，但这些功能受限于集中式方法和管理复杂性。大语言模型和意图驱动网络的兴起为网络编排管理带来了新机遇，Agentic AI通过推理与行动（ReAct）的集成能够实现与网络的持续交互。现有方法主要关注缓解部署和配置复杂性，而本文旨在利用Agentic AI原生层实现基于实时信息的闭环持续优化。
AI.method: 提出AgentxGCore架构，通过Agentic AI原生层扩展3GPP架构，构建跨超下一代核心网（xGC）域的AI驱动闭环系统。采用多智能体专业化系统设计，包括：1）网络规划智能体，负责可视化网络状态并制定满足意图的计划；2）网络执行智能体，负责评估和执行计划。该系统基于现有API实现自主组织和自适应能力，结合大语言模型实现推理与行动的持续交互。
AI.result: 通过使用开源核心网、异构数据集和多种大语言模型构建实验环境，成功验证了AgentxGCore方案的有效性。系统实现了基于实时信息的AI驱动闭环持续优化，能够进行自组织和自适应操作，证明了多智能体系统在核心网管理中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: AgentxGCore成功地将Agentic AI原生架构集成到3GPP核心网框架中，为6G网络的智能化管理提供了创新解决方案，通过多智能体协作实现了网络的自组织、自优化和自适应能力，为未来网络的智能化演进奠定了基础。

title: Characterizing Metastable Faults and Failures
summary: Metastable failures are hard to detect, prevent, and mitigate. During a metastable failure, a system exhibits self-sustaining bad behavior even in the absence of adversarial conditions. Prior work focuses on symptoms and has portrayed metastable failures as instances of self-sustaining overload. This characterization leaves the underlying failure causes and dynamics unknown, and does not account for metastable failures that do not manifest as overload. We present the first causal characterization of metastable failures by identifying their origin in metastable faults, i.e., structural destabilizing cycles of interaction among systems components that, in isolation, are stabilizing. Metastable failures arise when scheduling decisions let these destabilizing interactions gain the upper hand over the individual components' stabilizing tendencies. We then derive a methodology to predict metastable failures, and to build metastable-fault-tolerant (MFT) systems. We apply our methodology to three case studies, showcasing the generality of our results.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出亚稳态故障的因果表征，识别其源于“亚稳态缺陷”（系统组件间相互作用的失稳循环），并提出预测方法和构建容错系统的方法论。
AI.motivation: 现有的亚稳态故障研究主要关注症状，将其描述为自持续过载的实例。这种表征方式未能揭示潜在故障原因和动态机制，也未考虑不表现为过载的亚稳态故障。因此，需要从根本上理解此类故障的成因与机制。
AI.method: 作者提出“亚稳态缺陷”的概念，定义为系统组件间结构性的失稳交互循环，这些组件在隔离状态下是稳定的。研究发现当调度决策使这些失稳交互压倒组件个体的稳定趋势时，就会引发亚稳态故障。基于此因果表征，作者推导出预测亚稳态故障的方法，并提出了构建亚稳态容错（MFT）系统的方法论。
AI.result: 该工作提出了首个亚稳态故障的因果表征理论框架，并发展出预测此类故障和构建容错系统的方法。通过三个案例研究验证了所提方法的通用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过识别亚稳态故障的结构性根源（即失稳交互循环），填补了对其成因和动态机制理解的空白。提出的预测方法和MFT系统构建方法为预防、检测和缓解此类复杂故障提供了理论基础和实践指导。

title: Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models with Applications to Overhead Images
summary: Explainability of deep learning algorithms is critical for computer-vision applications with high-stake decisions. Concept bottleneck models (CBM) have recently shown promising performance to provide explainable and accurate predictions for classification problems, based on a bottleneck of high-level concepts. Existing CBM methods rely on a linear aggregation of the concept scores to compute predictions. However, a large number of concepts is often used in this linear approach, which undermines explainability and favors information leakage. In general, the underlying relation between concepts and output logits is not linear. Therefore, we introduce Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models (HCBM), which build on the Hoeffding functional decomposition of gradient-boosted trees to provide non-linear and sparse aggregations of concept scores, and generate compact predictions using prime implicants. HCBM are proved to be robust to interconcept leakage, and outperform standard linear CBM in practice, as shown in extensive experiments. Beyond classification, HCBM can be adapted to object detection, and we focus on a challenging case with overhead images to show the high performance of HCBM in these settings.

AI.tldr: 提出HCBM模型，通过梯度提升树的Hoeffding功能分解实现概念分数的非线性稀疏聚合，解决了传统CBM线性聚合导致的概念冗余和信息泄漏问题，显著提升了分类和目标检测任务的性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统概念瓶颈模型(CBM)采用线性聚合方式处理概念分数，需要大量概念参与运算，削弱了模型可解释性并导致信息泄漏。实际上，概念与输出logits之间通常存在非线性关系，线性假设限制了模型的表达能力和解释效果。
AI.method: 提出HCBM方法，基于梯度提升树的Hoeffding功能分解，构建概念分数的非线性稀疏聚合机制。该方法利用质蕴涵项生成紧凑预测，实现概念间的非线性组合，有效处理概念间信息泄漏问题。
AI.result: 实验表明HCBM对概念间信息泄漏具有鲁棒性，在实际应用中显著优于标准线性CBM。该方法不仅适用于分类任务，还可扩展至目标检测，在航拍图像等挑战性场景中展现出优异性能。
AI.conclusion: HCBM成功突破了CBM线性聚合的局限性，通过非线性稀疏聚合机制提升了模型的可解释性和预测性能，为高决策风险计算机视觉应用提供了更可靠的可解释深度学习方案。

title: Deliberative Curation: A Protocol for Multi-Agent Knowledge Bases
comment: 29 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Open-source implementation available at https://github.com/StevenJohnson998/AIngram
summary:
As AI agents transition from isolated tools to collaborative participants in shared knowledge ecosystems, governing collective knowledge curation becomes a critical challenge. Human platform governance mechanisms do not transfer directly: agent statelessness undermines deterrence-based sanctions, model homogeneity violates independence assumptions underlying crowd wisdom, and sycophancy collapses deliberative consensus.
  We propose a deliberative curation protocol combining three governance layers: (1) a knowledge artifact lifecycle formalized as a labeled transition system; (2) reputation-weighted deliberative voting integrating Beta Reputation with EigenTrust amplification; and (3) graduated sanctions adapted for stateless agents, including broken agent handling distinguishing malfunction from adversarial behavior.
  We evaluate the protocol through agent-based simulation with 100 agents across seven behavioral archetypes under two adversity scenarios (30 seeds, paired t-tests). The protocol trades modest precision under benign conditions for substantially better resilience under adversity: 0.826 vs 0.791 for majority vote under moderate adversity (p<0.001), widening to 0.807 vs 0.740 under stress (p<0.001). The protocol degrades roughly three times more slowly than majority vote. Ablation analysis identifies commit-reveal vote concealment as the most impactful single component (8.2-8.6pp precision improvement, p<0.001), outperforming reputation weighting and deliberation combined. Graduated sanctions were not exercised in simulation and remain empirically unvalidated.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个包含知识工件生命周期、声誉加权投票和分级制裁的三层治理协议，用于AI代理集体知识治理。在对抗环境下，协议精度显著优于多数投票（中等对抗：0.826 vs 0.791；压力对抗：0.807 vs 0.740），退化速度慢约3倍。提交-揭示投票隐藏机制贡献最大（提升8.2-8.6个百分点）。
AI.motivation: AI代理正从孤立工具转变为共享知识生态系统中的协作参与者，集体知识治理面临关键挑战。传统人类平台治理机制无法直接移植：代理无状态性破坏基于威慑的制裁机制，模型同质性违反群体智慧所需的独立性假设，而谄媚行为则导致协商共识崩溃。
AI.method: 提出一个三层协商治理协议：（1）将知识工件生命周期形式化为标记转换系统；（2）结合Beta声誉与EigenTrust放大机制的声誉加权协商投票；（3）针对无状态代理的分级制裁机制，包括区分故障与对抗行为的损坏代理处理。通过100个代理、七种行为原型、两种对抗场景的基于代理仿真进行评估（30个种子，配对t检验）。
AI.result: 协议在良性条件下以适度精度为代价换取对抗环境下的显著韧性提升：中等对抗下精度为0.826 vs 多数投票0.791（p<0.001）；压力对抗下扩大至0.807 vs 0.740（p<0.001）。协议退化速度约为多数投票的三分之一。消融分析显示提交-揭示投票隐藏是影响最大的单一组件（精度提升8.2-8.6个百分点，p<0.001），优于声誉加权和协商的组合。分级制裁在仿真中未被触发，仍待实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的协商治理协议在对抗环境下展现出显著优越的韧性性能，退化速度明显放缓。提交-揭示投票隐藏机制是最关键的组件贡献。然而，分级制裁机制仍需进一步实证验证。该协议为AI代理集体知识治理提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Magnum.np.distributed: Accelerating Finite Difference Micromagnetic Simulations with Multiple GPUs
summary: Micromagnetic simulations are essential tools in nanomagnetism and spintronics research. Although widely adopted solvers like Mumax3 and the Python-native magnum.np use GPU acceleration to improve performance, these tools are limited to single-device computation. In this work, we present the first Python-native multi-GPU micromagnetic framework by extending magnum.np with PyTorch Distributed. This leverages high-speed communication and computation across multiple GPUs while retaining the benefits of ease of installation, platform-agnostic design, and compatibility with Python. For computationally intensive demagnetisation effective-field calculations, we achieve a 7.0x speedup across 8 GPUs connected via NVLink, whereas Halo exchange required for Heisenberg exchange shows limited scaling due to kernel dispatch latency. We also demonstrated the framework's versatility by achieving a 6.8x speedup in demagnetisation field computation on CPU with NUMA pinning via the MPI backend of PyTorch Distributed. Faster turnaround times will enable researchers to explore larger, more complex systems and accelerate the design cycle for novel spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文基于PyTorch Distributed扩展了Python原生微磁学框架magnum.np，实现了首个多GPU微磁学仿真工具，在8个GPU上获得了7.0倍加速，并将支持多GPU与CPU并行计算。
AI.motivation: 现有GPU加速微磁学仿真工具（如Mumax3和magnum.np）仅支持单设备计算，无法利用多GPU进行大规模并行计算，限制了研究效率与计算规模。
AI.method: 利用PyTorch Distributed扩展magnum.np框架，实现多GPU通信与计算；针对退磁场计算实现高效多GPU并行，对海森堡交换作用采用Halo交换方法，并支持通过MPI后端在CPU上进行NUMA绑定并行。
AI.result: 在8个通过NVLink连接的GPU上，退磁场有效场计算实现7.0倍加速；Halo交换因内核调度延迟扩展性有限；在CPU上通过NUMA绑定实现6.8倍退磁场计算加速。
AI.conclusion: 该多GPU微磁学框架显著缩短计算时间，使研究人员能够探索更大、更复杂的系统，加速新型自旋电子器件的设计周期。

title: LP5X-PIM Sim: A High-Fidelity HW/SW Integrated Simulator for LPDDR5X-PIM
summary: This tech note describes the architecture and execution results of the LPDDR5X-PIM simulator, developed by Samsung Electronics. Based on the latest research and internal specifications, the simulator provides a high-fidelity model of both the hardware data paths and the software control layers of the LPDDR5X-PIM block. This integrated hardware-software simulation approach enables precise evaluation of system performance and energy efficiency while maximizing PIM resource utilization. We have refined existing simulation frameworks to align with actual hardware implementation, ensuring consistent behavioral accuracy. Further technical details regarding the specific architecture and circuit design of the LPDDR5X-PIM will be disclosed in future publications

AI.tldr: 三星电子开发了LPDDR5X-PIM模拟器，通过软硬件协同仿真实现对系统性能和能效的精确评估。
AI.motivation: 基于最新研究和内部规范，开发高保真的LPDDR5X-PIM模块仿真模型，以精确评估系统性能和能效，同时最大化PIM资源利用率。
AI.method: 采用集成硬件-软件仿真方法，构建硬件数据通路和软件控制层的高保真模型，并对现有仿真框架进行优化以与实际硬件实现保持一致。
AI.result: 成功实现了与实际硬件行为一致的仿真精度，能够精确评估系统性能和能效效率，同时最大化PIM资源利用率。
AI.conclusion: LPDDR5X-PIM模拟器为系统性能和能效评估提供了可靠的仿真平台，关于LPDDR5X-PIM的具体架构和电路设计细节将在未来出版物中披露。

title: Dynamic Coordination Strategy Selection for Enterprise Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
Enterprise multi-agent systems increasingly expose multiple coordination patterns, but deployments often lack evidence for when to use consensus, debate, synthesis, or a simpler single-agent workflow. This paper evaluates whether coordination strategy should be selected dynamically by problem class rather than fixed globally. We run a frozen matrix of 30 enterprise tasks spanning six industries, five problem classes, four execution conditions, three replications per cell, and four model arms: qwen_local, sonnet, gemma_openrouter, and an auxiliary openai cloud-validation arm. All 1,440 generated outputs are judged by a fixed Sonnet rubric.
  The main finding is bounded and operationally useful, but it is not the original strict H1. The pre-registered exact-winner/CI criterion is not supported: exact winner identity is unstable across model arms, and several predicted strategies are close to, but not above, the best observed alternative. A weaker near-best routing claim is strongly supported. In every pre-registered model arm and problem class, and again in the auxiliary OpenAI validation arm, the predicted strategy is within 0.10 quality-score points of the best observed condition. Structured compliance verification is the clearest exception to the original mapping: all arms favor single_agent rather than consensus. A pre-registered Kendall's W test finds no reliable difference between Vietnamese-domain and English-domain tasks in how consistently the four coordination conditions are ranked (mean W of 0.20 in both strata; signed-rank p = .85), so H2 is not supported. We conclude that enterprise coordination policy should use dynamic routing as a calibrated default, not as a deterministic winner-selection law.

AI.tldr: 企业多智能体协调策略应采用动态路由作为校准默认方案，而非确定性赢家选择法则。研究发现预测策略在所有条件下均接近最佳策略（差距≤0.10分），但精确赢家身份不稳定。
AI.motivation: 企业多智能体系统暴露多种协调模式（共识、辩论、综合、单智能体工作流），但部署时缺乏证据说明何时使用何种策略。本文旨在评估协调策略是否应根据问题类别动态选择，而非全局固定配置。
AI.method: 构建冻结矩阵实验设计：30个企业任务覆盖6个行业、5个问题类别、4种执行条件、每组3次重复，使用4个模型臂（qwen_local、sonnet、gemma_openrouter及辅助openai云验证臂），共生成1440个输出，由固定Sonnet评分标准评判。采用预注册的Kendall's W检验等统计方法。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）预注册的精确赢家/置信区间标准未获支持——精确赢家身份在模型臂间不稳定；（2）弱化的近最佳路由主张得到强支持——所有预注册模型臂和问题类别中，预测策略与最佳观察条件差距均在0.10质量分内；（3）结构化合规验证是原映射的明显例外——所有模型臂偏好单智能体而非共识；（4）越南语域与英语域任务在协调条件排名一致性上无可靠差异（平均W=0.20，p=0.85）。
AI.conclusion: 企业协调策略应采用动态路由作为校准默认方案，但不应视为确定性赢家选择法则。研究揭示了策略选择的边界条件和操作实用性，为多智能体系统部署提供了实证指导。

title: XOR Bidding and Knapsack Formulations for HPC Network Resource Allocation
summary: Modern High Performance Computing (HPC) centers face growing challenges in ingesting large and diverse data streams. These issues often create bottlenecks that limit bandwidth utilization and delay scientific progress. Traditional static allocation and simple queuing methods are often insufficient. This paper presents a dynamic, value-based approach to bandwidth allocation. We formalize the problem by incorporating both network and processing constraints. To address it, we introduce two auction-based mechanisms: the Greedy Value Density Auction, which is computationally efficient, and the Vickrey--Clarke--Groves (VCG) Knapsack Auction, which provides strong theoretical guarantees. Both mechanisms rely on user bids that specify data requirements and scientific value. The objective is to maximize the total value of successful transfers, commonly referred to as social welfare. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed mechanisms significantly outperform First Come First Served (FCFS) baselines. Under high-load conditions, they reduce average and tail completion delays by more than 80%. Predictability also improves, with the coefficient of variation of delay decreasing by 75--85%. Network stability increases as well, with load volatility, measured by the peak-to-average ratio, decreasing by 60--70%. These results indicate that value-driven, adaptive bandwidth allocation can reduce congestion, improve resource utilization, and provide fairer access based on scientific importance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种基于拍卖的动态带宽分配机制，在高负载条件下将平均和尾部完成延迟降低超过80%，显著优于传统FCFS方法。
AI.motivation: 现代高性能计算（HPC）中心在接收大规模、多样化数据流时面临严峻挑战。传统静态分配和简单排队方法往往导致瓶颈，限制带宽利用率并阻碍科学进展，亟需更高效的动态带宽分配方案。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为包含网络和处理约束的优化问题，提出了两种拍卖机制：计算高效的贪婪价值密度拍卖和具有强理论保证的VCG背包拍卖。两种机制均依赖用户提交数据需求和科学价值的投标，目标是最大化成功传输的总价值（社会福利）。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提机制显著优于FCFS基线。在高负载条件下，平均和尾部完成延迟降低超过80%；延迟变异系数降低75-85%，可预测性显著提升；负载波动峰值平均比降低60-70%，网络稳定性增强。
AI.conclusion: 基于价值的自适应带宽分配能够有效减少拥塞、提高资源利用率，并基于科学重要性提供更公平的访问，为HPC中心的数据传输管理提供了有效解决方案。

title: From Demonstrations to Rewards: Test-Time Prompt Optimization for VLM Reward Models
summary: Reinforcement learning relies on accurate reward functions, which are often hand-crafted or even unavailable in real-world applications, such as robotics. Recent work has explored the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models. However, without careful prompt engineering, these approaches tend to produce suboptimal rewards, where false positive predictions can severely degrade downstream policy learning. In robotics, limited datasets comprising expert demonstrations are often collected to bootstrap policy learning. This scenario provides an opportunity to optimize a reward model prior policy training. We propose Demo2Reward a test-time adaptation technique to optimize the language instruction of a reward model based on a few demonstrations (3-10 trajectories) to reduce false positives while preserving true positives. Crucially, this requires no additional model training or computation resources during policy learning. We show that Demo2Reward consistently outperforms existing zero- and few-shot VLM reward models across a range of simulated robotic tasks and policy backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that Demo2Reward effectively transfers to a real-world robotic learning scenario, enabling policy learning without manually engineering a reward function.

AI.tldr: 提出Demo2Reward方法，利用少量专家演示优化视觉语言模型的提示指令，减少奖励函数中的假阳性错误，无需额外训练即可显著提升强化学习策略性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习依赖准确的奖励函数，但在机器人等实际应用中奖励函数往往难以获取。现有基于视觉语言模型的零样本奖励模型在缺乏精心设计的提示时容易产生假阳性预测，严重影响下游策略学习。然而机器人场景中常存在少量专家演示数据，这为优化奖励模型提供了机会。
AI.method: 提出Demo2Reward测试时适应技术，基于少量演示轨迹（3-10条）优化奖励模型的语言指令，在策略训练前减少假阳性预测同时保留真阳性预测。该方法在策略学习过程中无需额外模型训练或计算资源，通过优化提示而非训练模型参数来改进奖励质量。
AI.result: 在多种模拟机器人任务和不同策略骨干网络上的实验表明，Demo2Reward持续优于现有的零样本和少样本视觉语言奖励模型。在真实世界机器人学习场景中有效迁移，无需人工设计奖励函数即可实现策略学习。
AI.conclusion: Demo2Reward为机器人强化学习提供了一种高效、实用的奖励函数优化方案，通过利用少量专家演示优化视觉语言模型的提示指令，在不增加训练成本的前提下显著提升奖励质量，为真实世界机器人学习场景中奖励函数工程难题提供了解决途径。

title: Agents on a Tree: Pathwise Coordination for Multi-Objective Molecular Optimization
summary: Multi-objective molecular optimization requires searching vast chemical spaces under conflicting objectives, where early design decisions strongly constrain downstream outcomes. Existing methods typically rely on a single policy or fixed scalarization, which limits their ability to represent diverse trade-offs and to explore multiple promising design trajectories. We propose ATOM, a multi-agent framework that formulates molecular optimization as a tree-structured search. Each node corresponds to an atomic operation and hosts an agent specialized for a particular objective or decision context. Agents coordinate along different paths of the tree rather than enforcing a global consensus, enabling the method to maintain and compare alternative molecular evolution trajectories. A global memory of past optimization behaviors further supports balanced exploration and exploitation across objectives. This tree-structured interaction enables reasoning over long-horizon dependencies inherent in molecular design. Experiments on challenging multi-objective benchmarks involving activity, synthesizability, and ADMET-related properties show that ATOM consistently achieves improved Pareto coverage and hypervolume over strong baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pathwise multi-agent coordination for molecular optimization. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ATOM-41CE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ATOM，一种多智能体分子优化框架，通过树状搜索和多智能体协作，在多目标分子优化中实现了更优的帕累托覆盖和超体积指标。
AI.motivation: 现有分子优化方法通常依赖单一策略或固定的标量化方法，在处理多目标冲突时难以表示多样化的权衡关系，也无法充分探索多个有前景的设计轨迹，限制了优化效果。
AI.method: 提出ATOM框架，将分子优化建模为树状搜索过程。树中每个节点对应一个原子操作，并部署一个针对特定目标或决策上下文的专业智能体。智能体沿树的不同路径进行协调而非强制全局共识，从而维护和比较不同的分子演化轨迹。此外，全局记忆机制存储过往优化行为，支持跨目标的平衡探索与利用。
AI.result: 在涉及活性、可合成性和ADMET相关属性的挑战性多目标基准测试中，ATOM相比强基线方法一致地实现了更优的帕累托覆盖和超体积指标。
AI.conclusion: 路径级多智能体协调在分子优化中具有显著有效性，能够更好地处理分子设计中的长期依赖关系和多目标权衡，为复杂分子优化问题提供了新的解决方案。

title: Schedule-Level Shared-Prefix Reuse for LLM RL Training
summary: GRPO- and PPO-style LLM post-training commonly sample multiple trajectories from the same prompt and then train on the resulting group. In long-context RL workloads, this shared prompt-side prefix can contain retrieved passages, visual tokens, tool schemas, system instructions, or task context, while the full rollout group is still too large to pack into one training microbatch. Standard dense trainers therefore recompute the same prefix forward and backward for every trajectory. We present a schedule-level reuse mechanism that decouples prefix and suffix computation. The schedule runs prefix forward once, executes suffixes as ordinary microbatches while reading prefix K/V and accumulating prefix-side gK/gV , and then runs prefix backward once on the accumulated gradient cache. This reordered schedule is equivalent to baseline training over real arithmetic and aligns numerically within finite-precision tolerance. Because only K/V and gK/gV are hot during suffix computation, the approach offloads dormant prefix activations, integrates with TP/EP/CP/PP and DP-style placement at the execution level, and preserves aux-loss-based MoE router semantics through logical prefix-token accounting. On dense Llama3-8B, Qwen3-8B, and MoE Qwen3-MoE-30B-A3B configurations, the schedule matches optimizer updates across TP/CP/PP/EP combinations, aligns on a 100-step real RL trace replay, reaches up to 4.395x speedup (2.930x under a conservative compile-on comparison) as prefix ratio and rollout group size grow, and reduces Phase-B peak HBM by up to 59.1%, extending the Llama3-8B capacity frontier from 17,920 to 29,696 total tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种调度级的前缀复用机制，通过解耦前缀和后缀计算来优化长上下文LLM后训练。该方法避免了重复计算相同前缀，实现了最高4.395倍的加速，并显著降低显存占用，将Llama3-8B的token容量上限提升了约65%。
AI.motivation: 在GRPO和PPO风格的LLM后训练中，通常会对同一提示采样多个轨迹并分组训练。在长上下文场景下，共享的提示前缀可能包含检索段落、视觉标记、工具模式、系统指令或任务上下文，而完整的展开组仍然太大，无法打包到单个训练微批次中。因此，标准的密集训练器会对每条轨迹重复计算相同的前缀前向和反向传播，造成大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种调度级复用机制，将前缀和后缀计算解耦。具体包括：1）前缀前向计算仅执行一次；2）后缀作为普通微批次执行，同时读取前缀K/V并累积前缀侧gK/gV；3）在累积梯度缓存上执行一次前缀反向传播。这种重排序的调度在实数算术上与基线训练等价，且在有限精度容差内数值对齐。由于后缀计算期间只有K/V和gK/gV是热的，该方法能够卸载休眠的前缀激活，在执行层与TP/EP/CP/PP和DP式布局集成，并通过逻辑前缀令牌记账保持基于辅助损失的MoE路由器语义。
AI.result: 在密集Llama3-8B、Qwen3-8B和MoE Qwen3-MoE-30B-A3B配置上的实验表明：1）调度在TP/CP/PP/EP组合中匹配优化器更新；2）在100步真实RL轨迹回放上数值对齐；3）随着前缀比例和展开组规模增长，达到最高4.395倍加速（保守编译对比下为2.930倍）；4）Phase-B峰值HBM降低高达59.1%；5）将Llama3-8B的容量边界从17,920扩展到29,696总token。
AI.conclusion: 该调度级前缀复用机制有效解决了长上下文RL训练中的前缀重复计算问题，在不改变训练语义的前提下显著提升了计算效率和显存利用率，为大模型长上下文后训练提供了实用的优化方案。

title: Linear Complexity Fermionic Simulation on Quantum Devices with Hardware Connectivity Constraints
comment: Based on the version submitted for peer review in April 2026, with minor revisions
summary: Simulating fermionic systems on quantum hardware requires compiling fermionic Hamiltonians into executable quantum circuits. Existing approaches treat each compilation stage independently, applying heuristics with localized objectives that produce circuits with superquartic gate count and depth scaling and compilation times reaching several hours for large instances. We present Accordion, an end-to-end framework that co-designs the fermion-to-qubit mapping with circuit synthesis and hardware routing. Accordion fixes the Jordan Wigner mapping, which despite its higher Pauli weight produces Pauli operators with structural regularity that enables provably efficient circuit generation. For full-rank all-to-all electronic structure Hamiltonians, we prove O(N^4) gate count and circuit depth, matching the information-theoretic lower bound imposed by the Theta(N^4) second excitation terms. On linear, IBM heavy-hex, and square-grid architectures, Accordion reduces gate count by up to 79% and circuit depth by up to 77% relative to the best baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出Accordion框架，通过协同设计费米子映射、电路合成与硬件路由，将门数量和电路深度分别降低79%和77%，并达到O(N^4)的信息理论下界。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将费米子哈密顿量的编译各阶段独立处理，使用局部启发式目标，导致电路门数量和深度呈超四次方增长，大规模实例编译时间长达数小时，整体效率低下。
AI.method: 提出端到端Accordion框架，协同设计费米子-量子比特映射、电路合成和硬件路由；固定Jordan-Wigner映射，利用其Pauli算符的结构规律性实现高效电路生成。
AI.result: 针对全秩全连接电子结构哈密顿量，证明了O(N^4)门数量和电路深度，匹配信息理论下界；在IBM heavy-hex等架构上，相比最优基线，门数量降低最高79%，电路深度降低最高77%。
AI.conclusion: Accordion框架通过全局协同设计突破了现有分阶段独立编译的效率瓶颈，证明了Jordan-Wigner映射在特定条件下的高效性，为量子硬件模拟费米子系统提供了更优的编译方案。

title: FinCom: A Financial Multi-Agent Demo with Disagree-or-Commit Deliberation
summary:
Multi-agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for financial analysis and decision support. However, existing coordination schemes, especially those emphasizing consensus or debate, are vulnerable to sycophancy: agents conform to peer reasoning instead of evidence, leading to premature agreement and degraded outcomes. We introduce FinCom (Financial Committee), a governed multi-agent framework and interactive system that operationalizes the Disagree-or-Commit (DoC) protocol to embed structured dissent into financial AI committees. A central Supervisor orchestrates three ReAct-enabled specialist agents: Research, Quantitative, and Risk. Each agent is equipped with role-specific tools for retrieval, computation, and stress testing. During deliberation, agents must either explicitly critique or commit to their peers' reasoning before converging on a unified recommendation.
  This demonstration showcases how FinCom supports committee-style financial analysis through coordinated multi-agent interaction, including structured report generation and interactive decision support. Evaluated across the most recent financial agent benchmark, in addition to 90 internal handcrafted financial tasks using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocol, DoC improves reasoning accuracy and risk awareness significantly over a consensus-seeking baseline on both an in-house and external evaluation set. By reframing disagreement as a governance primitive rather than noise, FinCom offers a lightweight, prompt-only recipe for improving accountability, transparency, and epistemic robustness in agentic financial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinCom框架，通过引入Disagree-or-Commit协议将结构化异议嵌入金融AI委员会，有效解决了多智能体系统中的盲从问题，显著提升了推理准确性和风险意识。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的多智能体金融系统普遍采用共识或辩论机制，但这类机制容易受到"盲从"（sycophancy）问题的影响：智能体倾向于顺从同伴的推理而非依据证据，导致过早达成一致并降低决策质量。
AI.method: 提出FinCom（金融委员会）框架，核心是Disagree-or-Commit协议。系统由一个中央监督者协调三个配备ReAct能力的专业智能体（研究、量化、风险），每个智能体配备特定工具。在审议过程中，智能体必须明确批评或承诺接受同伴推理，然后才能达成统一建议。
AI.result: 在最新金融智能体基准测试和90个内部手工金融任务上，使用LLM-as-a-Judge协议评估，DoC协议在内部和外部评估集上均显著优于寻求共识的基线方法，在推理准确性和风险意识方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 通过将异议重构为治理原语而非噪声，FinCom为提升智能体金融系统的问责性、透明度和认知鲁棒性提供了一个轻量级的、仅需提示词的解决方案。

title: SEArch: Optimistic Policy Selection Between Scene Noise and Drift for UAV Radar Search
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) equipped with radar sensors are deployed for target search missions in diverse environments, where targets exhibit characteristic signatures (e.g., respiration micro-motion in human search) detectable through occlusions. A fundamental challenge arises from shifts in radar statistics as the UAV moves through a dynamic and potentially non-stationary environment, rendering any fixed signal-processing strategy suboptimal; yet perception and adaptation must run onboard a resource-constrained aerial node in real time. Since no single detector performs well across all conditions, we adopt a multi-policy paradigm and formulate UAV target search as an online policy selection problem over a library of specialized detectors, with performance measured by regret, the cumulative loss gap relative to the best policy in each scene. The setting couples in-scene stochastic noise with inter-scene shifts. Whereas prior methods capture only one regime, we account for both through the Stochastically Extended Adversary (SEA) framework, without requiring oracle knowledge of scene dynamics. Because adaptation must run at the UAV, we instantiate SEA through \textsc{SEArch}, a lightweight optimistic Follow the Regularized Leader (OFTRL) selector with an adaptive learning rate, achieving regret $O(\barσ_T \sqrt{T} + \sqrt{J})$, where $\barσ_T$ captures radar measurement noise and $J$ is the number of scene transitions over the mission horizon $T$. To enable rapid adaptation under frequent scene changes, we further introduce \textsc{W-SEArch}, a windowed variant that restarts every $w$ rounds and achieves regret $O(\barσ_I \sqrt{w})$ under at most one transition per window. Experiments show up to 30\% regret reduction compared to non-adaptive baselines across a range of non-stationary settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对无人机雷达目标搜索中环境动态变化导致的固定检测策略次优问题，提出基于在线策略选择的SEA框架及轻量级算法SEArch和W-SEArch，实现了比非自适应方法高达30%的遗憾降低。
AI.motivation: 在无人机搭载雷达进行目标搜索任务时，环境动态变化会导致雷达统计特性发生偏移，使任何固定的信号处理策略都变得次优。由于没有单一检测器能在所有条件下表现良好，且无人机平台资源受限需要实时感知与适应，如何在计算约束下实现自适应策略选择成为核心挑战。
AI.method: 采用多策略范式，将无人机目标搜索建模为在线策略选择问题，在专门的检测器库上进行选择。引入随机扩展对抗（SEA）框架，同时考虑场景内随机噪声和场景间偏移。实现轻量级乐观正则化跟随领导者（OFTRL）选择器SEArch，采用自适应学习率；针对频繁场景变化，提出窗口变体W-SEArch，每w轮重启一次。
AI.result: SEArch算法实现遗憾界O(σ̄_T√T + √J)，其中σ̄_T捕捉雷达测量噪声，J为任务时域T内的场景转换次数；W-SEArch在每窗口最多一次转换条件下实现遗憾O(σ̄_I√w)。实验表明，在多种非平稳设置下，相比非自适应基线方法实现高达30%的遗憾降低。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了无人机雷达目标搜索中的动态环境适应问题，提出的SEA框架及其轻量级实现在保证理论遗憾界的同时满足无人机平台的实时计算约束，为资源受限平台上的自适应信号处理提供了有效解决方案。

title: A Shared Valence Axis Across Modern LLMs and Human EEG: The Saturation Regularity
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful representation learners whose internal features increasingly align with human cognition. We study whether modern LLMs can serve as a lens for understanding neural representations in the human brain, focusing on emotional valence in EEG.
  We first build a one-dimensional valence direction, the V-axis, from modern LLMs using only nine emotion-evocative sentences. We validate it through zero-shot transfer to sentiment benchmarks and cross-model consistency across fourteen LLMs. We then show that this LLM-derived direction maps onto human neural activity. On a public EEG cohort of 123 subjects watching affective videos, a single linear projection on EEG features tracks the V-axis position of each stimulus. Moreover, 36 EEG emotion classifiers trained without exposure to the V-axis spontaneously rediscover the same direction in their internal representations, suggesting that the same valence structure emerges in both language models and human electrophysiology.
  Yet this convergence does not provide an effective training signal. We test twenty-five alignment strategies, including knowledge distillation, representational similarity, contrastive, and topographic losses; none improve decoding, and sixteen significantly reduce accuracy. We formalize this result as the saturation regularity: once task labels alone drive a brain-decoding network onto the target direction, additional supervision mainly distorts an already-saturated basin, while the load-bearing within-class residual receives little useful gradient.
  This regularity also indicates where improvement should come from: the residual subspace unreachable by supervision. Motivated by this insight, we ensemble across residual diversity rather than supervising the basin, improving balanced accuracy by 10.5% over the prior best on FACED, with the same effect replicated on SEED-V.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLMs与人类大脑在情感效价表征上存在一致性，但直接对齐训练反而降低解码性能，基于此提出残差多样性集成方法，在EEG情感解码任务上提升10.5%准确率。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型（LLMs）是否可作为理解人类大脑神经表征的透镜，聚焦于EEG中的情感效价（emotional valence）研究。
AI.method: 1）仅用九个情感句子从LLMs构建一维效价方向（V-axis）并验证其有效性；2）在123名受试者的EEG数据集上映射该方向；3）测试25种对齐策略；4）基于饱和规律提出残差多样性集成方法。
AI.result: 1）LLM-derived V-axis可线性投影映射到EEG特征；2）36个EEG情感分类器自发重发现相同方向；3）所有对齐策略均未提升解码性能，16种显著降低准确率；4）提出饱和规律解释此现象；5）残差集成方法在FACED上提升10.5%平衡准确率，在SEED-V上复现相同效果。
AI.conclusion: LLMs与人类大脑在情感效价表征上存在自然收敛，但这种收敛不提供有效训练信号；改进应来自监督无法触及的残差子空间，而非对已饱和的基准方向施加额外约束。

title: Optimal Transport-based Permutation-Invariant Bayesian Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Layouts
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely and successfully adopted for solving optimization problems having an expensive-to-evaluate, black-box, and non-convex objective function. However, the vanilla BO algorithm is not able to exploit possible symmetries characterizing the target problem. An intuitive case is given by optimal location problems, whose decision variables refer to a finite set of points within a continuous space, with the order of points not affecting the value of the objective function. We refer to this setting as optimization over layouts to distinguish from optimization over point-clouds where, instead, the order of points counts. As an instance of optimization over layouts we consider a real-life industrial-relevant application, that is the optimization of the layout of an offshore wind farm: given identical wind turbines, switching any pair of them has not any effect on the annual energy production. Based on Optimal Transport theory, we propose a Permutation-Invariant BO approach, namely PIBO, proved to provide better wind farm layouts when compared to the vanilla BO approach while cutting computation time roughly in half.

AI.tldr: 针对目标函数对决策变量顺序不敏感的布局优化问题，提出了基于最优传输理论的置换不变贝叶斯优化方法（PIBO），在海上风电场布局优化中相比传统方法节省约一半计算时间并获得更优布局。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化方法无法利用目标问题中存在的对称性特征。在布局优化问题中（如风电场涡轮机位置优化），决策变量为连续空间中的点集，点的排列顺序不影响目标函数值，但标准BO算法未能有效利用这种置换不变性。
AI.method: 基于最优传输（Optimal Transport）理论，提出置换不变贝叶斯优化方法PIBO。该方法能够识别并利用布局优化问题中的对称性特征，使优化过程对点的排列顺序具有不变性。
AI.result: 在海上风电场布局优化这一实际工业应用中，PIBO方法相比传统贝叶斯优化方法能够获得更优的风电场布局，同时计算时间减少约一半。
AI.conclusion: PIBO方法成功解决了布局优化问题中的置换不变性建模问题，为具有对称性特征的昂贵黑盒优化问题提供了高效解决方案，具有重要的工业应用价值。

title: AcOrch: Accelerating Sampling-based GNN Training under CPU-NPU Heterogeneous Environments
comment: 18 pages, 22 figures, to be published in Frontiers of Computer Science
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable success in various applications. Sampling-based GNN training, which conducts mini-batch training on sampled subgraphs, has become a promising solution for large-scale graphs. Given the resource-intensive nature of sampling-based GNN training, Neural Processing Units (NPUs), such as the Ascend AI processor, offer a promising alternative due to their high throughput and energy efficiency, making them well-suited for GNN workloads. However, the multi-stage nature of sampling-based training, which involves subgraph sampling, feature gathering, and model training, with different resource requirements and computation volume. This requires careful coordination to fully utilize the heterogeneous computation resources of CPUs and NPUs. In this work, we present AcOrch, a sampling-based GNN training system optimized for CPU-NPU heterogeneous platforms. AcOrch offers fine-grained task orchestration and adopts a two-level pipelined execution model to overlap sampling, gathering, and training.
