AI.conclusion: RadioMaster成功填补了用户意图与实际无线发射之间的鸿沟，证明了多智能体框架在无线电信号生成任务中的有效性，为无线原型设计提供了自动化解决方案。

title: Discovering Agents for Discovery: The Case for DNS
summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents enter their next stage of being deployed ubiquitously throughout the Internet, their discoverability will become a central challenge. The information AI agents need to discover one another, how they will locate it, how to facilitate authentication, integrity, and authorization, how to connect across different platforms, and how to scale across organizational boundaries form a set of unanswered challenges that deployment success will prompt. These are challenges for which one of the Internet's most venerable, solid, and ubiquitous infrastructures is ideally suited: The Domain Name System (DNS). Such a rich, already ubiquitous, and programmatically flexible foundation is an ideal option for discovery of AI agents. In this work, we propose an illustration and rationale for the basic semantics that discovery for AI agents will require. We argue that three key evaluation criteria will become paramount: navigational completeness (the extent to which the necessary metadata, with elements like trust, is included in a discovery solution), lookup complexity, and transaction performance (e.g., latency, speed, or recency). Using data about 119,757 real-world service endpoints and multiple agent tooling ecosystems, we empirically evaluate the first of these considerations to illustrate the appropriateness of using DNS for AI agent discovery. Our results show the size and amount of data necessary are well within the range of a single DNS UDP transaction, whose latency can be on the order of milliseconds. Our evaluations illustrate a promising path toward enabling AI agent discoverability at the Internet's scale, and thereby accelerating secure, stable, and resilient AI agent deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用域名系统（DNS）作为AI代理发现的基础设施，通过对119,757个真实服务端点的实证评估，证明了DNS能够在单个UDP事务中以毫秒级延迟实现AI代理发现，为大规模、安全的AI代理部署提供了可行方案。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理在互联网中广泛部署，代理间的可发现性成为核心挑战。如何让AI代理相互发现、定位信息、实现认证与授权、跨平台连接以及跨组织边界扩展等问题尚未解决，亟需一个可扩展、安全且普遍可用的发现基础设施。
AI.method: 提出利用DNS作为AI代理发现的基础设施，定义了发现语义的基本要素，并建立了三个关键评估标准：导航完整性（元数据完整程度，包括信任等要素）、查找复杂度和事务性能（延迟、速度等）。通过收集119,757个真实世界服务端点数据及多个代理工具生态系统的数据，对导航完整性进行实证评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，AI代理发现所需的数据大小和数量完全在单个DNS UDP事务的处理范围内，延迟可达毫秒级。这证明了DNS在数据承载能力和响应速度方面完全满足AI代理发现的需求。
AI.conclusion: DNS作为互联网最成熟、稳定和普遍存在的基础设施，其丰富性、普遍可用性和编程灵活性使其成为AI代理发现的理想选择。本研究为实现互联网规模的AI代理可发现性指明了方向，有助于加速安全、稳定和弹性的AI代理部署。

title: Adaptive data selection improves wearable prediction under low baseline performance
summary: Adaptive sensing strategies that selectively sample data are increasingly used in wearable health systems to improve prediction performance under limited data budgets, yet their benefits across individuals remain poorly understood. Here, we evaluate adaptive selection of time windows for model training under fixed measurement budgets across multiple sensing modalities, including heart rate, activity, and ecological momentary assessment (EMA), in a longitudinal wearable dataset. We quantify performance gains relative to random sampling using both area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and F1 score. Adaptive strategies yield substantial improvements in AUROC for participants with low baseline performance (with gains up to 0.7), while offering limited or negative gains for participants with strong baselines. Across modalities, adaptive gain is strongly inversely correlated with baseline performance (Pearson r = -0.67; Spearman p = -0.62). At the participant level, most individuals benefit in AUROC (60-80% across modalities), although improvements in F1 are smaller and less consistent. These findings show that adaptive sensing is not uniformly beneficial, but instead provides the greatest value in underperforming settings. Our results support selective deployment strategies that tailor adaptive sensing based on baseline performance to improve efficiency in wearable health monitoring.

AI.tldr: 自适应感知策略并非对所有人都有效，主要能帮助基线表现差的参与者（AUROC提升高达0.7），而对基线表现好的人收益有限甚至为负。
AI.motivation: 自适应感知策略在可穿戴健康系统中被广泛用于在有限数据预算下提升预测性能，但其在不同个体间的收益差异尚不明确。本文旨在探究自适应策略在不同感知模态和个体中的效果差异。
AI.method: 在纵向可穿戴设备数据集中，评估在固定测量预算下自适应选择时间窗口进行模型训练的效果。涵盖心率、活动和生态瞬时评估（EMA）等多种感知模态，使用AUROC和F1分数作为指标，对比自适应采样与随机采样的性能差异。
AI.result: 自适应策略为基线表现差的参与者带来显著的AUROC提升（最高达0.7），但对基线表现好的参与者收益有限或为负。各模态下，自适应增益与基线性能呈强负相关（Pearson r = -0.67）。在参与者层面，60-80%的人AUROC有所提升，但F1分数的提升较小且不一致。
AI.conclusion: 自适应感知并非普遍有效，其最大价值在于改善表现欠佳的场景。研究结果支持基于基线性能量身定制自适应感知的部署策略，以提高可穿戴健康监测的效率。

title: A Multi-AI-agent Framework Enabling End-to-end Finite Element Analysis for Solid Mechanics Problems
summary: Finite element analysis (FEA) is the most important numerical approach for solid mechanics. Challenges of FEA include a steep learning curve for entry-level users and potential false simulations due to incorrect definitions of key simulation components, such as boundary conditions, load cases, and solution variables. Years of engineering experience are usually necessary for real-world problem-solving. To address these issues, we present AbaqusAgent, a multi-agent framework grounded in large language models (LLMs) for solid mechanics analyses. AbaqusAgent is developed to facilitate analysis case generation and execution using Abaqus, one of the most widely used FEA packages, by turning users' natural-language instructions into executed FEA analyses and result visualization. AbaqusAgent is composed of six agents, including interpreter, architect, input writer, runner, reviewer, and visualizer agents, encompassing all the essential pre-processing and post-processing steps of standard FEA analyses. A wide variety of 50 solid mechanics problems have been successfully validated, achieving an overall success rate of 86%. Beyond improving the efficiency of FEA for solid mechanics problems and lowering the barrier to computational mechanics education, AbaqusAgent advances the human-simulation interaction paradigm and enables integration with AI-empowered optimization and material characterization workflows. The code is available at https://github.com/LIRAM-LIN/AbaqusAgent

AI.tldr: 提出了AbaqusAgent，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，可将自然语言指令转换为有限元分析（FEA）执行，在50个固体力学问题上实现了86%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 有限元分析（FEA）作为固体力学最重要的数值方法，存在学习曲线陡峭、初学者难以正确设置边界条件等关键模拟组件导致仿真失败的问题，通常需要多年工程经验才能解决实际问题。
AI.method: 开发了AbaqusAgent多智能体框架，包含解释器、架构师、输入编写器、运行器、审查器和可视化器六个智能体，涵盖FEA分析的所有前处理和后处理步骤，将用户的自然语言指令转换为可执行的FEA分析和结果可视化。
AI.result: 在50个多样化的固体力学问题上进行了验证，总体成功率达到86%，有效提高了FEA效率，降低了计算力学教育门槛。
AI.conclusion: AbaqusAgent不仅提高了固体力学FEA效率并降低了计算力学教育门槛，还推进了人机仿真交互范式，实现了与AI驱动的优化和材料表征工作流的集成。

title: TwinQuant: Learnable Subspace Decomposition for 4-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: 4-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and latency of large language model inference, but its aggressive precision reduction can severely degrade accuracy. Prior methods address this by decomposing each weight matrix into two components (e.g., via singular value decomposition) and quantizing them separately, assigning the bulk of values to a low-precision residual component while handling outliers with a high-precision low-rank component. However, such decompositions are designed to minimize the real-valued energy of the residual, rather than the post-quantization error of the residual and low-rank components. We propose TwinQuant, a 4-bit quantization framework that learns quantization-friendly decomposed subspaces and jointly reshapes both the low-rank and residual components. TwinQuant learns component-specific transformations via a joint optimization over the Stiefel and general linear manifolds, flattening their distributions and reducing dynamic-range imbalance. To enable efficient end-to-end execution, we further design a fused dual-component kernel that pipelines the two-stage low-rank computation on-chip and merges both components with a single epilogue, avoiding intermediate global-memory traffic. Across LLaMA3 and Qwen3 models, TwinQuant preserves near-FP16 accuracy and delivers up to $1.8\times$ end-to-end speedup over an FP16 baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出了TwinQuant，一种通过联合优化学习量化友好分解子空间的4位量化框架，在LLaMA3和Qwen3模型上保持接近FP16精度并实现高达1.8倍的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的4位量化方法通过将权重矩阵分解为两个分量（如通过奇异值分解）来处理异常值，但这些分解旨在最小化残差的实值能量，而非残差和低秩分量在量化后的误差。这种不匹配导致了次优的量化性能，需要一种能够直接优化量化误差的分解方法。
AI.method: TwinQuant通过在Stiefel和一般线性流形上进行联合优化，学习分量特定的变换，同时重塑低秩和残差分量，使其分布更加平坦并减少动态范围不平衡。此外，设计了融合双分量内核，将两阶段低秩计算在芯片上流水线化，并通过单一收尾操作合并两个分量，避免中间全局内存流量。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3和Qwen3模型上，TwinQuant保持了接近FP16的精度，相比FP16基线实现了高达1.8倍的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: TwinQuant成功解决了传统分解方法中能量最小化与量化误差最小化之间的不匹配问题，通过学习量化友好的分解子空间和联合优化策略，在保持精度的同时显著提升了推理效率，为大规模语言模型的低精度量化提供了有效解决方案。

title: QoEReasoner: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Automated and Explainable QoE Diagnosis in RANs
summary: Diagnosing Quality-of-Experience (QoE) degradations in operational Radio Access Networks (RANs) is a critical but notoriously complex task, traditionally requiring labor-intensive expert analysis over high-dimensional, cross-layer telemetry. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer unprecedented reasoning capabilities, they are fundamentally unsuited for raw RANs troubleshooting: they fail at numeric time-series analysis, hallucinate protocol-violating causal links, and lack the stateful rigor required for multi-step fault localization. To bridge this gap, we present QoEReasoner, an end-to-end, LLM-driven agentic system designed for automated and explainable QoE diagnosis. QoEReasoner tames the inherent unpredictability of LLMs by grounding their reasoning in the physical realities of the network. It employs deterministic tools to reliably translate raw numeric KPIs into structured evidence, enforces protocol-consistent fault propagation through a domain-specific Knowledge Base, and leverages a Historical Bank of expert-validated cases to guide hypothesis generation. A stateful central planner orchestrates this closed-loop process across anomaly detection, causal tracing, and root-cause localization. Evaluations on real-world operational RANs datasets demonstrate that QoEReasoner outperforms strong baselines by 18\%-40\% in accuracy across multiple diagnostic tasks. Furthermore, it reduces diagnostic time from approximately 30 minutes of manual expert analysis to just 3 minutes per session, delivering highly interpretable, expert-grade reports while remaining robust across diverse LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出了QoEReasoner，一个基于LLM的智能代理系统，用于无线接入网络中QoE问题的自动诊断。通过将LLM推理与网络物理现实相结合，使用确定性工具、领域知识库和历史案例库来约束LLM的推理过程，在真实数据集上准确率提升18%-40%，诊断时间从30分钟缩短至3分钟。
AI.motivation: 在运营中的无线接入网络（RAN）中诊断QoE（体验质量）降级是一项关键但极其复杂的任务，传统方法需要专家对高维、跨层遥测数据进行劳动密集型分析。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）具有强大的推理能力，但它们不适合直接用于原始RAN故障排查：无法处理数值时间序列分析、会产生违反协议的幻觉因果链、缺乏多步故障定位所需的有状态严谨性。
AI.method: 提出了QoEReasoner，一个端到端的LLM驱动的智能代理系统。该方法通过将LLM推理与网络物理现实相结合来控制LLM的固有不可预测性：1）使用确定性工具将原始数值KPI可靠地转换为结构化证据；2）通过领域特定知识库强制执行符合协议的故障传播规则；3）利用专家验证案例的历史库指导假设生成；4）一个有状态的中央规划器协调闭环过程，包括异常检测、因果追踪和根因定位。
AI.result: 在真实运营RAN数据集上的评估表明，QoEReasoner在多个诊断任务中的准确率比强基线高出18%-40%。此外，它将诊断时间从约30分钟的手动专家分析缩短至每次会话仅3分钟，同时提供高度可解释、专家级的报告，并在不同的LLM骨干网络上保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: QoEReasoner成功地将LLM的推理能力与网络的物理现实相结合，解决了LLM在RAN故障诊断中的固有缺陷，实现了自动化、可解释且高效的QoE诊断，为运营商提供了一种可行的智能化网络运维解决方案。

title: Certified Closed-Loop Control for Packet Networks: A Compositional Certification Framework
summary: Packet networks are controlled dynamical systems with discontinuities, delayed observations, and partial state information. Adaptive or learning-driven proposers can improve performance, but an unsafe proposal may still cause starvation, tail-delay spikes, or unstable queue behaviour. This paper treats packet-network control as an executed-action certification problem. A certified operator sits between any proposer and the dataplane. At each control tick, the proposer emits an arbitrary candidate action $\tilde u(t)$. The operator either projects it to an executable action $u(t)$ that satisfies a configuration-compiled certificate, or reports INFEASIBLE and executes an always-defined fallback with quantified slack. The certificate also exports an auditable envelope $\bar z(t)$ for downstream composition. The guarantees are conditional and explicit. They apply on ticks where the operator reports CERTIFIED, the declared arrival envelope and backlog bound are valid, and the platform realises the assumed service lower bound. Under these conditions, one mechanism covers backlog caps, service floors, mitigation caps, Foster--Lyapunov drift constraints, and compositional envelope contracts. We prove operator-level safety, feed-forward compositional safety and stability using exported envelopes, and a cyclic closure result under a small-gain condition. We also define breach and infeasibility semantics, discuss calibration of the service-tracking factor that links certified targets to realised scheduler behaviour, and evaluate the design under delayed telemetry, delayed actuation, weak proposers, envelope mismatch, overload, and millisecond-scale certification. The present evaluation validates the certified execution boundary in a byte-level closed-loop backend; deployment-level scheduler tracking is left to future Linux or hardware experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对分组网络控制的安全认证机制，通过在提议器和数据平面之间部署认证操作器，确保所有执行动作满足安全约束，从而防止网络性能恶化。
AI.motivation: 分组网络是具有不连续性、观测延迟和部分状态信息的动态控制系统。尽管自适应或学习驱动的提议器能够改善性能，但不安全的提议仍可能导致饥饿、尾部延迟峰值或不稳定的队列行为，因此需要一种机制来保证控制动作的安全性。
AI.method: 将分组网络控制建模为执行动作认证问题。在提议器和数据平面之间设置认证操作器，每个控制时刻提议器发出候选动作，操作器将其投影到满足配置编译证书的可执行动作，或报告不可行并执行具有量化余量的回退动作。证书还导出可审计的包络用于下游组合。
AI.result: 在字节级闭环后端评估中验证了认证执行边界的有效性，证明了操作器级安全性、前馈组合安全性和稳定性，以及在小幅增益条件下的循环闭合结果。该方法能够处理延迟遥测、延迟执行、弱提议器、包络不匹配、过载和毫秒级认证等场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过认证操作器的引入，提供了条件性但明确的保证机制，涵盖了积压上限、服务下限、缓解上限、Foster-Lyapunov漂移约束和组合包络契约，为分组网络的安全控制提供了理论基础和实践验证，但部署级调度器跟踪留待未来研究。

title: BudgetDraft: Acceptance-Aware Multi-View Training for Sparse-KV Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up autoregressive decoding by using a drafter to propose multiple tokens that a verifier validates in parallel. In resource-constrained deployments, the drafter uses a sparse KV cache to limit peak GPU memory and end-to-end latency under a fixed KV budget, while the verifier keeps a full KV cache. Mid-to-long context inference (4K--16K context length) is common in real applications. However, naive sparse/full speculative decoding suffers from the sparse/full mismatch as context length grows, causing the acceptance rate to drop quickly. We propose BudgetDraft, a multi-view sparse training method for sparse drafting in mid-to-long inference. The drafter is exposed to multiple sampled KV budgets during training and learns to align each sparse view with one shared full-cache teacher target. BudgetDraft combines an acceptance-aware loss on a full-cache branch with a multi-view loss on a sparse-cache branch, producing a single budget-robust drafter that recovers acceptance across sparsity levels without extra inference-time components. Experimental results on PG-19, LongBench, and LWM show that BudgetDraft achieves up to 6.55x, 4.46x, and 2.10x end-to-end speedup vs AR at 4K, 8K, and 16K context lengths, while keeping the inference pipeline memory-friendly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BudgetDraft，一种用于中长上下文推理的多视图稀疏训练方法，通过在训练中引入多种KV预算采样，有效解决了稀疏/全量推测解码中的不匹配问题，在4K-16K上下文长度下实现了高达6.55倍的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的部署中，推测解码的草案生成器使用稀疏KV缓存以限制GPU内存和延迟，而验证器保持全量KV缓存。然而，随着上下文长度增长，这种稀疏/全量不匹配导致接受率快速下降，严重影响中长上下文推理（4K-16K）的性能，这是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: BudgetDraft采用多视图稀疏训练策略：1）在训练过程中让草案生成器接触多种采样的KV预算；2）学习将每个稀疏视图与共享的全量缓存教师目标对齐；3）结合全量缓存分支上的接受率感知损失和稀疏缓存分支上的多视图损失；4）训练出单一的预算鲁棒草案生成器，无需额外推理时组件即可在多种稀疏度级别恢复接受率。
AI.result: 在PG-19、LongBench和LWM数据集上的实验表明，BudgetDraft在4K、8K和16K上下文长度下分别实现了高达6.55倍、4.46倍和2.10倍的端到端加速，同时保持内存友好的推理流水线，有效解决了稀疏/全量不匹配问题。
AI.conclusion: BudgetDraft成功解决了中长上下文推测解码中稀疏/全量缓存不匹配的关键挑战，通过多视图训练方法显著提升了接受率和加速效果，为资源受限环境下的长上下文推理提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: CAST: Non-Privileged Clipped Asymmetric Self-Teaching with Advantage Flipping for GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), especially Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has been widely used to improve reasoning in large language models. However, outcome-level rewards provide only sparse supervision, and group-relative advantages vanish when all sampled trajectories for a prompt are either correct or incorrect. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) offers dense token-level guidance, but its token preferences are not necessarily aligned with trajectory correctness; empirical diagnostics show that OPSD signals behave differently on correct and incorrect rollouts, with teacher-positive and teacher-negative gap signals exhibiting different noise profiles. These diagnostics are conducted under an OPSD-style privileged teacher context for analysis only, whereas CAST training uses answer-free self-teacher scoring.Motivated by these observations, this work proposes CAST, an answer-free self-distillation method for GRPO-style RLVR. CAST keeps the verifier-grounded GRPO objective, but uses a stop-gradient self-teacher to shape token-level advantages according to trajectory correctness. Unlike prior self-distilled RLVR methods, CAST does not require reference-solution-conditioned teacher scoring, keeps the self-teacher log-probability gap active throughout training, and applies bidirectional local advantage sign reversal: teacher-negative tokens in correct trajectories can receive negative token-level advantages, while teacher-positive tokens in incorrect trajectories can receive bounded positive local advantages. For zero-variance all-correct and all-wrong groups, CAST assigns bounded sign-constrained base advantages, so these otherwise zero-gradient groups can contribute verifier-signed token feedback. Experiments on mathematical reasoning show that CAST improves RLVR training while retaining a lightweight, verifier-grounded trajectory-level objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAST，一种用于GRPO风格RLVR的无答案自蒸馏方法，通过保持验证器引导的GRPO目标，同时使用停止梯度的自教师来根据轨迹正确性塑造token级优势，解决了结果级奖励稀疏和群体相对优势消失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的GRPO方法存在两个主要问题：结果级奖励仅提供稀疏监督，且当提示的所有采样轨迹都正确或都错误时，群体相对优势会消失。虽然OPSD提供密集的token级指导，但其token偏好不一定与轨迹正确性一致。通过经验诊断发现，OPSD信号在正确和错误rollout上表现不同，teacher-positive和teacher-negative gap信号具有不同的噪声特征。
AI.method: 提出CAST（Answer-free Self-distillation）方法：1）保持验证器引导的GRPO目标；2）使用停止梯度的自教师根据轨迹正确性塑造token级优势；3）不需要参考解条件的教师评分；4）在整个训练过程中保持自教师对数概率差距活跃；5）应用双向局部优势符号反转：正确轨迹中的teacher-negative tokens可以接收负的token级优势，错误轨迹中的teacher-positive tokens可以接收有界的正局部优势；6）对于零方差的全正确和全错误组，分配有界的符号约束基础优势。
AI.result: 在数学推理实验中，CAST改善了RLVR训练效果，同时保持了轻量级的、验证器引导的轨迹级目标。对于原本零梯度的全正确和全错误组，CAST能够分配有界的符号约束基础优势，使这些组能够贡献验证器符号的token反馈。
AI.conclusion: CAST成功地将自蒸馏与验证器引导的强化学习相结合，通过token级的细粒度指导增强了GRPO的训练效果，同时保持了方法的轻量性和可扩展性。该方法为RLVR训练提供了一种新的解决方案，能够在保持轨迹级目标的同时实现更密集的监督信号。

title: Don't Let a Few Network Failures Slow the Entire AllReduce
summary: Network failures are among the most frequent hardware faults in large-scale GPU clusters and a leading cause of training-job interruptions. Modern collective communication libraries such as NCCL mitigate network failures by rerouting traffic through surviving NICs on the same server, trading reduced inter-node bandwidth for uninterrupted training. However, the degraded server remains on the critical path of the standard ring algorithm, slowing the entire collective. We present the first information-theoretic lower bound on AllReduce completion time under asymmetric network bandwidth and show that when the straggler retains at least half of its original bandwidth, the unavoidable overhead relative to the fault-free optimum is only O(1/p) for p GPUs. We then design OptCC, a four-stage pipelined AllReduce algorithm that approaches this lower bound. Experiments on SimAI confirm that OptCC closes the gap left by existing fault-tolerant schemes: under practical network failures with up to 50% bandwidth loss, OptCC completes AllReduce within 2-6% of NCCL's fault-free ring performance, whereas the state-of-the-art incurs up to 57% overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OptCC算法，一种针对非对称网络带宽的四阶段流水线AllReduce方案，在网络故障场景下将性能开销从现有方案的57%降低至2-6%，接近理论下界。
AI.motivation: 大规模GPU集群中网络故障是导致训练任务中断的主要原因之一。现有的容错方案（如NCCL）通过流量重路由来应对故障，但带宽降级的服务器仍处于关键路径上，导致整个集合通信的性能下降。
AI.method: 1）首次推导出非对称网络带宽下AllReduce完成时间的信息论下界，证明当故障节点保留至少一半带宽时，相对于无故障最优情况的不可避免开销仅为O(1/p)；2）设计了OptCC，一种四阶段流水线AllReduce算法来逼近该理论下界。
AI.result: 在SimAI上的实验表明，在实际网络故障（带宽损失高达50%）情况下，OptCC的AllReduce完成时间仅比NCCL无故障Ring算法慢2-6%，而现有最先进方案会产生高达57%的开销。
AI.conclusion: OptCC成功填补了现有容错方案留下的性能空白，在网络故障场景下实现了接近理论最优的AllReduce性能，显著优于当前最先进方案。

title: A Simple Hierarchical Causality Primer
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure; short technical primer with a toy example in an appendix
summary: We provide a brief primer for the idea behind formalising hierarchical causality in the context of complex systems. Here actors are not simply agents. Actors instantiate causation classes. Agents implement local dynamics in given levels or organisation in a given system. Hierarchical causality then describes how actor-level roles constrain, select, and organise agent-level behaviour across levels. The system then necessarily requires three additional structures. First, causation classes to abstract a given form of causal influence that an actor instantiates. Second, aggregation operators to move across the levels. Third, discrete event-time maps are required because the system comprises events, and the relation between local event counts and any global clock must be specified. Our formulation here is purposefully simple and discrete.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了复杂系统中层次因果关系的形式化框架，区分了行为者与智能体的概念，并引入三个必要结构：因果类、聚合算子和离散事件时间映射。
AI.motivation: 现有复杂系统理论缺乏对多层次因果关系的严格形式化描述，需要建立一个能够刻画跨层次因果约束、选择和组织机制的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建了一个简化的离散形式化框架，区分行为者（实例化因果类）与智能体（实现局部动力学），引入三个核心结构：因果类（抽象因果影响形式）、聚合算子（跨层次映射）、离散事件时间映射（关联局部事件计数与全局时钟）。
AI.result: 建立了层次因果关系的形式化表述，阐明了行为者层次的角色如何跨层次约束、选择和组织智能体层次的行为，并证明了系统必然需要上述三个附加结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为复杂系统中的层次因果关系提供了简洁离散的形式化基础，为后续研究多尺度系统的因果机制奠定了理论基础。

title: RAFT: Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting
summary: Domain-specific supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often improves in-domain performance at the cost of degrading a model's general capabilities. We view this degradation through two practical gaps in domain SFT: a supervision-compatibility gap, where domain targets differ in style and reasoning format from the original model's natural responses, and a trajectory-preservation gap, where teacher-forced SFT optimizes fixed target tokens without constraining the model's behavior on its own generated prefixes. This process fails to preserve the model's original behavior. We propose RAFT (Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting), a two-stage framework that addresses both factors. First, RAFT constructs model-compatible supervision through self-conditioned rewriting, semantic filtering, and answer fusion. Second, RAFT performs Answer-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation, where the original instruction-tuned model provides soft targets on student-generated trajectories while being conditioned on the fused answer as helpful context. We further introduce top-K temperature distillation and EMA-based adaptive loss balancing to stabilize the domain-general trade-off. Across three instruction-tuned backbones and five domains, RAFT improves average domain accuracy by 23.2% over standard SFT, while recovering part of the SFT-induced degradation on MS-Bench and IFEval, with relative improvements of 18.2% and 10.2%, respectively. These results show that coupling data refinement with trajectory-level preservation provides an effective recipe for domain fine-tuning with alleviated forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAFT框架，通过数据精炼和自适应蒸馏缓解领域微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，在提升领域性能23.2%的同时，恢复了部分通用能力（MS-Bench提升18.2%，IFEval提升10.2%）。
AI.motivation: 领域特定的监督微调（SFT）虽然能提升领域内性能，但往往以牺牲模型的通用能力为代价。作者识别出导致这种退化的两个实际差距：1）监督兼容性差距，即领域目标在风格和推理格式上与原始模型的自然响应不同；2）轨迹保持差距，即教师强制的SFT优化固定目标token，而不约束模型在自身生成前缀上的行为，无法保持模型的原始行为。
AI.method: RAFT是一个两阶段框架：第一阶段通过自条件重写、语义过滤和答案融合构建模型兼容的监督信号；第二阶段执行答案条件的在策略蒸馏，原始指令微调模型在学生生成的轨迹上提供软目标，同时以融合答案作为有用上下文。此外，还引入了top-K温度蒸馏和基于EMA的自适应损失平衡来稳定领域-通用权衡。
AI.result: 在三个指令微调骨干网络和五个领域上的实验表明，RAFT相比标准SFT平均领域准确率提升23.2%，同时在MS-Bench和IFEval上分别实现了18.2%和10.2%的相对改进，恢复了部分SFT导致的退化。
AI.conclusion: 将数据精炼与轨迹级别保持相结合，为缓解领域微调中的遗忘问题提供了有效方案。该方法证明了在提升领域性能的同时，可以通过精心设计的框架保留模型的通用能力。

title: TIGER: Traceable Inference with Graph-Based Evidence Routing for Mitigating Hallucinations in Multimodal Generation
summary: We study fact-level repair for multimodal generation, where a fluent output may contain specific facts that are not supported by the input. Existing inference-time repair methods often generate feedback by jointly conditioning on the input and the current output. This design has two limitations: hallucinated claims in the output can bias the model's interpretation of the input, and free-form feedback cannot be ranked or scheduled at the fact level. We present TIGER, an inference-time framework that redesigns feedback for localized repair. TIGER independently extracts an observation graph from the input and a claim graph from the current output, then assigns each claim a graph-conditioned risk score based on support and conflict. The model repairs selected high-risk claims while keeping the backbone frozen. We provide a convergence analysis showing that the expected total risk decreases geometrically to an explicit asymptotic bound under mild assumptions. Experiments across four cross-modal paths, including image-to-text, image+text-to-text, audio-to-text, and video-to-text, show that TIGER reduces unsupported content while preserving task quality. The gains hold across multiple backbones, and a CrisisFACTS case study suggests that the same repair mechanism can improve grounding in multi-source settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TIGER框架，通过独立的图结构提取和风险评分机制，在推理时对多模态生成中的事实级幻觉进行定位修复，在四个跨模态任务上有效减少了不 supported 内容。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成推理时修复方法存在两个关键局限：一是输出中的幻觉声明会偏差模型对输入的理解，二是自由形式的反馈无法在事实层面进行排序或调度，导致修复效果受限。
AI.method: TIGER框架独立地从输入提取观察图、从当前输出提取声明图，为每个声明分配基于支持和冲突的图条件风险分数，然后修复选中的高风险声明，同时保持骨干模型参数冻结。
AI.result: 在图像到文本、图像+文本到文本、音频到文本和视频到文本四个跨模态路径上的实验表明，TIGER在保持任务质量的同时有效减少了不支持内容；在多骨干模型上均取得增益，且CrisisFACTS案例研究显示该机制能改善多源场景中的基础性。
AI.conclusion: TIGER通过图结构的解耦设计和风险导向的定位修复策略，在温和假设下实现了预期总风险的几何级收敛，为多模态生成的事实级修复提供了理论保障和实证验证。

title: Scalable Concurrent Queues for GPU
summary: Concurrent queues can significantly impact supercomputing performance by being critical bottlenecks for task distribution, load balancing, and resource utilization. As HPC systems move beyond 10-million processor cores, the ability to rapidly move items between producer and consumer threads without excessive locking is essential for efficient queues, preventing idle cores, maximizing utilization, and achieving high parallel speedup. While concurrent queues are well studied on CPUs, they remain largely unexplored on modern GPUs, where SIMT execution, massive parallelism, and atomic contention reshape the design space. We present three linearizable GPU concurrent queues spanning from lock-free to wait-free guarantees: (1) G-WFQ-YMC, an adaptation of Yang and Mellor-Crummey's wait-free queue using preallocated segments; (2) G-LFQ, a bounded lock-free queue that uses wave-batched fast paths to maximize throughput; and (3) G-WFQ, a bounded wait-free queue that packs shared state into 64-bit compare-and-swap operations while preserving linearizability and bounded memory.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高性能计算系统中GPU并发队列设计空白，提出了三种线性化的GPU并发队列，涵盖从无锁到无等待的不同保证级别。
AI.motivation: 并发队列是超算性能的关键瓶颈，影响任务分发、负载均衡和资源利用。随着HPC系统扩展至千万级处理器核心，快速移动数据项而不产生过度锁竞争至关重要。虽然CPU上的并发队列已得到充分研究，但现代GPU上的并发队列设计因SIMT执行、大规模并行和原子争用等因素仍处于未探索状态。
AI.method: 提出了三种线性化GPU并发队列：(1) G-WFQ-YMC，基于Yang和Mellor-Crummey的无等待队列，采用预分配段设计；(2) G-LFQ，有界无锁队列，使用波浪批量快速路径最大化吞吐量；(3) G-WFQ，有界无等待队列，将共享状态打包到64位CAS操作中，同时保持线性化和有界内存特性。
AI.result: 成功设计了三种跨越不同并发保证级别（从无锁到无等待）的GPU并发队列，每种队列都针对GPU的SIMT执行模型和大规模并行特性进行了优化设计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了GPU并发队列设计的空白，为千万级处理器核心的HPC系统提供了高效、低争用的并发队列解决方案，有助于避免核心空闲、最大化资源利用率并实现高并行加速比。

title: Agentic-J: An AI Agent for Biological Microscopy Image Analysis
comment: Presented at Cell Biology at Scale 2026 (Poster). The Agentic-J project is available at https://mmv-lab.github.io/Agentic-J/
summary: Biological image analysis increasingly demands integration across heterogeneous tools, programming environments, and domain knowledge that few researchers can command simultaneously. We present Agentic-J, a containerised, multi-agent AI assistant, primarily for ImageJ/Fiji that enables biologists to specify analysis tasks in natural language, from nuclei segmentation and cell tracking to multi-condition quantification. The agent generates executable scripts organised into a documented project structure, so every analysis decision is traceable and the workflow can be reproduced or shared. The specialised sub-agents handle plugin management, code generation, debugging, quality assurance, and statistical reporting. In this paper we introduce the system's design, demonstrate real biological microscopy image analysis workflows, and detailed the technical implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Agentic-J，一个针对ImageJ/Fiji的容器化多智能体AI助手，使生物学家能够用自然语言指定图像分析任务，并生成可追溯、可复现的分析流程。
AI.motivation: 生物图像分析日益需要整合异构工具、编程环境和领域知识，但很少有研究人员能同时掌握这些技能，这造成了技术壁垒。
AI.method: 设计了一个容器化的多智能体AI助手系统Agentic-J，包含专门处理插件管理、代码生成、调试、质量保证和统计报告的子智能体，能够将自然语言任务转换为可执行脚本和有文档记录的项目结构。
AI.result: 成功实现了自然语言驱动的生物显微图像分析工作流程，包括细胞核分割、细胞追踪和多条件定量分析，生成的分析决策可追溯，工作流程可复现或共享。
AI.conclusion: Agentic-J通过多智能体协作降低了生物图像分析的技术门槛，使生物学家能够专注于科学问题而非编程细节，提高了研究的可复现性和协作效率。

title: Emergence of Exploration in Policy Gradient Reinforcement Learning via Retrying
summary: In reinforcement learning (RL), agents benefit from exploration only because they repeatedly encounter similar states: trying different actions can improve performance or reduce uncertainty; without such retries, a greedy policy is optimal. We formalize this intuition with ReMax, an objective that evaluates a policy by the expected maximum return over $M$ samples, where $M$ is a positive integer, while accounting for return uncertainty. Optimizing this objective induces stochastic exploration as an emergent property, without explicit bonus terms. For efficient policy optimization, we derive a new policy-gradient formulation for ReMax and introduce ReMax PPO (RePPO), a PPO variant that optimizes ReMax while generalizing the discrete retry count $M$ to a continuous parameter $m > 0$, enabling fine-grained control of exploration. Empirically, RePPO promotes exploration, without any explicit exploration bonuses, on the MinAtar and Craftax benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMax目标和RePPO算法，通过期望最大回报实现无需显式探索奖励的随机性探索。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中探索的价值源于对相似状态的重复访问，若无重试机制，贪婪策略即为最优。现有方法通常依赖显式探索奖励，缺乏对探索本质的形式化理解。
AI.method: 提出ReMax目标函数，评估策略在M次采样中的期望最大回报并考虑回报不确定性；推导其策略梯度公式，开发RePPO算法，将离散重试次数M推广为连续参数m以精细控制探索程度。
AI.result: 在MinAtar和Craftax基准测试中，RePPO在无显式探索奖励的情况下有效促进了探索行为。
AI.conclusion: ReMax提供了一种新的探索范式，通过优化目标函数自然诱导随机性探索，为无奖励探索提供了理论基础和实用算法。

title: MindZero: Learning Online Mental Reasoning With Zero Annotations
summary: Effective real-world assistance requires AI agents with robust Theory of Mind (ToM): inferring human mental states from their behavior. Despite recent advances, several key challenges remain, including (1) online inference with robust uncertainty updates over multiple hypotheses; (2) efficient reasoning suitable for real-time assistance; and (3) the lack of ground-truth mental state annotations in real-world domains. We address these challenges by introducing MindZero, a self-supervised reinforcement learning framework that trains multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for efficient and robust online mental reasoning. During training, the model is rewarded for generating mental state hypotheses that maximize the likelihood of observed actions estimated by a planner, similar to model-based ToM reasoning. This method thus eliminates the need for explicit mental state annotations. After training, MindZero internalizes model-based reasoning into fast single-pass inference. We evaluate MindZero against baselines across challenging mental reasoning and AI assistance tasks in gridworld and household domains. We found that LLMs alone are insufficient; model-based methods improve accuracy but are slow, costly, and limited by backbone MLLM capacity. In contrast, MindZero enhances MLLMs' intrinsic ToM ability and significantly outperforms model-based methods in both accuracy and efficiency, showing that mental reasoning can be effectively learned as a self-supervised skill.

AI.tldr: 提出了MindZero框架，通过自监督强化学习训练多模态大语言模型，实现高效且鲁棒的在线心理推理，在准确性和效率上均优于纯模型方法。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理的心理理论（ToM）推理面临三个关键挑战：1）需要对多假设进行鲁棒不确定性更新的在线推理；2）适合实时辅助的高效推理；3）现实领域缺乏心理状态的真实标注。这些限制阻碍了AI在现实场景中有效辅助人类。
AI.method: 提出MindZero自监督强化学习框架：在训练阶段，模型因生成能最大化规划器估计的观察动作可能性的心理状态假设而获得奖励，类似基于模型的ToM推理，从而无需显式的心理状态标注。训练后，MindZero将基于模型的推理内化为快速的单次前向推理。
AI.result: 在网格世界和家庭领域的心理推理和AI辅助任务中评估显示：纯LLM能力不足；基于模型的方法虽提高准确性但速度慢、成本高且受限于骨干MLLM能力；MindZero在准确性和效率上均显著优于基于模型的方法。
AI.conclusion: 心理推理可以有效地作为自监督技能进行学习，MindZero成功增强了MLLM的内在ToM能力，证明了该方法在AI辅助应用中的实用价值。

title: Night-Window Batching versus Carbon-Aware Scheduling for Clinical AI GPU Workloads
comment: International Conference on Technological Intelligence and Business Strategies (TIBS 2026)
summary: Hospitals run more machine learning on GPUs while the carbon footprint of grid electricity rises and falls through the day. Using a computer simulation, we compare $13$ scheduling rules on mixed GPU hardware, with synthetic patient-style jobs, urgency tiers, and time-of-day carbon traces. We do not study patient outcomes; every percentage we report is a simulator queue number, not a clinical finding. We ask whether running non-urgent jobs overnight is almost as good as a richer rule that mixes urgency and carbon (CUCA at weight 0.45, written CUCA$_{0.45}$). The comparison keeps carbon reduction secondary to clinical priority and deadline compliance, so each policy is judged on both average kg CO$_2$e and missed-deadline behavior. CarbonGreedy and CarbonShift are carbon-first stress tests that demonstrate how poorly wrong vendor presets can disrupt clinical priorities, and are not meant for production. Numbers are averages over many test settings, with wide run-to-run spread and no statistical adjustment, so headline ratios are exploratory. On an eight-GPU baseline, the overnight rule closes about $78\%$ of the carbon gap between urgency-only and CUCA$_{0.45}$ while missing fewer urgent deadlines than either. CarbonShift lets about $46\%$ of the most urgent jobs miss their deadline; this is simulated queueing, not bedside harm. At $48$ jobs per hour, the carbon footprints almost tie, yet the overnight rule still misses fewer urgent deadlines. A geography test, where regions share one daily carbon shape with only timezone shifts, trims under one percentage point of average carbon; a twelve-hour routine window saves a little carbon for CUCA$_{0.45}$ but raises overall missed deadlines. Overnight batching stays competitive on average modelled carbon; carbon-only rules belong only in stress tests.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过计算机模拟评估了医院GPU机器学习任务的调度策略，发现简单的"夜间运行非紧急任务"规则能关闭78%的碳减排差距（相比更复杂的CUCA调度），同时保持更好的紧急任务截止期限合规性。以碳减排为首要目标的策略会严重影响临床优先级。
AI.motivation: 医院在GPU上运行越来越多的机器学习任务，而电网电力的碳足迹在一天中存在波动。需要在保持临床优先级和截止期限合规的前提下，探索能够减少碳排放的任务调度策略。
AI.method: 使用计算机模拟方法，比较了13种调度规则在混合GPU硬件上的表现。采用合成患者式任务、紧急等级分层和日内碳足迹追踪数据。以碳减排为次要目标，临床优先级和截止期限合规为主要约束，评估各策略的平均碳排放量(kg CO₂e)和错失截止期限情况。
AI.result: 在八GPU基线设置下，夜间运行规则关闭了约78%的碳减排差距（介于仅考虑紧急性与CUCA₀.₄₅之间），且错失的紧急截止期限更少。以碳为先的策略（如CarbonShift）导致46%的最紧急任务错失截止期限。在48任务/小时的负载下，碳足迹几乎持平但夜间规则仍有更好的截止期限表现。地理区域测试（仅时区偏移）仅减少不到1%的平均碳排放。
AI.conclusion: 夜间批处理策略在平均建模碳排放方面保持竞争力，同时更好地保护临床优先级。纯碳优先策略仅适用于压力测试，不应在生产环境中使用。简单的夜间运行策略可以成为复杂调度算法的有效替代方案。

title: A Game-Theoretic Decision Framework for Optimal Selection of Coordination Detection Methods in Multi-UAV Fleet Operations
summary: Detecting coordination among unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) fleets operating in shared airspace and identifying the route-lead aircraft whose navigation decisions govern fleet behavior presents a fundamental speed--accuracy trade-off: fast methods enable real-time traffic management but sacrifice detection fidelity, while accurate methods may exceed the time budget for actionable airspace deconfliction. This paper presents a game-theoretic decision framework that resolves this trade-off by formulating method selection as a two-player zero-sum game between a Monitor (selecting computational methods and parameters) and Nature (selecting the unknown traffic scenario). We construct an end-to-end pipeline from trajectory surveillance data through eight candidate detection algorithms, a Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis characterizing their stochastic performance, and finally a multi-objective optimization layer that identifies Pareto-optimal method portfolios. The minimax solution provides a robust mixed strategy with a probability distribution over methods that guarantees worst-case performance regardless of scenario uncertainty. Experimental evaluation across 200 randomized configurations spanning 5--50 aircraft demonstrates that the framework recommends distinct method portfolios depending on operational priority: Koopman Phase dominates balanced (70.6%) and speed-priority (79.7%) profiles, while CRQA emerges as primary (47.4%) when route-lead identification is prioritized. The framework achieves a guaranteed game value of 0.29--0.53 (normalized utility) across all tested preference profiles, providing the first principled, scenario-adaptive methodology for computational method selection in UTM fleet monitoring operations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种博弈论决策框架，解决了无人机群协调检测和领航机识别中的速度-精度权衡问题，通过零和博弈方法为不同运营优先级推荐最优的计算方法组合。
AI.motivation: 在共享空域的无人机群监控中，现有的检测方法存在速度-精度权衡困境：快速方法牺牲检测保真度，而高精度方法可能超出实时空域冲突规避的时间预算，缺乏一种能够自适应选择最优计算方法的系统化方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个端到端的博弈论决策框架：(1)将方法选择建模为监控者与自然之间的两人零和博弈；(2)设计包含八种候选检测算法的流水线；(3)通过蒙特卡洛敏感性分析刻画算法的随机性能；(4)采用多目标优化识别帕累托最优方法组合；(5)求解极小极大解获得鲁棒的混合策略，给出在各种场景不确定性下保证最坏情况性能的方法概率分布。
AI.result: 在200个随机配置（5-50架飞机）的实验评估中，框架根据运营优先级推荐不同的方法组合：Koopman Phase在平衡型(70.6%)和速度优先型(79.7%)场景中占主导地位，而CRQA在领航机识别优先场景中成为主要方法(47.4%)。框架在所有测试偏好配置下实现了0.29-0.53的保证博弈值（归一化效用）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次为UTM机群监控操作中的计算方法选择提供了原理性、场景自适应的方法论，通过博弈论方法有效解决了速度-精度权衡问题，为实时空域管理提供了理论保障的决策支持。

title: ChurnNet: A Optimized Modern AI for Churn Prediction
summary: Increased competition and the growing similarity of products and services offered by retailers have lowered the barriers for customers to switch to competitors. Accurate churn prediction can be a valuable tool for driving effective personalized marketing campaigns and helping to reduce customer attrition. This study evaluates the performance of traditional machine learning techniques, namely, Random Forests, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machines, and compares them with the Unified Multi-Task Time Series Model for churn prediction, a binary time-series classification task. Despite the strong capacity of the latter to model complex temporal dynamics and inter-variable relationships, our results indicate that for churn prediction, conventional methods can still outperform it in terms of predictive performance, data efficiency, and computational resource requirements for training and deployment. These findings are consistent across multiple datasets and various churn labeling techniques.

AI.tldr: 在客户流失预测任务中，传统机器学习方法（随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量机）在预测性能、数据效率和计算资源需求方面均优于统一多任务时间序列模型。
AI.motivation: 由于零售商之间竞争加剧且产品服务日趋同质化，客户流失风险上升。准确的流失预测对于制定有效的个性化营销活动、降低客户流失率具有重要价值。
AI.method: 对比评估传统机器学习技术（随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量机）与统一多任务时间序列模型在流失预测这一二分类时间序列任务上的表现，并在多个数据集及多种流失标签技术下进行验证。
AI.result: 尽管统一多任务时间序列模型具备建模复杂时间动态和变量间关系的能力，但实验结果表明，传统方法在预测性能、数据效率以及训练部署的计算资源需求方面均表现更优，且该结论在不同数据集和标签技术下保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 对于客户流失预测任务，传统机器学习方法仍具有显著优势，不应被复杂的时间序列模型盲目替代；在追求高效、低耗的预测方案时，传统方法是更优选择。

title: Geodesic Flow Matching for Denoising High-Dimensional Structured Representations
summary: Vector Symbolic Algebras (VSAs) enable robust neurosymbolic reasoning by encoding symbolic information into high-dimensional distributed representations. For continuous domains, Spatial Semantic Pointers (SSPs) extend this framework by mapping variables onto continuous toroidal manifolds. However, standard approaches like Flow Matching assume a flat Euclidean geometry, which fails to account for the geometric constraints imposed on valid SSP states. We demonstrate that this assumption fails for SSPs: Euclidean linear interpolants ``cut through" the manifold's interior, destroying the phase and magnitude structure required for accurate decoding. To resolve this, we employ Geodesic Flow Matching, adapting Riemannian transport dynamics to strictly restrict the denoising flow to the SSP toroidal manifold. We validate this approach in a Spiking Neural SLAM system, showing that manifold-aware cleanup stabilizes path integration against drift. The method achieves a 72\% reduction in tracking error and enables a 40\% increase in neural efficiency compared to competitive baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/kremHabashy/CleanupSSP .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了测地流匹配方法，通过将去噪流限制在SSP环面流形上，解决了传统欧氏几何方法在向量符号代数中破坏编码结构的问题，在脉冲神经SLAM系统中实现了跟踪误差降低72%和神经效率提升40%。
AI.motivation: 传统的流匹配方法假设平坦的欧氏几何，忽略了空间语义指针(SSP)在环面流形上的几何约束。欧氏线性插值会“穿过”流形内部，破坏相位和幅度结构，导致解码不准确。
AI.method: 提出测地流匹配方法，将黎曼传输动力学适配到SSP环面流形上，严格限制去噪流在有效SSP状态空间内，实现流形感知的清理机制。
AI.result: 在脉冲神经SLAM系统验证中，该方法相比竞争基线实现了跟踪误差降低72%，神经效率提升40%，有效稳定了路径积分过程中的漂移问题。
AI.conclusion: 流形感知的几何约束对向量符号代数的连续域建模至关重要，该方法成功解决了传统欧氏几何假设的局限性，为神经符号推理提供了更稳健的框架。

title: Beyond Augmentation: Score-Guided Pathological Prior for EEG-based Depression Detection
summary:
Deep learning-based Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) detection using Electroencephalography (EEG) is fundamentally constrained by the "small-sample dilemma." Prevailing generative data augmentation methods not only incur heavy computational overhead but also risk introducing synthetic noise, thereby blurring classification boundaries. To challenge the traditional "data quantity first" convention, we propose a novel framework "Beyond Augmentation": Score-Guided Classification (SGC). SGC does not synthesize pseudo-samples; instead, it utilizes an unsupervised generative network architecture to model the structural and statistical anomaly degrees of samples, serving as the core "Pathological Prior". This prior, after robust normalization, is explicitly fused with deep feature representations, thereby precisely guiding the classifier's decision boundary. Furthermore, to dynamically adapt to varying channel configurations, we propose a Cross-Channel Spatial Adaptation module, utilizing a spatial mapping mechanism to effectively resolve the hardware heterogeneity of mismatched channels in multi-center datasets. Extensive experiments on the Mumtaz2016 and high-density MODMA datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and exceptional generalizability of our method under the challenging "zero data augmentation" setting and at "zero sample synthesis cost".
  Keywords: Electroencephalography (EEG), Depression Detection, Anomaly Score, Diffusion Models, Few-Shot Learning

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SGC框架，通过建模样本异常程度作为病理先验来指导分类，在零数据增强条件下有效解决了EEG抑郁检测的小样本问题，无需合成伪样本。
AI.motivation: 基于深度学习的EEG抑郁检测面临"小样本困境"，现有生成式数据增强方法计算开销大且可能引入合成噪声，模糊分类边界。作者旨在挑战传统"数据量优先"的惯例，探索无需数据增强的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出"超越增强"框架SGC：1) 利用无监督生成网络建模样本的结构和统计异常程度，作为核心"病理先验"；2) 将鲁棒归一化后的先验与深度特征显式融合，精确引导分类器决策边界；3) 设计跨通道空间适应模块，通过空间映射机制解决多中心数据集的通道不匹配硬件异质性问题。
AI.result: 在Mumtaz2016和高密度MODMA数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在挑战性的"零数据增强"设置和"零样本合成成本"条件下，展现出有效性和卓越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SGC框架成功突破了传统数据增强范式的局限，证明了通过病理先验引导而非数据量堆叠来解决小样本问题的可行性，为EEG抑郁检测提供了新思路，并具有优异的泛化性能。

title: Capability Self-Assessment: Teaching LLMs to Know Their Limits
summary: The ability to recognize one's own limitations and decide whether to solve a problem or delegate is fundamental for reliable intelligent systems. Yet we show that modern large language models systematically lack this ability: across diverse model families and scales, they overestimate their competence and attempt queries they cannot solve. We refer to this ability as Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) and formulate it as a policy-learning problem, aiming to improve self-assessment while preserving the model's original capabilities. Our results show that reinforcement learning teaches CSA effectively, significantly outperforming supervised fine-tuning while preserving original capabilities. In contrast, supervised fine-tuning severely degrades the capabilities the model is meant to assess. Moreover, learned self-assessment behavior generalizes well out of distribution, suggesting that CSA is a transferable model trait. Finally, CSA is practically useful: it improves local-cloud decision making at inference time and provides a signal for targeted data selection during training.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型存在系统性能力自我评估缺陷，强化学习能有效改善该问题且优于监督微调。
AI.motivation: 可靠智能系统需要具备识别自身局限性并决定自主解决或委托的能力，但现代大语言模型在此方面存在系统性缺陷，倾向于高估自身能力并尝试处理无法解决的问题。
AI.method: 将能力自我评估(CSA)构建为策略学习问题，采用强化学习方法进行训练，旨在改善自我评估能力的同时保持模型原有能力。
AI.result: 强化学习能有效教会CSA能力，显著优于监督微调方法，且能保持模型原有能力；而监督微调会严重损害模型本应评估的能力。学习到的自我评估行为在分布外泛化良好，表明CSA是一种可迁移的模型特性。
AI.conclusion: CSA具有实际应用价值：可改善推理时的本地-云端决策，并为训练时的定向数据选择提供信号。

title: Parallelizing Large-Scale Tensor Network Contraction on Multiple GPUs
summary: Exact tensor network contraction underpins quantum circuit simulation, quantum error correction, combinatorial optimization, and many-body dynamics. The dominant parallelization strategy, slicing, scales exponentially and incurs redundant computation. We present a multi-GPU framework that instead distributes intermediate tensors across devices with explicit communication, converting a fixed contraction path into a communication-efficient schedule via GEMM-oriented mode reordering and communication-aware mode distribution planning. Within a single DGX H100 node (8 GPUs, NVLink), distribution delivers $7$--$173\times$ extra speedup beyond embarrassingly parallel slicing, capturing nearly all of the available compute reduction (87--101%) because NVLink's high bandwidth keeps communication small relative to compute. Scaling the same four workloads to 1024 H100 GPUs over InfiniBand, the extra speedup beyond slicing ranges from $42\times$ to $67{,}869\times$, demonstrating that communication-aware distributed contraction far surpasses slicing-based scaling limits for frontier tensor networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于中间张量分布式存储和多GPU显式通信的张量网络收缩框架，在单节点8 GPU上相对切片方法获得7-173倍加速，在1024 GPU上获得42-67869倍加速，显著突破了切片方法的扩展性限制。
AI.motivation: 现有的张量网络收缩并行化主要依赖切片（slicing）策略，该方法存在指数级扩展开销和冗余计算的问题，难以高效扩展到大规模并行计算。
AI.method: 提出一种多GPU框架，通过显式通信将中间张量分布到不同设备上，利用面向GEMM的模式重排序和通信感知的模式分布规划，将固定收缩路径转换为通信高效的调度方案。
AI.result: 在单个DGX H100节点（8个GPU，NVLink互连）上，相比尴尬并行切片获得7-173倍额外加速，捕获了87-101%的可用计算减少量；扩展到1024个H100 GPU（InfiniBand互连）时，相比切片获得42-67,869倍的额外加速。
AI.conclusion: 通信感知的分布式张量网络收缩方法能够显著超越基于切片方法的扩展限制，NVLink的高带宽使得通信开销相对于计算保持较小，该方法适用于前沿张量网络计算。

title: Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Tree search is a central abstraction behind many language-agent reasoning and decision-making tasks: agents must explore actions, remember failures, and backtrack toward promising alternatives. Yet, we lack a theoretical understanding of how transformer-based policies acquire such search capabilities from the training dynamics of reinforcement learning (RL). We study this question in a stochastic $k$-ary tree environment, where an agentic transformer observes only its trajectory history through interaction and receives a terminal reward for reaching a hidden leaf goal node. We first construct a two-head transformer that implements randomized depth-first search (DFS): one head tracks previous actions, while the other detects failure outcomes and triggers backtracking. We then analyze the training dynamics of policy gradient under a depth-wise curriculum, showing that this same DFS mechanism emerges in stages from sparse reinforcement feedback without expert demonstrations. The resulting policy exhibits depth generalization: after training only on depth-$1$ and depth-$2$ trees, it succeeds on deeper full trees. We further show that, under imbalanced goal distributions, discounting the return leads to a ranked DFS policy that prioritizes higher-probability branches. Overall, our results identify a mechanistic normal form for transformer-based search, in which attention heads specialize and cooperate to extract decision-relevant traces from context and convert them into agentic action selection via RL training.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了Transformer策略如何通过强化学习训练自发涌现出树搜索能力，证明了注意力头可以特化并协作实现深度优先搜索机制，并在有限训练下实现泛化。
AI.motivation: 树搜索是语言智能体推理与决策的核心抽象，但目前缺乏理论理解：基于Transformer的策略如何从强化学习训练动态中获得搜索能力。作者旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 在随机k-ary树环境中研究该问题，智能体仅观察轨迹历史并获得终端奖励。首先构建双头Transformer实现随机深度优先搜索(DFS)：一个头追踪先前动作，另一个检测失败并触发回溯。随后分析策略梯度在深度课程下的训练动态。
AI.result: DFS机制从稀疏强化反馈中分阶段涌现，无需专家演示。策略具备深度泛化能力：仅在深度1和深度2树上训练后，能在更深的完整树上成功。在不平衡目标分布下，回报折现引导策略形成优先搜索高概率分支的排序DFS。
AI.conclusion: 识别出基于Transformer搜索的机制范式：注意力头特化并协作从上下文中提取决策相关轨迹，通过RL训练将其转化为智能体动作选择，为理解语言模型搜索能力提供了理论基础。

title: Closed-Loop Neural Activation Control in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF CVPR 2026 Workshop on Visual Concepts (VisCon). 25 pages, 8 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can be steered at test time by intervening on semantically meaningful internal directions, but existing methods use a fixed steering coefficient, effectively operating in open loop. This is poorly suited to embodied control, where task state and concept error evolve over time, often causing overcorrection, oscillation, and reduced task success, especially for temporal behaviors such as speed and smoothness. We propose CTRL-STEER, a closed-loop framework that replaces static intervention strength with adaptive, time-varying control signals. The key idea is to decouple representation from regulation: rather than assuming temporal concepts are directly controlled by individual neurons, we steer along motion-aligned residual directions while a feedback controller adjusts intervention magnitude online. We instantiate this framework with both PID and reinforcement learning based controllers. Experiments with a fine-tuned OpenVLA policy on four LIBERO task suites show that CTRL-STEER achieves more stable concept regulation and a better steering-task success trade-off than fixed-coefficient baselines, without modifying or retraining the base model.

AI.tldr: 提出CTRL-STEER框架，用闭环自适应控制信号替代固定系数，解决VLA模型在具身控制任务中因开环干预导致的过矫正、振荡和任务成功率下降问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型推理时干预方法采用固定转向系数，本质上是开环操作。这不适合具身控制任务，因为任务状态和概念误差随时间动态变化，常导致过矫正、振荡以及任务成功率降低，特别是对于速度和平滑性等时间相关的行为。
AI.method: 提出CTRL-STEER闭环框架，核心思想是将表示与调节解耦：不假设时间概念由单个神经元直接控制，而是沿运动对齐的残差方向进行转向，同时由反馈控制器在线调整干预强度。实现了基于PID和强化学习的两种控制器实例。
AI.result: 在四个LIBERO任务套件上，使用微调的OpenVLA策略进行实验，结果表明CTRL-STEER相比固定系数基线实现了更稳定的概念调节和更好的转向-任务成功权衡，且无需修改或重新训练基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 闭环自适应干预框架能够有效提升VLA模型在具身控制任务中的干预稳定性和任务成功率，为无需重训练的推理时模型控制提供了有效解决方案。

title: Boosting Multimodal Federated Learning via Chained Modality Optimization
summary: Multimodal Federated Learning (MMFL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative learning across decentralized clients with heterogeneous data and modality availability. However, most existing MMFL methods cast multimodal training as a joint optimization problem, overlooking a key bottleneck: modality competition, where dominant modalities suppress weaker ones and lead to suboptimal global models. To address this, we propose FedMChain, a balanced MMFL framework that structures federated multimodal training as a chain of modality-wise phases. This phase-wise design gives each modality a dedicated local optimization window on multimodal clients to mitigate modality competition, and further promotes cross-modal complementarity via an error-compensated regularizer. On the server side, we employ a sparse sign-guided aggregation strategy that leverages directional sign agreement for robust intra-modality aggregation, avoids destructive averaging, and supports less frequent synchronization to reduce communication overhead. Extensive experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that FedMChain consistently improves predictive performance while requiring less frequent communication than baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FedMChain框架，通过阶段式训练缓解多模态联邦学习中的模态竞争问题，并利用稀疏符号引导聚合策略提升模型性能与通信效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态联邦学习方法通常将多模态训练视为联合优化问题，忽略了模态竞争这一关键瓶颈，即主导模态会抑制弱势模态，导致全局模型性能欠佳。
AI.method: 提出FedMChain框架，将联邦多模态训练构建为按模态划分的阶段链式结构，为每个模态分配专属的本地优化窗口以缓解模态竞争，并通过误差补偿正则化项促进跨模态互补性；在服务器端采用稀疏符号引导聚合策略，利用方向符号一致性实现稳健的模态内聚合，避免破坏性平均并支持低频同步以降低通信开销。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，FedMChain在预测性能上持续优于基线方法，同时支持更低频率的模型同步，显著降低了通信成本。
AI.conclusion: FedMChain通过阶段式训练与稀疏符号引导聚合有效解决了MMFL中的模态竞争与通信效率问题，为异构数据与模态缺失场景下的隐私保护协同学习提供了高效解决方案。

title: When Parallelism Pays Off: Cohesion-Aware Task Partitioning for Multi-Agent Coding
summary:
Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems offer a way to decompose complex tasks, such as coding, through parallelization and context isolation. However, adding agents in practice introduces inter-agent communication overhead, which incurs extra cost and can sometimes offset the efficiency gains. We formalize multi-agent orchestration as a graph partitioning problem that captures the communication-to-computation trade-off: task decomposition can shorten critical-path computation, but cross-agent dependencies require costly context transfer. We instantiate this view in repository-level software engineering and present Cohesion-aware Coder (Co-Coder), which builds dependency graphs from static analysis, isolates structural hub files, partitions the graph via community detection, and executes the partition with a dependency-aware scheduler.
  Across 28 real-world tasks on DevEval and CodeProjectEval, Co-Coder advances the Pareto-frontier over sequential and file-based parallel baselines as well as Claude Code with Agent Teams, lifting pass rate by up to 14.0%, achieving up to a 2.10x wall-clock speedup, and reducing API cost by up to 35%, with the largest gains on the most dependency-dense projects. Co-coder demonstrates how cohesion-aware orchestration can make parallel coding agents both theoretically grounded and practically efficient, suggesting a broader design principle for multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Co-Coder，一种基于内聚感知的多智能体LLM编排方法，通过将任务分解形式化为图划分问题来平衡通信与计算开销，在代码任务上实现了最高14.0%通过率提升、2.10倍加速和35%成本降低。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统虽然能通过并行化和上下文隔离分解复杂任务，但在实践中增加智能体会引入智能体间通信开销，这种额外成本有时会抵消效率增益。现有方法缺乏对通信-计算权衡的有效建模和优化。
AI.method: 将多智能体编排形式化为图划分问题；通过静态分析构建依赖图；隔离结构性中心文件；采用社区检测算法划分图；使用依赖感知调度器执行划分后的任务。该方法捕获了任务分解可缩短关键路径计算但跨智能体依赖需要昂贵上下文传输的权衡关系。
AI.result: 在DevEval和CodeProjectEval的28个真实任务上，Co-Coder在帕累托前沿上超越顺序执行、基于文件的并行基线以及Claude Code with Agent Teams：通过率提升最高14.0%，墙钟时间加速最高2.10倍，API成本降低最高35%，在依赖最密集的项目上收益最大。
AI.conclusion: Co-Coder证明了内聚感知编排能使并行编码智能体在理论上更有基础且在实践中更高效，为多智能体系统提出了更广泛的设计原则，即需要显式建模和优化通信-计算权衡。

title: AI-Guided Design and Optimization of Graphite-Based Anodes via Iterative Experimental Feedback
summary: This study presents an iterative AI-guided workflow that accelerates graphite-based anode development by improving both formulation feasibility and process robustness. Sequential learning via AI/ML-guided multiobjective inverse design for anode optimization was implemented using the Citrine Platform. Starting from a noisy, incomplete dataset, the Citrine Platform was used to generate early surrogate models, which despite low predictive certainty highlighted missing process constraints. By iteratively adding feasibility labels and boundary condition failures, the workflow rapidly converged toward manufacturable, higher-performing formulations. Fabrication reliability improved from frequent process failures to 100% successful cell production, while the fraction of cells delivering $\geq$ 350 mAh g$^{-1}$ increased from 28.4% to 84.8%, with capacity retention rising from 42.1% to 97.3%. These results demonstrate that structured, feedback-driven AI workflows can transform imperfect industrial data into actionable guidance, enabling faster, more reproducible optimization of battery electrode manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了AI引导的迭代工作流程，显著加速了石墨基负极材料的开发，实现了100%的成功制造率，并将高性能电池单元比例从28.4%提升至84.8%，容量保持率从42.1%提升至97.3%。
AI.motivation: 传统电池电极制造依赖试错法，面临配方可行性低、工艺鲁棒性差的问题。工业数据通常存在噪声大、不完整等缺陷，难以直接用于优化。研究旨在利用AI/ML方法，将不完美的工业数据转化为可操作的指导，加速电池电极材料的开发与优化。
AI.method: 采用基于Citrine平台的AI/ML引导的多目标逆向设计方法，实施序列学习策略。从噪声大、不完整的数据集出发，构建早期代理模型；通过迭代添加可行性标签和边界条件失效信息，逐步收敛至可制造、高性能的配方。整个工作流程采用结构化的反馈驱动机制。
AI.result: 制造可靠性大幅提升，工艺失败率从频繁失败降至100%成功生产电池单元。放电比容量≥350 mAh g⁻¹的电池单元占比从28.4%提升至84.8%，容量保持率从42.1%提高至97.3%。工作流程能够从不完美的工业数据中快速提取可制造的优化配方。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的反馈驱动AI工作流程能够有效转化不完美的工业数据为可操作的优化指导，实现电池电极制造的快速、可重复优化。该工作流程有望推广至其他材料开发领域，提高研发效率和成功率。

title: Robust Shielding for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Shielding is an effective approach to formally guarantee the safety of reinforcement learning agents in Markov decision processes (MDPs). However, existing shielding techniques typically assume knowledge of the safety-relevant transition dynamics - a requirement that is seldom met in practice. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel shielding framework for robust MDPs (RMDPs), i.e., MDPs with sets of transition probabilities. We define safety as the satisfaction of a linear temporal logic (LTL) formula with a certain threshold probability under the worst-case transition probabilities of the RMDP. We prove that our shielding framework is both sound and optimal for the RMDP: every policy admissible by the shield is safe, and conversely, every safe RMDP policy is admissible by the shield. We combine our approach with existing sampling methods for learning transition probabilities of MDPs with probably approximately correct (PAC) guarantees. This combination enables the construction of shields for MDPs that, with high confidence, guarantee safety while remaining minimally restrictive. Our experiments show that our shields for learned RMDPs guarantee safety in unknown MDPs while recovering strong expected return as the number of samples increases.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程(RMDP)的新型屏蔽框架，无需预先知道安全相关的转移动力学，能够为未知MDP中的强化学习智能体提供安全保证。
AI.motivation: 现有的屏蔽技术通常假设已知安全相关的转移动力学，但这一要求在实际中很少满足。为了解决这一局限性，需要开发能够在转移概率未知的情况下保证安全性的屏蔽方法。
AI.method: 1. 为鲁棒MDP(RMDP，即具有转移概率集合的MDP)引入屏蔽框架；2. 将安全性定义为在RMDP最坏情况转移概率下以特定阈值概率满足线性时序逻辑(LTL)公式；3. 将该方法与现有的采样方法结合，用于学习具有概率近似正确(PAC)保证的MDP转移概率；4. 构建对学习到的RMDP有效的屏蔽器。
AI.result: 1. 证明了屏蔽框架对RMDP是可靠且最优的：每个被屏蔽器允许的策略都是安全的，反之，每个安全的RMDP策略都能被屏蔽器允许；2. 结合采样方法能够以高置信度保证安全，同时保持最小限制性；3. 实验表明，为学习到的RMDP构建的屏蔽器能够在未知MDP中保证安全，并且随着样本数量增加能够恢复强期望回报。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功解决了现有屏蔽技术需要预知转移动力学的限制，通过结合鲁棒MDP建模和PAC学习理论，实现了在未知环境中为强化学习智能体提供形式化安全保证的目标。

title: Scaling LLM Inference Beyond Amdahl`s Limits via Eliminating Non-Scalable Overheads
summary: Deployers of online LLM services usually seek to maximize cluster-wide performance given a fixed number of GPUs. Tensor parallelism (TP) is necessary to fit modern models but scales sub-linearly as the TP degree t grows, due to cross-GPU communication and non-scalable runtime work, as predicted by Amdahl's Law. Conversely, increasing t improves memory efficiency and alleviates KV-cache contention and swapping. We identify and validate an empirical optimal TP degree t_e that balances these effects. We present Albireo, a parallel inference system that raises the attainable t_e by shrinking the non-scalable portion via overlap of scheduling and I/O with compute and sequence-parallel sampling, without changing model architectures. Across models and benchmarks, Albireo achieves up to 1.9x higher throughput, 48% lower latency, 28% higher GPU utilization, and 54% lower energy than vLLM; in production it yields up to 2x higher throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Albireo系统，通过优化调度与计算重叠及序列并行采样来提高张量并行度，在不改变模型架构的情况下显著提升在线LLM服务的吞吐量、延迟和能效。
AI.motivation: 在线LLM服务部署中，张量并行（TP）是适配现代大模型的必要手段，但随着TP度增加，跨GPU通信和非可扩展运行时开销导致性能扩展呈次线性增长，同时增加TP度可改善内存效率并缓解KV缓存竞争。现有方法未能在两者间找到平衡点。
AI.method: 识别并验证经验最优TP度t_e，提出Albireo并行推理系统，通过调度与I/O操作同计算重叠，以及序列并行采样技术来缩减非可扩展部分，从而提升可达到的最优TP度，且不改变模型架构。
AI.result: 在多种模型和基准测试中，Albireo相比vLLM实现最高1.9倍吞吐量提升、48%延迟降低、28% GPU利用率提升和54%能耗降低；生产环境中吞吐量提升最高达2倍。
AI.conclusion: Albireo有效平衡了TP度增加带来的通信开销与内存效率改善，通过系统级优化显著提升了在线LLM服务的性能与能效，具有良好的实用价值。

title: Genotype-Conditioned Molecular Generation via Evidence-Grounded Multi-Objective Latent Perturbation in Diffusion Models
summary: Developing effective anticancer therapeutics remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity and the absence of well-defined molecular targets across cancer subtypes. Generative models conditioned on cancer genotypes offer a promising avenue for personalized drug discovery, yet existing approaches lack explicit optimization for simultaneous sensitivity, synthesizability, and mechanistic binding plausibility. We present a latent-space optimization approach for a pretrained genotype-to-drug diffusion model, introducing a learnable perturbation over the molecular latent space optimized via gradient ascent to maximize a composite reward combining predicted drug sensitivity (AUC), drug-likeness (QED), and synthetic accessibility (SAS). Critically, biological realism is enforced by grounding both reward design and evaluation in experimentally-derived cancer cell line data and validated pharmacologic signals, anchoring candidate generation in real-world clinical evidence. Mechanistic consistency plausibility is further assessed by a multi-agent LLM pipeline grounded in the diffusion model's attention mechanism. Experiments across 15 cancer cell lines from three held-out evaluation sets demonstrate consistent and noticeable improvements over competing baselines in sensitivity, drug-likeness, synthesizability, and chemical validity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对基因型到药物扩散模型的潜在空间优化方法，通过梯度上升优化复合奖励函数（药物敏感性、类药性、可合成性），在15个癌细胞系上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 由于肿瘤异质性和跨癌症亚型缺乏明确分子靶点，开发有效抗癌疗法仍然具有挑战性。现有基于癌症基因型的生成模型缺乏对敏感性、可合成性和机制结合合理性的同时显式优化。
AI.method: 对预训练的基因型到药物扩散模型进行潜在空间优化，引入分子潜在空间上的可学习扰动，通过梯度上升最大化复合奖励（预测药物敏感性AUC、类药性QED、合成可及性SAS）。通过基于实验癌细胞系数据和验证药理学信号的奖励设计和评估来确保生物学真实性，并通过基于扩散模型注意力机制的多智能体LLM管道评估机制一致性合理性。
AI.result: 在三个留出评估集的15个癌细胞系上的实验表明，该方法在敏感性、类药性、可合成性和化学有效性方面相比竞争基线有一致且显著的改进。
AI.conclusion: 该潜在空间优化方法成功解决了个性化药物发现中多目标优化的挑战，为基于基因型的抗癌药物设计提供了有效框架。

title: Learning to Construct Practical Agentic Systems
summary: Automated design and optimization of agentic LLM-based systems leads to sophisticated systems that substantially improve result quality over off-the-shelf agentic patterns. However, studies of fielded agentic systems show that production systems focus much more on issues such as simplicity, controllability, and predictability of inference costs. In this paper we propose principled approaches to designing and optimizing practical agentic systems. We describe an agent framework that enables designers to enforce modularity in agentic systems, by defining "pseudo-tools" that call LLMs recursively on a restricted context. Using this framework we hand-engineer agents for a diverse set of tasks, and show that relative to dynamically-planned workflows, hand-constructed fixed workflows are generally cheaper and more accurate. We then propose novel learning methods for the agentic components required by this framework, namely pseudo-tools and fixed workflows. These learning methods generally outperform hand-engineered agents. We also exploit the modularity of the framework to apply multi-objective optimization methods to jointly optimize cost and response quality and blend the results of multiple learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个模块化的智能体框架，通过定义“伪工具”来限制上下文递归调用LLM，证明手工构建的固定工作流比动态规划更高效准确，并提出新的学习方法优化这些组件，在成本和响应质量上均优于手工设计。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动化设计和优化方法虽然能提升结果质量，但在实际生产环境中，系统更关注简单性、可控性和推理成本的可预测性，而现有研究往往忽视了这些工程实践需求。
AI.method: 提出一个模块化的智能体框架，通过定义“伪工具”在受限上下文中递归调用LLM；手工构建固定工作流并与动态规划工作流对比；提出针对伪工具和固定工作流的新型学习方法；利用框架的模块化特性应用多目标优化方法联合优化成本和响应质量。
AI.result: 手工构建的固定工作流相比动态规划工作流通常更便宜且更准确；提出的学习方法普遍优于手工设计的智能体；多目标优化成功实现了成本与响应质量的联合优化及多学习系统结果的融合。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过模块化设计实现了实用性智能体系统的设计优化，在保持生产系统关注的简单性、可控性和成本可预测性的同时，通过学习方法和多目标优化进一步提升了系统性能，为实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: On Wednesdays, We Ask Questions: Optimizing "Active Listening" in Automated Legal Triage and Referral
comment: Working paper submitted as accepted to AIDA2J workshop at International Conference for AI and Law in Singapore, June 2026
summary: The FETCH classifier generates follow-up questions to help refine the best match for the applicant's legal problem, using a low-cost ensemble of LLMs. In this paper, we describe an expert attorney and LLM-assisted evaluation of the follow-up question approach in FETCH and show that while low-cost LLMs perform well at classification tasks, generating high-quality plain-language questions in this setting appears to require a more sophisticated and higher-cost model. Through discussion with legal intake workers, we propose a rubric for the evaluation of legal intake classification questions, and we find that prompt engineering alone is not enough to improve question quality for intake purposes. We also find that LLM-as-judge and human ratings diverge. We demonstrate that with the addition of a single high-cost model, GPT-5, the classifier can elicit relevant information from applicants for legal help, and that the questions lead to more accurate performance at classification tasks. We also find uneven fact elicitation across different categories, including domestic violence, at odds with family law screening protocols, suggesting the value of including dedicated screening panels for certain areas of law.

AI.tldr: FETCH分类器利用低成本LLM集成生成追问以匹配法律问题，但低成本模型生成高质量追问能力不足；引入GPT-5后问题质量与分类准确率提升，且发现LLM评估与人类评分存在偏差，某些领域（如家暴）的事实引导不均衡。
AI.motivation: 评估FETCH分类器在法律援助场景中生成追问的效果，验证低成本LLM是否能够胜任分类与追问生成任务，并建立法律援助分类追问的评估标准。
AI.method: 1) 通过专家律师与LLM协作进行追问质量评估；2) 提出法律援助分类追问的评估量表；3) 对比低成本LLM与高成本模型（GPT-5）的表现；4) 比较LLM-as-judge与人类评分的差异；5) 分析不同法律类别下事实引导的均衡性。
AI.result: 1) 低成本LLM分类表现良好，但难以生成高质量追问；2) 单一高成本模型（GPT-5）可显著提升追问质量与分类准确率；3) LLM评估与人类评分存在分歧；4) 不同法律类别（如家暴）事实引导不均衡，与家事法筛查协议不符。
AI.conclusion: 低成本LLM适合分类任务，但追问生成需高成本模型；建议针对特定法律领域（如家暴）设置专门筛查模块；单纯提示工程不足以提升追问质量；LLM自动评估需谨慎，应结合人类专家评审。

title: TAPAAL SMC: Statistical Model Checking of Stochastic Timed-Arc Petri Nets
summary: Timed-Arc Petri net (TAPN) is a timed extension of the classical Petri net model where tokens have their age and input arcs are associated with time intervals restricting the ages of tokens available for transition firing. Additionally, a TAPN can also contain place invariants constraining the ages of tokens in places, inhibitor arcs preventing a transition from firing and transport arcs that preserve token ages upon firing. This set of features, as much as it allows us to model complex systems, also often makes verification problems computationally hard or even undecidable. Moreover, in order to model real-life examples, additional stochastic aspects are often necessary to capture the desired behaviour. We suggest the first stochastic semantics for TAPNs and design and implement the quantitative and qualitative Statistical Model Checking (SMC) algorithms in the model checker TAPAAL. We argue for the semantic choices we made in the stochastic semantics and prove that the semantics is well-behaving. On a number of case studies we demonstrate the practical applicability of our modelling formalism and its SMC implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为时间弧Petri网(TAPN)提出随机语义，并在TAPAAL模型检测器中实现了统计模型检测(SMC)算法，通过案例研究验证了方法的实用性。
AI.motivation: TAPN的时间特性使验证问题计算复杂甚至不可判定，且实际系统建模常需引入随机性来刻画系统行为，因此需要为TAPN定义随机语义并开发相应的分析工具。
AI.method: 为TAPN设计随机语义，论证语义选择的合理性并证明其良态性；在TAPAAL模型检测器中设计并实现定量和定性统计模型检测(SMC)算法。
AI.result: 成功实现了TAPN的随机语义和SMC算法，证明了语义的良态性，并通过多个案例研究展示了该建模形式及其SMC实现的实际适用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的TAPN随机语义及SMC实现为复杂时序系统的随机建模与验证提供了有效方法，具有良好的理论基础和实用价值。

title: ClinEnv: An Interactive Multi-Stage Long Horizon EHR Environment for Agents
summary: Clinical practice is not the selection of an answer from enumerated options: a physician gathers heterogeneous information incrementally and commits to sequential, irreversible decisions under uncertainty. Static benchmarks cannot probe and existing interactive medical benchmarks each compromise on at least one of them. We present ClinEnv, an interactive benchmark that evaluates LLMs as attending physicians over real inpatient admissions under a paradigm we term Longitudinal Inpatient Simulation. Each case is automatically constructed into an ordered sequence of decision stages; at every stage the model must actively query four specialized agents before committing to medications, procedures, and diagnoses. ClinEnv scores both what the model decides, through deterministic ontology-grounded matching, and how it gathers information. Across seven models, the strongest reaches only 0.31 decision F1, and outcome quality is sharply decoupled from process quality. Difficulty concentrates in management decisions and later stages, where models recover discharge diagnoses far more reliably than management actions (0.51 vs. 0.17 F1) and continue to issue redundant queries as cases progress. ClinEnv makes this information-acquisition gap, invisible to outcome-only evaluation, directly measurable.

AI.tldr: 提出了ClinEnv，一个交互式基准测试，通过纵向住院模拟评估LLMs作为主治医生在真实住院病例中的决策能力，发现最强模型决策F1仅为0.31，且结果质量与过程质量严重脱节。
AI.motivation: 临床实践并非从枚举选项中选择答案，而是医生在不确定性下逐步收集异构信息并做出连续、不可逆的决策。现有静态基准无法有效探测这一过程，而现有的交互式医疗基准至少在某一方面存在缺陷。
AI.method: 构建ClinEnv交互式基准，采用纵向住院模拟范式，将每个病例自动构建为有序的决策阶段序列。在每个阶段，模型必须主动查询四个专业智能体，然后做出药物、手术和诊断决策。评估包括决策内容（通过确定性本体匹配）和信息收集方式两个方面。
AI.result: 在七个模型中，最强模型决策F1仅为0.31；结果质量与过程质量严重脱节。困难集中在管理决策和后期阶段，模型恢复出院诊断的可靠性远高于管理行动（0.51 vs. 0.17 F1），且随着病例进展仍继续发出冗余查询。
AI.conclusion: ClinEnv使仅关注结果的评估无法发现的信息获取差距变得可直接测量，揭示了当前LLMs在临床决策过程中存在的关键缺陷。

title: BAGEN: Are LLM Agents Budget-Aware?
summary: While agents are increasingly spending more resources, today agent cost is mostly measured only after execution. A Budget-Aware Agent (BAGEN) should treat budget as an active control signal, rather than a passive cost metric. We first systematically define budget estimation as internal budgets (from agent computation) and external budgets (from agent actions). We then formalize budget-awareness as progressive interval estimation: at each step of a plan, an agent should predict an upper and lower bound on remaining budget, and alert when completion is unlikely. Scoring with a rollout-replay protocol, we find consistent failure patterns on four environments and five frontier agents: (1) strong agents do not necessarily have strong budget-awareness, with correlation r=0.35. (2) frontier models are consistently over-optimistic, continue spending on tasks that are unlikely to succeed, instead of alerting the user early. (3) budget-aware signal is actionable and trainable. Early stop saves 28-64% tokens on failed trajectories, and SFT+RL strengthens early stop and alert behavior. (4) precise interval calibration remains challenging, with interval coverage capping at 47% after SFT+RL. Project page: https://ragen-ai.github.io/bagen/

AI.tldr: 提出了BAGEN（预算感知智能体）框架，通过预测剩余预算上下限实现预算的主动控制。发现现有强智能体预算感知能力不足（相关性仅0.35）、普遍过度乐观、在失败任务上持续消耗资源；早期停止可节省28-64%的token，SFT+RL可强化该行为。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体成本通常仅在执行后测量，预算作为被动指标而非主动控制信号。智能体缺乏在执行过程中预测剩余预算和判断任务完成可能性的能力，导致在注定失败的任务上持续浪费资源。
AI.method: 首先系统定义预算为内部预算（计算消耗）和外部预算（行动消耗）；将预算感知形式化为渐进区间估计——在计划每一步预测剩余预算的上下界，并在完成可能性低时发出警报。采用rollout-replay协议进行评估，并在四个环境和五个前沿智能体上进行实验。
AI.result: 在四个环境和五个前沿智能体上发现一致失败模式：（1）强智能体未必有强预算感知能力（r=0.35）；（2）前沿模型持续过度乐观，在不太可能成功的任务上继续投入而非提前警报；（3）早期停止在失败轨迹上节省28-64%的token，SFT+RL可强化早期停止和警报行为；（4）精确区间校准仍有挑战，SFT+RL后区间覆盖率上限仅47%。
AI.conclusion: 预算感知是可训练且可行动的信号，能显著节省失败任务的成本。但精确的预算区间预测仍具挑战性，需要进一步研究改进智能体的预算意识能力。

title: Evaluating Bivariate Causal Statements Based on Mutual Compatibility
summary: For many real-world systems, causal ground truth is difficult to obtain, making claims about causal effects hard to assess. We develop methods for evaluating collections of $\binom{n}{2}$ bivariate causal statements over a set of $n$ variables. In the setting of acyclic linear statements, any such collection can be extended to a unique multivariate causal model, but we argue that this induced model is implausible if it imposes substantial additional confounding to explain observed correlations. We introduce a compatibility score that quantifies this notion of plausibility, notably without relying on the faithfulness assumption. Additionally, we define an incompatibility score for purely graphical bivariate causal statements, based on global consistency constraints that are derived from acyclicity and faithfulness assumptions. We give theoretical and empirical evidence that both scores can successfully distinguish correct from incorrect causal statements in generic settings. Moreover, we demonstrate the practical applicability of our methods by analyzing causal claims made by large language models. Our work aims to provide a foundation for assessing the reliability of causal information derived from human experts or artificial intelligence in settings where alternative forms of validation are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种评分方法来评估一组二元因果陈述的合理性，无需依赖因果基准真值，为评估AI或人类专家提供的因果信息的可靠性提供了新方法。
AI.motivation: 在现实系统中，因果基准真值往往难以获取，导致因果效应的主张难以验证。随着大语言模型等AI系统开始输出因果主张，亟需一种方法来评估这些因果陈述的可靠性，特别是在无法通过其他方式进行验证的场景中。
AI.method: 作者提出了两种评分方法：1）兼容性评分（compatibility score）：针对线性无环因果陈述，通过将二元因果陈述集合扩展为唯一的多变量因果模型，评估该诱导模型是否引入过多额外混淆来解释观测相关性，从而量化合理性，且不依赖忠实性假设；2）不兼容性评分（incompatibility score）：针对纯图形式的二元因果陈述，基于无环性和忠实性假设推导出的全局一致性约束来定义。
AI.result: 理论分析和实验证据表明，这两种评分方法能够在一般场景下成功区分正确和错误的因果陈述。作者还将该方法应用于分析大语言模型生成的因果主张，展示了其实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 本工作为评估来自人类专家或人工智能的因果信息可靠性奠定了基础，在缺乏传统验证手段的场景中提供了一种新的因果主张评估范式。

title: EES-CND: Collaborative Neural Decision-Making for Drift-Aware Fault-Tolerant Edge-Cloud Service Placement
comment: In Proceedings of the 16th International Conference on Cloud Computing and Services Science (CLOSER 2026). (https://www.scitepress.org/Link.aspx?doi=10.5220%2f0015047300004039)
summary: The edge-cloud paradigm improves service delivery by orchestrating resources across edge nodes and cloud data centres. These environments consist of heterogeneous, interconnected computing nodes that cooperate to deliver continuous services. However, their scale and complexity increase vulnerability to failures from hardware malfunctions, software defects, and dynamic operating conditions. These failures can disrupt system configurations and service execution, leading to reduced reliability, performance degradation, and violations of service-level objectives. Ensuring service execution requires adaptive service placement strategies across edge-cloud resources. This study introduces a fault-tolerant service placement approach (Enhanced Evolution Strategy for Collaborative Neural Decision-making, EES-CND) for edge-cloud environments. The method employs collaborative decision-making, wherein multiple lightweight neural networks jointly infer redeployment strategies during failure events. To address the system dynamics and mitigate performance drift, adaptive models are updated online using an enhanced evolution strategy. Extensive simulations show that EES-CND effectively handles performance drift and significantly outperforms existing methods in service recovery time, response time, and reliability, achieving a 44.8\% reduction in fault-tolerance cost compared to standalone models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向边云环境的容错服务放置方法（EES-CND），通过多个轻量级神经网络协同决策与在线进化的自适应更新，显著降低故障恢复成本并提升系统可靠性。
AI.motivation: 边云环境由异构、互联的计算节点组成，其规模与复杂性增加使其易受硬件故障、软件缺陷及动态运行条件影响，导致服务中断、性能下降与服务等级目标（SLO）违背，现有方法难以有效应对系统动态性与性能漂移，亟需自适应容错服务放置策略。
AI.method: 提出Enhanced Evolution Strategy for Collaborative Neural Decision-making（EES-CND）方法：1）采用协同决策机制，多个轻量级神经网络联合推断故障事件下的重部署策略；2）引入增强进化策略在线更新自适应模型，以应对系统动态性并缓解性能漂移。
AI.result: 大规模仿真实验表明，EES-CND有效处理性能漂移，在服务恢复时间、响应时间与可靠性方面显著优于现有方法；相比独立模型，故障容错成本降低44.8%。
AI.conclusion: EES-CND方法通过协同神经决策与在线进化策略实现了边云环境下的自适应容错服务放置，显著提升了系统可靠性与性能，为复杂动态环境下的服务保障提供了有效解决方案。

title: From Rashomon Theory to PRAXIS: Efficient Decision Tree Rashomon Sets
summary: Standard machine learning pipelines often admit many near-optimal models. These "Rashomon sets" pose a range of challenges and opportunities for uncertainty-aware, robust decision making. They allow users to incorporate domain knowledge and preferences that would otherwise be difficult to specify directly in an objective, and they quantify diversity among valid models for a given training dataset and objective function. However, computation of Rashomon sets, even for simple, interpretable model classes such as sparse decision trees, continues to require immense memory and runtime resources. We present PRAXIS, an algorithm to approximate this Rashomon set with orders of magnitude improvement in runtime and memory usage. We validate that PRAXIS regularly recovers almost all of the full Rashomon set. PRAXIS allows researchers and practitioners to scalably model the Rashomon set for real-world datasets. Code for PRAXIS is available at https://github.com/zakk-h/PRAXIS

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRAXIS算法，用于高效近似计算机器学习中的Rashomon集（近优模型集合），在运行时间和内存使用上实现数量级的提升。
AI.motivation: 标准机器学习流程通常存在多个近优模型，这些Rashomon集对不确定性感知的鲁棒决策既带来挑战也提供机遇。它们允许用户融入难以直接在目标函数中指定的领域知识和偏好，并能量化给定训练数据集和目标函数下有效模型之间的多样性。然而，即使对于简单的可解释模型类（如稀疏决策树），Rashomon集的计算仍需要巨大的内存和运行时间资源。
AI.method: 提出PRAXIS算法来近似计算Rashomon集，该算法在运行时间和内存使用方面实现了数量级的改进。
AI.result: 实验验证表明，PRAXIS通常能够恢复几乎全部的完整Rashomon集，使研究人员和实践者能够对真实世界数据集进行可扩展的Rashomon集建模。
AI.conclusion: PRAXIS算法有效解决了Rashomon集计算的资源瓶颈问题，为实际应用中的不确定性感知决策提供了可扩展的解决方案。代码已在GitHub开源。

title: Model-Native Computing Architecture: Envisioning Future System Architecture Through the Lens of Computer Architecture
summary:
Large language models are undergoing a transition from model technology to system technology. As developers use Codex, Claude Code, AutoGPT, and related agents to write code, manage projects, and execute multi-step tasks, recurring engineering problems such as cache reuse, context management, agent scheduling, and permission control increasingly resemble classical computer systems problems. This paper develops that analogy as a visionary survey. We map concepts from computer architecture to the emerging model-native stack and review work on LLM-as-OS, memory management, agent frameworks, tool protocols, multi-agent coordination, cognitive architectures, and safety governance. We argue that these strands address different layers of the same system but lack a unified model.
  To fill this gap, we propose the Intelligent Computing Architecture Model (ICAM), a six-layer framework for model-native computing with explicit interface contracts and design axioms. ICAM resolves the apparent tension over whether an LLM is more like a CPU or an operating system through a dual-plane view: a probabilistic execution plane concerned with what can be computed, and a deterministic control plane concerned with what should be computed. We further introduce three design laws: the Semantic Locality Law for KV-cache reuse and inference speedup, the Context Budget Law for effective working sets under finite windows and attention decay, and the Agent Speedup Law for diminishing returns in multi-agent collaboration. We validate these laws against published system-level data and relate them to recent evidence on agentic software practices. We conclude by identifying where the analogy breaks down and outlining a research roadmap for model-native computing. This is a conceptual and survey contribution; it does not report new experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出智能计算架构模型(ICAM)，将大语言模型系统类比为传统计算机系统，建立了六层架构框架和三大设计定律，为模型原生计算提供了统一的系统视角。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正在从模型技术转向系统技术。随着Codex、Claude Code、AutoGPT等代理被用于编写代码、管理项目和执行多步骤任务，缓存复用、上下文管理、代理调度和权限控制等反复出现的工程问题越来越类似于经典的计算机系统问题，但目前缺乏一个统一的模型来整合这些不同层面的研究。
AI.method: 本文采用类比分析方法，将计算机架构概念映射到新兴的模型原生技术栈，提出智能计算架构模型(ICAM)——一个包含明确接口契约和设计公理的六层框架。通过双平面视角解决LLM更像CPU还是操作系统的争论：概率执行平面关注"可以计算什么"，确定性控制平面关注"应该计算什么"。进一步引入三大设计定律：语义局部性定律(KV缓存复用和推理加速)、上下文预算定律(有限窗口下的有效工作集)和代理加速定律(多代理协作的边际收益递减)。
AI.result: 通过已发表的系统级数据验证了三大设计定律的有效性，并将其与代理软件实践的最新证据相关联。该框架成功解决了LLM作为CPU还是操作系统的张力问题，为模型原生计算提供了统一的架构视角。同时识别了类比的局限性，并为模型原生计算制定了研究路线图。
AI.conclusion: 本文作为概念性和综述性贡献，提出了模型原生计算的系统架构框架，为该领域的未来研究指明了方向。研究表明传统计算机系统概念可以有效地迁移到LLM系统，但需要考虑概率性计算的本质差异，为下一代智能计算系统的设计提供了理论基础。

title: Strategies for Molecular Dynamics using Hybrid Systems: LAMMPS Use Case
summary: The complexity of biomolecular simulations has substantially increased the demand for High-Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructures, particularly in molecular dynamics and coarse-grained modeling.
