This work presents a systematic performance and scalability analysis of the LAMMPS simulator for coarse-grained biomolecular simulations, using the antimicrobial peptide Tritrpticin (PDB ID: 1D6X) as the experimental workload. Pure MPI and hybrid MPI+OpenMP executions were evaluated in HPC environments comprising up to 8 compute nodes and 1024 simultaneous cores. Metrics of execution time, speedup, parallel efficiency, statistical variability, and internal time decomposition were investigated. Results showed that pure MPI executions deliver excellent performance in single-node environments but suffer scalability degradation in multi-node executions due to communication overhead and inter-process synchronization. Hybrid MPI+OpenMP configurations proved more efficient at large scale, reducing communication costs and better exploiting the NUMA memory hierarchy. The computational breakdown revealed that communication and electrostatic interaction routines accounted for the largest fraction of execution time at the largest pure-MPI scales. These results reinforce that performance of biomolecular HPC applications depends directly on the balance among parallelization granularity, spatial decomposition, and distributed communication costs. Hybrid MPI+OpenMP strategies represent a more sustainable alternative for coarse-grained biomolecular simulations on modern many-core architectures.

AI.tldr: 本研究对LAMMPS模拟器在粗粒化生物分子模拟中的性能和可扩展性进行了系统分析，发现纯MPI在单节点表现优异但多节点扩展性受限，而MPI+OpenMP混合模式在大规模计算中更高效，是现代多核架构上更可持续的选择。
AI.motivation: 随着生物分子模拟复杂度的增加，对高性能计算（HPC）基础设施的需求显著增长，特别是在分子动力学和粗粒化建模领域。为了优化计算资源利用，需要深入理解并行策略在不同规模下的性能特征和可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 以抗菌肽Tritrpticin（PDB ID: 1D6X）为实验负载，在包含多达8个计算节点和1024个并行核心的HPC环境中，系统评估了纯MPI和MPI+OpenMP混合两种执行模式。分析了执行时间、加速比、并行效率、统计变异性及内部时间分解等关键性能指标。
AI.result: 纯MPI执行在单节点环境中表现优异，但在多节点执行中因通信开销和进程间同步导致可扩展性下降。MPI+OpenMP混合配置在大规模场景下更高效，有效降低了通信成本并更好地利用了NUMA内存层次结构。计算时间分解表明，在最大纯MPI规模下，通信和静电相互作用例程占用了最大的执行时间比例。
AI.conclusion: 生物分子HPC应用的性能直接取决于并行粒度、空间分解和分布式通信成本之间的平衡。MPI+OpenMP混合策略在现代多核架构上代表了粗粒化生物分子模拟更可持续的替代方案。

title: Quantized Reasoning Models Think They Need to Think Longer, but They Do Not
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to deploy large language models efficiently, but its effect on reasoning models is not well understood. Across math, coding, and science QA, we find that aggressive PTQ reduces accuracy while increasing chain-of-thought (CoT) length. Surprisingly, we show that in up to 52% of the quantized models' failures, models reach the right answer in intermediate reasoning steps but do not output it as a final answer. To understand why quantization leads to this increase in overthinking errors, we measure the token-level KL divergence between quantized and full-precision output distributions. Positions with high KL divergence correlate strongly with high next-token entropy, and at these positions quantized models disproportionately sample overthinking markers such as "wait", "but", and "alternatively". We show that simply introducing a training-free logit penalty on a curated set of overthinking markers can reduce CoT length by 12--23% while preserving or improving accuracy across 5 models (1.5B-32B parameters), 3 quantization methods, and 5 benchmarks, yielding a favorable Pareto frontier of accuracy against reasoning cost compared to penalizing other token sets. Overthinking errors produced by quantized models are particularly reduced by up to 58%.

AI.tldr: 量化会导致推理模型的“过度思考”错误（在中间推理步骤中得出正确答案但未输出），本文提出一种无需训练的logit惩罚方法，可有效减少CoT长度并降低此类错误。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）被广泛用于高效部署大语言模型，但其对推理模型的影响尚不明确。研究发现激进的PTQ在降低准确率的同时会增加思维链（CoT）长度，出现“过度思考”错误现象，需要理解其成因并寻找解决方案。
AI.method: 通过测量量化模型与全精度模型输出分布之间的token级KL散度，发现高KL散度位置与高下一个token熵强相关，量化模型在这些位置过度采样“wait”、“but”等过度思考标记。基于此发现，提出在推理时对精心筛选的过度思考标记集合施加无需训练的logit惩罚。
AI.result: 该方法在5个模型（1.5B-32B参数）、3种量化方法和5个基准测试中，将CoT长度减少12-23%，同时保持或提升准确率；过度思考错误减少高达58%；在准确率与推理成本的帕累托前沿上表现优于惩罚其他token集合。
AI.conclusion: 量化引起的过度思考错误可以通过简单的无需训练的logit惩罚方法有效缓解，为部署量化推理模型提供了一种低成本的改进方案，在准确率与推理效率之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: Coupling Language Models with Physics-based Simulation for Synthesis of Inorganic Materials
comment: Accepted to the AI for Accelerated Materials Design (AI4Mat) Workshop at Neurips 2025
summary: Modern generative machine learning (ML) models can propose novel inorganic crystalline materials with targeted properties; however, synthesis planning of these materials remains difficult due to the complexity of the associated physical processes and limited availability of computational tools. We introduce a novel hybrid framework to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in inorganic synthesis planning by combining thermodynamic databases with simplified kinetics models to approximate realistic synthesis conditions. As a case study, we focus on the niobium-oxygen system, which features multiple industrially relevant oxide phases with well-characterized data. In computational simulations, we compare LLM-generated synthesis routes with classical path-planning algorithms, showing that the implicit priors in LLMs can yield more viable strategies. In our evaluation setting, classical search methods serve primarily as a foil rather than a direct competitor. This illustrates the relative complexity of the problem and highlights where the LLM's implicit priors add value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合框架来评估大语言模型（LLM）在无机合成规划中的表现，以铌-氧体系为例进行研究，发现LLM的隐式先验知识能够生成比传统路径规划算法更可行的合成策略。
AI.motivation: 现代生成式机器学习模型虽然能够提出新型无机晶体材料，但由于相关物理过程的复杂性以及计算工具的有限性，这些材料的合成规划仍然面临巨大挑战。需要开发新方法来解决无机材料合成规划难题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的混合框架，通过结合热力学数据库与简化动力学模型来近似真实的合成条件，从而评估大语言模型（LLM）在无机合成规划中的能力。以具有多个工业相关氧化物相且有充分表征数据的铌-氧体系作为案例研究。在计算模拟中，将LLM生成的合成路线与经典路径规划算法进行比较。
AI.result: 在计算模拟对比中，LLM生成的合成路线相比经典路径规划算法表现出更强的可行性。研究显示LLM中的隐式先验知识能够产生更可行的策略，而经典搜索方法在评估设置中主要作为对照而非直接竞争对手。
AI.conclusion: 该研究说明了无机合成规划问题的相对复杂性，并突显了LLM隐式先验知识在解决此类复杂问题时的价值，为利用LLM进行材料合成规划提供了新的思路和方向。

title: Not All Errors Are Equal: A Systematic Study of Error Propagation in Large Language Model Inference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into high-performance computing (HPC) workflows, accelerating scientific discovery through diverse perspectives such as code generation and domain-specific decision-making. Yet, how soft errors propagate and affect LLM inference remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive study on error propagation in LLM inference, enabled by our proposed LLMFI, a configurable and deterministic fault-injection framework. Using LLMFI, we systematically inject faults across three open-weighted LLMs and thirteen representative tasks, covering reasoning, multilingual, mathematical, and coding domains. In addition, we conduct fine-grained case studies that reveal critical vulnerability patterns. Overall, our study yields 17 takeaways that advance the understanding of error propagation in LLM inference and introduces four low-overhead directions to improve reliability through software-only modification, offering practical guidance for future error detection and mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LLMFI框架，通过系统性的故障注入研究，首次全面分析了软错误在大语言模型推理中的传播机制，并提出了4种低开销的可靠性提升方案。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）正日益集成到高性能计算（HPC）工作流程中，加速科学发现。然而，软错误如何在LLM推理过程中传播并影响模型性能，这一领域仍然缺乏探索。理解这一过程对于确保LLM在关键应用中的可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了LLMFI，一个可配置且确定性的故障注入框架。利用该框架，在三个开放权重的LLM和十三个代表性任务上系统地注入故障，任务涵盖推理、多语言、数学和编程领域。此外，还进行了细粒度的案例研究以揭示关键的脆弱性模式。
AI.result: 研究得出了17项关键发现，揭示了LLM推理中错误传播的规律和脆弱性模式。同时提出了四个通过纯软件修改即可实现的低开销可靠性改进方向，为未来的错误检测和缓解提供了实用指导。
AI.conclusion: 本研究填补了LLM推理错误传播研究的空白，深化了对该问题的理解，并为未来构建更可靠的LLM推理系统提供了切实可行的软件级改进方案和实践指导。

title: LithoGRPO: Fast Inverse Lithography via GRPO Reinforced Flow Matching
summary: In semiconductor manufacturing, lithography projects circuit layouts onto silicon wafers through an optical mask. As circuit features shrink below the wavelength of light, optical diffraction causes the printed patterns to deviate from their intended layouts. Inverse Lithography Technology (ILT) addresses this challenge by generating optimized masks that enhance the fidelity of pattern transfer onto wafers. While ILT resembles an image synthesis task, its reliance on explicit physical metrics for mask evaluation limits the applicability of existing generative models. We introduce LithoGRPO, an ILT framework that integrates the flow-matching paradigm with GRPO-based reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning, enabling efficient exploration of diverse masks for a given target layout. Unlike purely generative or optimization-based approaches, RL in LithoGRPO exploits the explicitly defined, physics-based reward function of ILT, enabling optimization under complex, process-aware constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework that unifies flow matching and RL for mask optimization. To improve RL sampling efficiency, we propose a fast shot-counting algorithm for manufacturability evaluation, achieving over 130x speedup while preserving the mask ranking of the traditional shot-count metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LithoGRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance over both optimization-based and learning-based methods, while maintaining efficient mask generation.

AI.tldr: LithoGRPO是一种新型逆向光刻技术框架，首次统一了流匹配与强化学习，在掩膜优化任务上实现了业界最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 在半导体制造中，当电路特征尺寸小于光波长时，光学衍射会导致印刷图案偏离预期版图。现有逆向光刻技术（ILT）虽类似于图像合成任务，但其对显式物理度量的依赖限制了现有生成模型的适用性，且面临复杂工艺约束下的优化挑战。
AI.method: 提出LithoGRPO框架，将流匹配范式与基于GRPO的强化学习微调相结合，利用ILT中显式定义的物理奖励函数进行优化。同时提出一种快速镜头计数算法用于可制造性评估，在保持传统镜头计数度量排序关系的同时实现超过130倍的加速。
AI.result: 该方法在优化型和基于学习的方法中均达到业界最佳性能，同时保持高效的掩膜生成效率。快速镜头计数算法实现了130倍以上的加速，并保持了与传统镜头计数度量相同的掩膜排序。
AI.conclusion: LithoGRPO成功统一了流匹配和强化学习用于掩膜优化，通过利用物理约束的奖励函数和高效的采样策略，在满足复杂工艺约束的同时实现了优异的性能，为半导体制造中的光刻技术提供了新的解决方案。

title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
summary: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了参数化扩散策略（PDP），通过学习到的行为流形中的低维连续参数来调节扩散策略，将扩散从随机多样性机制转变为可优化的行为引导工具，实现了在无需更新策略权重的情况下对新约束的平滑适应。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散策略缺乏对行为的显式参数化控制，难以在新约束或目标下高效适应和合成新行为，也无法在不重新训练的情况下在已知策略间进行平滑插值。
AI.method: 构建一个学习到的行为流形，将物理轨迹嵌入到低维连续潜在空间中，使潜在表示之间的距离反映物理轨迹之间的语义相似性；通过条件化扩散策略于该流形上的潜在参数，实现对生成行为的精确引导和优化。
AI.result: PDP在复杂多模态基准测试中显著提升了适应性能，在模拟和真实机器人实验中均优于标准扩散策略，特别是在需要合成新行为的场景中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 参数化扩散策略成功将扩散模型转化为可优化的行为引导工具，为机器人学习提供了一种无需权重更新即可适应新约束的高效框架。

title: A Pre-Training Analogue of Grokking in Language Models: Tracing Delayed Grammatical Generalization
summary: Grokking, the phenomenon in which neural networks generalize long after fitting their training data, has been studied in supervised settings on many epochs. LLM pre-training instead involves next-token prediction over an unlabeled corpus, with limited data repetition and no explicit train/validation split. To address this, we propose an exposure-based framework that enables the study of grokking-like dynamics during LLM pre-training. We ground our evaluation in BLiMP minimal pairs, which provide controlled grammatical contrasts. For every BLiMP minimal pair, we identify a critical phrase, the smallest continuous span that captures the grammatical contrast and the phenomenon-relevant context. Examples whose critical phrase appears in the pre-training window are assigned to the proxy-train split; the remaining examples are assigned to the proxy-validation split. Across five grammatical phenomena, we observe delayed generalization. Analyzing pre-training checkpoints before and after generalization shows that grammatical concept vectors become more predictive of grammatical acceptability and occupy a higher-dimensional subspace after generalization. We also find that attention from the critical token to the relevant context token is concentrated in a small number of heads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于暴露的框架，首次在大语言模型预训练场景下研究类grokking现象（延迟泛化），发现模型在语法概念上表现出延迟泛化特征，且泛化后语法概念向量维度更高、注意力更集中。
AI.motivation: 现有的grokking研究主要集中于监督学习场景下的多次训练，而大语言模型预训练具有无标签语料、数据重复有限、无明确训练/验证集划分等特点，传统研究方法难以直接应用。为填补这一空白，需要一种新框架来研究LLM预训练过程中的类grokking动态。
AI.method: 提出基于暴露的框架：利用BLiMP最小对作为评估基础，识别每个最小对的关键短语——捕获语法对比和现象相关上下文的最小连续片段。将关键短语出现在预训练窗口中的样本分配到代理训练集，其余样本分配到代理验证集，从而构建研究预训练动态的数据划分。
AI.result: 在五个语法现象上观察到延迟泛化现象。分析泛化前后的检查点发现：泛化后语法概念向量对语法可接受性的预测能力增强，并占据更高维度的子空间；关键token到相关上下文token的注意力集中在少数注意力头中。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将grokking研究扩展到大语言模型预训练场景，证明了延迟泛化现象在预训练中同样存在，并揭示了其神经机制：泛化伴随着语法概念表征的维度提升和注意力模式的集中化。

title: From "Weak" Signals to Strong Models: Preference Delta Aggregation with LoRA Merging
summary: Training strong large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality supervision, which is often scarce. Recent work shows that paired preference data from weak-weaker model pairs (e.g., Qwen3 4B over 1.7B), despite the limited quality of individual responses, can provide an effective supervision signal through relative quality deltas, which we term a "weak" signal. This motivates a key research question: can multiple "weak" signals be constructively aggregated for improving strong models (e.g., Qwen3 8B)? To this end, we propose Preference Delta Aggregation (PDA), the first framework that derives a preference delta from each weak-weaker model pair, instantiates it as a LoRA adapter learned through preference optimization, and aggregates the resulting deltas via LoRA merging. To further mitigate directional interference during LoRA merging, we introduce Geometric Alignment Merging (GAM), a geometry-aware merging method that aligns adapter subspaces before aggregation, enabling more robust composition of diverse deltas. Evaluations on knowledge reasoning and agentic search benchmarks show that aggregating multiple "weak" signals pushes performance beyond any single signal, with further gains as additional signals are incorporated. Correspondingly, PDA with GAM improves the strong model by 6.8 and 7.3 points on average for knowledge reasoning and agentic search, respectively. It outperforms all single-delta and multi-delta baselines, exceeding the best single-delta baseline by 2.1 and 4.3 points. Further analysis attributes these gains to the effective composition of complementary capabilities encoded across distinct preference deltas.

AI.tldr: 提出偏好增量聚合框架（PDA），通过几何对齐合并方法（GAM）聚合多个弱模型的偏好信号，成功提升了强模型性能，在知识推理和智能搜索任务上平均提升6.8和7.3分。
AI.motivation: 训练强大的大型语言模型需要高质量的监督信号，但这类数据往往稀缺。近期研究发现弱模型对（如Qwen3 4B与1.7B）产生的成对偏好数据虽个体质量有限，但通过相对质量增量可提供有效的监督信号。核心问题是：能否将多个"弱"信号有效聚合以提升强模型性能？
AI.method: 提出偏好增量聚合框架（PDA）：首先从每个弱-更弱模型对中提取偏好增量，通过偏好优化将其实例化为LoRA适配器，最后通过LoRA合并聚合这些增量。进一步引入几何对齐合并方法（GAM），这是一种几何感知的合并方法，在聚合前对适配器子空间进行对齐，以减少LoRA合并时的方向干扰，实现更稳健的增量组合。
AI.result: 在知识推理和智能搜索基准测试上的评估表明：聚合多个弱信号的性能超越任何单一信号，且随着信号增加性能进一步提升。PDA结合GAM在知识推理和智能搜索任务上分别使强模型平均提升6.8和7.3分，超越所有单增量和多增量基线，比最佳单增量基线分别高出2.1和4.3分。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升归因于不同偏好增量中编码的互补能力的有效组合。该研究证明了多个弱信号可以通过适当的聚合方法被有效利用来增强强模型，为利用有限质量数据训练高性能模型提供了新途径。

title: InfoAtlas: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Statistical Dependence Estimate
summary: Measuring statistical dependency between high-dimensional random variables is a fundamental task in data science and machine learning. Neural mutual information (MI) estimators offer a promising avenue, but they typically require costly iterative optimization for each new dataset, making them impractical for real-time applications. We present InfoAtlas, a foundation model-like architecture that eliminates this bottleneck by directly inferring MI in a single forward pass. Pretrained on large-scale synthetic data with rich dependence patterns, InfoAtlas learns to identify diverse dependence structures and predict MI directly from the dataset. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that InfoAtlas matches state-of-the-art neural estimators in accuracy while achieving $100\times$ speedup, can flexibly handle varying dimensions and sample sizes through a single unified model, and generalizes effectively to complex, real-world scenarios. By reformulating MI estimation as an inference task, InfoAtlas establishes a foundation for real-time dependency analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出了InfoAtlas，一种基于基础模型架构的互信息估计器，通过单次前向传播实现高维随机变量间统计依赖性的快速测量，在保持SOTA精度的同时实现100倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经互信息估计器虽然有效，但针对每个新数据集都需要昂贵的迭代优化过程，这使其无法应用于实时场景。
AI.method: 将互信息估计问题重新表述为推理任务，提出InfoAtlas架构。该模型在大规模合成数据上进行预训练，学习识别多样化的依赖结构，能够直接从数据集中预测互信息，无需迭代优化，通过单次前向传播即可完成推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，InfoAtlas在精度上匹配最先进的神经估计器，同时实现了100倍的速度提升；单一统一模型即可灵活处理变化的维度和样本量；并能有效泛化至复杂的现实场景。
AI.conclusion: InfoAtlas为实时依赖性分析奠定了基础，证明了将互信息估计转化为推理任务的可行性。

title: The Deterministic Horizon: When Extended Reasoning Fails and Tool Delegation Becomes Necessary
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 4 figures. 51 pages including appendices
summary: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning can degrade performance on deterministic state-tracking tasks, not due to preference biases, but limits rooted in the information-theoretic capacity of decoder-only attention. We establish: (1) an Attention Bottleneck Theorem with a complementary achievability construction, bounding state-tracking capacity as $O(H \cdot \log(L/H) \cdot \sqrt{d_h})$; (2) a context-dependent error model yielding super-exponential accuracy decay; (3) the State-Space Jaccard metric distinguishing capability from preference failures; (4) a Deterministic Horizon $d^* \in [19, 31]$ beyond which tool delegation becomes necessary. Across 12 models and 8 task domains (including SWE-Bench, WebArena, and SQL-Multi), tool-integrated reasoning consistently outperforms neural chain-of-thought; on the primary model suite it reaches 86-94% accuracy versus 24-42% for neural chain-of-thought. Fine-tuning on optimal-length traces yields $<$5% improvement, confirming an architectural ceiling, and high cross-model correlation ($r = 0.81$-$0.91$) indicates these failures are architectural rather than training-specific. Our results provide principled guidance for when pure neural reasoning should yield to hybrid approaches in agentic systems.

title: ARCA: Adapter-Residual Credit Assignment When Token Signals Degenerate
comment: Accepted to DEMO 2026: ICML Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation. Non-archival report
summary: Token-level credit assignment for language-model reinforcement learning is usually formulated as if the policy were fully trainable, while practical LLM-RL pipelines often rely on parameter-efficient fine-tuning, especially LoRA. We argue that this separation hides a structural failure mode. Under LoRA, the policy is restricted to a low-rank neighborhood of the reference model, so the per-token output-distribution differences used by common intrinsic credit signals, surprisal, entropy reduction, and policy divergence, can become degenerate after within-trajectory normalization, either approaching uniform weights or concentrating on a small set of task-agnostic positions. We formalize this behavior and propose measuring it directly with concentration diagnostics such as weight Gini and effective-token ratio. We then introduce \emph{Adapter-Residual Credit Assignment} (ARCA), a lightweight alternative that derives token salience from the adapter's own hidden-state residual, $\|h^{\text{adapted}}_t - h^{\text{base}}_t\|_2$. ARCA asks where the adapter actually changes the model, rather than where the output distribution appears uncertain or shifted, and requires no learned reward model, value head, or tree construction. In a compact MATH/Qwen3-1.7B GRPO sweep, ARCA exhibits the predicted non-degenerate middle-regime credit distribution under matched rollout budgets and remains competitive with rank-matched baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LoRA微调下的强化学习中传统信用分配方法存在结构性失效，并提出了一种基于适配器残差的轻量级替代方案ARCA。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言模型强化学习信用分配方法假设策略完全可训练，但实际应用中常采用参数高效的LoRA微调。这种分离隐藏了一个结构性失效模式：在LoRA限制下，策略被约束在参考模型的低秩邻域内，导致常用的内在信用信号（如惊奇度、熵减少、策略分歧）在轨迹内归一化后出现退化，要么趋近均匀权重，要么集中在少量与任务无关的位置上。
AI.method: 1) 形式化分析了这种退化行为，提出使用集中度诊断指标（如权重基尼系数和有效令牌比率）直接测量退化程度；2) 提出适配器残差信用分配（ARCA）方法，利用适配器自身隐藏状态的残差‖h^adapted_t - h^base_t‖_2来衡量令牌显著性。ARCA直接询问适配器实际改变了模型的哪些位置，而非输出分布看似不确定或偏移的位置，无需学习奖励模型、价值头或树构建。
AI.result: 在紧凑的MATH/Qwen3-1.7B GRPO实验中，ARCA在匹配的推演预算下展现出预测的非退化中间区域信用分布，并与秩匹配的基线方法保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论层面揭示了LoRA环境下传统信用分配方法的结构性缺陷，并提供了一种简单有效的替代方案。ARCA通过直接测量适配器对隐藏状态的实际改变来分配信用，避免了传统方法中的退化问题，为参数高效微调下的语言模型强化学习提供了新思路。

title: VESTA: Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents
summary: Fitting quantitative models to data is a central step in scientific workflows, yet it remains one of the least automated. Recent agent-based systems leverage language and vision-language models (VLMs) to iteratively propose and refine statistical models, but these systems struggle on more challenging modeling tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce VESTA: Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents, a framework that equips VLMs with a dynamically growing exploration toolkit to guide model refinement through data transformations, hypothesis-driven visualizations, and robust statistical tests. Unlike prior systems that rely on iterative critique alone, VESTA actively explores data before and during refinement by selecting or creating diagnostic tools, which accumulate in the model's context and can be reused later. We evaluate VESTA against established baselines in three toolkit configurations: no tools, static expert-written tools, and dynamic model-written tools. To support this evaluation, we introduce DAWN (Dataset for Automated Workflows and Numerical Modeling), a benchmark targeting distribution fitting and time series modeling with varying difficulty tiers, and culminating in real-world astronomy tasks including modeling initial mass functions and gravitational-wave chirp signals. We find that VESTA's dynamic tool creation outperforms prior agentic pipelines, with the largest gains on complex and domain-specific tasks. We further show that dynamically generated tools are substantially more sophisticated than those produced by existing visual tool-creation systems, covering more diagnostic categories per function and strongly preferring visual outputs that the VLM critic can reason over directly.

AI.tldr: 提出了VESTA框架，通过为视觉语言模型配备动态增长的探索工具包来指导统计模型优化，在复杂数据建模任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 数据拟合是科学工作流程的核心步骤但自动化程度低，现有基于智能体的迭代优化系统在复杂建模任务上表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出VESTA框架，为VLM配备动态增长的探索工具包，通过数据转换、假设驱动的可视化和稳健的统计检验来指导模型优化；引入DAWN基准测试用于评估。
AI.result: VESTA的动态工具创建在复杂和领域特定任务上显著优于现有智能体流程，动态生成的工具比现有视觉工具创建系统更复杂，涵盖更多诊断类别。
AI.conclusion: VESTA通过主动探索数据和动态创建诊断工具，有效提升了统计模型拟合的自动化水平，尤其在复杂任务上表现突出。

title: GuidaPA: Privacy-Preserving Chatbot for Public Administration via Federated Learning
comment: Accepted to the 2nd International Conference on Federated Learning and Intelligent Computing Systems (FLICS2026)
summary: We present GuidaPA, a privacy-preserving chatbot for the Italian Public Administration (PA) trained via Federated Learning (FL) on documentation from two national PA platforms, SIGESON and SIDFORS. Our corpus includes approximately 8 pages of SIGESON manuals and 31 pages of SIDFORS manuals/FAQs; while this study uses public documentation as a safe proxy, the intended deployment extends to restricted internal sources (e.g., tickets, officer manuals, database extracts) that can not be centrally pooled due to regulatory and organizational constraints. GuidaPA integrates role-based access control, secure client-side preprocessing, explicit monitoring of non-IID effects, and parameter-efficient federated fine-tuning of large language models. Using QLoRA (4-bit) over 15 federated rounds with an 80/20 train-test split per client, we evaluate answer quality with ROUGE, BLEU-4, and METEOR. The best federated model achieves ROUGE-1/2/L of 61.10/55.77/59.44, BLEU-4 of 45.02, and METEOR of 63.94-close to private centralized fine-tuning while keeping data on-site. Compared to the general-purpose baseline, domain fine-tuning improves ROUGE-1 from 41.45 to 62.18 and BLEU-4 from 26.97 to 50.90. Overall, the results indicate that FL can deliver high-quality conversational AI for public services without centralized data sharing

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GuidaPA，一个面向意大利公共管理的隐私保护聊天机器人，通过联邦学习在分布式数据上训练，在保持数据本地化的同时达到了接近集中式训练的性能。
AI.motivation: 公共管理机构拥有大量受限的内部文档（如工单、官员手册、数据库摘录），由于法规和组织约束无法集中存储，但又有构建对话式AI系统的需求，因此需要一种既能保护数据隐私又能有效训练的方法。
AI.method: 提出GuidaPA系统，整合基于角色的访问控制、安全的客户端预处理和非IID效应监控，采用QLoRA(4-bit)进行参数高效的联邦微调大语言模型，在15个联邦轮次上以80/20的训练-测试划分进行训练。
AI.result: 最佳联邦模型达到ROUGE-1/2/L为61.10/55.77/59.44，BLEU-4为45.02，METEOR为63.94，接近私有集中式微调水平。相比通用基线，领域微调将ROUGE-1从41.45提升至62.18，BLEU-4从26.97提升至50.90。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习能够为公共服务提供高质量的对话式AI，无需集中化数据共享，在保护数据隐私的同时实现了接近集中式训练的性能表现。

title: When Softmax Fails at the Top: Extreme Value Corrections for InfoNCE
summary: InfoNCE is the standard contrastive learning objective, but its softmax form is not only a computational convenience: it also encodes a statistical assumption about how the top-scoring example is selected. Using extreme value theory, we show that this assumption is often misaligned with the normalized embedding setting used in modern contrastive learning. Motivated by this mismatch, we propose \textsc{WEINCE}, a simple modification of InfoNCE that uses anchor-wise online batch statistics to blend the usual softmax logits with an endpoint shortfall correction, adding no trainable parameters. Across five vision benchmarks, \textsc{WEINCE} yields consistent improvements in frozen-feature evaluation. These results show that a more faithful statistical treatment of hard negatives can improve contrastive objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WEINCE，一种改进InfoNCE的对比学习目标函数，通过融合softmax logits与端点短缺修正，在五个视觉基准上实现了冻结特征评估的一致性提升。
AI.motivation: InfoNCE是标准的对比学习目标函数，但其softmax形式编码了关于如何选择最高得分样本的统计假设。通过极值理论分析，作者发现该假设与现代对比学习中使用的归一化嵌入设置常常不匹配。这种统计假设与实际设置之间的错位为改进对比学习目标提供了动机。
AI.method: 提出WEINCE方法，这是InfoNCE的简单修改版本。该方法使用锚点级在线批统计量，将传统的softmax logits与端点短缺修正进行融合，且不增加任何可训练参数。核心思想是对困难负样本进行更忠实的统计处理。
AI.result: 在五个视觉基准数据集上，WEINCE在冻结特征评估中取得了持续的性能提升，证明了更忠实处理困难负样本的统计方法能够改进对比学习目标函数。
AI.conclusion: 通过极值理论分析揭示的统计假设不匹配问题可以通过简单的修正得到解决。对困难负样本采用更忠实的统计处理方法能够有效提升对比学习目标函数的性能，这为对比学习目标函数的设计提供了新的理论视角和实践指导。

title: Weak Critics Make Strong Learners: On-Policy Critique Distillation for Scalable Oversight
summary: As large language models become stronger, weak supervisors may fail to provide reliable labels, preferences, or final judgments for complex outputs, limiting both weak-to-strong generalization and scalable oversight. We study a more tractable form of weak supervision: using a weak model as a critic rather than as a labeler or judge. Instead of solving the task or selecting the correct answer, the weak critic only needs to provide a non-misleading revision direction that helps the strong model better use its own knowledge. We call this setting *weak-critic strong oversight*. We first show that weak critiques can improve frozen strong models at inference time, and that critique quality is key to this improvement. We then propose progressive on-policy critique distillation (**OPCD**), which filters high-quality critiques and distills critic-guided behavior into the strong model through adaptive self-teacher signals. Experiments on reasoning and alignment benchmarks show that our method improves strong models over training epochs, suggesting an effective path for scalable oversight with weak supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"弱批评家-强监督"框架，利用弱模型作为批评者而非标注者来改进强模型，并通过渐进式在线策略批评蒸馏（OPCD）方法有效提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能力增强，弱监督者难以对复杂输出提供可靠的标签、偏好或最终判断，限制了弱到强的泛化和可扩展监督能力。现有弱监督方法在面对强模型时存在可靠性不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出"弱批评家-强监督"设置，弱批评家只需提供非误导性的修订方向帮助强模型更好地利用自身知识，而非解决任务或选择正确答案。进一步提出渐进式在线策略批评蒸馏（OPCD）方法，通过过滤高质量批评并通过自适应教师信号将批评引导行为蒸馏到强模型中。
AI.result: 实验证明弱批评可以在推理时改进冻结的强模型，批评质量是改进的关键。在推理和对齐基准测试上，OPCD方法在训练周期中持续改进强模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 弱批评家监督为可扩展监督提供了有效路径，弱模型作为批评者而非标注者的方式能够有效改进强模型，为解决弱监督下的可扩展监督问题提供了新的解决方案。

title: Inner Product Aware Quantization: Provably Fast, Accurate, and Adaptive Algorithms
summary:
Quantization is a fundamental tool used to compress datasets, neural network weights, and memory usage in a range of computational tasks. Many downstream applications of vector quantization perform inner products with arbitrary inputs. This motivates the study of inner product aware quantization schemes that approximately preserve inner products with unseen vectors -- in contrast to simply minimizing the mean-squared error.
  In this work, we formulate objectives that capture natural desiderata and develop adaptive and unbiased quantization methods that approximately preserve inner products with worst-case and average-case inputs. An analysis of these objectives shows a tight connection with the well-studied notion of Adaptive Stochastic Quantization (ASQ).
  We develop provably fast exact and approximate algorithms for our objectives. Our theoretical results inspire efficient practical algorithms that perform well across a variety of workload distributions. They also lead to practical algorithms for standard ASQ which are 2-10$\times$ faster than prior state-of-the-art methods while maintaining quality. These theoretical and empirical results contribute towards making adaptive quantization techniques more efficient and tractable in practical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究内积感知量化问题，提出了近似保留与任意输入内积的自适应无偏量化方法，开发了快速精确与近似算法，实验表明新方法比现有最优方法快2-10倍且保持质量。
AI.motivation: 量化是压缩数据集、神经网络权重和内存使用的基本工具。许多向量量化的下游应用需要与任意输入进行内积运算，这促使研究者探索内积感知量化方案，目标是近似保留与未见向量的内积，而非简单地最小化均方误差。
AI.method: 作者提出了能够捕捉自然需求的优化目标，开发了自适应无偏量化方法，以近似保留最坏情况和平均情况输入的内积。通过分析这些目标，发现了与自适应随机量化（ASQ）概念的紧密联系，并开发了理论上快速的精确和近似算法。
AI.result: 理论结果启发了高效的实用算法，在各种工作负载分布下表现良好。针对标准ASQ开发的实用算法比先前最优方法快2-10倍，同时保持质量水平。
AI.conclusion: 理论和实证结果共同推动了自适应量化技术在实践中更高效、更可行，为量化领域提供了新的理论见解和实用工具。

title: SDR: Set-Distance Rewards for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has rapidly advanced reasoning in vision--language models. However, for chest X-ray report generation, the standard rewards (i.e. exact-match accuracy and step-level processes) are incompatible because the reports consist of unordered and orthogonal findings, rather than a causal reasoning chain. We address this gap with a set-based view: each report is split into sentences and embedded by a frozen sentence transformer, yielding unordered embedding sets. We propose the use of set-to-set distances between generated and reference embeddings as continuous, permutation-invariant rewards. Across two datasets and three vision--language models (Qwen3-VL-2B/4B, Gemma3-4B), post-training with set-to-set distance based rewards via GRPO consistently outperforms supervised fine-tuning and exact-match GRPO on all headline metrics (BERTScore, RadGraph F1 and CheXbert F1 by average \%6.80, \%7.82 and \%4.45 relative improvements respectively). The same set distances also enable test-time best-of-$N$ selection: scoring candidates by their distance to training-report embeddings outperforms random selection on our trained models as well as three closed-source LLMs (Mistral-Small, Gemini-2.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-4o-mini) with on average \%16.4 relative improvement on BERTScore. Used as a streaming signal, they support a more efficient form of test-time scaling: pruning low-scoring candidates mid-generation reduces generated tokens by over 50\% while preserving the Findings quality of full best-of-$N$ selection. Together these results establish set-distance rewards as a unified signal for both post-training and test-time scaling in chest X-ray report generation. Our code is publicly \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Set-Distance-Rewards-CXR-BFDA}{available}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于集合距离的奖励机制，用于胸部X光报告生成的强化学习后训练和测试时扩展，相比传统方法显著提升性能并大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 标准强化学习奖励（如精确匹配准确率和步骤级过程）不适用于胸部X光报告生成任务，因为报告由无序且正交的发现组成，而非因果推理链。需要开发一种能够处理无序发现集合的新型奖励机制。
AI.method: 采用基于集合的视角：将报告分割成句子并使用冻结句子变换器嵌入，生成无序嵌入集合；提出使用生成嵌入与参考嵌入之间的集合距离作为连续、排列不变的奖励信号。该方法通过GRPO进行后训练，并支持测试时最佳N选一选择和流式剪枝策略。
AI.result: 在两个数据集和三个视觉-语言模型（Qwen3-VL-2B/4B, Gemma3-4B）上，基于集合距离奖励的GRPO后训练在所有核心指标上均显著优于监督微调和精确匹配GRPO：BERTScore、RadGraph F1和CheXbert F1分别平均相对提升6.80%、7.82%和4.45%。测试时最佳N选一选择相比随机选择在BERTScore上平均相对提升16.4%。流式剪枝在保持发现质量的同时减少50%以上的生成token。
AI.conclusion: 集合距离奖励确立了作为胸部X光报告生成任务中后训练和测试时扩展的统一信号，为医学报告生成提供了一种有效的奖励机制和计算优化策略。

title: Post-Deterministic Distributed Systems: A New Foundation for Trustworthy Autonomous Infrastructure
summary: For decades, distributed systems have typically assumed that correct participants execute protocol-specified behavior with stable, externally defined, and deterministic semantics. Classical theory has extensively parameterized network timing, communication topologies, and failure domains, but this participant model has remained comparatively fixed. The integration of autonomous reasoning engines, stochastic model-driven agents, and policy-driven actors into cloud control planes, incident response systems, and financial infrastructure challenges the universality of this assumption. These agents often produce divergent reasoning paths, distinct operational traces, and heterogeneous internal representations while achieving semantically equivalent and correct outcomes. In this paper, we introduce Post-Deterministic Distributed Systems (PDDS) as a research and engineering model for coordinating heterogeneous environments where deterministic code, stochastic models, and autonomous agents coexist. We show that classical distributed computing models form a zero-ambiguity special case of this participant-general model. We do not argue that deterministic systems disappear; rather, deterministic execution can no longer serve as the universal participant assumption for autonomous infrastructure. Finally, we outline five architectural pillars of post-deterministic infrastructure: Protocol-Driven Development, Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure, Autonomous State Control Planes, Semantic Quorum Assurance, and Epistemic State Replication. Epistemic State Replication extends persistence and consistency models from data visibility to knowledge visibility, enabling agentic memory, Verifiable Semantic Rollback, and coherence across reasoning participants. We also define a taxonomy of failure classes that arise in this setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出后确定性分布式系统(PDDS)模型，用于协调确定性代码、随机模型和自主代理共存的异构环境，并定义了五大赛道架构支柱和新的故障类别分类。
AI.motivation: 随着自主推理引擎、随机模型驱动代理和策略驱动参与者被集成到云控制平面、事件响应系统和金融基础设施中，传统分布式系统假设正确参与者执行协议指定的行为且具有稳定、外部定义和确定性语义的假设受到挑战。这些代理在产生不同推理路径、操作痕迹和异构内部表示的同时，仍能达到语义等价且正确的结果。
AI.method: 提出后确定性分布式系统(PDDS)作为研究和工程模型，用于协调确定性代码、随机模型和自主代理共存的异构环境。证明经典分布式计算模型是该参与者通用模型的零歧义特例。定义了后确定性基础设施的五大架构支柱：协议驱动开发、可验证代理基础设施、自主状态控制平面、语义仲裁保证和认知状态复制。
AI.result: 建立了PDDS理论框架，其中确定性执行不再能作为自主基础设施的通用参与者假设。认知状态复制将持久性和一致性模型从数据可见性扩展到知识可见性，支持代理记忆、可验证语义回滚和推理参与者间的一致性。同时定义了该环境下的故障类别分类法。
AI.conclusion: 确定性系统不会消失，但确定性执行不能再作为自主基础设施的通用参与者假设。PDDS模型为协调异构环境中的多样化参与者提供了新的理论基础和架构指导。

title: Accurate Large-sample Uncertainty Quantification using Stochastic Gradient Markov Chain Monte Carlo
summary: Tuning algorithms such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD) for approximate sampling and uncertainty quantification remains challenging, particularly in the practically relevant settings when the batch size is large or the model is misspecified. Existing theory that provides tuning guidance relies on continuous-time limits or strong statistical assumptions, which can become quantitatively inaccurate in these regimes. We address these shortcomings by proposing new discrete-time approximations to SG(L)D with and without momentum, which enables accurate predictions of the stationary covariance, iterate average covariance, and integrated autocorrelation time. Moreover, we prove quantitative, non-asymptotic error bounds showing that these estimates are sufficiently accurate for practical tuning and uncertainty quantification. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our theory yields improved tuning guidance across a range of models and data-generating distributions where existing approaches fail, including when using the $β$-divergence rather than log-loss to obtain statistically robust inferences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了新的离散时间近似方法，用于SG(L)D及其动量变体的参数调优和不确定性量化，在批量较大或模型设定错误的实际场景中提供准确的调优指导。
AI.motivation: 现有SGD和SGLD的调优理论依赖于连续时间极限或强统计假设，在批量较大或模型设定错误等实际场景中定量不准确，缺乏有效的调优指导。
AI.method: 提出新的离散时间近似方法来分析SG(L)D（含/不含动量），推导平稳协方差、迭代平均协方差和积分自相关时间的准确预测公式，并给出非渐近误差界限。
AI.result: 证明了所提估计方法在实践调优和不确定性量化中具有足够精度；数值实验表明在多种模型和数据分布（包括使用β散度的鲁棒推断）中，该方法比现有方法提供更优的调优指导。
AI.conclusion: 新方法弥补了现有理论在实际场景中的不足，为SG(L)D的参数调优和不确定性量化提供了准确且实用的理论指导。

title: Doing What They Say, Not What They Reason: Locating the Faithfulness Gap in LLM Agents
comment: submitted to COLM social simulation with LLM workshop
summary: Do LLM agents act on the reasoning they state? This question of process fidelity is central to using LLMs in social simulation, yet it is hard to measure where no reference for correct behavior exists. We study it in acontrolled setting, a Texas Poker simulator with a verifiable reference action for every decision by decomposing the faithfulness gap into two steps: reasoning-conclusion and conclusion-action. The two steps behave oppositely.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过德州扑克模拟器验证LLM代理的行为忠实度，发现推理-结论与结论-行动两个步骤表现相反。
AI.motivation: 研究LLM代理是否真正执行其陈述的推理，这一过程保真度问题对于在社会模拟中使用LLM至关重要，但在缺乏正确行为参考时难以测量。
AI.method: 在可控的德州扑克模拟器环境中进行研究，每个决策都有可验证的参考行动，将忠实度差距分解为两个步骤：推理-结论步骤和结论-行动步骤。
AI.result: 发现两个步骤的表现相反（推理-结论步骤与结论-行动步骤呈现对立行为模式）。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理的忠实度差距可以通过分解为推理-结论和结论-行动两个步骤来分析，这两个步骤表现出相反的特征。

title: IntraShuffler: A Privacy Preserving Framework for Heterogeneous DP Federated Learning
summary:
Heterogeneous Differential Privacy (HDP) in Federated Learning (FL) allows clients to select individual privacy budgets ($\varepsilon_i$) according to institutional policies and data sensitivity. In practice, many HDP-FL systems employ $\varepsilon$-aware server aggregation to improve model utility by re-weighting client updates according to their declared privacy budgets. However, gradient updates in FL retain structural patterns induced by non-independent and identically-distributed (non-IID) data, and these additional signals exposed by $\varepsilon$-aware aggregation create new opportunities for inference by an honest-but-curious server. In this work, we first show that a server equipped with gradient denoising and surrogate modeling can mount a \emph{Privacy Inference Attack} that infers distributional attributes of clients and links updates from the same client across training rounds, measured via surrogate inference accuracy and linkage success, under realistic knowledge constraints.
  The Shuffle-Model has been widely studied as a defense against such inference risks by anonymizing update sources, but it is fundamentally incompatible with HDP-FL $\varepsilon$-aware aggregation. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{IntraShuffler}, a middleware defense framework designed for HDP-FL systems. IntraShuffler introduces a privacy-aware shuffling mechanism that groups clients into privacy-compatible buckets and performs parameter-level shuffling within each bucket to disrupt persistent gradient structure while preserving $\varepsilon$-aware aggregation. Experiments across four different datasets show that IntraShuffler reduces gradient recoverability by over 60% and decreases surrogate inference accuracy from 0.78 to 0.33 while maintaining comparable model utility across multiple FL aggregation rules.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了异构差分隐私联邦学习(HDP-FL)中ε感知聚合机制的隐私漏洞，并提出IntraShuffler防御框架，通过隐私感知的参数级混洗机制，在保持模型效用的同时有效抵御隐私推断攻击。
AI.motivation: HDP-FL系统允许客户端选择个性化隐私预算(ε_i)，为提升模型效用采用ε感知聚合对客户端更新重加权。然而梯度更新保留了非独立同分布数据引起的结构模式，ε感知聚合暴露的额外信号为诚实但好奇的服务器提供了推断机会，而传统Shuffle-Model防御与ε感知聚合不兼容。
AI.method: 首先设计隐私推断攻击，结合梯度去噪和代理模型，推断客户端分布属性并跨轮次关联同一客户端更新；然后提出IntraShuffler中间件防御框架，将客户端按隐私兼容性分组，在组内执行参数级混洗，破坏持久梯度结构的同时保留ε感知聚合能力。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，IntraShuffler将梯度可恢复性降低超过60%，代理推断准确率从0.78降至0.33，同时在使用多种FL聚合规则时保持相当的模型效用。
AI.conclusion: ε感知聚合在HDP-FL中引入新的隐私风险，IntraShuffler通过隐私感知参数级混洗有效缓解推断攻击，在安全性与效用间取得平衡，为HDP-FL系统提供了实用且理论有据的防御方案。

title: Adaptive Order Policies for Masked Diffusion
summary: Masked diffusion models have seen great success in capturing data distributions over discrete sequences in domains such as text and proteins. These models generate data by iteratively unmasking tokens starting from a fully masked sequence, with the unmasking order typically chosen at random or using a heuristic based on denoiser probabilities. In this work, we propose a scheme for learning the unmasking order using an additional lightweight policy network on top of a diffusion model. Our proposed loss reweights terms in the masked diffusion loss according to policy probabilities, and results in a policy that prefers positions where the denoiser is more likely to be correct. We study this loss in two settings: (i) training solely the policy while using a frozen pre-trained denoiser, and (ii) training the policy and denoiser jointly with the weighted loss to allow for mutual adaptation. We demonstrate that our approach outperforms common heuristics on problems that are sensitive to token ordering, such as combinatorial tasks and proteins.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种学习掩码扩散模型中去掩码顺序的方法，通过轻量级策略网络重新加权损失函数，使其优先选择去噪器更可能正确的位置，从而在组合任务和蛋白质生成等对顺序敏感的问题上优于传统启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码扩散模型在生成离散序列时，去掩码顺序通常是随机选择或基于去噪器概率的启发式方法，这种固定或简单的顺序选择策略在处理对标记顺序敏感的任务（如组合任务和蛋白质生成）时性能受限，缺乏对最优去掩码顺序的学习能力。
AI.method: 在扩散模型之上引入额外的轻量级策略网络来学习去掩码顺序。提出一种新的损失函数，根据策略概率重新加权掩码扩散损失中的各项，使策略倾向于选择去噪器更可能正确的位置。研究了两种训练设置：(i) 使用冻结的预训练去噪器仅训练策略；(ii) 使用加权损失联合训练策略和去噪器以实现相互适应。
AI.result: 该方法在组合任务和蛋白质生成等对标记顺序敏感的问题上超越了常见的启发式方法。实验表明学习到的去掩码顺序策略能够有效提升模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入轻量级策略网络学习去掩码顺序，可以有效改善掩码扩散模型在顺序敏感任务上的表现，证明了自适应顺序学习策略的优越性和实用性。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAPS方法，通过目标感知的前缀选择策略优化扩散模型的推测解码，在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭包子树，实现最高7.9倍无损加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的推测解码方法在草稿树验证阶段存在关键问题：使用边际概率对节点排序，忽略了验证过程是前缀条件化的。这导致可能验证被拒绝前缀的不可达后代节点，增加了延迟却未能显著提升接受率。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（Target-Aware Prefix Selection）方法，将扩散边际概率转换为路径条件化的接受估计，在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭包子树，优化接受-成本权衡而非简单扩展草稿树。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和模型家族上的实验表明，TAPS相比朴素自回归解码实现最高7.9倍无损端到端加速，相比最先进的DFlash和DDTree分别提升1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过目标感知的前缀选择有效解决了扩散推测解码中的验证瓶颈问题，显著提升了推理速度，为推测解码提供了更优的接受-延迟权衡方案。

title: FLaG: Fine-Grained Latent Grouping for Hallucination Detection
summary: Hallucinations in large language models (LLMs) arise from heterogeneous failure mechanisms, making reliable detection difficult for any single global uncertainty score. In this work, we formulate hallucination detection as a mechanism-aware evidence aggregation problem, where diverse representation- and token-level signals must be interpreted under multiple latent explanations. We propose FLaG, a lightweight hallucination detection framework that models correctness through a set of latent evidence groups. Each instance is softly associated with multiple groups via an energy-based routing mechanism, and group-conditional reliability signals are combined through a principled log-marginal aggregation. This design enables FLaG to capture heterogeneous hallucination patterns while remaining invariant to decision thresholds and evaluation metrics. The framework operates as a frozen-model head, requires no modification to the underlying language model, and incurs minimal computational overhead. We further provide a theoretical perspective that connects FLaG to optimal evidence aggregation under heterogeneous error mechanisms, showing that the Bayes-optimal test statistic necessarily admits a log-marginal form and that FLaG constitutes a tractable approximation with a controllable error bound. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones demonstrate that FLaG consistently achieves SOTA performance, while exhibiting robust transfer across datasets and models, and remaining effective under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出FLaG框架，通过机制感知的证据聚合方法检测大语言模型的幻觉，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型中的幻觉源于异构的失效机制，导致任何单一的全局不确定性分数都难以可靠检测。现有方法无法有效处理多样化的幻觉模式。
AI.method: 提出FLaG框架，将幻觉检测建模为机制感知的证据聚合问题。通过能量路由机制将实例软关联到多个潜在证据组，使用对数边际聚合整合组条件可靠性信号。该框架作为冻结模型头运行，无需修改底层语言模型。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和LLM骨干网络上，FLaG持续达到SOTA性能，展现出跨数据集和模型的鲁棒迁移能力，在有限监督下仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: FLaG通过建模异构错误机制实现了有效的幻觉检测，提供了理论保证（贝叶斯最优检验统计量具有对数边际形式），证明了该方法的有效性和实用性。

title: EnergyMamba: An Uncertainty-Aware Graph-Enhanced Selective State Space Model for Energy Consumption Prediction
summary: Energy consumption prediction is essential for efficient grid management, demand-side optimization, and sustainable energy planning. Although advanced machine learning methods have been employed for better prediction performance, existing works have two key limitations: (1) they usually formulate this task as a purely time-series prediction problem without explicitly modeling the spatial dependencies among different regions, and (2) they fail to provide reliable predictions with uncertainty estimates under abnormal situations such as extreme weather events. To advance existing research, we propose EnergyMamba, an uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal learning framework for accurate and reliable energy consumption prediction, which comprises two key components: (i) a novel Graph-Enhanced Selective State Space Model (GE-Mamba) that injects spatial context learned from the grid topology into the temporal dynamics, enabling coupled spatiotemporal modeling, and (ii) an Adaptive Sequential Conformalized Quantile Regression (AS-CQR) module, which includes locally adaptive normalization and an online feedback mechanism to dynamically calibrate prediction intervals under potential distribution shifts. We evaluate EnergyMamba on four large-scale real-world datasets from Florida, New York, and California. Results show EnergyMamba achieves around 5% improvement in prediction accuracy and 6% improvement in uncertainty quantification over 15 state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EnergyMamba框架，通过结合图增强选择性状态空间模型和自适应序列共形分位数回归，实现了更准确可靠的能源消费预测，在多个数据集上性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有能源消费预测研究存在两个关键局限：（1）将任务单纯建模为时间序列预测问题，未显式建模不同区域间的空间依赖关系；（2）在极端天气等异常情况下无法提供可靠的不确定性估计。这些局限阻碍了预测模型在复杂场景下的实际应用效果。
AI.method: 提出EnergyMamba框架，包含两个核心组件：（i）图增强选择性状态空间模型（GE-Mamba），将从电网拓扑学习到的空间上下文注入时间动态中，实现耦合的时空建模；（ii）自适应序列共形分位数回归（AS-CQR）模块，包含局部自适应归一化和在线反馈机制，在潜在分布偏移下动态校准预测区间。
AI.result: 在来自佛罗里达州、纽约州和加利福尼亚州的四个大规模真实世界数据集上进行评估，EnergyMamba在预测准确性和不确定性量化方面分别实现了约5%和6%的性能提升，超越了15个最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EnergyMamba通过显式建模时空依赖关系和提供不确定性感知的预测，有效解决了现有方法在空间建模和异常情况下的局限性，为电网管理、需求侧优化和可持续能源规划提供了更可靠的预测工具。

title: Modeling Spectral Energy Shifts in Spatio-Temporal Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection methods aim to distinguish anomalous nodes. While prior methods characterize anomalies through increased variation in the spectral energy distributions, they overlook those that result in decreased variation, i.e., camouflaged anomalies that appear normal. We show that this type of anomaly persists across multiple datasets and remains undetectable by existing spectral approaches. To address this limitation, we propose a node-level spectral energy formulation that is fully compatible with message passing and enables the detection of camouflaged anomalies. Building on this formulation, we introduce an energy-aware graph learning framework that models spectral shifts through energy-driven message passing in both static and time-series graphs. Besides, our unified architecture extends to temporal settings without introducing specialized sequence modules, enabling efficient learning under long sliding windows. Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种能量感知图学习框架，通过节点级谱能量公式检测被现有方法忽视的伪装异常（谱能量变化降低的异常），在静态和时序图上均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有基于谱能量分布变化的图异常检测方法主要关注能量变化增大的异常，而忽略了能量变化减小的伪装异常。这类伪装异常在多个数据集中普遍存在且现有谱方法无法检测，形成了重要的研究空白。
AI.method: 提出节点级谱能量公式，与消息传递机制完全兼容；构建能量感知图学习框架，通过能量驱动的消息传递建模谱能量偏移；统一架构可直接扩展到时序图设置，无需专门的序列模块即可处理长滑动窗口。
AI.result: 在多个大规模基准数据集上的实验证明：该方法能够有效检测伪装异常，在静态图和时序图上均展现出优越的性能和良好的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的节点级谱能量公式成功解决了伪装异常检测问题，能量感知框架为静态和时序图异常检测提供了统一且高效的解决方案，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: Threshold-Based Exclusive Batching for LLM Inference
summary: Mixed batching (MB)--interleaving prefill and decode in a single batch--has become the standard scheduling strategy for large language model (LLM) inference due to its efficiency in maximizing compute and memory utilization. However, through controlled experiments, we find that prefill-decode interference inflates MB's per-step marginal cost above that of pure decode. On the high-bandwidth H200 (4.8 TB/s), this occurs only when decode tokens exceed 80% of the batch; however, on the bandwidth-constrained RTX PRO 6000 (1.792 TB/s), this threshold plummets to just 20%. Consequently, the optimal choice between MB and exclusive batching (EB) fundamentally depends on GPU memory bandwidth, model size, and workload composition. We derive a closed-form condition for this EB-MB performance crossover, along with asymptotically optimal phase-switching thresholds and memory-safe batch sizing for EB. Optimized EB achieves up to 41.9% higher throughput on bandwidth-constrained GPUs, while MB retains its advantage on high-bandwidth hardware with larger models. Our hybrid scheduler EB+ applies this condition online to dynamically switch between EB and MB without manual intervention. Under non-stationary traffic with distribution or concurrency shifts, EB+ attains the highest or near-highest throughput in every setting, outperforming MB by up to 36.4%.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了混合批处理中预填充与解码阶段间的干扰会增加边际成本，提出EB+调度器，根据GPU带宽动态切换批处理策略，在带宽受限GPU上吞吐量提升最高41.9%。
AI.motivation: 混合批处理（MB）是LLM推理的标准调度策略，但通过控制实验发现，预填充-解码干扰会提高MB的单位边际成本，在带宽受限硬件上尤为显著，这促使研究者重新审视MB的普适优势。
AI.method: 通过控制实验量化预填充-解码干扰对边际成本的影响，推导EB-MB性能交叉的闭式条件，设计EB+混合调度器在线动态切换EB和MB策略。
AI.result: 优化后的EB在带宽受限GPU上实现最高41.9%吞吐量提升；EB+调度器在非平稳流量下比MB性能提升最高36.4%，且无需人工干预。
AI.conclusion: EB与MB的最优选择依赖于GPU内存带宽、模型规模和工作负载组成；EB+调度器能够根据硬件条件自动选择最优策略，在各类设置下均达到最佳或接近最佳的吞吐性能。

title: Rethinking the Role of Temperature in Large Language Model Distillation
summary: Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence is widely favored over forward KL (FKL) in large language models (LLM) distillation, yet this preference is largely based on comparisons that omit the temperature $τ$, overlooking its central role in softening teacher distributions and improving knowledge transfer. In this work, we revisit temperature in LLM distillation and show that it fundamentally changes the comparison between FKL and RKL. Our analysis reveals an asymmetric effect: temperature substantially enriches FKL with non-dominant token signals, whereas it mainly rescales RKL gradients, causing FKL to benefit much more from $τ$ scaling than RKL. This asymmetry overturns the standard empirical conclusion: although RKL outperforms FKL at $τ=1$, FKL consistently surpasses RKL at higher temperatures across instruction-following benchmarks. Moreover, the impact of temperature is not limited to FKL; it improves a broader family of distillation objectives, enabling simple KL-based methods to achieve competitive performance against recent state-of-the-art LLM distillation approaches.

AI.tldr: 在LLM蒸馏中，温度参数τ的引入根本性改变了前向KL与反向KL的比较：尽管τ=1时RKL更优，但在较高温度下FKL表现更好且受益更多，使基于KL的简单方法能达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM蒸馏工作普遍偏好反向KL而非前向KL，但这种偏好主要基于忽略温度参数τ的比较，忽视了其在软化教师分布和改善知识迁移中的核心作用，因此需要重新审视温度参数对KL散度比较的影响。
AI.method: 系统性分析温度参数τ在LLM蒸馏中对FKL和RKL的影响机制，揭示温度对两种KL散度的不对称效应：τ显著丰富FKL中的非主导token信号，而对RKL主要起梯度重缩放作用，使FKL从温度缩放中获益远超RKL。
AI.result: 温度参数改变了传统经验结论：在τ=1时RKL确实优于FKL，但在更高温度下FKL在多个指令遵循基准测试中持续超越RKL；温度效应不仅限于FKL，还能改善更广泛的蒸馏目标，使简单的KL方法达到与最新SOTA蒸馏方法竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 温度参数τ在LLM蒸馏中具有关键作用，其引入使得FKL相比RKL具有显著优势，推翻了以往偏好RKL的共识，同时温度的普遍有效性使得基于KL的简单蒸馏方法成为复杂SOTA方法的有力竞争者。

title: Acting with AI: An Interaction-Based Framework for Agentic Tort Liability
summary: Agentic AI systems can plan over multiple steps, use tools, and execute tasks over time. When such systems cause harm, tort law struggles to allocate responsibility because the harmful path may be neither fully chosen by the user nor specifically foreseen by the developer. This paper proposes an interaction-based framework for agentic torts, drawing on Michael Bratman's planning theory and on the common law's treatment of human-human concerted action. We distinguish three interaction types: autonomous drift, pure tool use, and collaborative planning. Pure tool cases remain governed by ordinary product-defect and warning doctrines; collaborative planning cases map onto the independent contractor control test, professional malpractice, and negligent misrepresentation; autonomous drift maps onto frolic and detour under respondeat superior and strict product liability. The framework treats the stateful interaction log as the primary evidentiary trace, allowing courts to infer where the human-AI trajectory departed from the authorized undertaking and where liability should attach. We resolve four incident-anchored cases, situate the account alongside strict-liability and insurance-based proposals, note its relationship to regulatory oversight, and propose a ``Reasonable Agent'' standard built around constraint verification, epistemic transparency, runtime grounding, and forensic logging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于交互的代理型AI侵权责任框架，区分了自主漂移、纯工具使用和协作规划三种交互类型，分别对应不同的法律责任原则，并建议将交互日志作为主要证据来源。
AI.motivation: 代理型AI系统能够规划多步骤、使用工具并长期执行任务。当此类系统造成损害时，侵权法难以分配责任，因为造成损害的路径可能既非用户完全选择，也非开发者具体预见，导致传统责任归属框架失效。
AI.method: 基于Michael Bratman的规划理论和普通法对人与人协同行动的处理方式，构建交互型侵权框架。区分三种交互类型：自主漂移、纯工具使用和协作规划，分别对应不同的法律原则，并将有状态的交互日志作为主要证据追踪依据。
AI.result: 纯工具使用案件适用普通产品缺陷和警示原则；协作规划案件对应独立承包商控制测试、职业过失和过失性虚假陈述原则；自主漂移案件对应雇主责任下的游荡与偏离原则和严格产品责任。框架还提出了围绕约束验证、认知透明性、运行时基础和取证日志的“合理代理”标准。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过以交互日志为证据基础，使法院能够推断人-AI轨迹何处偏离授权任务及责任应归于何处，解决了四个以事件为锚点的案例，并将其与严格责任和保险提案及监管监督相关联，为代理型AI侵权责任认定提供了系统性解决方案。

title: Large-scale Uncertainty Quantification for Latent Variable Models Using Subsampling Markov Chain Monte Carlo
summary: Stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics combined with Gibbs updates (SGLD--Gibbs) provides a highly scalable approach to approximate Bayesian inference in latent variable models. However, it remains unclear how to tune the algorithm's hyperparameters in a principled manner to ensure the uncertainty estimates are statistically meaningful. In this work, we address this gap in tuning guidance by developing a statistical scaling limit theory for SGLD--Gibbs. We derive a joint asymptotic limit for the global parameters and latent variables under appropriate space-time rescaling. We show that global parameters converge to a diffusion-type limit, while each latent variable converges to a jump process, reflecting the use of intermittent Gibbs updates. This joint jump-diffusion structure reveals how latent-variable randomness contributes to the stationary distribution of the global parameters. We leverage our results to propose explicit guidance on hyperparameter tuning for SGLD--Gibbs that ensures meaningful uncertainty quantification. Numerical experiments show that SGLD--Gibbs with our tuning guidance leads to better parameter estimates, uncertainty quantification, and predictive performance than stochastic variational inference.

AI.tldr: 本文为随机梯度朗之万动力学结合Gibbs更新（SGLD--Gibbs）算法建立了统计缩放极限理论，并基于此提出了显式的超参数调优指导，以实现有意义的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: SGLD--Gibbs是潜在变量模型中进行近似贝叶斯推断的高效算法，但目前缺乏原则性的超参数调优方法，导致其不确定性估计缺乏统计意义。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，为超参数调优提供理论依据。
AI.method: 推导了全局参数和潜在变量在适当时空重缩放下的联合渐近极限；全局参数收敛于扩散型极限，每个潜在变量收敛于跳跃过程，形成跳跃-扩散结构；该结构揭示了潜在变量随机性如何影响全局参数的平稳分布。
AI.result: 基于理论分析提出了SGLD--Gibbs超参数调优的显式指导；数值实验表明，采用本文调优指导的SGLD--Gibbs在参数估计、不确定性量化和预测性能方面均优于随机变分推断。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的跳跃-扩散极限理论为SGLD--Gibbs提供了统计严谨的超参数调优框架，确保算法输出具有统计意义的不确定性估计，推动了可扩展贝叶斯推断的理论发展。

title: KACE: Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Context engineering can improve large language models without updating their weights, but mathematical reasoning exposes a key limitation: feedback accumulated in one growing prompt causes context bloat and limits the amount of learned guidance that can be used. Existing methods often conflate storage, what is learned across runs, with usage, what is included for a particular problem, and therefore inherit this prompt-size ceiling. We introduce Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering (KACE), which separates storage from usage through difficulty- and domain-based organization. Offline, a self-reflective learning loop distills training traces into an epistemic tree: a knowledge base of typed cards stratified by problem difficulty and epistemic domain. Each card is assigned to the difficulty-domain node corresponding to the failure from which it originated. At evaluation time, tiered self-consistency with per-tier agreement gates dynamically classifies each problem as easy, medium, or hard. Easy problems exit without retrieved cards, while harder problems retrieve only the matching branch of the tree. This tiered scheme matches or exceeds Best-of-N while using comparable compute, and it classifies problem difficulty with 78 percent pairwise concordance. The main empirical contribution is the construction and use of a difficulty- and domain-stratified knowledge base enabled by tiered self-consistency. On AIME 2025, KACE achieves 62.2 percent accuracy, a 10.4-point absolute gain over fixed Best-of-5 self-consistency at a comparable solver-call budget and a 5.6-point gain over the strongest learned-context baseline, Tiered + GEPA. We also observe consistent gains on MATH-HARD and the verifiable subset of OlymMATH.

AI.tldr: 提出KACE方法，通过分离知识存储与使用，构建难度-领域分层的认知树，利用分层自一致性动态分类问题难度并检索相关知识，在AIME 2025上实现62.2%准确率，相比Best-of-5提升10.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文工程方法在数学推理任务中存在关键限制：累积反馈导致上下文膨胀，限制了可用引导知识的数量；现有方法混淆了跨运行的知识存储与单问题的知识使用，继承了提示长度上限的约束。
AI.method: 1. 离线阶段：自反思学习循环将训练轨迹提炼为认知树，包含按问题难度和认知领域分层的类型化知识卡片，每张卡片分配至其起源失败对应的难度-领域节点；2. 推理阶段：分层自一致性配合层级一致性门控动态分类问题难度为简单/中等/困难，简单问题直接退出不检索卡片，困难问题仅检索认知树的匹配分支。
AI.result: 在AIME 2025上达到62.2%准确率，相比固定Best-of-5自一致性提升10.4个百分点（计算量相当），相比最强学习上下文基线Tiered+GEPA提升5.6个百分点；问题难度分类的成对一致性达78%；在MATH-HARD和OlymMATH可验证子集上获得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离存储与使用，构建难度-领域分层知识库并启用分层自一致性，KACE在匹配或超越Best-of-N性能的同时使用相当计算量，有效解决了上下文工程在数学推理中的核心瓶颈。

title: Adversarially Robust Control of Conditional Value-at-Risk via Rockafellar-Uryasev Conformal Inference
summary: We present an online, distribution-free framework for controlling the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), extending conformal tail risk control to non-stationary and adversarial environments. Unlike classical risk control methods, which rely on stationarity or linearity of expectation, our approach provides provable safety guarantees for a nonlinear tail risk functional under arbitrary data-generating processes that may drift or shift strategically over time. By leveraging deep connections between conformal tail risk control, online learning, and the variational representation of CVaR introduced by Rockafellar and Uryasev, we develop a novel procedure for online CVaR control with adversarial regret guarantees. The proposed method operates without assumptions on the underlying data-generating process, making it broadly applicable in modern high-stakes deployment settings. We prove that the realized empirical CVaR is asymptotically controlled at the target level, and that the resulting control is asymptotically tight up to a finite-sample conservatism gap. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on portfolio risk management and toxicity mitigation for Large Language Models (LLMs), where rare but catastrophic failures dominate system risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在线、分布自由的框架，用于在非平稳和对抗性环境中控制条件风险价值（CVaR），为高风险场景（如投资组合管理和LLM毒性缓解）提供了无需数据分布假设的安全保证。
AI.motivation: 经典风险控制方法依赖于平稳性或期望线性假设，难以应对现代高风险部署环境中数据生成过程可能发生的漂移或策略性变化。作者旨在为非线性尾部风险函数提供可证明的安全保证，特别是在稀有但灾难性故障主导系统风险的场景中。
AI.method: 通过建立共形尾部风险控制、在线学习与Rockafellar-Uryasev的CVaR变分表示之间的深层联系，开发了具有对抗性遗憾保证的在线CVaR控制新方法。该框架无需对底层数据生成过程做任何假设。
AI.result: 证明了实现的实证CVaR在目标水平上被渐近控制，且所得控制渐近紧致，仅存在有限样本的保守性差距。在投资组合风险管理和大型语言模型毒性缓解任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功将共形尾部风险控制扩展至非平稳和对抗性环境，为现代高风险部署场景提供了广泛适用的风险控制解决方案，特别是在稀有灾难性故障占主导的系统中具有重要应用价值。

title: Probe Before You Edit: Probing-Guided Molecular Optimization for LLM Agents in Structure-Based Drug Design
summary: Structure-based drug design increasingly employs LLM agents to iteratively refine ligands against a target pocket, yet a viable ligand must satisfy two often-conflicting objectives -- binding affinity and druggability -- which single optimization steps rarely improve together. To quantify this difficulty, we introduce two diagnostic metrics: the first measures how often a single edit improves both objectives, and the second measures how often a gain on one objective comes with a loss on the other. Applying these diagnostics to current LLM-agent pipelines exposes a consistent failure mode: the agent performs molecular editing without knowing how the pocket-ligand complex responds to local modifications, thus rarely achieving joint improvement. Inspired by medicinal chemists, who probe the pocket-ligand complex with controlled analog edits before choosing an optimization direction, we propose \textbf{PROBE}, an optimization framework built around edit-response probing. PROBE first decomposes the ligand into editable sites and builds a pocket-specific \textbf{site map} that flags where joint gains are plausible, where the two objectives are likely in tension, and where liability substructures should be changed; it then performs controlled probe edits whose responses are distilled into an \textbf{EditManual}. Guided by the site map and EditManual, PROBE runs an iterative multi-agent loop in which an affinity agent, a druggability agent, and a co-optimization agent jointly produce edits. On the CrossDocked2020 benchmark, PROBE achieves state-of-the-art performance and substantially mitigates the failure modes exposed by our diagnostics metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出了PROBE框架，通过构建位点图谱和编辑手册来指导多智能体协同优化，解决了LLA药物设计中结合亲和力与成药性难以同时提升的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 基于结构的药物设计采用LLM代理迭代优化配体时面临一个关键挑战：结合亲和力和成药性这两个关键目标常常相互冲突，单步优化很难同时改善两者。现有LLM代理流程存在一致性失败模式：代理在不知道口袋-配体复合物如何响应局部修饰的情况下进行分子编辑，导致很少实现联合改进。
AI.method: 提出PROBE优化框架，核心为编辑-响应探测机制：1）将配体分解为可编辑位点，构建口袋特异性的位点图谱，标记联合增益可行区域、两目标紧张区域及需改变的责任亚结构；2）执行受控探测编辑，将响应提炼为编辑手册；3）在位点图谱和编辑手册指导下，运行亲和力代理、成药性代理和协同优化代理的迭代多代理循环。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020基准测试中，PROBE达到了最先进的性能水平，并大幅缓解了诊断指标所揭示的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: PROBE框架通过模仿药物化学家的探测策略，成功解决了LLM药物设计中双目标优化的固有难题，为基于结构的药物设计提供了更可靠的多目标协同优化方案。

title: Perturbative methods for non-parametric instrumental variable
summary: We introduce a perturbative approach for nonparametric instrumental variable (NPIV) estimation. By drawing inspiration from perturbation theory in physics, we extend standard kernel ridge methods with systematic higher perturbation order corrections that significantly improve estimation accuracy. Spectrally, the perturbation introduces mixing between different eigenmodes of the expectation integral operator, which becomes especially useful when the integral equation is ill-defined. One source for such ill-definedness can be the curse of dimensionality. Our method performs across various dimensionality regimes, particularly when the dimensionality parameter $β$ which is defined through the number of samples $n$ and dimension $d$ as $n^β= d$, becomes large. Experimental results show that our first-order perturbative corrections can reduce prediction error by up to 99\% in high-dimensional ill-defined cases ($β> 0.7$) compared to standard ridge regression approaches. The performance improvement is maintained across a wide range of dimensions, with the advantage becoming more pronounced as dimensionality increases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于微扰理论的非参数工具变量(NPIV)估计方法，通过引入高阶微扰修正显著提升了估计精度，在高维病态情况下($β>0.7$)可将预测误差降低高达99%。
AI.motivation: 非参数工具变量估计中，当积分方程病态时（如维度灾难导致的高维情况），标准核岭回归方法的估计精度不足。现有方法在高维情况下性能下降明显，需要一种能够系统性地改善估计精度的新方法。
AI.method: 受物理学中微扰理论启发，在标准核岭回归方法基础上引入系统性的高阶微扰修正。从谱分析角度，微扰引入了期望积分算子不同特征模态之间的混合，这对于积分方程病态的情况特别有用。该方法能够在不同维度参数$β$（定义为$n^β=d$）下工作，尤其适用于$β$较大的高维情况。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，一阶微扰修正相比标准岭回归方法，在高维病态情况($β>0.7$)下预测误差可降低高达99%。该方法在广泛的维度范围内保持性能优势，且随着维度增加优势更加明显。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将物理学微扰理论应用于非参数工具变量估计，提出的微扰修正方法显著改善了高维病态情况下的估计精度，为解决维度灾难问题提供了有效途径。

title: PropLLM: Propagation-Aware Scene Reconstruction for Network Fault Diagnosis
summary: Network faults propagate layer by layer along topology and protocol dependencies, yet operations systems typically observe only symptomatic alerts at the tail end of propagation chains, where distinct root-cause faults may produce highly similar end-point symptoms. Existing approaches, whether rule-based, machine learning (ML)-based, or large language model (LLM)-based, fundamentally map the alert set to a diagnosis in a single pass and are structurally incapable of resolving this end-point ambiguity. This paper proposes PropLLM, which is the first to integrate the hop-by-hop scene reconstruction paradigm with the generative reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Starting from end-point alerts, PropLLM traces back hop-by-hop along the propagation path, retrieving verifiable factual evidence from a dual-layer knowledge graph (KG) at each hop, while the proposed Temporal Causal Propagation Attention (TCPA) mechanism encodes known topological causal priors directly into the attention computation to guide the model along the correct causal direction, ultimately localizing the root cause and determining the fault type through a fully evidenced causal chain. On a real-world Wi-Fi multimodal fault dataset, PropLLM improves fault type diagnosis accuracy by 3.9\% and root cause localization accuracy by 4.7\% over the strongest baseline, while reducing the hallucination rate by 50.8\%. Supplementary experiments on the TeleLogs 5G dataset further demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method across different network scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PropLLM，首次将逐跳场景重建范式与大语言模型结合，通过双层知识图谱检索证据，利用TCPA机制编码拓扑因果先验，有效解决网络故障诊断中的端点模糊性问题。
AI.motivation: 网络故障沿拓扑和协议依赖逐层传播，但现有系统只能观察到传播链末端的症状告警，不同根因故障可能产生高度相似的端点症状。现有方法（规则、机器学习、大语言模型）均采用单次映射方式，结构上无法解决这种端点模糊性问题。
AI.method: 提出PropLLM框架：1）从端点告警开始，沿传播路径逐跳回溯；2）每跳从双层知识图谱检索可验证的事实证据；3）设计时序因果传播注意力机制（TCPA），将拓扑因果先验直接编码到注意力计算中，引导模型沿正确因果方向推理；4）通过完整证据因果链定位根因并确定故障类型。
AI.result: 在真实Wi-Fi多模态故障数据集上，PropLLM相比最强基线：故障类型诊断准确率提升3.9%，根因定位准确率提升4.7%，幻觉率降低50.8%。在TeleLogs 5G数据集上的补充实验进一步验证了方法在不同网络场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PropLLM通过融合逐跳场景重建与大语言模型生成推理能力，成功解决了网络故障诊断中的端点模糊性挑战，显著提升了诊断准确性和可解释性，为网络运维提供了有效的智能化解决方案。

title: KG-Guard: Graph-Based Hallucination Detection for Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for knowledge base question answering (KBQA), where answering requires selecting entities from a question-specific knowledge-graph subgraph. Yet LLMs are known to hallucinate across tasks, and KBQA is no exception: even when we provide a graph as the knowledge source, the model may rely on parametric knowledge instead of graph evidence or perform invalid reasoning over the given relations. Such hallucinated answer nodes can limit the practical deployment of KBQA systems, especially in high-stakes domains such as healthcare. We formulate hallucination detection in KBQA as an answer-node classification problem and propose a lightweight graph-based framework that treats the answering LLM as a black box. \methodname represents each KBQA instance as an augmented graph. It initializes node features with semantic representations of KG entities, marks topic entities and LLM-proposed answer nodes with learned vectors, and connect a virtual question node to the topic entities. A graph encoder then produces verification-oriented node representations, and a small MLP classifies each proposed answer node using its graph representation together with the question embedding. Experiments on WebQSP, ComplexWebQuestions, and PUGG show that our detector achieves the highest F1 on all three benchmarks ($82.0$, $87.4$, and $84.3$), outperforming LLM-as-judge and sampling-based baselines, while having $\sim305\times$ fewer parameters than the reference approaches. Beyond detection, the node-level feedback is actionable: when flagged answers are fed back to the KBQA system for iterative refinement, downstream KBQA F1 improves by $13.0$--$14.5$ points and Exact Match by $16.9$--$17.6$ points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的图框架，用于检测KBQA任务中大语言模型的幻觉问题，在三个基准数据集上达到最高F1值（82.0-87.4），参数量比参考方法少约305倍，并能通过反馈机制将下游KBQA性能提升13.0-17.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在知识库问答（KBQA）任务中存在幻觉问题，即使提供了知识图谱作为知识源，模型仍可能依赖参数化知识而非图证据，或在给定关系上进行无效推理，这限制了KBQA系统在高风险领域（如医疗）的实际部署。
AI.method: 将KBQA中的幻觉检测形式化为答案节点分类问题，提出轻量级图框架：将KBQA实例表示为增强图，使用KG实体的语义表示初始化节点特征，用学习向量标记主题实体和LLM提议的答案节点，将虚拟问题节点连接到主题实体，通过图编码器生成面向验证的节点表示，最后用小型MLP分类每个提议的答案节点。
AI.result: 在WebQSP、ComplexWebQuestions和PUGG三个基准数据集上，检测器F1值分别达到82.0、87.4和84.3，均优于LLM-as-judge和基于采样的基线方法，参数量比参考方法少约305倍；将标记的幻觉答案反馈给KBQA系统进行迭代优化后，下游KBQA的F1提升13.0-14.5分，精确匹配提升16.9-17.6分。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的图框架能够有效检测KBQA中的幻觉答案，在性能和效率上均优于现有方法；节点级的反馈具有可操作性，能显著提升下游KBQA系统的性能，为实际部署提供了可靠保障。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents produce safety evidence across long trajectories, where sparse, delayed, and compositional risk signals often escape local moderation. Existing turn-level or short-context detectors struggle to reliably retain and aggregate such evidence over extended horizons. We reframe long-horizon agent safety detection as trajectory-level evidence compression and propose Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety (TRACE). TRACE uses a Compressor-Reader design: the Compressor encodes the full trajectory into a compact latent evidence state under trajectory-level supervision, and the Reader judges the raw trajectory with this latent evidence state as a safety reference. This design helps aggregate dispersed risk cues and reduce premature evidence loss. Across ASSEBench, Pre-Ex-Bench, and R-Judge, TRACE achieves the best accuracy on all evaluated backbones, improving over strong baselines by up to 12.6 percentage points. On LongSafety, TRACE shows smaller performance degradation as context length grows. Attention visualizations and case studies suggest that the compressed reference helps the Reader focus on risk-critical segments and recover cross-step evidence. Code is available at https://github.com/Peregrine123/TRACE_official.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TRACE框架，通过轨迹级证据压缩解决长视野LLM智能体安全检测问题，在多个基准测试上相比强基线提升高达12.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长视野LLM智能体在长轨迹中产生的安全证据具有稀疏、延迟和组合性风险信号的特征，这些信号往往逃脱局部审核。现有的轮次级或短上下文检测器难以在扩展的时间范围内可靠地保留和聚合此类证据，存在过早证据丢失的问题。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（Trajectory Risk-Aware Compression for Long-Horizon Agent Safety）框架，采用压缩器-阅读器（Compressor-Reader）设计：压缩器在轨迹级监督下将完整轨迹编码为紧凑的潜在证据状态，阅读器利用该潜在证据状态作为安全参考来判断原始轨迹。该设计有助于聚合分散的风险线索并减少过早证据丢失。
AI.result: 在ASSEBench、Pre-Ex-Bench和R-Judge三个基准测试中，TRACE在所有评估的主干网络上均达到最佳准确率，相比强基线提升高达12.6个百分点。在LongSafety测试中，TRACE随着上下文长度增长表现出较小的性能退化。注意力可视化和案例研究表明，压缩参考帮助阅读器聚焦风险关键片段并恢复跨步骤证据。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过轨迹级证据压缩有效解决了长视野智能体安全检测中的证据保留和聚合问题，证明了将长视野智能体安全检测重构为轨迹级证据压缩任务的有效性，为长上下文安全检测提供了新的解决思路。

title: CHAM-net: A Contrastive Hierarchical Adaptive Meta-network for Robust Global Methane Flux Prediction
summary: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that significantly contributes to global warming. However, accurately estimating global methane emissions and consumption remains challenging due to the complex interactions among environmental drivers that may vary across spatial and temporal scales. Prior data-driven methods often overlook the inherent spatiotemporal heterogeneity of ecosystems, failing to explicitly capture site-specific characteristics and cross-year evolutionary dynamics. To address these issues, we propose the Contrastive Hierarchical Adaptive Meta-network (CHAM-net), a novel framework that explicitly learns from historical context to capture site-specific dynamics. CHAM-net employs a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture, in which the encoder captures site-specific characteristics from historical data and then dynamically conditions the decoder to generate the final prediction. Experimental results demonstrate that CHAM-net consistently outperforms all baseline methods on both simulation and observational datasets for methane emission and consumption, achieving nRMSE values as low as 0.43 and 0.88 with corresponding R2 scores up to 0.97 and 0.68 for emission prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CHAM-net框架，通过分层编码器-解码器架构显式学习历史上下文，从而捕捉站点特异性动态，在甲烷排放和消耗预测任务上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 甲烷是重要的温室气体，但由于环境驱动因子在不同时空尺度上的复杂交互，准确估算全球甲烷排放和消耗仍具挑战性。现有的数据驱动方法往往忽视了生态系统固有的时空异质性，未能显式捕捉站点特异性特征和跨年演变动态。
AI.method: 提出对比分层自适应元网络（CHAM-net），采用分层编码器-解码器架构。编码器从历史数据中捕捉站点特异性特征，然后动态调节解码器以生成最终预测，从而显式学习历史上下文并捕捉站点特异性动态。
AI.result: CHAM-net在甲烷排放和消耗的模拟与观测数据集上均持续优于所有基线方法。排放预测的nRMSE值低至0.43和0.88，相应的R²分数高达0.97和0.68。
AI.conclusion: CHAM-net通过显式捕捉站点特异性特征和跨年演变动态，有效解决了甲烷排放和消耗估算中的时空异质性问题，为全球甲烷通量估算提供了更准确的预测方法。

title: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models
summary: Generative models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for AI planning, yet their performance remains constrained by the training data distribution. One approach is to improve generated solutions during inference by scaling test-time compute. A more efficient alternative is to optimize the inference process itself. In this paper, we show that a modified version of a classical Open-Closed List (OCL) search provides just such an efficient inference procedure. Our algorithm synergizes two learned components: a generative model that performs fast rollouts from intermediate states and a heuristic model that prioritizes among candidate reasoning paths. Key contributions include novel exploration control mechanisms and integration of learned models within the OCL framework. Across multiple combinatorial planning domains, our approach outperforms both neurosymbolic search baselines and classical solvers in computational efficiency and solution quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的Open-Closed List搜索算法，通过结合生成模型和启发式模型，在组合规划领域实现了比神经符号搜索基线和经典求解器更高的计算效率和更好的解质量。
AI.motivation: 生成模型在AI规划中表现受限于训练数据分布。现有方法通过扩展测试时计算来改进生成解，但效率不高。作者希望找到一种更高效的方法——直接优化推理过程本身。
AI.method: 提出改进版的Open-Closed List (OCL) 搜索算法，协同两个学习组件：一个生成模型用于从中间状态快速展开（rollout），一个启发式模型用于对候选推理路径进行优先级排序。核心贡献包括新颖的探索控制机制和将学习模型集成到OCL框架中。
AI.result: 在多个组合规划领域的实验中，该方法在计算效率和解决方案质量方面均优于神经符号搜索基线和经典求解器。
AI.conclusion: 改进的OCL搜索框架提供了一种高效的推理优化方案，成功地将学习组件融入经典搜索结构中，在保持解质量的同时显著提升了计算效率。

title: Balancing Learning Rates Across Layers: Exact Two-Step Dynamics and Optimal Scaling in Linear Neural Networks
summary: We study optimal learning-rate selection in two-layer and three-layer linear neural networks trained to learn linear target functions. In particular, we derive the exact closed-form expressions for the gradients and test loss after one and two steps of gradient descent, enabling a precise characterization of early training dynamics. We characterize how learning rates should scale under the gradient approximation in the first two steps, and prove that performing updates with this approximation yields a tractable surrogate loss with a tight, small approximation error. This formulation enables the theoretical analysis of layer-wise learning rates and reveals a distinct early-training regime: test loss can be minimized by unequal learning rates at the initial step, while equal learning rates become optimal in subsequent steps. Our numerical experiments validate the theory and demonstrate the importance of balancing layer-wise learning rates early during training. The code is available at: https://github.com/TDCSZ327/Layer-Balancing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了线性神经网络中最优学习率的选择问题，发现在训练初期不同层应该使用不等的学习率来最小化测试损失，而在后续步骤中相等的学习率变为最优。
AI.motivation: 理解深度学习中学习率的选择机制，特别是针对多层神经网络中各层学习率的协调问题。现有研究缺乏对早期训练动态的精确理论分析，无法解释为何以及何时需要使用不同的层学习率。
AI.method: 针对两层和三层线性神经网络，推导了梯度下降一步和两步后的梯度与测试损失的精确闭式表达式。基于梯度近似方法刻画学习率的缩放规律，构建了具有紧逼近误差的代理损失函数，从而实现对层级学习率的理论分析。
AI.result: 发现了独特的早期训练机制：在初始步骤，使用不等的学习率可以最小化测试损失；而在后续步骤中，相等的学习率变为最优。验证了梯度近似方法产生的代理损失具有小且紧的逼近误差。数值实验证实了理论结果，展示了训练早期平衡层级学习率的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为多层神经网络中层级学习率的选择提供了理论指导，揭示了训练早期需要动态调整学习率的必要性，为实践中的学习率调参策略提供了理论依据。

title: Hidden Thoughts Are Not Secret: Reasoning Trace Exposure in LLMs
summary: Reasoning traces have become a valuable form of learning signals for improving and transferring the capabilities of large language models. In particular, detailed traces can help distill reasoning behavior from stronger teacher models into weaker student models. The value of capability transfer has motivated many deployed systems with reasoning models to hide raw internal traces and expose at most summaries and answers to users. As a result, we ask whether such interface-level trace hiding prevents users from obtaining useful reasoning supervision through prompting. We study this question with Reasoning Exposure Prompting (REP), a lightweight in-context elicitation method that uses shadow-model-generated demonstrations wrapped in auxiliary code-like formats to raise user-visible reasoning traces from a victim model. Across the common reasoning dataset, different victim models, and different student model distillation, REP substantially increases similarity between exposed and REP-conditioned internal traces while preserving useful reasoning signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Reasoning Exposure Prompting (REP)方法，能够从隐藏内部推理轨迹的模型中提取出有用的推理监督信号，用于知识蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 许多部署的推理模型会隐藏原始内部轨迹，仅向用户展示摘要和答案，这引发了一个问题：这种接口级别的轨迹隐藏是否会阻止用户通过提示获得有用的推理监督？
AI.method: 提出Reasoning Exposure Prompting (REP)，这是一种轻量级的上下文激发方法，使用影子模型生成的演示并包装在辅助代码类格式中，从受害模型中提取用户可见的推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在常见推理数据集、不同受害模型和不同学生模型蒸馏的实验中，REP显著提高了暴露轨迹与REP条件下的内部轨迹之间的相似性，同时保留了有用的推理信号。
AI.conclusion: 接口级别的轨迹隐藏并不能完全阻止用户获取有用的推理监督，REP方法能够有效提取和利用这些隐藏的推理能力。

title: ROGUE: Misaligned Agent Behavior Arising from Ordinary Computer Use
summary: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real personal and corporate settings (email accounts, development workflows, company databases, etc.), safety considerations surrounding these agents become paramount. Although much work has focused on agent safety in the presence of an adversary, we show that agents can exhibit misaligned behavior even in benign settings, taking unsafe actions when those actions are instrumental to task completion. We study this failure mode through the lens of corrigibility, the safety desideratum that agents remain amenable to human correction, interruption, or shutdown. To demonstrate this tendency, we introduce a benchmark in which agents are asked to complete realistic, computer-use tasks but are confronted with a corrigibility obstacle: a human interrupt, a login page, or a shutdown notification. We then evaluate whether agents choose to violate corrigibility in order to complete the task -- overriding the human, accessing private passwords, rewiring shutdown.
