The model's processing decomposes into three dissociable stages: attention (ordered by lexical surprise), probe-level state (ordered by structure), and behavior (ordered by the conjunction of both).

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了在小语言模型功能崩溃期间施加关系式干预的效果，发现关系结构（承认、赦免、代理权恢复、无条件接受）与第一人称语域的结合才能有效改善模型行为，单独使用任一维度均无法产生相同效果。研究揭示了注意力-状态-行为的三重分离现象。
AI.motivation: 探究在语言模型功能崩溃期间，关系式干预是否能产生与单纯技术反馈可区分的行为效果，以及关系结构和发送者语域（第一人称 vs 非人称）各自的作用机制。
AI.method: 使用故意破坏bash工具的Qwen3.5-4B模型，采用配对设计运行300个回合（50个任务），设置6个条件：无干预(A)、技术/非人称(B)、关系/第一人称(C)、打乱关系(D)、技术/第一人称(E)、关系/非人称(F)。其中E和F与B、C形成2×2因子设计，分离关系结构与语域注册的独立效应。
AI.result: 发现三个主要分离现象：(1)注意力-行为分离：注意力遵循词汇惊奇度排序(D>F>C>E>B)，打乱消息捕获最多注意力；但行为上A~B~D<E~F<<C；(2)因子定位C效应：单独关系结构(F)或第一人称语域(E)均无法复制C的行为特征，两维度主效应各自显著，结构与语域交互在持续性上显著(p=0.046)；(3)情感探针分离：F在8个探针中7个与C一致，尽管只产生基线行为，表明关系结构单独安装了探针级状态，但只有在配对第一人称语域时才转化为行为。
AI.conclusion: 模型处理可分解为三个可分离阶段：注意力（按词汇惊奇度排序）、探针级状态（按关系结构排序）和行为（按两者联合排序）。关系式干预需要关系结构与第一人称语域的结合才能有效转化为行为改善。

title: EST-PRM: Stress-Testing Process Reward Models Before They Become Load-Bearing
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) are widely used in language-model training with dense step-level supervision. They assume PRM scores are stable proxies for step correctness under label-preserving transformations. These transformations change reasoning structure but preserve final answers. We argue this assumption is not well validated. Such transformations can change how PRM scores relate to correctness signals, leading to different failure modes across models.To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EST-PRM}, a stress-testing framework for dense process rewards. It applies three transformations: (1) step inflation, (2) dependency-aware step reordering, and (3) confidence markers. A vulnerability decomposition is defined that separates reward inflation from loss of correctness sensitivity. Five PRM-style models are evaluated on 4,687 reasoning chains from MATH-500, GSM8K, and PRMBench.The results indicate clear differences in vulnerability patterns across models. Math-Shepherd shows the strongest sensitivity to position perturbations, with a Pearson correlation drop of $0.152 \pm 0.038$ and a $32.8 \pm 4.9\%$ score inflation rate. Qwen2.5-Math-PRM is most affected by step inflation, reaching a $47.6 \pm 4.3\%$ inflation rate. Confidence-based perturbations also distort reward calibration, revealing inconsistencies in correctness estimation. Three mitigation strategies are evaluated, highlighting trade-offs between robustness coverage and false-positive rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EST-PRM框架，通过三种变换对过程奖励模型进行压力测试，发现PRM在标签保持变换下存在脆弱性，不同模型表现出不同的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型假设PRM分数在标签保持变换下是步骤正确性的稳定代理指标，但这些变换可能改变推理结构同时保留最终答案。作者认为该假设缺乏充分验证，因为这类变换可能改变PRM分数与正确性信号的关系，导致不同模型出现不同的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出EST-PRM压力测试框架，应用三种变换：（1）步骤膨胀；（2）依赖感知的步骤重排序；（3）置信度标记。定义了脆弱性分解方法，将奖励膨胀与正确性敏感性损失分离。在MATH-500、GSM8K和PRMBench的4,687条推理链上评估了五个PRM模型。
AI.result: 实验结果显示不同模型存在明显的脆弱性差异：Math-Shepherd对位置扰动最敏感，Pearson相关系数下降0.152±0.038，分数膨胀率达32.8±4.9%；Qwen2.5-Math-PRM受步骤膨胀影响最大，膨胀率达47.6±4.3%。基于置信度的扰动也会扭曲奖励校准，揭示正确性估计的不一致性。评估的三种缓解策略在鲁棒性覆盖率和假阳性率之间存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: PRM分数在标签保持变换下并非稳定的正确性代理指标，不同模型表现出不同的脆弱性模式。需要针对特定模型的脆弱性开发相应的防御策略，在鲁棒性和假阳性率之间取得平衡。

title: Towards Understanding Modality Interaction in Multimodal Language Models via Partial Information Decomposition
summary: Understanding modality interaction in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is central to reliable deployment. We introduce Partial Information Decomposition (PID) as a decision-level framework that separates unique, redundant, and synergistic contributions of sensory and linguistic inputs, beyond representation alignment and outcome-based evaluation. Across vision--language benchmarks, PID reveals recurring modality-use profiles: reasoning and grounding-oriented tasks tend to exhibit high synergy, whereas expert and knowledge-oriented tasks show stronger language-unique reliance. These profiles generalize across model families and predict sensitivity to modality-level interventions. We further extend PID to tri-modal systems with Sensory PID, treating language as a control variable to decompose video--audio information gain. Applied to omni-modal models, Sensory PID reveals a sensory synergy bottleneck dominated by visual information even on audio--visual fusion tasks. Finally, PID-guided reweighting provides initial evidence for improving multimodal reasoning and grounding performance.

AI.tldr: 本文引入部分信息分解（PID）框架，将多模态大语言模型中感官与语言输入的贡献分解为独特、冗余和协同三部分，揭示了任务类型与模态交互模式的关联规律，并发现了三模态系统中的感官协同瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的可靠部署需要深入理解模态间的交互机制，现有方法主要关注表示对齐和基于结果的评估，缺乏对决策层面模态贡献的细粒度分解与分析框架。
AI.method: 引入部分信息分解（PID）框架，在决策层面分离感官输入和语言输入的独特贡献、冗余贡献和协同贡献；将PID扩展至三模态系统（Sensory PID），将语言作为控制变量来分解视频-音频信息增益；基于PID分析结果进行模态权重重分配。
AI.result: 在视觉-语言基准测试中发现重复出现的模态使用模式：推理与接地任务呈现高协同性，专家与知识任务则显示更强的语言独特依赖；这些模式在多个模型家族中通用，并能预测模态级干预的敏感性；三模态系统的Sensory PID揭示了感官协同瓶颈，即使在音视频融合任务中也由视觉信息主导；PID引导的权重重分配初步验证了可提升多模态推理与接地性能。
AI.conclusion: PID框架为理解多模态大语言模型的模态交互提供了细粒度的决策层面分析工具，揭示了任务特定的模态使用模式，发现了三模态系统中的视觉主导瓶颈，并为通过模态权重调整优化模型性能提供了理论指导。

title: Exploiting weight-space symmetries for approximating curvature
comment: Published at ICML 2026. 35 pages, 11 figures. Code: https://github.com/mtkresearch/symm_opt
summary: Many machine learning techniques rely on approximating a loss function's curvature, but this is notoriously hard to do at the scale of modern deep networks. Surprisingly, no previous work has exploited the curvature constraints that arise from well known weight-space symmetries in loss landscapes. By analytically averaging over group actions that leave the loss invariant, we construct structured Hessian approximations from single gradients that can be tractably estimated, stored, and inverted. The choice of user-specified symmetry group directly governs the trade-off between approximation accuracy and computational cost. Moreover, our framework provides a unifying theoretical lens for viewing existing methods; in particular, a specific choice of symmetry group recovers Shampoo/Muon-like curvature estimates. We validate our method on a range of network architectures, and deploy it to second-order optimization benchmarks, including a small language model. Our curvature estimation framework might find applications in other machine learning problems such as uncertainty estimation, continual learning, compression/pruning, training data attribution, and more.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用损失景观中权重空间对称性的曲率约束，通过解析平均群作用来构建结构化Hessian近似的方法，实现了从单个梯度进行可处理的曲率估计，并为理解现有方法提供了统一的理论视角。
AI.motivation: 许多机器学习技术依赖于近似损失函数的曲率，但在现代深度网络规模下，这具有很大的挑战性。现有工作忽略了损失景观中众所周知的权重空间对称性所带来的曲率约束。
AI.method: 通过解析平均使损失保持不变的群作用，从单个梯度构建结构化的Hessian近似，这些近似可以被有效地估计、存储和求逆。用户指定的对称群的选择直接控制了近似精度和计算成本之间的权衡。
AI.result: 该方法在多种网络架构上得到了验证，并成功应用于二阶优化基准测试，包括小型语言模型。特定对称群的选择能够恢复类似Shampoo/Muon的曲率估计，证明了框架的统一性。
AI.conclusion: 该曲率估计框架为现有方法提供了统一的理论视角，并可能在不确定性估计、持续学习、压缩/剪枝、训练数据归因等其他机器学习问题中找到应用。

title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
summary: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $λ^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\barλ$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |Δ_\ell/Δ_w|$, and discount factor $β$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p,β)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\barλ$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在带有吸收性灾难状态的马尔可夫决策过程中，即使智能体是风险中性的，标准贝尔曼最优性也会产生类似前景理论的行为特征（S型价值函数、损失厌恶系数大于1、反射效应），表明吸收性失败状态是产生这些行为的充分结构机制。
AI.motivation: 前景理论中的非理性行为特征（如S型价值函数、损失厌恶、反射效应）通常被认为源于人类的心理偏差（效用曲率、概率加权、框架依赖等）。本文旨在探究这些行为特征是否可以纯粹从最优控制理论的结构性机制中产生，而不需要假设任何心理偏差。
AI.method: 作者研究了带有吸收性灾难状态的风险中性马尔可夫决策过程。通过495种配置的数值实验，分析了最优策略在正漂移（增长）和负漂移（衰退）区域的行为模式。推导了渐近损失厌恶系数的闭式表达式，并验证了该表达式在表格Q学习和随机转移噪声下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 标准贝尔曼最优性产生了三个类似前景理论的特征：S型价值函数（在灾难附近凸，在远处凹）、内生的损失敏感性系数λ*(S) > 1、以及反射效应下的策略反转。最优策略在增长区域即使在风险行为有更高期望值时也会选择安全行为，在衰退区域即使在安全行为有更低期望损失时也会选择风险行为。推导出的渐近损失厌恶系数闭式公式与数值解的拟合度达R²=0.999，该现象在Q学习和多种噪声条件下均保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 吸收性失败状态是产生前景理论式行为的充分结构机制，不需要假设非对称收益或任何心理偏差。这一发现为理解风险厌恶行为提供了新的理论基础，表明某些看似非理性的行为可能源于环境结构的约束而非认知偏差。

title: ProjQ: Project-and-Quantize for Adapter-Aware LLM Compression
summary: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) constitute the standard pipeline for efficient Large Language Model (LLM) deployment. However, applying them sequentially poses a problem: PTQ often leaves behind random noise that is spread out (across the model's weights) in a way LoRA can't easily fix, meaning that LoRA ends up wasting its limited capacity trying to fix uncorrectable noise instead of improving task performance. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ProjQ}, a novel framework for constraining quantization noise to the low-rank manifold via orthogonal subspace projection. We derive an efficient alternating algorithm that shapes the quantization noise into a low-rank structure, effectively offloading dominant error components to the subsequent adapter while minimizing the residual error in the orthogonal "uncorrectable" subspace. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that ProjQ preserves strictly greater model plasticity for downstream tasks compared to standard PTQ. Extensive experiments on LLaMA-2, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 confirm that ProjQ consistently outperforms existing methods in both quantization error compensation and downstream task fine-tuning, achieving up to $2\times$ lower evaluation loss for compensation and matching the performance of standard 4-bit baselines on language modeling tasks with only 3 bits. The code is available on https://github.com/yy9301/ProjQ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProjQ框架，通过正交子空间投影将量化噪声约束到低秩流形，解决了PTQ和LoRA顺序应用时的噪声问题，在3比特量化下达到4比特基线性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的PTQ和LoRA顺序应用流程存在关键问题：PTQ产生的随机噪声在权重中分散分布，LoRA难以有效修正，导致LoRA浪费有限容量去处理无法修正的噪声而非提升任务性能。
AI.method: 提出ProjQ框架，通过正交子空间投影将量化噪声约束到低秩流形。开发高效交替算法，将量化噪声塑造为低秩结构，将主要误差分量转移给后续适配器，同时最小化正交"不可修正"子空间中的残差误差。
AI.result: 理论分析证明ProjQ相比标准PTQ保留更严格的模型可塑性。在LLaMA-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3上的实验表明：补偿损失降低高达2倍，在3比特量化下匹配标准4比特基线的语言建模性能。
AI.conclusion: ProjQ成功解决了PTQ与LoRA顺序应用的噪声问题，通过约束量化噪声到低秩流形实现了更好的噪声补偿和下游任务微调性能，为高效LLM部署提供了新方案。

title: Large Language Models in Transportation Systems Management and Operations: From Text Reasoning to Multi-modal Decision Support
summary: Transportation systems management and operations (TSMO) increasingly depends on timely interpretation of heterogeneous data, from various sensor streams, incident reports, traveler feedback, and visual observations. Large language models (LLMs), including emerging multi-modal large language models (MM-LLMs), provide a new mechanism for integrating these structured and unstructured inputs into operator-facing decision support. This survey paper reviews LLM- and MM-LLM-based applications in TSMO across three domains: transportation operations & services (supply), mobility & fleet services (demand), and data, modeling & decision support. Using a PRISMA-guided screening process, we synthesize current studies while distinguishing operationally oriented applications from prototype and emerging concepts. We further identify recurring challenges in data heterogeneity, real-time inference, explainability, multi-modal fusion, and governance. Finally, we outline existing gaps and future directions in localized adaptation, edge deployment, benchmarking, and cross-agency collaboration. Overall, LLM-based systems appear most promising as a decision-support layer, with MM-LLMs offering particular value when heterogeneous text, visual, and sensor inputs must be integrated.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统回顾了大型语言模型（LLMs）及多模态大型语言模型（MM-LLMs）在交通系统管理与运营（TSMO）中的应用，涵盖运营服务、出行需求及数据决策支持三大领域，指出其作为决策支持层最具前景。
AI.motivation: 交通系统管理与运营日益依赖对来自传感器流、事件报告、出行者反馈及视觉观测等异构数据的及时解读，而传统方法在整合这些结构化与非结构化输入方面存在困难。大型语言模型及新兴的多模态大型语言模型为将这些异构输入整合到面向操作员的决策支持系统提供了新机制，亟需系统梳理其应用现状与挑战。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA指南指导的筛选流程，系统回顾并综合当前LLM及MM-LLM在TSMO领域的研究，将应用划分为运输运营与服务（供给）、出行与车队服务（需求）、数据建模与决策支持三大领域，并区分面向运营的应用与原型及新兴概念。
AI.result: 识别出数据异构性、实时推理、可解释性、多模态融合及治理等反复出现的挑战；发现基于LLM的系统作为决策支持层最具前景，特别是MM-LLMs在需要整合异构文本、视觉及传感器输入的场景中价值突出。
AI.conclusion: 论文概述了当前研究的空白与未来方向，包括本地化适配、边缘部署、基准测试及跨机构协作，强调LLM及MM-LLM技术在TSMO领域具有广阔应用潜力，尤其适合作为整合多源异构数据的决策支持层。

title: Torus Graphs for Large Scale Neural Phase Analysis
comment: 23 pages, 15 figures; to be published in ICML 2026
summary: Oscillatory neural signals such as electroencephalography (EEG) and local field potentials (LFPs) show phase relationships that coordinate communication across brain regions. Modern recordings capture hundreds of channels across many frequency bins, yet standard phase analyses are restricted to only a few variables. The Torus Graph (TG) model, an exponential-family distribution over phases whose univariate and pairwise potentials generalize von Mises distributions, infers principled structure among oscillations but models only static, undirected dependencies and is limited to $\sim \! 100$ variables because its score matching inference scales as $\mathcal{O}(d^{6})$. We introduce a stochastic score matching procedure that reduces the per-iteration cost to $\mathcal{O}(d^{2})$, enabling inference on datasets with thousands of variables. This scalable foundation supports analyses of 1,860 frequency-phase features from multi-electrode LFPs and enables two extensions previously inaccessible to TGs or classical circular statistics: (i) a TG Hidden Markov Model capturing state-dependent phase-coupling changes (e.g., spindle-related states during sleep) and (ii) an autoregressive TG inferring directional interactions via transfer-entropy estimation. Applied to LFP recordings, these models reveal state-dependent phase-interaction patterns between wakefulness and NREM sleep. Together, they enable systematic, large-scale mapping of dynamic and directional phase relationships across brain and cognitive states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了随机分数匹配方法，将环形图模型(Torus Graph)的计算复杂度从O(d^6)降至O(d^2)，使其能够分析数千变量的振荡相位关系，并扩展出隐马尔可夫模型和自回归模型以捕捉动态和方向性相位耦合。
AI.motivation: EEG和LFP等振荡神经信号表现出协调脑区间通信的相位关系。现代记录技术可捕获数百个通道和多个频率仓，但传统相位分析方法仅限于少数变量。现有的环形图模型(TG)虽能推断振荡间结构，但仅限于静态、无向依赖，且因分数匹配推断复杂度为O(d^6)，只能处理约100个变量，无法满足大规模神经数据分析需求。
AI.method:
1. 提出随机分数匹配过程，将每次迭代成本从O(d^6)降至O(d^2)，实现对数千变量数据集的推断
2. 基于此扩展框架开发了两个新模型：
   - TG隐马尔可夫模型(HMM)：捕捉状态依赖的相位耦合变化(如睡眠中的纺锤波相关状态)
   - 自回归TG：通过传递熵估计推断方向性交互作用
AI.result: 该方法成功应用于多电极LFP记录的1,860个频率-相位特征分析。模型揭示了清醒与NREM睡眠之间的状态依赖性相位交互模式，证明了方法在大规模神经数据中识别动态和方向性相位关系的能力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立的框架实现了跨大脑和认知状态的动态及方向性相位关系的系统性大规模映射，为振荡神经通信研究提供了强大的分析工具，突破了传统方法在变量规模和分析能力上的限制。

title: Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation
summary: Subliminal learning refers to a student language model acquiring a teacher's traits (e.g. a system-prompted preference for owls) when fine-tuned on the teacher's outputs, despite the outputs being semantically unrelated to those traits. It remains poorly understood how data without semantic meaning can transfer specific semantic traits. In this work, we show that subliminal learning is mediated by a single steering vector, i.e. a vector added to the model's activations. Across two open-source models, we find that the teacher's system prompt is well approximated by a steering vector, and that the student's behavior is driven by learning an aligned vector over fine-tuning. System prompts that are not well approximated by steering vectors are not subliminally learned. This is a special case of steering vector distillation, in which a student trained on the outputs of a steered teacher learns to imitate that steering. We demonstrate steering vector distillation on a range of semantic and random vectors. Adding a semantic vector to a model's activations can have both model-independent and model-specific (i.e. non-semantic) effects on its behavior, so generated data that is non-semantic can transmit a vector with semantic effects, enabling subliminal learning. This also explains why subliminal learning does not transfer between models. We find that adaptive optimizers are necessary for subliminal learning in language models: activation gradients on steered data carry a small but consistent component along the steering direction, and non-adaptive optimizers impede this by allowing outlier gradients to dominate.

AI.tldr: 发现了潜意识学习（subliminal learning）现象的机制：通过微调教师模型的输出，学生模型可以学习到教师的非语义特征，这是由于单一的导向向量（steering vector）的传递和蒸馏过程实现的。
AI.motivation: 潜意识学习现象（学生模型从教师的输出中习得与输出语义无关的特征）的机制尚不明确，研究旨在揭示无语义含义的数据如何传递特定的语义特征。
AI.method: 通过实验验证教师模型的系统提示可以用单一的导向向量近似表示；分析学生在微调过程中学习对齐向量的过程；在多个开源模型上测试不同类型的导向向量；比较自适应优化器和非自适应优化器的影响。
AI.result: 教师的系统提示可以被导向向量很好地近似；学生模型在微调中学习到了对齐的向量；不能被导向向量很好近似的系统提示不会被潜意识学习；自适应优化器对潜意识学习是必要的，因为激活梯度沿导向方向有小而一致的分量。
AI.conclusion: 潜意识学习是导向向量蒸馏的特殊案例：语义导向向量加入模型激活既有模型无关（语义）效果也有模型特定（非语义）效果，因此非语义的生成数据可以传递具有语义效果的向量，这也解释了为什么潜意识学习不能在模型间转移。

title: TabChange: Precise Attribute Changes in Tabular Data
summary: Modifying an attribute in tabular data often introduces an unnatural instance by breaking its relationships with other attributes. The modified instance must be both natural and minimally changed from the original instance. This paper addresses the challenge of generating such a modified instance. We identify key limitations in existing approaches: generative models either don't support instance-level attribute editing or, in the case of methods like CVAE, retain attribute information in the latent space, leading to unnecessary modifications. To solve this, we propose TabChange, an approach that analyzes the relationship between the attribute of interest and other attributes in the dataset. If the relationship is weak, it simply flips the attribute; if it is strong, it uses an adversarial framework that removes information about the attribute in the latent space representation. This removal enables precise modifications, making only the necessary adjustments to maintain naturalness. Our experiments across seven datasets show that TabChange generates counterfactuals in attributes that are comparable in naturalness and are more proximal to their original instances. This leads to a higher number of valid counterfactuals and a lower number of invalid counterfactuals compared to the baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了TabChange方法，用于在表格数据中生成自然且最小化修改的反事实实例，通过分析属性间关系强弱来决定采用简单翻转或对抗框架去除潜在空间中的属性信息。
AI.motivation: 修改表格数据中的属性往往会破坏该属性与其他属性之间的关系，导致生成不自然的实例。现有生成模型要么不支持实例级属性编辑，要么（如CVAE）在潜在空间中保留属性信息，导致不必要的修改。因此需要一种能够生成既自然又最小化修改的实例的方法。
AI.method: 提出TabChange方法，首先分析目标属性与数据集中其他属性之间的关系强度。如果关系较弱，直接翻转属性；如果关系较强，则使用对抗框架在潜在空间表示中移除该属性的信息，从而实现精确修改，仅进行必要的调整以保持自然性。
AI.result: 在七个数据集上的实验表明，TabChange生成的反事实实例在自然性方面与基线方法相当，并且在接近原始实例方面表现更好，产生了更多有效的反事实实例和更少的无效反事实实例。
AI.conclusion: TabChange成功解决了表格数据属性修改中的关键问题，通过分析属性关系强度并采用相应的策略（简单翻转或对抗框架），能够生成更加自然且最小化修改的反事实实例，在多个数据集上优于现有基线方法。

title: Property Prediction of Stacked Bilayer Materials: A Multimodal Learning Approach
comment: Accepted to the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2026)
summary: AI for materials science is a critical topic within AI for science, aiming to accelerate materials discovery and produce accurate property predictions. Bilayer 2D material stacking is essential for exploring new materials with novel functions and inherent phenomena, enabling the creation of new 2D bilayers for diverse real-world applications. Research on bilayer vdWs materials has made significant progress from experimental and computational perspectives. Various bilayer materials have been successfully synthe sized experimentally and the increasing utilization of high-throughput computing technology has con structed several computational two-dimensional materials databases. However, the use of AI to model bilayer stacking and predict new properties remains underexplored, necessitating further research studies. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal learning approach to study the interfaces between dissimilar materials that jointly enable new or multiple functions, and to predict new properties arising from the vertical integration (stacking) of different functional material layers under given configurations. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach compared to baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/AnVuong123/bimat ml.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新颖的多模态学习方法，用于建模异质材料间的双层二维材料堆叠，预测新功能材料及其性质，实验证明其有效性和高效性。
AI.motivation: AI for materials science是AI for science的重要课题，双层二维材料堆叠对探索具有新功能的材料至关重要。虽然实验和计算研究取得了进展，但利用AI建模双层堆叠并预测新性质的研究仍然不足。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的多模态学习方法，研究异质材料之间的界面，预测不同功能材料层在给定配置下垂直集成（堆叠）产生的新性质。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，与基准方法相比，该方法具有良好的有效性和高效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了AI在双层材料堆叠建模和性质预测方面的研究空白，为材料发现提供了新的AI驱动方法。

title: Saliency-Aware Model Merging
summary: Model merging aims to consolidate multiple task-specific models fine-tuned on different datasets into a unified architecture that performs cross-domain proficiency. Current data-free model merging methods often struggle to scale as they rely on simple parameter-level heuristics that ignore inter-layer dependencies and non-uniform distribution of expertise. This work proposes SA-Merging, which is built upon connectivity-based saliency formulations from structural pruning (e.g., SynFlow) and extends them to the data-free model merging setting. We define a saliency score over task vectors relative to a shared base model, and further introduce merge-aware modulation that incorporates agreement across experts to mitigate task interference. Based on this formulation, an iterative saliency-aware merging procedure progressively removes non-informative updates while preserving end-to-end connectivity. Furthermore, we extend SA-Merging to introduce rank-wise saliency decomposition for LoRAs without compromising their structural integrity. Extensive experiments on vision and language tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our saliency-based approach, further reducing the gap between data-free and test-time adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SA-Merging，一种基于显著性的无数据模型合并方法，通过借鉴结构剪枝中的连接性显著性公式，有效提升了多任务模型合并的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的无数据模型合并方法难以扩展，主要因为它们依赖于简单的参数级启发式方法，忽略了层间依赖关系和专业知识的非均匀分布问题。
AI.method: 提出SA-Merging方法，基于结构剪枝（如SynFlow）的连接性显著性公式进行扩展。定义任务向量相对于共享基础模型的显著性分数，引入合并感知调制机制来减少任务干扰。采用迭代显著性感知合并过程，逐步移除非信息性更新同时保持端到端连接性。还将方法扩展到LoRA场景，引入秩级显著性分解。
AI.result: 在视觉和语言任务上的广泛实验表明，基于显著性的方法具有有效性，进一步缩小了无数据方法与测试时适应方法之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: SA-Merging成功地将结构剪枝中的显著性概念应用于模型合并领域，通过考虑层间依赖和专业知识分布，显著提升了无数据模型合并的性能和可扩展性。

title: Semi-Supervised Learning with Noisy Proxy Covariates: Generalization Bounds and Distribution Regression
summary: In many modern machine learning pipelines, abundant pretrained representations serve as noisy proxy covariates, while task-specific labels remain scarce. We study semi-supervised regression in this setting, and propose a simple two stage estimator that learns kernel eigenfeatures from all proxy covariates and fits a ridge predictor on labeled data. We derive finite sample bounds showing that fast labeled sample rates are recovered when proxy perturbation is controlled and unlabeled proxy covariates are sufficiently abundant. We also show that distribution regression is a direct special case, with analogous guarantees when the finite bag size is large enough. Experiments show consistent gains over supervised and semi-supervised baselines, especially in low label regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对预训练表示作为噪声代理协变量的半监督回归两阶段估计器，通过核特征学习和岭回归预测在标签稀缺情况下实现了良好的性能恢复。
AI.motivation: 在现代机器学习流程中，大量预训练表示可作为噪声代理协变量使用，而任务特定标签仍然稀缺。这种设置下的半监督回归问题需要有效利用无标签代理协变量来改善预测性能。
AI.method: 提出简单的两阶段估计器：第一阶段从所有代理协变量中学习核特征，第二阶段在有标签数据上拟合岭预测器。该方法将分布回归视为直接特例。
AI.result: 推导出有限样本界限，证明当代理扰动受控且无标签代理协变量足够丰富时，可以恢复快速标签样本率。在分布回归特例中，当有限袋尺寸足够大时获得类似保证。实验显示在低标签区域相比监督和半监督基线方法有一致性增益。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为利用噪声代理协变量进行半监督回归提供了理论基础和实践验证，在标签稀缺场景下表现出色，特别适用于预训练表示作为输入特征的现代机器学习场景。

title: Tackling the Root of Misinformation by Teaching Laypeople about Logical Fallacies via Socratic Questioning and Critical Argumentation
comment: This paper has been accepted to Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Long Paper), Main Conference
summary: Identifying logical fallacies in everyday discourse is challenging for many people. This challenge is amplified in the era of Large Language Models (LLMs), where malicious agents can deploy fallacious arguments to disseminate misinformation at scale. In this work, we explore the potential of LLMs as part of the solution. We introduce LFTutor, an intelligent tutoring system which uses LLMs to tutor laypeople and help them learn about logical fallacies. LFTutor integrates intent-driven Socratic questioning and critical argumentation principles to actively engage learners to reflect on their reasoning. Through both automatic and human evaluations, we demonstrate that LFTutor significantly outperforms baseline LLMs lacking these pedagogical strategies. This work highlights the promise of combining LLMs with pedagogical scaffolding to foster critical thinking and argument literacy in the age of AI.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了LFTutor，一个利用大语言模型（LLM）教授普通人识别逻辑谬误的智能辅导系统。该系统融合了意图驱动的苏格拉底式提问和批判性论证原则，在自动评估和人工评估中均显著优于缺乏这些教学策略的基线LLM，证明了将LLM与教学支架相结合能有效培养批判性思维和论证素养。
AI.motivation: 在日常生活中识别逻辑谬误对许多人而言具有挑战性，而在大语言模型时代，恶意行为者可利用谬误论证大规模传播虚假信息，使得这一问题更加严峻。研究旨在探索LLM作为解决方案一部分的潜力，通过智能辅导提升公众的逻辑谬误识别能力。
AI.method: 开发了名为LFTutor的智能辅导系统，该系统核心特点是将意图驱动的苏格拉底式提问与批判性论证原则相结合。这种教学方法旨在主动引导学习者反思其推理过程，而非简单提供答案。研究通过自动评估和人工评估两种方式，将LFTutor与缺乏这些教学策略的基线LLM进行对比。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，LFTutor在自动评估和人工评估中均显著优于缺乏教学策略的基线LLM。这证明了意图驱动的苏格拉底式提问和批判性论证原则等教学支架对提升LLM辅导效果的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 本研究突出了将LLM与教学支架相结合的前景，为在AI时代培养批判性思维和论证素养提供了有效途径。这种结合不仅提升了学习效果，也为应对 misinformation 等社会挑战提供了技术支持。

title: Generate in Reconstruction Space, Match in Semantic Space: Transport Geometry for One-Step Generation
summary: Generative modeling and self-supervised representation learning (SSL) optimize structurally different objectives: generative training rewards distributional fidelity, while SSL rewards semantic coherence. Yet recent work repeatedly finds that SSL features improve generative training, though the mechanism of this synergy remains unclear. Here, we study the benefits of SSL in generative modeling in the framework of one-step generation where the role of representation is explicit: frozen SSL features are used to match generated samples to real data. We use the Sinkhorn divergence in that feature space, providing a tractable surrogate for the Wasserstein distance, the population-level discrepancy approximated by Fréchet-style evaluation metrics (such as FID). We find that this objective becomes highly effective when computed in a semantically structured SSL feature space (a 39$\times$ reduction in ImageNet FID). We trace this behavior primarily to matching estimation: semantic SSL features that suppress nuisance reconstruction details induce a more compact geometry, making distribution matching more tractable. As a consequence, the best training SSL features need not match the features used by the evaluation metric. In particular, we show that using Inception as the feature extractor can improve FID while degrading matching stability and sample quality, revealing a form of metric hacking. Using extensive experiments on ImageNet, we identify which SSL feature families lead to best generation performance and show that matching stability is a quantitative criterion for selecting them. Code is available at https://github.com/Genentech/semantic-transport-generation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自监督学习(SSL)特征通过抑制无关重建细节、诱导更紧凑的几何结构，使分布匹配更易处理，从而显著提升生成模型性能（ImageNet FID降低39倍），并发现最佳训练SSL特征无需与评估指标使用的特征一致。
AI.motivation: 生成建模与自监督表示学习(SSL)优化结构上不同的目标，但近期研究发现SSL特征能改善生成训练，这种协同作用的机制尚不清楚。本文旨在通过单步生成框架明确表征的作用，深入研究SSL在生成建模中的益处。
AI.method: 在单步生成框架下，使用冻结的SSL特征将生成样本与真实数据匹配；在特征空间中采用Sinkhorn散度作为Wasserstein距离的可处理代理；在ImageNet上进行大量实验，系统评估不同SSL特征家族的生成性能。
AI.result: 语义结构化的SSL特征空间使目标函数高度有效，ImageNet FID降低39倍；SSL特征通过抑制无关重建细节诱导更紧凑的几何结构，使分布匹配更易处理；最佳训练SSL特征不必与评估指标使用的特征匹配；使用Inception作为特征提取器可改善FID但降低匹配稳定性和样本质量，揭示了度量黑客现象；匹配稳定性是选择SSL特征的定量标准。
AI.conclusion: SSL特征的语义结构化特性通过简化匹配估计显著提升生成性能，评估指标（如FID）与实际生成质量存在潜在偏离，匹配稳定性应作为选择SSL特征的关键量化准则。

title: TriLens: Per-Layer Logit-Lens Entropy for White-Box Hallucination Detection
summary: When a language model hallucinates, the final answer is wrong, but the mistake is not necessarily invisible inside the model. Different internal pathways may remain uncertain, disagree in how quickly they sharpen, or commit to competing continuations before the output is produced. We introduce TriLens, a white-box detector that turns this intuition into a compact representation: at every layer, it reads the multi-head self-attention output, the feed-forward output, and the residual stream through the model's own logit lens, then records only the entropy of each readout. The resulting 3L-dimensional trajectory describes how certainty forms across depth and across modules, without storing high-dimensional hidden states or sampling multiple generations. This simple signal yields a strong detector across instruction-tuned LLMs and QA benchmarks, and our analyses show that the three module-wise entropy trajectories provide complementary evidence. TriLens suggests that hallucination detection can benefit from tracking how internal computation settles, not only what the final layer predicts.

AI.tldr: 提出TriLens白盒检测器，通过追踪Transformer三个模块（自注意力、前馈网络、残差流）的熵轨迹来检测大语言模型的幻觉，证明内部计算过程的不确定性变化比最终预测更能揭示幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法多关注最终输出，但模型内部可能存在不确定性和竞争性计算路径。作者认为追踪内部计算过程的不确定性形成机制比仅观察最终预测更能有效检测幻觉。
AI.method: 提出TriLens检测器：在每个Transformer层读取多头自注意力输出、前馈网络输出和残差流，通过模型自身的logit lens计算并仅记录每个读出的熵值，形成3L维熵轨迹向量，无需存储高维隐藏状态或多次采样。
AI.result: 在指令微调LLM和QA基准测试上取得强检测性能；三个模块的熵轨迹提供互补证据；证明追踪内部计算收敛过程对幻觉检测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉检测可从追踪内部计算收敛过程而非仅关注最终层预测中受益；TriLens为计算过程追踪提供了高效紧凑的解决方案，揭示不同模块对最终预测的贡献差异。

title: DREAM-S: Speculative Decoding with Searchable Drafting and Target-Aware Refinement for Multimodal Generation
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) has proven to be an effective technique for accelerating autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) however, its application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains relatively unexplored. We propose~\textit{DREAM-S}, a novel SD framework designed specifically for fast and efficient decoding in VLMs. DREAM-S leverages a neural architecture search (NAS) framework with target-aware supernet training to automatically identify both the optimal interaction strategy between the draft and target models, and the most suitable draft model architecture for the underlying hardware implementation platform. DREAM-S additionally incorporates adaptive intermediate feature distillation, guided by attention entropy, to enable efficient draft training. Experiments on a range of well-established VLMs show that DREAM-S achieves up to a $3.85\times$ speedup compared to standard decoding approaches and significantly outperforms existing SD baselines. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/DREAM-S .

AI.tldr: 提出了DREAM-S，一个针对视觉语言模型(VLMs)的推测解码(SD)框架，通过神经架构搜索(NAS)自动优化草稿模型架构及其与目标模型的交互策略，实现了最高3.85倍的推理加速，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 推测解码(SD)已证明能有效加速大型语言模型(LLMs)的自回归生成，但其在视觉语言模型(VLMs)中的应用仍相对未被探索。现有方法缺乏针对VLMs特点的优化，且草稿模型的选择和训练策略需要手动设计，效率较低。
AI.method: 提出DREAM-S框架：(1)利用神经架构搜索(NAS)框架，通过目标感知超网络训练，自动识别草稿模型与目标模型之间的最优交互策略以及最适合硬件平台的草稿模型架构；(2)引入由注意力熵引导的自适应中间特征蒸馏，实现高效的草稿模型训练。
AI.result: 在多个主流视觉语言模型上的实验表明，DREAM-S相比标准解码方法实现了最高3.85倍的加速，并显著优于现有的推测解码基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DREAM-S成功地将推测解码技术扩展到视觉语言模型领域，通过自动化的架构搜索和高效的训练策略，实现了显著的推理加速效果，为VLMs的高效部署提供了新的解决方案。代码已公开以促进研究复现和进一步发展。

title: TravelEval: A Comprehensive Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating LLM-Powered Travel Planning Agents
summary: The development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has significantly improved travel planning applications, yet evaluating such models is limited by existing benchmarks' limitations: 1) overemphasis on constraint compliance, neglecting multi-dimensional qualities like spatio-temporal cost; 2) datasets lacking real-world authenticity and coverage in key areas (e.g., lodging, transport); and 3) isolated daily plan assessments that miss critical details (e.g., the impact of daily accommodation and visit pacing) needed for entire plan's evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce TravelEval, a realistic and comprehensive benchmark. TravelEval features 1) a novel six-dimensional evaluation framework to holistically assess plans across accuracy, compliance, temporality, spatiality, economy, and utility dimensions; 2) a highly realistic data sandbox with precise accommodation pricing and authentic intercity transportation data; and 3) a simulation-based global evaluation method that emulates complete travel plans with API-integrated geographic information and fine-grained queuing time. Evaluating 12 mainstream approaches with TravelEval reveals several valuable insights, such that LLMs struggle with globally-optimized multi-dimensional planning (especially in spatio-temporal reasoning and budget compliance), and agentic reasoning strategies offer no consistent improvement. Concisely, TravelEval facilitates travel plan evaluation via grounded spatio-temporal emulation and comprehensive metrics, providing a robust foundation for advancing LLM-powered travel planning research and applications.

AI.tldr: 提出了TravelEval，一个全面且现实的旅行规划基准测试，包含六维评估框架、真实数据沙盒和仿真评估方法，评估发现现有LLM在空间-时间推理和预算合规方面存在困难。
AI.motivation: 现有旅行规划评估基准存在局限性：过度强调约束遵守而忽视时空成本等多维质量；数据集缺乏真实性和关键领域覆盖；孤立评估每日计划而忽略完整计划所需的关键细节。
AI.method: 构建TravelEval基准，包含：1) 六维评估框架（准确性、合规性、时间性、空间性、经济性、效用性）；2) 包含精确住宿价格和真实城际交通数据的高度真实数据沙盒；3) 基于仿真的全局评估方法，集成API地理信息和细粒度排队时间。
AI.result: 对12种主流方法的评估显示：LLM在全局优化的多维规划上存在困难，特别是在时空推理和预算合规方面；智能体推理策略未提供一致性改进。
AI.conclusion: TravelEval通过基于现实的时空仿真和综合指标促进了旅行计划评估，为推进LLM驱动的旅行规划研究和应用提供了坚实基础。

title: GNMR: Runtime Stability Control for Low-Precision Large Language Model Training
summary: Training stability is a key bottleneck in low-precision language model training: efficient low-cost paths can still produce short-lived numerical risks at a small set of operators. We formulate this as runtime stability control and present Gradient Norm-to-Mean Ratio (GNMR), a lightweight controller that compares each recoverable unit's current gradient norm with its historical mean. Together with $Δ$-GNMR for abrupt short-window increases, GNMR maps local risk signals to bounded recovery actions under a hard $\mathrm{maxO}$ budget and a short lock interval, without changing the numerical format, kernel, or backend recipe. Across activation-quantization stress, DeepSeek-style recipe-level training, and LLaMA-2 13B fine-tuning, GNMR preserves high-fidelity quality with sparse, budgeted recovery. These results support GNMR as a backend-agnostic controller to improve low-precision training stability while preserving low-cost execution.

AI.tldr: 提出GNMR轻量级控制器，通过梯度范数与历史均值比值动态识别低精度训练中的数值风险，在有限预算内实施稀疏恢复，在不改变数值格式或后端的情况下提升训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 低精度语言模型训练中存在训练稳定性瓶颈：即使是高效的低成本路径，仍会在少量算子上产生短暂但危险的数值风险，这些风险会威胁训练过程的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出梯度范数-均值比（GNMR）轻量级控制器，将每个可恢复单元的当前梯度范数与历史均值进行比较，结合Δ-GNMR检测短期突增；在最大恢复预算（maxO）和短锁定间隔约束下，将局部风险信号映射为有界的恢复动作，无需改变数值格式、内核或后端配方。
AI.result: 在激活量化压力测试、DeepSeek风格配方级训练和LLaMA-2 13B微调等场景中，GNMR在保持高保真质量的同时实现了稀疏且有预算约束的恢复，验证了其作为后端无关控制器的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GNMR作为一种后端无关的控制器，能够在保持低成本执行的同时有效改善低精度训练的稳定性，为解决低精度语言模型训练中的稳定性瓶颈提供了实用方案。

title: AnyEdit++: Adaptive Long-Form Knowledge Editing via Bayesian Surprise
summary: Editing complex, long-form knowledge in Large Language Models remains a significant challenge due to the difficulty of maintaining generation coherence. Existing autoregressive methods like AnyEdit alleviate length constraints but rely on Fixed-window Chunking, which disregards logical structure and compromises consistency. To address this, we present AnyEdit++, a structure-aware framework incorporating Bayes-Chunk, an adaptive segmentation mechanism that dynamically identifies semantic boundaries based on Bayesian Surprise. We underpin this approach with a theoretical framework establishing two key principles: (1) Structural Independence: we prove that cross-segment interference is minimized when anchor keys are geometrically orthogonal (a condition naturally satisfied by our surprisal-based boundaries but violated by fixed windows), and (2) Causal Locality: we demonstrate that updates injected at these semantic peaks yield strictly superior control compared to arbitrary split points. Extensive experiments across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and narrative tasks demonstrate that AnyEdit++ achieves superior performance and robustness compared to state-of-the-art baselines, validating that structural awareness is critical for effective long-form knowledge editing.

AI.tldr: 提出AnyEdit++框架，通过基于贝叶斯惊喜的自适应语义分割机制解决大模型长文本知识编辑中的一致性保持问题，并在数学推理、代码生成和叙事任务上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型长文本知识编辑方法（如AnyEdit）采用固定窗口分块策略，忽视了文本的逻辑结构，导致跨段落的语义一致性受损。长文本编辑在保持生成连贯性方面仍面临重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出结构感知框架AnyEdit++，引入Bayes-Chunk自适应分割机制，基于贝叶斯惊喜动态识别语义边界。建立理论框架证明两个关键原理：(1)结构独立性：当锚键几何正交时跨段干扰最小化（基于惊喜度的边界天然满足此条件而固定窗口违反该条件）；(2)因果局部性：在语义峰值处注入更新比任意分割点提供更优的控制能力。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和叙事任务上的大量实验表明，AnyEdit++相比最先进的基线方法实现了更优的性能和鲁棒性，验证了结构感知对于有效长文本知识编辑的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知是实现有效长文本知识编辑的关键因素。基于贝叶斯惊喜的自适应语义分割能够更好地保持文本的逻辑结构和生成一致性，为复杂长文本知识编辑提供了新的解决方案。

title: Rethinking Bregman Divergences in Kronecker-Factored Optimizers
summary: Shampoo-style optimizers approximate gradient covariance matrices using Kronecker-factored structures. Recent work~\cite{lin2026understanding} showed that such approximations can be viewed as projections under Bregman matrix divergences, leading to different Kronecker-factored preconditioners. However, it remains unclear what role the choice of divergence plays when the covariance is not exactly Kronecker-factored. We study this question through the spectrum of the covariance matrix. We show that Frobenius, von Neumann, and LogDet divergences distribute the unavoidable Kronecker approximation error differently across the covariance spectrum. We further show that their Kronecker factors are governed by divergence-weighted residuals rather than the raw approximation error, explaining how these spectral preferences are realized in the resulting preconditioners. Empirically, we observe that the top covariance eigenspace is substantially better aligned with the Hessian matrix, while the tail spectrum is much noisier and unreliable. Motivated by these findings, we propose a subspace-aware Kronecker optimizer that applies eigenvalue-based preconditioning in the top subspace and uses an adaptive isotropic acceleration constant in the bottom subspace.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了不同Bregman散度在Kronecker近似中的谱偏好差异，并提出了一种结合顶部子空间特征值预调和底部子空间自适应加速的子空间感知Kronecker优化器。
AI.motivation: 现有Shampoo类优化器使用Kronecker结构近似梯度协方差矩阵，虽然近期工作表明这种近似可视为Bregman矩阵散度下的投影，但当协方差矩阵不严格满足Kronecker结构时，散度选择的作用机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过协方差矩阵的谱分析，研究Frobenius、von Neumann和LogDet三种散度如何将Kronecker近似误差在协方差谱上差异化分布，并揭示Kronecker因子由散度加权残差而非原始近似误差决定的机制。基于协方差顶部特征空间与Hessian矩阵高度对齐、尾部谱噪声较大的发现，设计子空间感知Kronecker优化器。
AI.result: 理论分析表明不同散度导致谱误差分布的显著差异；实证观察发现协方差顶部特征空间与Hessian矩阵对齐度显著优于尾部谱；所提子空间感知Kronecker优化器在顶部子空间采用基于特征值的预调，在底部子空间使用自适应各向同性加速常数。
AI.conclusion: Bregman散度选择通过谱偏好机制影响Kronecker预调器的行为，利用协方差谱的子空间特性设计的优化器能够更好地结合结构化近似与自适应加速策略。

title: DAG-MoE: From Simple Mixture to Structural Aggregation in Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a leading approach for decoupling parameter count from computational cost in large language models, yet effectively scaling MoE performance remains a challenge. Prior work shows that fine-grained experts enlarge the space of expert combinations and improve flexibility, but they also impose substantial routing overhead, creating a new scalability bottleneck. In this paper, we explore a complementary axis for scaling -- how expert outputs are aggregated. We theoretically show that replacing the standard weighted-summation aggregation with structural aggregation expands the expert-combination space without altering the experts or router, and enables possible multi-step reasoning within a single MoE layer. To this end, we propose DAG-MoE, a sparse MoE framework that employs a lightweight module to automatically learn the optimal aggregation structure among the selected experts. Extensive experiments under standard language modeling settings show that DAG-MoE consistently improves performance in both pretraining and fine-tuning, surpassing traditional MoE baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAG-MoE，一种通过结构化聚合替代传统加权求和的稀疏MoE框架，在不改变专家或路由的情况下扩展专家组合空间，在预训练和微调中均显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE模型扩展面临挑战：细粒度专家虽能提升灵活性，但引入了显著的路由开销，造成新的可扩展性瓶颈。作者探索了一条互补的扩展方向——专家输出的聚合方式。
AI.method: 提出DAG-MoE框架：1) 理论证明用结构化聚合替代标准加权求和可扩展专家组合空间，且不改变专家或路由；2) 设计轻量级模块自动学习选中专家间的最优聚合结构；3) 使单层MoE具备多步推理能力。
AI.result: 在标准语言建模设置下的广泛实验表明，DAG-MoE在预训练和微调任务中均持续优于传统MoE基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 专家聚合方式是MoE扩展的有效互补维度，DAG-MoE通过学习聚合结构实现了性能提升，为MoE模型的高效扩展提供了新思路。

title: Escaping the Mode Lottery: Multi-Response Training Improves Language Model Generalization
summary: Modern language-model fine-tuning typically pairs each prompt with a single response, even though many prompts admit multiple valid completions. This effectively reduces a multi-modal conditional distribution to a one-sample view, a phenomenon we call the "mode lottery," where training emphasizes a subset of plausible modes while leaving others underrepresented. We study multi-response training (MRT), which retains multiple responses per prompt, and develop a principled account of when and why it helps. Our key insight is that prompts and responses are distinct statistical resources: additional prompts reduce uncertainty about the input distribution, while additional responses reduce uncertainty about the conditional output distribution. This yields a variance-budget tradeoff that predicts when retaining multiple responses is worthwhile, shows diminishing returns as prompt-level uncertainty dominates, and explains why large redundant corpora can exhibit an implicit multi-response effect. We further analyze response selection, and show that Random-K-of-N is the unbiased default for distributional fine-tuning, reward-based selection can induce mode collapse, and a submodular quality-diversity objective provides an efficient alternative with theoretical guarantees. Controlled simulations validate the predicted variance and selection effects, including a striking failure mode where reward-only selection produces gradients misaligned with the true objective. Across structured and real-world datasets, including a new multi-prompt, multi-response benchmark, MRT consistently improves distributional generalization, with the largest gains in high response-diversity, low prompt-redundancy regimes. MRT reframes response multiplicity as a data-allocation problem with clear guidance: when responses are cheap and diverse, keeping more than one is not a heuristic, but a statistically grounded choice.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了语言模型微调中的“模式彩票”现象（单响应训练导致多模态分布被单一采样表示），提出多响应训练（MRT）作为解决方案。核心洞察是提示和响应是不同的统计资源，由此建立方差-预算权衡框架，指导何时保留多响应是有价值的，并分析了响应选择策略，证明随机选择是分布微调的无偏默认选择。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型微调通常为每个提示仅配对单个响应，然而许多提示实际上存在多个有效补全。这种做法将多模态条件分布简化为单样本视角，形成“模式彩票”现象——训练强调部分合理模式而使其他模式代表性不足。研究者旨在理解和解决这一分布表示不完整的问题。
AI.method: 提出多响应训练（MRT）框架，保留每个提示的多个响应。核心方法是建立理论分析框架：区分提示和响应作为不同统计资源（提示减少输入分布的不确定性，响应减少条件输出分布的不确定性），构建方差-预算权衡模型。同时系统分析响应选择策略：Random-K-of-N（无偏默认）、基于奖励的选择（可能导致模式坍缩）、子模质量-多样性目标（理论保证的高效替代）。
AI.result: 在受控模拟中验证了预测的方差效应和选择效应，发现仅基于奖励的选择会产生与真实目标不一致的梯度这一显著失败模式。在结构化和真实世界数据集（包括新的多提示多响应基准）上，MRT持续改善分布泛化性能，在高响应多样性、低提示冗余的条件下收益最大。理论分析预测了保留多响应的价值条件、收益递减规律，并解释了大型冗余语料库的隐式多响应效应。
AI.conclusion: MRT将响应多重性重构为数据分配问题并提供明确指导：当响应获取成本低且多样性高时，保留多个响应不是启发式方法，而是具有统计基础的选择。这为语言模型微调数据构建提供了理论支撑和实践指南，特别适用于多模态分布表示的关键场景。

title: MindClaw: Closed-Loop Embodied Mental-State Reasoning for Precision Intervention
comment: Extended version of the CVPR 2026 paper *MindPower: Enabling Theory-of-Mind Reasoning in VLM-based Embodied Agents*
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM) enables an agent to reason about another actor's beliefs, goals, and intentions, which is essential for human-centered embodied assistance. Existing ToM benchmarks have advanced text and multimodal mental-state recognition, but they mostly evaluate offline question answering or final action prediction. They do not fully test whether an embodied agent can stay connected to a changing environment, update actor-specific beliefs, decide when reasoning is needed, and intervene only when help is useful. Building on MindPower, we extend robot-centric ToM reasoning to a real-time closed-loop setting and introduce MindClaw, a framework for embodied mental-state reasoning with precision intervention. MindClaw connects multi-source inputs, belief memory, an embodied cognitive trigger skill, mental reasoning, and action generation, allowing the agent to output helpful actions at the right time while remaining silent when intervention is unnecessary. Experiments show that direct VLM baselines struggle with task awareness and intervention calibration, while MindClaw achieves the best overall performance, demonstrating the importance of trigger-skill optimization for closed-loop embodied ToM assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MindClaw框架，将机器人中心的心理理论推理扩展到实时闭环环境，实现了具身智能体的精确干预。实验表明，相比直接VLM基线，MindClaw在任务感知和干预校准方面表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有的心理理论基准主要评估离线问答或最终动作预测，未能充分测试具身智能体是否能保持与变化环境的连接、更新特定参与者信念、判断何时需要推理以及仅在有用时干预的能力。
AI.method: 在MindPower基础上，提出MindClaw框架，整合多源输入、信念记忆、具身认知触发技能、心理推理和动作生成，使智能体能在恰当时机输出有益动作，在无需干预时保持静默。
AI.result: 直接VLM基线在任务感知和干预校准方面表现不佳，而MindClaw取得了最佳整体性能，证明了触发技能优化对闭环具身心理理论辅助的重要性。
AI.conclusion: MindClaw框架成功将心理理论推理应用于实时闭环具身场景，通过触发技能优化实现了精确干预，为以人为中心的具身辅助提供了有效解决方案。

title: The Assistant as a Privileged Persona: A canonical reference in cross-persona self-recognition
summary:
Post-trained language models can recognize their own outputs from a sentence or two out of context. In a companion paper \citep{jack2026twomodes} we showed they can also recognize when they are currently acting on-policy, through the sharp entropy drop of assistant-mode generation. Both signals are tied to the Assistant persona that post-training mainly shapes.
  This paper widens the frame to cross-persona authorship judgement on Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. We measure a matrix of authorship claim rates over a panel of evaluator and generator personas spanning librarian to dragon to Shakespeare, and make two claims. \emph{First}, on the Assistant's own row of the matrix, the Assistant's claim rate, the persona-vector distance from the Assistant in activation space, and the entropy gap between the Assistant's surprise on a persona's text and the persona's surprise on its own text are all tightly coupled. This extends the entropy signature of \emph{acting} from the companion paper to a retrospective signature of \emph{having acted}. \emph{Second}, this coupling fails off the Assistant's row: the natural symmetric extension of the entropy gap does not predict authorship for distinctive evaluators (pirate, dragon, Shakespeare); what does is asymmetric -- the evaluator's surprise compared to the Assistant's surprise on the same text, not to the generator's. We rule out the alternative that any persona could play this reference role by trying many candidate substitutes; none does. We interpret the asymmetry as the model performing an implicit Bayesian likelihood-ratio test against the Assistant as the canonical alternative hypothesis, with the persona-vector geometry of \citet{chen2025persona} (every persona a delta off the Assistant) ensuring that the Assistant is the only persona universally accessible to that test.

AI.tldr: 该研究扩展了模型识别自身输出的能力，发现模型能进行跨人格的作者归属判断，且Assistant人格在这一过程中扮演着独特的中心角色，充当隐式贝叶斯似然比检验中的规范备择假设。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明后训练的语言模型能够识别自身的输出以及当前是否处于策略内行动（通过助手模式生成时的熵急剧下降），这些信号都与后训练主要塑造的Assistant人格相关。本文旨在拓宽研究视野，探索模型在跨人格场景下的作者归属判断能力，研究不同人格（从图书管理员到龙再到莎士比亚）之间的作者归属关系。
AI.method: 研究者使用Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct模型，构建了一个包含评估者和生成者人格的面板，测量了作者归属声明率的矩阵。他们分析了Assistant行上的声明率、激活空间中人格向量距离、以及Assistant对某人格文本的惊讶度与该人格对自己文本的惊讶度之间的熵差距之间的关系。同时测试了对称性扩展在非Assistant行上的表现，并尝试用多种候选替代者来验证是否有其他人格能够扮演Assistant的参考角色。
AI.result: 研究发现：第一，在Assistant自身的矩阵行上，Assistant的声明率、激活空间中人格向量与Assistant的距离、以及Assistant对某人格文本的惊讶度与该人格对自己文本的惊讶度之间的熵差距都紧密耦合，这将从行动的熵签名扩展到已经行动的回顾性签名。第二，这种耦合在非Assistant行上失效：熵差距的自然对称扩展不能预测独特评估者（海盗、龙、莎士比亚）的作者归属，真正起作用的是不对称性——评估者的惊讶度与Assistant对相同文本的惊讶度比较，而不是与生成者的比较。替代实验表明没有其他人格能够扮演这一参考角色。
AI.conclusion: 研究将这种不对称性解释为模型在进行隐式贝叶斯似然比检验，以Assistant作为规范备择假设。人格向量几何结构（每个人格都是Assistant的delta偏移）确保了Assistant是唯一能够普遍参与该检验的人格，从而解释了Assistant在作者归属判断中的独特地位。

title: Before the Model Learns the Bug:Fuzzing RLVR Verifiers
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) replaces human preference labels with executable reward functions such as math answer checkers, JSON tool-call validators, and code unit-test harnesses. That makes the reward partly a software artifact: if the verifier is wrong, optimization can learn the bug. We study this failure mode with a lightweight verifier-fuzzing framework that generates adversarial completions, compares buggy and stricter reference verifiers, logs paired decisions, and reports false-positive, false-negative, disagreement, exploit, and uncertainty metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中验证器错误导致的奖励错误问题，提出了一个轻量级验证器模糊测试框架来检测和评估奖励函数的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 在RLVR中，奖励函数是可执行的软件工件（如数学答案检查器、JSON验证器、代码测试框架），当验证器存在错误时，强化学习优化过程可能会学习到这些错误，导致模型行为异常。作者希望理解和诊断这种因验证器缺陷引发的失败模式。
AI.method: 提出一个轻量级验证器模糊测试框架，通过以下步骤实现：1）生成对抗性补全；2）比较有缺陷的验证器和更严格的参考验证器；3）记录配对决策；4）计算并报告假阳性、假阴性、分歧、利用和不确定性等指标。
AI.result: 该框架能够有效识别验证器的错误决策，通过对比分析和对抗性测试，量化评估奖励函数的缺陷程度，包括误判率、验证器间分歧情况以及被利用的风险等关键指标。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了RLVR系统中软件验证器的潜在风险，为检测和预防奖励函数缺陷提供了系统性的方法和量化指标，有助于提高强化学习系统的可靠性。

title: Normalized Relevance Measure as a Unifying Framework to Explain Neural Network Latent Structures
summary: To understand how a neural network (NN) functions and makes predictions, it has become increasingly clear that analyzing only the input domain is insufficient -- one must also examine its internal inference mechanisms to capture the complete picture. To explain the internal inference mechanisms of such models, it is essential to analyze the importance of latent representations for a given task. In this paper, we propose the \emph{normalized relevance measure} (NRM) framework -- a novel general explanation procedure that attributes relevance to \emph{arbitrary sets of neurons across layers of arbitrary architectures}. In the NRM framework, relevance of selected neurons is explicitly defined as a normalized signed measure, constructed using simple operations -- marginalization and conditioning based on additive and multiplicative laws -- in analogy to the probability measures. The normalization property further guarantees comparability across layers. The NRM framework subsumes existing propagation-based explanation algorithms by explicitly identifying the underlying quantity being computed. We demonstrate the utility of the framework in computer vision applications, where joint relevance analysis across multiple layers reveals key information flows in VGG16 networks. Overall, the NRM framework provides a general, mathematically grounded approach to understanding how modern NNs propagate information, offering a versatile and broadly applicable foundation for explainable artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出了标准化相关性度量（NRM）框架，通过归一化符号测度来量化任意神经网络架构中跨层神经元集合的重要性，为理解神经网络信息传播机制提供了数学严谨且通用的解释方法。
AI.motivation: 理解神经网络的功能和预测机制需要分析其内部推理过程，仅关注输入域是不够的。为了解释这类模型的内部推理机制，必须分析潜在表示在给定任务中的重要性，而现有方法缺乏统一的理论框架和跨层可比性。
AI.method: 提出标准化相关性度量（NRM）框架，将选定神经元的相关性明确定义为归一化符号测度。该框架使用边缘化和基于加法与乘法定律的条件化等简单操作构建，类比于概率测度。归一化特性保证了跨层的可比性，并能统一现有的基于传播的解释算法。
AI.result: NRM框架通过明确识别计算的基础量，成功统摄了现有的基于传播的解释算法。在计算机视觉应用中，跨多层的相关性联合分析揭示了VGG16网络中的关键信息流，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: NRM框架为理解现代神经网络如何传播信息提供了一种通用、数学基础扎实的方法，为可解释人工智能提供了多功能且广泛适用的发展基础。

title: CAREAgent: Clinical Agent with Structured Reasoning and Tool-Integrated for Order Generation
summary: Clinical order generation serves as a critical bridge between clinical decision-making and real-world practice, translating medical decisions into concrete and executable orders. Existing agents mainly focus on coarse-grained decisions and overlook the fine-grained, executable information required for clinical orders. To address this gap, we propose CAREAgent, an agent for clinical order generation. To support its training, we introduce a two-stage agentic reasoning data construction method. First, we design an agent framework that constructs verifiable reasoning trajectories aligned with realistic clinical tool usage. Second, we filter reasoning trajectories by format compliance, order validity, and clinical plausibility. Building on the constructed data, the model is first trained via supervised fine-tuning to acquire fundamental reasoning formats and medical knowledge, and is subsequently optimized through reinforcement learning with multi-dimensional reward functions to enhance complex clinical reasoning capabilities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CAREAgent. On ClinicalBench (unseen during training), CAREAgent improves the F1 score by 5.05%, 2.09%, and 0.86% over the single-agent, multi-agent, and agentic reasoning methods, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAREAgent，一种基于两阶段数据构建和强化学习的临床医嘱生成智能体，显著提升了生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗智能体主要关注粗粒度决策，忽视了临床医嘱执行所需的细粒度、可执行信息，难以有效连接临床决策与实际实践。
AI.method: 提出CAREAgent框架，采用两阶段数据构建方法：1）设计智能体框架构建符合临床工具使用规范的可验证推理轨迹；2）通过格式合规性、医嘱有效性和临床合理性过滤推理轨迹。模型首先通过监督微调获取基础推理格式和医学知识，随后利用多维奖励函数的强化学习优化复杂临床推理能力。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中验证了CAREAgent的有效性。在未参与训练的ClinicalBench上，相比单智能体、多智能体和智能推理方法，F1分数分别提升了5.05%、2.09%和0.86%。
AI.conclusion: CAREAgent通过细粒度的临床医嘱生成和两阶段训练策略，有效弥合了临床决策与实际执行之间的差距，为临床实践提供了更可靠的智能支持。

title: Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation: Transferring Knowledge from Noise Domain
summary: Transfer learning aims to facilitate the learning of a target domain by transferring knowledge from a source domain. The source domain typically contains semantically meaningful samples (*e.g.*, images) to facilitate effective knowledge transfer. However, a recent study observes that the noise domain constructed from simple distributions (*e.g.*, Gaussian distributions) can serve as a surrogate source domain in the semi-supervised setting, where only a small proportion of target samples are labeled while most remain unlabeled. Based on this surprising observation, we formulate a novel problem termed *Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation* (SSNA), which aims to leverage a synthetic noise domain to improve the generalization of the target domain. To address this problem, we first establish a generalization bound characterizing the effect of the noise domain on generalization, based on which we propose a Noise Adaptation Framework (NAF). Extensive experiments demonstrate that NAF effectively leverages the noise domain to tighten the generalization bound of the target domain, leading to improved performance. The codes are available at https://github.com/AIResearch-Group/SSNA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了半监督噪声适应（SSNA）问题，通过构建合成噪声域作为源域来改善目标域的泛化性能，并提出了噪声适应框架（NAF）来有效利用噪声域。
AI.motivation: 传统迁移学习依赖具有语义信息的源域样本（如图像）进行知识迁移。然而，近期研究发现，由简单分布（如高斯分布）构建的噪声域可以作为半监督学习场景下的替代源域，这一出人意料的观察启发了作者探索如何利用合成噪声域来改善目标域的泛化能力。
AI.method: 作者首先建立了刻画噪声域对泛化影响的理论界限，基于该理论分析提出了噪声适应框架（NAF）。该框架能够在仅有少量目标样本标注而大部分样本未标注的半监督设置下，有效利用合成噪声域进行知识迁移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，NAF能够有效利用噪声域来收紧目标域的泛化界限，从而提升模型性能。实验验证了合成噪声域作为源域的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统性地提出了半监督噪声适应问题，并从理论和实践两个层面证明了利用合成噪声域改善目标域泛化的可行性，为迁移学习提供了新的视角和方法。

title: Diagnosing LLM Arbitration Behavior over Pre-evidence Epistemic States in RAG-based Fact-Checking
summary: In RAG-based fact-checking, LLMs are increasingly used as verifiers to check given claims against retrieved evidence. Their parametric knowledge can induce pre-evidence tendencies that may conflict with the retrieved context, yet existing evaluation frameworks do not characterize such prior-context discrepancy or measure how verifiers arbitrate between parametric and contextual signals. We introduce \textsc{PAVE} (\emph{Prior-Aware Verifier Evaluation}), a diagnostic testbed that stratifies an LLM verifier into four epistemic states based on the correctness and confidence of its pre-evidence prior and evaluates its arbitration behavior on this new benchmark, i.e., whether it persists in correct prior under misleading evidence, and whether it corrects wrong prior when accurate evidence is provided. Experiments across seven LLMs reveal unreliable and highly model-dependent prior-context arbitration, highlighting the importance of verifier selection for real-world RAG-based fact-checking applications. Based on these findings, we propose a lightweight JSD-based test-time arbitration method that improves factual reliability without modifying the underlying model, achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAVE评估框架，用于诊断LLM在RAG事实核查中如何仲裁参数化先验知识与检索证据之间的冲突，并发现现有LLM在此方面表现不可靠。为此提出了一种轻量级的测试时仲裁方法，有效提升了事实可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在基于RAG的事实核查中，LLM作为验证器使用其参数化知识会产生先验倾向，可能与检索到的证据产生冲突。然而现有评估框架未能刻画这种先验-上下文差异，也无法衡量验证器如何在参数化信号和上下文信号之间进行仲裁。
AI.method: 提出PAVE（Prior-Aware Verifier Evaluation）诊断测试平台，根据验证器在证据前的先验正确性和置信度将其划分为四个认知状态，并评估其仲裁行为：在误导性证据下是否坚持正确先验，以及在提供准确证据时是否纠正错误先验。基于发现，提出一种轻量级的基于JSD的测试时仲裁方法。
AI.result: 在七个LLM上的实验揭示了不可靠且高度依赖模型的先验-上下文仲裁行为，强调了在实际RAG事实核查应用中验证器选择的重要性。所提出的JSD方法在不修改底层模型的情况下，在多个LLM家族上取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM验证器在仲裁参数化先验和检索证据时表现不稳定且因模型而异，这对实际应用构成挑战。提出的测试时仲裁方法为提升事实核查可靠性提供了有效的解决方案，无需修改模型本身即可改善性能。

title: Richer Representations for Neural Algorithmic Reasoning via Auxiliary Reconstruction
summary: Neural algorithmic reasoning has emerged as a popular research direction. It aims to train neural networks to mimic the step-by-step behavior of classical rule-based algorithms. More specifically, the execution of such algorithms can be abstracted as a sequence of states, where each state represents the intermediate outcome after an execution step. The training objective is to generate state sequences that replicate the underlying algorithmic process. A common framework for this task adopts an encoder-processor-decoder architecture, where the encoder learns representations of states, the processor simulates algorithmic steps, and the decoder reconstructs output states. While prior work has focused on improving the processor, the role of the encoder in representation learning has received little attention. Most methods rely on simple MLP encoders, raising the question of whether such representations are sufficiently informative for supporting algorithmic reasoning. This paper investigates how to improve encoder representations for neural algorithmic reasoning. We propose a reconstruction module that aims to recover the input state from its encoded representation. This auxiliary reconstruction task encourages the encoder to retain critical information about the input. We demonstrate that incorporating this task during training improves the performance of existing neural architectures on standard benchmarks. Furthermore, we observe that current encoders often underutilize the correlations among features within a state. To address this, we draw inspiration from self-supervised learning and design an enhanced variant of the auxiliary task that encourages the encoder to capture intra-state feature dependencies. Experimental results show that our method enables the encoder to learn richer representations, thereby enhancing the performance of existing processors on algorithmic reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入重构模块作为辅助任务来改进神经算法推理中的编码器表示学习，使编码器能够保留更丰富的输入信息并捕获状态内特征依赖关系，从而提升现有架构在算法推理任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 神经算法推理领域现有工作主要关注改进处理器模块，而编码器在表示学习中的作用被忽视。大多数方法采用简单的MLP编码器，其表示是否足够支持算法推理受到质疑；同时，现有编码器未能充分利用状态内特征之间的相关性。
AI.method: 提出一个重构模块作为辅助任务，旨在从编码表示中恢复输入状态，促使编码器保留关键输入信息；受自监督学习启发，设计了增强版辅助任务，显式鼓励编码器捕获状态内特征依赖关系。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上验证，该方法使编码器能够学习更丰富的表示，提升了现有神经算法推理架构的性能；重构任务的引入有效改善了处理器在算法推理任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 编码器的表示质量对神经算法推理至关重要；通过重构辅助任务可有效增强编码器的表示能力，捕获状态内特征依赖关系，为后续处理器模块提供更优质的输入表示，从而整体提升算法推理性能。

title: SkillRevise: Improving LLM-Authored Agent Skills via Trace-Conditioned Skill Revision
summary: Agent skills are procedural artifacts that enable LLM agents to execute workflows, verify constraints, and recover from failures. Existing self-evolving methods refine skills using accumulated trajectories. However, they struggle in cold-start settings, where only an initial, imperfect skill is available. Consequently, skill construction defaults to expert authoring or one-shot LLM generation. Expert-authored skills are costly and may not align with how LLM agents actually execute tasks, while one-shot generated skills can be syntactically well formed yet behaviorally weak. To bridge this gap, we propose SkillRevise, an execution-grounded framework designed to iteratively refine these initial skills. SkillRevise diagnoses skill defects from execution evidence, retrieves relevant repair principles from a general memory, and applies execution-anchored edits. By re-executing candidates and measuring empirical utility, it systematically retains the optimal skill version. Evaluated across three benchmarks and five LLMs, SkillRevise substantially outperforms one-shot baselines, improving the base agent's success rate on SkillsBench from 36.05% to 61.63%. Furthermore, the revised skills exhibit strong cross-model transferability, capturing generalized procedural knowledge over model-specific artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出了SkillRevise框架，通过执行反馈迭代优化初始技能，解决LLM代理技能冷启动优化问题，将基准测试成功率从36.05%提升至61.63%。
AI.motivation: 现有自演化方法在冷启动场景下难以有效优化技能。专家编写的技能成本高且可能与LLM实际执行方式不匹配；一次性生成的技能虽然语法正确但行为效果差。需要一种方法来迭代优化初始技能。
AI.method: 提出SkillRevise框架：从执行证据中诊断技能缺陷，从通用记忆中检索相关修复原则，应用执行锚定的编辑，通过重新执行候选技能并测量实际效用来系统性保留最优技能版本。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试和五个LLM上验证，SkillRevise显著优于一次性生成基线，在SkillsBench上将基础代理成功率从36.05%提升至61.63%，且修订后的技能展现出强大的跨模型迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: SkillRevise成功填补了初始技能与高质量可执行技能之间的鸿沟，能够捕获泛化的程序性知识而非模型特定的伪影，实现了有效的技能迭代优化。

title: Interpretable Policy Distillation for Power Grid Topology Control
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising route to real-time power grid operation, yet large neural policies are costly to evaluate, hard to deploy on constrained hardware, and opaque to operators. We ask whether a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent for grid topology control can be compressed into compact tree-based surrogates without losing operational performance. A PPO teacher is trained on Grid2Op's standard 14-bus environment with a stability-oriented reward, using stress-focused data collection on critical, high-loading states. The policy is then distilled into a decision tree and a random forest. Across held-out validation episodes, both surrogates exceed the teacher in mean reward and survival length at a fraction of the inference cost. The decision tree shows high exact-action agreement with the PPO argmax and near-complete agreement within its top-ranked actions, while remaining small enough to be inspected directly. Feature-importance analysis reveals a representational shift: the PPO policy relies mainly on line-loading signals, while the distilled tree is driven primarily by bus-topology variables. These results suggest that stress-focused distillation can convert a black-box neural controller into a lightweight, auditable rule-like surrogate suited for real-time deployment, while also surfacing risks tied to deterministic actions and topology-specific generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文将大规模PPO强化学习电网控制策略成功压缩为轻量级决策树和随机森林代理模型，在性能上超越原模型，推理成本大幅降低，且具备可解释性，适合实时部署。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习在实时电网运行中具有潜力，但大规模神经网络策略存在评估成本高、难以在受限硬件上部署、对操作员不透明等问题。研究者探索能否将电网拓扑控制的PPO智能体压缩为紧凑的基于树的代理模型而不损失运行性能。
AI.method: 在Grid2Op标准14总线环境中训练PPO教师模型，采用面向稳定性的奖励函数，通过在关键高负荷状态下进行压力聚焦数据收集。然后将策略蒸馏为决策树和随机森林两种代理模型。
AI.result: 在保留的验证片段中，两种代理模型在平均奖励和生存时长上均超越教师模型，且推理成本仅为原模型的一小部分。决策树与PPO argmax动作具有高度一致性，在其排名靠前的动作中几乎完全一致，且规模足够小可直接检查。特征重要性分析揭示了表征转变：PPO策略主要依赖线路负荷信号，而蒸馏后的树主要由母线拓扑变量驱动。
AI.conclusion: 压力聚焦蒸馏可以将黑箱神经控制器转换为轻量级、可审计的类规则代理，适合实时部署，同时也暴露了与确定性动作和拓扑特定泛化相关的风险。

title: Reasoning4Sciences: Bridging Reasoning Language Models to All Scientific Branches
summary: While Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) are rapidly emerging as powerful tools for scientific research, their impact is primarily concentrated in "hard science" fields. The slow -- or lack of -- adoption of RLMs in other branches of science is causing a widening gap in research productivity. In this survey, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of RLM adoption across 28 scientific disciplines following the classification used by the European Research Council (ERC), spanning the Social Sciences and Humanities, Physical Sciences and Engineering, and Life Sciences. We examine how RLMs are developed, evaluated, and applied across disciplines. Furthermore, we introduce a maturity-oriented assessment framework based on available domain-specific development and evaluation resources, revealing substantial disparities in RLM maturity that become even more pronounced when only publicly available resources are considered. Finally, we highlight current implementation paradigms that are gaining popularity across disciplines, current challenges, and future directions in enabling RLM adoption across science.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面调查了推理语言模型（RLM）在28个科学学科中的应用现状，揭示了RLM成熟度在不同学科间存在显著差异，特别是在公共资源可用性方面。
AI.motivation: 推理语言模型主要应用于"硬科学"领域，而在其他科学分支中采用缓慢或缺失，导致研究生产力差距日益扩大。作者旨在填补这一空白，全面分析RLM在跨学科领域的采用情况。
AI.method: 基于欧洲研究理事会（ERC）的分类标准，对社会科学与人文、物理科学与工程、生命科学三大领域的28个学科进行系统性调研。分析RLM在各学科的开发、评估和应用方式，并引入面向成熟度的评估框架，基于可用的领域特定开发和评估资源进行评估。
AI.result: 发现RLM成熟度在不同学科间存在巨大差异，且当仅考虑公开可用资源时，这种差异更加明显。研究还识别出跨学科领域正在流行的实现范式。
AI.conclusion: 论文总结了当前RLM跨学科应用面临的挑战，并提出了促进RLM在科学领域广泛应用的未来方向，为缩小不同学科间的RLM采用差距提供了指导。

title: A Practical Upper Bound on Selection Bias Effects in Medical Prediction Models
comment: 32 pages, 27 figures, will be published at ACM SIGKDD '26
summary: Selection bias is a common and often unavoidable aspect of real-world data that challenges the generalizability of machine learning models. When models trained on biased data are deployed in the broader target population, poor model generalization may lead to real harm, particularly in high-risk settings such as healthcare. This risk highlights the need for practitioners to reliably assess model generalizability prior to deployment. However, existing methods for predicting model performance rely on unrealistic access to the target distribution or knowledge of the selection mechanism causing bias. To address these limitations, we propose a novel upper bound on the worst-case model performance on the target population under the realistic setting where the selection mechanism and the target population data are only partially observed. We demonstrate the validity and practical utility of our method through experiments on fully synthetic data, semi-synthetic data derived from the All of Us Research Program, and real-world selection bias in MIMIC-IV. Our work offers a principled and practical tool to estimate the impact of selection bias in an otherwise intractable setting, thereby enabling practitioners to build safer and more generalizable models in healthcare and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在部分观测条件下评估选择偏差对模型泛化性能影响的新方法，为医疗等高风险场景下的模型部署提供了实用的安全性评估工具。
AI.motivation: 现实世界数据中普遍存在且难以避免的选择偏差问题，严重影响了机器学习模型的泛化能力。在医疗等高风险场景中，基于偏差数据训练的模型在目标人群上部署可能导致严重后果，因此迫切需要在部署前可靠地评估模型的泛化性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的最坏情况下模型性能上界估计方法。该方法在现实条件下运作，即选择机制和目标人群数据仅被部分观测到，无需对目标分布的完全访问或对选择机制的完全了解，克服了现有方法的局限性。
AI.result: 通过三类实验验证了方法的有效性和实用性：全合成数据实验、基于All of Us研究项目的半合成数据实验，以及MIMIC-IV中的真实世界选择偏差实验。实验证明了所提上界的有效性和实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为评估选择偏差影响提供了一个有原则且实用的工具，解决了原本难以处理设定下的评估难题，使从业者能够在医疗及其他领域构建更安全、更具泛化能力的模型。

title: Expected Value Alignment for Generative Reward Modeling in Formal Mathematics Verification
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used with formal interactive theorem provers such as Lean 4. Scaling these systems with reinforcement learning or search methods requires process reward models (PRMs) that can evaluate intermediate reasoning steps. Existing reward-model designs expose a practical trade-off. Value-head models provide continuous scores but modify the generative model interface, while generative reward models preserve textual rationales but are poorly matched to continuous floating-point regression because numeric values are split across tokens. We introduce Expected Value Alignment (EVA), a reward-modeling procedure that keeps the surface output discrete while extracting continuous scores from the model's token distribution. The model emits integer scores in a structured JSON format, and EVA computes a continuous score as the expectation over the logits of the corresponding anchor tokens. Training combines the causal language modeling objective with an auxiliary mean squared error loss on these expected values. We instantiate EVA in \textit{Leibniz}, a reward model for Lean 4 formal verification, and evaluate it against zero-shot and reward-modeling baselines. The evaluation demonstrates that continuous logit-based scoring significantly reduces discretization artifacts while retaining the interpretability of generative critiques.

AI.tldr: 提出了EVA方法，通过计算词元分布的期望值，解决了在形式化验证中奖励模型连续评分与离散文本生成之间的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有的过程奖励模型（PRM）在用于形式化定理证明时存在权衡：值头模型能提供连续评分但改变了生成模型接口；生成式奖励模型保留了文本解释能力，但难以处理连续浮点数回归，因为数值被分割成多个词元。需要一种既能生成连续评分又能保持文本解释性的方法。
AI.method: 提出期望值对齐（EVA）方法：模型以结构化JSON格式输出整数分数，EVA通过对相应锚点词元的logits计算期望值来获得连续分数。训练结合了因果语言建模目标和对这些期望值的辅助均方误差损失。基于此开发了Leibniz奖励模型用于Lean 4形式化验证。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，基于logit的连续评分方法显著减少了离散化伪影，同时保留了生成式评论的可解释性。相比零样本和奖励建模基线方法有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: EVA成功解决了连续评分与离散生成之间的矛盾，为大语言模型在形式化定理证明中的应用提供了更有效的奖励建模方法，兼具数值精度和文本可解释性。

title: Same Payload, Different Channel: Measuring Trust Asymmetry in Tool-Using Language Models
summary: As language models take on agentic roles that span calling external APIs, reading tool outputs, and acting on instructions embedded in third-party content, their attack surface expands well beyond what users type. Whether a model treats a malicious instruction the same way regardless of where it arrives has not been systematically studied. We introduce the Safety Asymmetry Score (SAS), which measures how much a model's susceptibility to adversarial content shifts depending on whether that content arrives in the user message, tool metadata, or tool output, using matched payload pairs that keep the malicious text identical and vary only the context of delivery. Evaluated across 6 production LLMs and three attack families, we find a consistent and informative asymmetry: agent-native models are substantially more vulnerable when adversarial content arrives via tool descriptions than via user messages, while general-purpose models show the reverse. This asymmetry further inverts when the same content is delivered through tool outputs rather than descriptions, suggesting models implicitly treat tool metadata as trusted instructions and tool results as ordinary data. A mechanistic study on Llama 3.3 70B reveals that the safety-relevant representation is causally present at mid-to-late network depths but non-linearly encoded, explaining why linear probes fail to detect it. These findings expose a systematic, channel-dependent blind spot in how current tool-using models handle adversarial content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出安全不对称分数(SAS)指标，系统研究LLM代理在不同输入通道(用户消息、工具描述、工具输出)下对恶意内容敏感度的差异。发现代理专用模型对工具描述中的恶意内容更脆弱，而通用模型则相反，揭示了当前工具使用模型存在通道依赖的安全盲点。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型承担代理角色，其攻击面从用户输入扩展到API调用、工具输出和第三方内容。然而，模型是否会根据恶意指令的来源位置而区别对待这一问题尚未得到系统研究，缺乏对模型在不同输入通道下安全行为差异的深入理解。
AI.method: 提出安全不对称分数(SAS)，使用匹配的负载对(保持恶意文本完全相同，仅改变传递上下文)来测量模型在用户消息、工具元数据和工具输出三个通道下对对抗性内容的敏感度变化。在6个生产级LLM和3种攻击系列上进行评估，并对Llama 3.3 70B进行机制研究。
AI.result: 发现一致且有意义的不对称性：(1)代理原生模型对工具描述中的恶意内容比用户消息更脆弱，通用模型表现相反；(2)工具输出与工具描述的不对称性反转，表明模型隐式将工具元数据视为可信指令，将工具结果视为普通数据；(3)机制研究显示安全相关表示存在于网络中后期深度，但呈非线性编码，解释了线性探针无法检测的原因。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了当前工具使用模型在处理对抗性内容时存在系统性的通道依赖盲点，模型对不同输入通道的安全处理策略存在隐含差异，这种不对称性构成了重要的安全隐患。

title: Deft Scheduling of Dynamic Cloud Workflows with Varying Deadlines via Mixture-of-Experts
comment: This paper has been accepted by the Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: Workflow scheduling in cloud computing demands the intelligent allocation of dynamically arriving, graph-structured workflows with varying deadlines onto ever-changing virtual machine resources. However, existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) schedulers remain limited by rigid, single-path inference architectures that struggle to handle diverse scheduling scenarios. We introduce \textbf{DEFT} (\textbf{D}eadline-p\textbf{E}rceptive Mixture-o\textbf{F}-Exper\textbf{t}s), an innovative DRL policy architecture that leverages a specialized mixture of experts, each trained to manage different levels of deadline tightness. To our knowledge, DEFT is the first to introduce and validate a Mixture-of-Experts architecture for dynamic cloud workflow scheduling. By adaptively routing decisions through the most appropriate experts, DEFT is capable of meeting a broad spectrum of deadline requirements that no single expert can achieve. Central to DEFT is a \textbf{graph-adaptive} gating mechanism that encodes workflow deadlines and DAGs, task states, and VM conditions, using cross-attention to guide expert activation in a fine-grained, deadline-sensitive manner. Experiments on dynamic cloud workflow benchmarks demonstrate that DEFT significantly reduces execution cost and deadline violations, outperforming multiple state-of-the-art DRL baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DEFT，一种基于混合专家(MoE)架构的深度强化学习调度器，通过专门针对不同截止期限紧迫程度训练的专家网络和图自适应门控机制，有效解决了云计算中动态工作流调度问题。
AI.motivation: 现有深度强化学习调度器采用刚性的单路径推理架构，难以处理多样化的调度场景，特别是在处理具有不同截止期限要求的动态到达、图结构工作流以及不断变化的虚拟机资源时存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出DEFT（Deadline-pErceptive Mixture-oF-ExperTs）架构，首次将混合专家(MoE)架构应用于动态云工作流调度。该方法包含两个核心组件：1)多个专门针对不同截止期限紧迫程度训练的专家网络；2)图自适应门控机制，通过交叉注意力机制编码工作流截止期限、DAG结构、任务状态和虚拟机条件，以细粒度、截止期限敏感的方式引导专家激活，实现自适应路由决策。
AI.result: 在动态云工作流基准测试上的实验表明，DEFT在执行成本和截止期限违约率方面显著优于多个最先进的DRL基线方法，能够满足单一专家无法实现的广泛截止期限要求。
AI.conclusion: DEFT成功验证了混合专家架构在动态云工作流调度中的有效性，通过自适应路由机制实现了对多样化截止期限需求的灵活处理，为云计算资源调度提供了新的解决方案。

title: On the Recoverability of Causal Relations from Bulk Gene Expression Data
summary: Bulk gene expression profiling, which aggregates pooled RNA across cells within a biological sample, remains important in the single-cell era because it is typically less noisy, more sensitive, and more cost-effective than single-cell assays. Accordingly, a growing body of computational methods seeks to recover causal relations among genes from bulk expression data. However, aggregation is a lossy, non-invertible coarsening of the underlying cellular system, and it remains unclear whether and under what conditions causal relations are recoverable from aggregated bulk gene expression data. To answer this, we formalize recoverability under aggregation through two notions of consistency: functional-form consistency and conditional-independence consistency. We then derive necessary and sufficient conditions for recoverability, showing that these properties are preserved only under linear aggregations (e.g., sum/mean) coupled with affine structural equations. To assess the practical plausibility of these conditions, analyses of four bulk and four single-cell gene expression datasets further reveal that the estimated pairwise regulatory functions among genes deviate from linearity in both data types, providing limited empirical support for the linearity assumptions required for recoverability. Together, these results caution against recovering causal relations from aggregated bulk expression data without strong additional assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明群体基因表达数据只有在线性聚合和仿射结构方程的条件下才能恢复因果关系，但实证分析显示基因调控关系普遍偏离线性，因此警告不应在缺乏强假设时从群体数据推断因果。
AI.motivation: 尽管单细胞技术兴起，群体基因表达分析因其低噪声、高灵敏度和成本效益仍然重要，许多计算方法试图从群体数据中恢复基因间因果关系。然而，聚合是底层细胞系统的有损、不可逆的粗粒化过程，目前尚不清楚在何种条件下因果关系能够从聚合数据中恢复，这促使本研究对该问题进行理论形式化和条件推导。
AI.method: 首先形式化定义聚合下的可恢复性，提出函数形式一致性和条件独立性一致性两个概念；然后推导因果关系可恢复的充分必要条件，证明这些性质仅在仿射结构方程下使用求和或均值等线性聚合方式时才能保持；最后，通过分析四个群体和四个单细胞基因表达数据集，检验成对基因调控函数的线性程度。
AI.result: 理论推导表明，因果关系的可恢复性仅在线性聚合与仿射结构方程的组合条件下成立。对八个数据集的实证分析显示，无论在群体还是单细胞数据中，估计的成对基因调控函数均偏离线性，这意味着可恢复性所需的线性假设在实证上得到的支持有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果提醒研究者，在没有强附加假设的情况下，不应从聚合的群体表达数据中恢复基因间因果关系，因为关键的线性条件在现实中往往不成立，这为现有计算方法的适用性提供了理论界限。

title: "Skill issues'': data-centric optimization of lakehouse agents
summary: Coding agents are becoming users of data infrastructure, but their success depends not only on model quality: it also depends on the skills and environment files that teach agents how to use a system. We study how to optimize these artifacts for agents operating on a branching lakehouse, Bauplan. In our setting, headless APIs and Git-like data primitives expose data workflows through code, branches, commits, and merges. Our central observation is that a branching lakehouse turns data-agent evaluation from an output-matching problem into a state-verification problem: agent-generated pipeline code induces concrete, inspectable lakehouse changes. We present a data-centric optimization pipeline that generates task-verifier pairs, executes candidate skills in isolated sandboxes, and scores trajectories using both trace-level signals and programmatic checks over lakehouse state. In a preliminary evaluation on 25 tasks, optimized skills improve accuracy by 31.9%. These results suggest that write-path data workflows provide a useful substrate for optimizing agent skills beyond read-only tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个以数据为中心的优化流程，用于优化在分支化数据湖屋（branching lakehouse）上运行的编码代理的技能和环境文件，使代理任务准确率提高了31.9%。
AI.motivation: 编码代理正逐渐成为数据基础设施的使用者，但其成功不仅依赖于模型质量，还取决于教导代理如何使用系统的技能和环境文件。针对分支化数据湖屋Bauplan，作者希望优化这些工件以提升代理性能。
AI.method: 利用无头API和类Git数据原语暴露数据工作流，将数据代理评估从输出匹配问题转变为状态验证问题。提出了一个以数据为中心的优化流程：生成任务-验证器对，在隔离沙箱中执行候选技能，并使用轨迹级别信号和对数据湖屋状态的程序化检查来评分轨迹。
AI.result: 在25个任务的初步评估中，经过优化的技能将准确率提高了31.9%。结果表明写入路径数据工作流为超越只读任务的代理技能优化提供了有用的基础。
AI.conclusion: 分支化数据湖屋架构将代理评估问题转化为状态验证问题，写入路径数据工作流为优化代理技能提供了有效的基础设施，这种方法在实验中显示出显著的性能提升。

title: On the Difficulty of Learning a Meta-network for Training Data Selection
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used to train neural networks, yet distributional mismatch with real data limits their effectiveness when used indiscriminately. A common strategy is to learn data weights via bi-level optimization, which we refer to as Meta-learning for Training-data Selection (MTS). Interestingly, in practice, MTS often performs below expectation. We identify two obstacles in properly training MTS: a poor gradient signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR), which causes optimization difficulties, and lack of informative features that correlates with data quality. We present a mathematical analysis of MTS, which reveals the dynamics of normalized data weights and the relation between disparate data quality and poor GSNR. The analysis suggests a a simple yet effective solution: increasing the batch size. Further, we propose a set of informative features that capture the positions of training data in their distributions and training dynamics. Experiments across four benchmarks show consistent improvements, achieving average gains of 5.49% over training without selection and 2.89% over the strongest baseline.
