AI.method: 引入了一类新的异步自适应一阶优化方法，包含多种流行算法的异步变体，并考虑了使用动量和/或不精确归一化的版本。在完全随机设定下分析了该方法在非凸函数上的收敛性。
AI.result: 在合理假设下证明了该方法类在非凸函数上的收敛速率（对数因子外）为O(1/√t)，数值实验表明异步自适应算法在异构大规模机器学习系统中非常有效。
AI.conclusion: 异步自适应优化方法成功将自适应算法扩展到异步执行场景，为异构大规模机器学习系统提供了有效的优化工具，具有良好的理论收敛保证和实际性能表现。

title: An Exploratory Study into using Machine-Learning for Fast Step-by-step Emulation of Numerical Mechanical Thrombectomy Simulations for Ischemic Stroke
comment: 40 pages, 16 figures, master thesis artificial intelligence
summary: The treatment of ischemic stroke using mechanical thrombectomy involves difficult decisions under intense time constraints. Numerical physics simulations can in theory inform operators to make better decisions regarding treatment approaches and device selection, but are too slow to do so in practice. In this thesis, we investigate if current machine learning based surrogates can accurately emulate these simulations in a step-by-step manner while making them significantly faster. To do this we train three surrogate models on two simulations that involve a simplified aspiration procedure, with varying levels of geometric complexity. Our results show that two of our models accurately predict singular simulation steps and provide substantial speedups, especially when combined with specific data augmentations. However, the models showed a lack of stability when emulating simulations with complex geometries over longer time periods. Overall, this work provides a foundation for future studies to develop stable methods that scale to realistic numerical physics simulations of mechanical thrombectomy.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索机器学习代理模型能否在准确模拟机械取栓手术物理仿真步骤的同时显著提升计算速度，结果显示部分模型在预测精度和加速效果上表现良好，但在处理复杂几何结构的长期仿真时存在稳定性问题。
AI.motivation: 机械取栓治疗缺血性卒中需要在紧迫的时间限制下做出困难的决策。虽然数值物理仿真能够为手术方案和器械选择提供理论指导，但计算速度过慢无法满足临床实时应用需求。因此研究需要开发既能保持准确性又能大幅提升速度的仿真替代方案。
AI.method: 针对包含简化抽吸过程的两个仿真场景（具有不同几何复杂度），训练三种机器学习代理模型以逐步方式模拟仿真过程。研究结合特定数据增强技术来提升模型性能，并对模型的预测精度、计算加速效果和稳定性进行评估。
AI.result: 两种模型能够准确预测单个仿真步骤，并结合数据增强技术实现了显著的加速效果。然而，在处理具有复杂几何结构的长期仿真时，模型表现出稳定性不足的问题。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为未来开发能够扩展到真实机械取栓数值物理仿真的稳定方法奠定了基础。尽管现有模型在复杂几何场景的长时程仿真中存在稳定性局限，但研究成果验证了机器学习代理模型在该领域的应用潜力，为后续研究指明了改进方向。

title: Consistency evaluation of benchmarks used for causal discovery
summary: In graphical causal model, causal discovery aims to construct a causal graph based on numerical data and domain knowledge in plain text. However, the evaluation of causal discovery methods remains a challenge in the area as the progress of domain researches often makes benchmark causal graphs contain mis-aligned knowledge. This problem especially affects the evaluation of large language model (LLM) based causal discovery methods as they are sensitive to the new discoveries in the literature. This work is the first to systematically study the quality of benchmark causal graphs. Specifically, we design a pipeline that automatically retrieves relevant research papers from scientific databases, and prompts LLMs to check the consistency between the benchmark causal graphs and domain research papers. We evaluate 11 popular real-world benchmarks, for which our pipeline in total proceeds 38,081 domain papers. Our results show that popular benchmarks vary significantly in their consistency with domain research, with clear implications for causal discovery research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了基准因果图的质量问题，通过设计自动化流程检索相关研究论文并利用大语言模型检验基准图与领域研究的一致性，对11个流行基准进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 在图形因果模型中，因果发现方法基于数值数据和领域知识构建因果图，但其评估面临挑战：随着领域研究进展，基准因果图往往包含与最新知识不匹配的内容。这一问题对基于大语言模型（LLM）的因果发现方法影响尤为显著，因为此类方法对文献中的新发现较为敏感。
AI.method: 设计了一个自动化流程：从科学数据库自动检索相关研究论文，并提示大语言模型检查基准因果图与领域研究论文之间的一致性。
AI.result: 对11个流行的真实世界基准进行了评估，流程共处理了38,081篇领域论文。结果表明，流行基准与领域研究的一致性差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 基准因果图与领域研究的一致性存在显著差异，这对因果发现研究具有明确的影响和启示。

title: Accuracy, Stability, and Repeated-Run Reliability of Large Language Models on Deterministic Programming Tasks
summary: Run-level pass rate overstates retry-free coverage by up to 17.8 percentage points -- and the gap is largest precisely for mid-performing systems. We investigate this accuracy--stability relationship in large language model (LLM) evaluation for deterministic text-conditioned generation, using programming tasks as a concrete testbed. Standard code-generation benchmarks emphasize single-run accuracy or eventual success under repeated sampling, but many deployment settings also require stability: consistent outcomes across repeated invocations under the same task description. We present a repeated-run evaluation protocol with metrics for run-level accuracy, retry-free coverage, and per-problem variability. On a recency-based benchmark of 100 LeetCode-style problems, we evaluate 16 models from five provider families under two prompt templates with five repeated runs per problem, yielding 16,000 evaluation instances. Although run-level pass rate and perfect stability rate are strongly correlated (r=0.985), pass rate consistently exceeds retry-free coverage -- a gap that reaches 17.8 percentage points and reverses model rankings even among closely matched systems. Prompt effects are model-dependent rather than uniformly beneficial. These results suggest that repeated-run stability analysis is a necessary complement to conventional accuracy reporting for deterministic text-conditioned generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 传统单次运行通过率最高可高估17.8个百分点的实际无重试覆盖率，且会导致模型排名逆转，因此重复运行稳定性分析是必要的。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准主要关注单次运行准确率或多次采样后的最终成功率，但在实际部署中往往需要稳定性，即在相同任务描述下重复调用时保持结果一致。研究者旨在探究确定性的文本条件生成任务中准确率与稳定性之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出重复运行评估协议及相应的度量指标（包括运行级准确率、无重试覆盖率、每题变异性）。构建包含100道LeetCode风格问题的时效性基准，评估来自5个提供商的16个模型，使用2种提示模板，每道题进行5次重复运行，共产生16,000个评估实例。
AI.result: 运行级通过率与完美稳定性率高度相关（r=0.985），但通过率持续高于无重试覆盖率，差距最高达17.8个百分点。这种差距在中等表现系统中最大，甚至导致排名接近的模型出现排名逆转。提示词效应因模型而异，并非普遍有益。
AI.conclusion: 重复运行稳定性分析是对传统准确率报告的必要补充，这对确定性的文本条件生成任务评估具有重要意义。

title: OctoT2I: A Self-Evolving Agentic Text-to-Image Router
summary: The explosive growth of Text-to-Image (T2I) models, from large-scale versions to lightweight, real-time ones, now faces diminishing marginal returns from single-model scaling. Agentic T2I methods emerged to alleviate this bottleneck by using multiple models. However, existing agentic T2I methods suffer from three key challenges: reliance on expensive handcrafted priors or human annotations, rigid single-path decision mechanisms, and a neglect of inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce OctoT2I, a novel agentic framework that reformulates the T2I task as a joint optimization of generation quality and inference efficiency. OctoT2I implements a stateful, multi-round routing strategy that adaptively selects the most suitable tool based on its knowledge and memory. This strategy is enabled by a knowledge base built from scratch by our novel Self-Evolving Mechanism. This mechanism, which requires no human supervision, first autonomously defines foundational Conceptual Dimensions (eg, style, color, count) and then intelligently explores their combinations via an iterative" Propose--Solve--Evaluate--Learn"(PSEL) loop. The PSEL loop efficiently discovers each tool's capability frontier, driving continuous improvement without external guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OctoT2I achieves competitive performance (0.96) on GenEval while delivering a 90.3% inference speedup and a 56.6% energy-efficiency gain over the leading baseline (Flow-GRPO), striking an exceptional balance between performance and efficiency. Code and models will be made available.

AI.tldr: 提出OctoT2I框架，通过自演化机制和状态化多轮路由策略，在无人工监督下实现T2I任务的生成质量与推理效率联合优化，在GenEval上达到0.96性能的同时实现90.3%的推理加速和56.6%的能效提升。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像（T2I）模型面临单模型扩展收益递减的问题，而现有的智能体T2I方法存在三大局限：依赖昂贵的人工先验或标注、僵化的单路径决策机制、忽视推理效率。
AI.method: 提出OctoT2I智能体框架，核心创新包括：（1）状态化多轮路由策略，基于知识和记忆自适应选择最优工具；（2）自演化机制构建知识库，无需人工监督；（3）PSEL（提出-求解-评估-学习）迭代循环，自动定义概念维度并探索工具能力边界。
AI.result: 在GenEval基准上达到0.96的竞争性性能，相比主流基线Flow-GRPO实现90.3%的推理加速和56.6%的能效提升，有效平衡了性能与效率。
AI.conclusion: OctoT2I通过将T2I任务重构为质量与效率的联合优化问题，配合无监督的自演化机制，成功突破了现有智能体T2I方法的瓶颈，为高效高质量的图像生成提供了新范式。

title: Task Structure Reverses Layerwise State Encoding in Sequence Models
summary:
Mechanistic studies of sequence models often treat layerwise state encodings as architectural traits: recurrent models concentrate readable state, attention-based models distribute it. We find that the same architecture reverses this profile when the task changes. Across Transformers, Mamba, Mamba-2, LSTMs, and GRUs, Parity is concentrated late in Mamba and the recurrent baselines and built gradually by Transformer; on bounded-depth Dyck-k the pattern flips. The same flip appears in fine-tuned Mamba-130M and Pythia-160M, and the Pythia Dyck bottleneck persists at 410M. Two explanations are conflated in the literature: algebraic structure (commutativity) versus computational structure (prefix update vs. stack). To separate them we add a third task: non-commutative S_3 permutation composition. S_3 groups with Parity, not Dyck, on layerwise probing across all five architectures and on Mamba-specific Conv1D attribution, so the grouping tracks computational structure rather than commutativity.
  Causal interventions show that, in the 4-layer formal models, linearly readable directions are often functionally necessary and can remain important at out-of-distribution lengths on Parity and Dyck. At pretrained scale the picture splits. Fine-tuned Pythia Dyck has a strong middle-layer bottleneck (L6-L7 ablation drops accuracy by roughly 81% at 160M; broader L4-L18 plateau at 410M), far weaker at the best-probe layer. Pretrained Mamba shows the complementary failure mode: its final layer is highly readable, no single probe direction breaks the task on Parity, Dyck, or S_3, yet mid-position activation patching there recovers about 97-98% of the clean-corrupted logit gap. Probing localizes where state is linearly available, not always where the computation is bottlenecked. Mechanistic signatures are properties of architecture and task together.

AI.tldr: 研究发现序列模型的机制特性并非固定架构属性，而是架构与任务共同作用的结果；探测定位的是线性可读的状态位置，不一定是计算瓶颈所在。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将层级状态编码视为架构特性（循环模型集中可读状态，注意力模型分散状态），但作者观察到同一架构在不同任务下呈现相反模式，因此需要厘清代数结构（交换性）与计算结构（前缀更新vs栈）对机制特性的影响。
AI.method: 在Transformer、Mamba、Mamba-2、LSTM、GRU五种架构上测试Parity、有界深度Dyck-k和非交换S_3置换组合三类任务，采用层级探测、因果干预（消融和激活修补）及Mamba特定的Conv1D归因方法。
AI.result: Parity在Mamba和循环基线中晚期集中，Transformer逐步构建；Dyck则相反。S_3与Parity同组，表明分组遵循计算结构而非交换性。微调Pythia在Dyck上存在强烈中间层瓶颈（L6-L7消融精度下降约81%），而预训练Mamba末层高度可读但无单一探测方向破坏任务，中间位置激活修补可恢复97-98%的logit差距。
AI.conclusion: 机制特性是架构与任务共同决定的属性，探测定位的是线性可获取状态的位置，并不总是计算瓶颈所在。这挑战了将层级编码模式视为固定架构特征的传统观点。

title: Token Predictors Are Not Planners: Building Physically Grounded Causal Reasoners
summary: Current benchmarks for embodied vision-language planning often favor linguistic next-token prediction over physically grounded next-state reasoning. This rewards models that mimic statistical language priors rather than track causal dependencies, reducing physical planning to shallow sequence modeling. We argue that reliable physical autonomy requires a shift from linguistically grounded token prediction toward physically grounded causal reasoning. To this end, we introduce Causal-Plan-Bench, a high-fidelity diagnostic suite curated through multi-stage verification to evaluate embodied planning across four causal dimensions. We also construct Causal-Plan-1M, a million-scale corpus of explicit reasoning traces produced by a four-stage annotation pipeline over egocentric videos. Extensive evaluation shows that leading models still struggle to demonstrate genuine physical agency, with Gemini 3 Pro reaching only 38.18 on our benchmark. In contrast, our training recipe enables Causal Planner, built on Qwen3-VL-8B, to internalize physical logic for more accurate next-state estimation. The model achieves strong in-domain performance and cross-benchmark generalization, and reveals a Causal Scaling Law: scaling causal training data to one million instances yields a 36.3% relative gain, from 33.22 to 45.28. Overall, our work provides a concrete step toward turning agents from superficial token predictors into physically grounded causal reasoners.

AI.tldr: 本文针对具身规划任务中语言预测优于物理推理的问题，提出了因果规划基准Causal-Plan-Bench和百万规模语料库Causal-Plan-1M，训练出的Causal Planner模型相比主流模型在物理推理能力上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 当前的具身视觉-语言规划基准过度偏重语言层面的下一词元预测，而非物理层面的下一状态推理，导致模型仅模仿统计语言先验而忽略因果依赖关系，将物理规划退化为浅层序列建模。可靠的物理自主性需要从语言基础的词元预测转向物理基础的因果推理。
AI.method: 提出了Causal-Plan-Bench诊断套件，通过多阶段验证构建，从四个因果维度评估具身规划能力；构建了百万规模的Causal-Plan-1M语料库，包含基于自我中心视角视频、通过四阶段标注流程生成的显式推理轨迹；基于Qwen3-VL-8B训练了Causal Planner模型。
AI.result: 主流模型表现不佳，Gemini 3 Pro在基准测试中仅达38.18分；Causal Planner实现了强大的领域内性能和跨基准泛化能力；发现因果缩放定律：将因果训练数据扩展至百万规模，性能从33.22提升至45.28，相对增益达36.3%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为将智能体从表面的词元预测器转变为物理基础的因果推理器提供了具体路径，证明了物理因果推理训练的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators for Structure-Preserving Surrogate Modeling of Constrained PDEs
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogate models for PDE simulations, but standard architectures often treat geometry and discretization as secondary to field data. Physical states are usually represented as grid-channel stacks, even when different quantities naturally belong on vertices, edges, faces, cells, boundaries, or interfaces and must satisfy compatibility constraints. We propose Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators, a discretization-aware framework for structure-preserving neural PDE surrogates. The method represents PDE states on oriented cell complexes, couples local feature spaces through learned restriction maps, and uses incidence/Hodge-informed message passing to follow computational geometry. Learned update heads pass through coboundary or flux maps, allowing selected constraints to arise from cell-complex structure rather than only from loss penalties. For magnetohydrodynamics, this yields face-based magnetic-flux updates driven by edge electromotive fields and finite-volume-style fluid updates driven by learned face fluxes and cell sources. On turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium surrogate tasks, the method improves structure-sensitive diagnostics, including rollout behavior, divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium-regression accuracy. These results indicate that cellular-sheaf structure is a useful inductive bias for neural PDE surrogates in constrained multiphysics systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了蜂窝束神经算子（Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators），这是一种保持结构的神经PDE代理模型框架，通过在定向胞腔复形上表示PDE状态并利用关联/霍奇消息传递，在湍流磁流体动力学和聚变平衡代理任务中显著改善了结构敏感诊断性能。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子架构通常将几何和离散化视为次要因素，物理状态被表示为网格通道堆栈，忽略了不同物理量应自然存在于顶点、边、面、胞腔、边界或界面上这一事实，且必须满足兼容性约束。这种表示方式无法有效处理约束多重物理系统的结构保持需求。
AI.method: 提出蜂窝束神经算子框架：在定向胞腔复形上表示PDE状态；通过学习的限制映射耦合局部特征空间；利用关联/霍奇消息传递遵循计算几何；学习更新头通过余边界或通量映射，允许选定的约束从胞腔复形结构中自然产生，而不仅仅依赖损失惩罚。对于磁流体动力学，实现基于面的磁通更新（由边缘电动势驱动）和有限体积式流体更新（由学习面通量和单元源驱动）。
AI.result: 在湍流磁流体动力学和聚变平衡代理任务上，该方法改进了结构敏感诊断指标，包括：推出行为、散度控制、谱误差和平衡回归精度。实验结果表明蜂窝束结构是约束多重物理系统中神经PDE代理的有效归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: 蜂窝束结构为约束多重物理系统中的神经PDE代理提供了有用的归纳偏置，能够更好地保持物理结构约束，提升模型在复杂多物理场问题上的表现。

title: CAPF: Guiding Search-Agent Rollouts with Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback
summary: Recent LLM search agents use reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to learn search-augmented reasoning from outcome rewards. On hard problems, these agents rarely sample end-to-end successful rollouts, leaving outcome-only RLVR with few positive-reward trajectories. We argue that improving learning on such problems requires additional guidance during training, and RLVR already contains verifier-side information that can provide it. This information can identify errors or omissions in the agent's submitted answer and guide revision within the rollout. We propose a training-time mechanism called \textbf{Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback} (CAPF), which makes this verifier-side information available through a Privileged Feedback call during training. CAPF lets the policy revise zero-reward attempts into positive-reward repair trajectories and attenuates credit for the feedback call and earlier actions to accommodate deployment without this call. Empirical research demonstrates that CAPF improves Qwen3-4B's average exact-match score from 44.7% under outcome-only RLVR to 48.5% on seven open-domain QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPF方法，通过在训练时引入特权反馈来解决困难问题上正样本稀少的问题，将Qwen3-4B在7个QA基准上的准确率从44.7%提升至48.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM搜索代理使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）从结果奖励中学习搜索增强推理。在困难问题上，代理很少采样到端到端成功的轨迹，导致仅基于结果的RLVR缺乏正奖励轨迹。作者认为改进这类问题上的学习需要在训练期间提供额外指导。
AI.method: 提出Credit-Attenuated Privileged Feedback（CAPF）方法。该方法利用验证器端的信息来识别代理提交答案中的错误或遗漏，并在rollout内指导修订。CAPF通过训练期间的特权反馈调用提供这些信息，允许策略将零奖励尝试修正为正奖励修复轨迹，并对反馈调用及先前动作进行信用衰减，以适应部署时无此调用的情况。
AI.result: 实验表明，CAPF将Qwen3-4B在七个开放域QA基准上的平均精确匹配分数从仅结果RLVR下的44.7%提升至48.5%。
AI.conclusion: CAPF有效解决了困难问题上正样本稀少的问题，通过训练时的特权反馈机制提升了模型性能，同时通过信用衰减确保了部署时的适用性。

title: PRISM: Gauge-Invariant Tangent-Space Differentially Private LoRA
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026) as an oral presentation
summary: Applying differential privacy (DP) via DP-SGD to Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a natural approach for privacy-preserving fine-tuning. However, LoRA's low-rank parameterization poses a fundamental challenge. In LoRA, each trainable update is represented as a low-rank matrix $Z = AB^\top$, but this factorization is inherently non-identifiable: many factor pairs $(A,B)$ represent the same update $Z$. As a result, applying DP-SGD directly to the factors induces gauge-dependent perturbations on $Z$, and we show that this naive DP-LoRA can lead to unbounded noise amplification. We propose PRISM, an intrinsic DP mechanism for LoRA that is gauge invariant by construction, avoids bilinear noise amplification, and admits an efficient low-dimensional noise sampler. Moreover, PRISM yields a closed-form characterization of the effective intrinsic noise induced on $Z$, enabling stable privacy-utility trade-offs through bounded, gauge-invariant perturbations. We establish standard $(ε,δ)$-DP guarantees for PRISM and introduce a DP-aware, gauge-invariant adaptive update rule that prevents adaptive optimization from amplifying injected privacy noise, improving numerical stability in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISM，一种针对LoRA的固有差分隐私机制，解决了直接应用DP-SGD导致的规范相关噪声和噪声放大问题，实现了有界的规范不变扰动。
AI.motivation: 将差分隐私(DP)通过DP-SGD应用于低秩适应(LoRA)是一种自然的隐私保护微调方法。然而，LoRA的低秩参数化存在根本性挑战：每个可训练更新表示为低秩矩阵Z=AB^T，但该分解本质上是不可识别的——多个因子对(A,B)表示相同的更新Z。因此直接对因子应用DP-SGD会在Z上引入规范相关的扰动，导致无界的噪声放大。
AI.method: 提出PRISM机制，通过构造实现规范不变性，避免双线性噪声放大，并采用高效的低维噪声采样器。该机制产生对Z的有效固有噪声的闭式表征，通过有界的规范不变扰动实现稳定的隐私-效用权衡。建立了PRISM的标准(ε,δ)-DP保证，并引入了DP感知的规范不变自适应更新规则，防止自适应优化放大注入的隐私噪声。
AI.result: PRISM成功避免了朴素DP-LoRA导致的无界噪声放大问题；实现了规范不变的差分隐私保护；提供了有效的固有噪声闭式表征；改进了数值稳定性。
AI.conclusion: PRISM为LoRA提供了一种理论上可靠且实用的差分隐私解决方案，通过规范不变性设计确保了隐私保护的有效性和数值稳定性。

title: Evaluation of Baseline Methods for IDD-based SSD External Memory Search
comment: accepted to The 19th International Symposium on Combinatorial Search (SoCS2026)
summary: Many difficult search problems cannot be solved by algorithms such as A* using only RAM. Search algorithms which use external memory such as SSDs and HDDs with much higher capacity than RAM have been proposed in previous work, but previous work has focused on delayed duplicate detection approaches, as well as complex immediate duplicate detection (IDD) methods, and relatively simple methods for IDD have not been systematically studied. In addition, the effect of OS-level mechanisms for managing and speeding up accesses to external memory, such as page caches, has not been studied. This paper addresses these gaps in the literature by evaluating and analyzing the performance of simple baseline approaches for IDD-based A*.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了基于即时重复检测（IDD）的A*算法的简单基线方法在外部存储环境下的性能表现，填补了该领域研究的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有使用外部存储（如SSD和HDD）的搜索算法研究主要关注延迟重复检测方法和复杂的即时重复检测方法，而简单的IDD方法缺乏系统性研究；此外，操作系统级别的页面缓存等机制对算法性能的影响也未被研究。
AI.method: 评估和分析基于IDD的A*算法的简单基线方法在外部存储环境下的性能表现。
AI.result: 通过对简单基线方法的系统性评估，揭示了这些方法在外部存储搜索中的性能特征和表现。
AI.conclusion: 简单的IDD基线方法可以作为评估更复杂方法的有效参照基准，同时操作系统级别的页面缓存机制对算法性能有重要影响，需要在算法设计和分析中加以考虑。

title: Silent Failures in Federated Personalization of Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are increasingly personalized on decentralized private data through federated learning and are now deployed at scale under growing regulatory requirements for post-market monitoring. We argue that this convergence creates a distinct and under-recognized class of trustworthiness failures, which we term "Silent Failures." These include amplified bias, fairness collapse, and alignment erosion that may remain difficult to detect because federated learning's privacy constraints limit visibility into model behavior. A landscape analysis of existing benchmarks reveals a structural divide. Federated benchmarks evaluate system performance but provide limited insight into model behavior, whereas centralized trustworthiness benchmarks assess behavior but require model access incompatible with federated privacy. We introduce a taxonomy of six silent failure modes arising from the interaction of foundation model personalization, dataset shift, and core federated constraints. Our analysis shows that privacy-preserving training alone is insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We conclude with a research agenda for privacy-preserving behavioral evaluation and propose that silent failures become a standard diagnostic category for trustworthy federated artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联邦学习中基础模型个性化部署存在的"静默失败"问题，即因隐私约束限制模型行为可见性而难以检测的信任度失效，并提出研究议程以应对此类风险。
AI.motivation: 基础模型通过联邦学习在去中心化私有数据上进行个性化部署日益普遍，同时监管对上市后监测要求不断提高。这种融合产生了一类独特且未被充分认识的信任度失效问题，即"静默失败"，包括放大的偏见、公平性崩塌和对齐侵蚀，由于联邦学习的隐私约束限制了模型行为的可见性，这些问题难以被检测。
AI.method: 对现有基准进行全景分析，揭示联邦基准与中心化信任度基准之间的结构性分歧：前者评估系统性能但难以洞察模型行为，后者评估行为但需要与联邦隐私不兼容的模型访问权限。进而提出由基础模型个性化、数据集偏移和核心联邦约束交互产生的六种静默失效模式的分类体系。
AI.result: 分析表明，仅依赖隐私保护训练不足以实现可信部署。现有基准存在结构性分歧，无法有效评估联邦学习场景下的模型信任度问题。六种静默失效模式分类体系揭示了基础模型个性化与联邦约束交互产生的独特风险。
AI.conclusion: 提出隐私保护行为评估的研究议程，建议将静默失败作为可信联邦人工智能的标准诊断类别，为未来研究和实践提供指导方向。

title: Does Compression Preserve Uncertainty? A Unified Benchmark for Quantized and Sparse LLMs via Conformal Prediction
summary: Model compression techniques such as quantization and pruning are widely used to reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), with existing evaluations focusing almost exclusively on accuracy preservation. However, in safety-critical applications, a model's ability to reliably quantify its own uncertainty is equally important. We ask: does compression preserve this ability? To answer this question, we benchmark 12 LLMs under various compression configurations across five NLP tasks, using conformal prediction to provide a rigorous, distribution-free measure of uncertainty. Our experiments reveal that: (I) compression frequently decouples accuracy from uncertainty; (II) larger models absorb compression-induced uncertainty far more effectively than smaller ones; and (III) uncertainty inflation is often threshold-like rather than gradual. These results suggest that accuracy-only evaluation is insufficient for assessing the deployment readiness of compressed LLMs, and that uncertainty-aware benchmarking should be a standard component of model compression pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了12个大语言模型在多种压缩配置下的不确定性保持能力，发现压缩经常导致准确性与不确定性脱钩，仅评估准确性的传统方法不足以判断压缩后模型的部署就绪性，应将不确定性感知的基准测试纳入标准流程。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型压缩技术评估几乎完全专注于准确性保持，但在安全关键应用中，模型可靠量化自身不确定性的能力同样重要。作者旨在探究压缩是否能够保持这种不确定性量化能力，填补这一评估空白。
AI.method: 在五种NLP任务上对12个大语言模型进行基准测试，覆盖多种压缩配置（量化和剪枝），使用保形预测（conformal prediction）提供严格的、无分布假设的不确定性度量方法。
AI.result: 实验揭示三个关键发现：（I）压缩经常使准确性与不确定性脱钩；（II）较大模型比小模型能更有效地吸收压缩引起的不确定性；（III）不确定性膨胀通常呈现阈值特性而非渐进式增长。
AI.conclusion: 仅评估准确性的方法不足以评估压缩后大语言模型的部署就绪性，不确定性感知的基准测试应成为模型压缩流程的标准组成部分。

title: Explainable deep reinforcement learning reveals energy-efficient control strategies for turbulent drag reduction
summary: We propose a method combining Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning (MARL) and eXplainable Deep Learning (XDL) to reduce drag in wall-bounded turbulent flows. Taking as a baseline the results of training agents directly targeting wall-shear stress and opposition control, three SHAP-guided approaches are compared. In the first, the reward is computed from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the future velocity field; in the second, from SHAP attributions of a U-net predicting the skin-friction coefficient; in the third, from a combination of SHAP attributions of two U-nets predicting the skin-friction coefficient and the wall pressure fluctuations, respectively. The combined SHAP strategy based on skin-friction coefficient and wall-pressure fluctuations achieves the best overall performance, achieving a DR of 34.44% and a NES of 34.01% with only 0.43% normalized input power. Relative to opposition control, drag reduction and net energy saving increase by 49.41% and 48.52%, respectively. Compared with the direct wall-shear-stress baseline, the proposed strategy simultaneously improves performance while reducing the normalized actuation cost from 5.90% to 0.43%. Analysis of the results reveals that the energetically efficient policy is consistent with pressure-gated actuation, activating predominantly at near-zero wall pressure, and operates on a temporal timescale comparable to the lifetime of the near-wall turbulent structures.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）和可解释深度学习（XDL）的方法来减少壁面受限湍流中的阻力。基于SHAP引导的组合策略实现了34.44%的减阻率和34.01%的净节能，仅需0.43%的标准化输入功率，优于传统 Opposition Control。
AI.motivation: 传统的壁面受限湍流减阻方法（如直接针对壁面剪切应力和 Opposition Control）存在控制成本高、效率低的问题。需要开发更智能、更节能的减阻策略，同时理解控制策略背后的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）结合可解释深度学习（XDL）方法，提出三种基于SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）引导的策略：1）基于U-net预测未来速度场的SHAP属性计算奖励；2）基于U-net预测表面摩擦系数的SHAP属性计算奖励；3）结合表面摩擦系数和壁面压力波动两个U-net预测的SHAP属性计算奖励。通过比较三种方法，确定最优控制策略。
AI.result: 组合SHAP策略（基于表面摩擦系数和壁面压力波动）取得了最佳性能：减阻率（DR）达34.44%，净节能（NES）达34.01%，仅需0.43%的标准化输入功率。相比Opposition Control，减阻和净节能分别提高了49.41%和48.52%；相比直接壁面剪切应力基线方法，在提升性能的同时将标准化驱动成本从5.90%降低到0.43%。分析发现，该高效节能策略与压力门控驱动机制一致，主要在接近零壁面压力时激活，并按接近壁面湍流结构寿命的时间尺度运行。
AI.conclusion: 基于SHAP引导的组合深度强化学习策略能够显著提高壁面受限湍流的减阻效率，大幅降低控制成本，同时揭示了压力门控驱动和时间尺度匹配的物理机制。该方法为湍流控制提供了一种高效、可解释的智能控制框架。

title: WorldCoder-Bench: Benchmarking Physically Grounded 3D World Synthesis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked not only to write static interfaces, but to construct executable interactive worlds from natural language. Browser-native 3D, commonly built with Three.js, is a natural next frontier: generated programs must integrate assets, obey spatial and physical constraints, and keep user-facing controls synchronized with hidden runtime state. Existing web-generation benchmarks and evaluators, however, largely observe only pixels or DOM nodes, while the mechanics of a Three.js world unfold inside an opaque <canvas>. We introduce WorldCoder-Bench, a benchmark for autonomous, physically grounded 3D world synthesis. WorldCoder-Bench contains 2,026 expert-curated tasks across Simulation, Rendering, and Application scenarios, with optional .glb assets and hidden behavioral contracts. We further propose StateProbe, an execution-based protocol that probes generated programs in a sandboxed browser and verifies hidden, mutation-hardened contracts over runtime states and transitions. Beyond verification coverage, we report Return on Automation and Time Efficiency Multiplier to measure correctness-adjusted cost and time savings. Across nine frontier models, the best system reaches only 27.8% verification coverage on WorldCoder-Core and 19.9% on WorldCoder-Robust, with failures dominated by state-schema drift and broken interaction chains rather than missing scene elements. Utility metrics further show that cheap or fast models can still provide substantial value on easier domains. WorldCoder-Bench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WorldCoder-Bench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WorldCoder-Bench基准测试，用于评估大语言模型生成可执行的Three.js 3D交互世界的能力。该基准包含2,026个专家标注任务，并提出StateProbe协议来验证隐藏的运行时状态和行为约束。评估结果显示，九个前沿模型中最佳系统仅达到27.8%的验证覆盖率，主要失败原因是状态模式漂移和交互链断裂。
AI.motivation: 现有网页生成基准和评估器主要关注像素或DOM节点，无法有效评估Three.js 3D世界的运行时机制，因为这些机制在透明的<canvas>元素内部展开。随着LLMs被要求从自然语言构建可执行的交互式3D世界，需要一个能够验证运行时状态、物理约束和空间约束的基准测试。
AI.method: 提出WorldCoder-Bench基准测试，包含2,026个跨Simulation、Rendering和Application场景的专家标注任务，提供可选的.glb资产和隐藏的行为契约。开发StateProbe协议，在沙盒浏览器中探测生成的程序，验证经过变异加固的运行时状态和转换契约。引入验证覆盖率、自动化回报率和时间效率倍数等指标来评估系统性能。
AI.result: 在九个前沿模型的评估中，最佳系统在WorldCoder-Core上仅达到27.8%的验证覆盖率，在WorldCoder-Robust上为19.9%。失败主要由状态模式漂移和断裂的交互链导致，而非缺失场景元素。效用指标显示廉价或快速模型在简单领域仍能提供显著价值。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型在生成符合物理约束和交互逻辑的3D可执行世界方面仍有显著局限，主要挑战在于维护一致的状态模式和完整的交互链，而不仅仅是场景元素的生成。WorldCoder-Bench为这一重要能力提供了系统化的评估框架。

title: COLLIE: Guiding Skill Discovery in Semantically Coherent Latent Space
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery (USD) aims to learn diverse behaviors without reward functions, but often results in task-irrelevant or hazardous behaviors due to uniform exploration. Guided skill discovery (GSD) addresses this issue by incorporating human intent to focus exploration on meaningful regions. However, existing GSD methods typically require training additional guidance models, and rely on pre-defined rules or expert demonstration, which can be ineffective under sparse, online-collected human feedback. To overcome this, we propose COLLIE, a GSD framework that leverages dense unsupervised data to construct a semantically coherent skill latent space. This latent space is well-structured, enabling reliable guidance with sparse online feedback. Moreover, its semantic coherence property enables training-free construction of guidance signals, eliminating the need for additional model training beyond skill learning. Theoretical analysis justifies the effectiveness of our training-free guidance signal, while experiments across diverse state-based and pixel-based tasks show that COLLIE learns diverse, human-aligned skills, avoids hazardous behaviors, and achieves superior downstream performance with minimal human feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出COLLIE框架，通过构建语义连贯的技能潜空间，利用稀疏在线反馈实现免训练的引导信号，在无需额外模型训练的情况下学习与人类意图对齐的技能。
AI.motivation: 无监督技能发现(USD)因均匀探索会导致任务无关或危险行为；现有的引导技能发现(GSD)方法需要训练额外的引导模型，且依赖预定义规则或专家演示，在稀疏在线人类反馈下效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出COLLIE框架，利用密集无监督数据构建语义连贯的技能潜空间，该空间结构良好且语义连贯，能够通过稀疏在线反馈提供可靠引导，并实现免训练的引导信号构建，无需在技能学习之外进行额外模型训练。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了免训练引导信号的有效性；在多种基于状态和基于像素的任务实验中，COLLIE学习到多样化且与人类对齐的技能，避免了危险行为，并以最少的人类反馈实现了优越的下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: COLLIE框架成功解决了现有引导技能发现方法的局限性，通过语义连贯的潜空间实现了高效、安全且与人类意图对齐的技能发现，在最小化人类反馈需求的同时显著提升了性能。

title: EVA-Net: Subject-Independent EEG Motor Decoding with Video-Derived Motor Priors
summary: Practical non-invasive Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems require EEG decoders with strong cross-subject generalization and minimal calibration. However, inter-subject variability and signal non-stationarity often entangle motor semantics with subject-specific noise, limiting subject-independent decoding. Recent multimodal approaches use text as a semantic anchor, yet text provides sparse and static supervision for inherently dynamic motor processes. To address this issue, we propose EVA-Net, a two-stage framework that uses action videos as semantic priors for subject-independent EEG motor decoding. In the first stage, EEG and video features are aligned in a shared space using cross-modal and supervised contrastive objectives to reduce subject-specific variation. In the second stage, video category prototypes and knowledge distillation transfer video-derived priors to an EEG-only classifier without adding inference overhead. Experiments on two public datasets show that EVA-Net achieves strong subject-independent decoding performance, including an 8.66% LOSO accuracy gain on EEGMMI. Ablation results further suggest that video provides a more effective semantic anchor than the text baseline considered in this work.

AI.tldr: 提出EVA-Net框架，利用动作视频作为语义先验，实现跨受试者EEG运动意图解码，在EEGMMI数据集上LOSO准确率提升8.66%。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式脑机接口系统需要具有强跨受试者泛化能力和最小校准的EEG解码器。然而，受试者间变异性和信号非平稳性导致运动语义与受试者特定噪声纠缠，限制了独立于受试者的解码。现有文本多模态方法提供的监督信号稀疏且静态，难以捕捉动态运动过程。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架EVA-Net：第一阶段利用跨模态对比目标和监督对比目标将EEG与视频特征对齐到共享空间，减少受试者特定变异；第二阶段通过视频类别原型和知识蒸馏，将视频先验迁移至仅EEG分类器，推理阶段无额外开销。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上实现强跨受试者解码性能，在EEGMMI数据集上LOSO准确率提升8.66%；消融实验表明视频比文本基线提供更有效的语义锚点。
AI.conclusion: EVA-Net通过引入动作视频作为动态语义先验，有效解决了EEG运动解码中的跨受试者泛化问题，验证了视频优于文本作为语义锚点的有效性。

title: Absorbing Complexity: An Interaction-Native Knowledge Harness for Financial LLM Agents
summary:
Financial AI agents often fail for a simple reason: they make users carry the complexity. A user must repeatedly restate goals, risk preferences, portfolio context, past judgments, and shifting market assumptions, while the agent answers, retrieves, acts, and forgets. In finance, this is not just inconvenient. In tasks such as market analysis, copy-trading review, and trade preparation, forgotten context and stale memory can create latency, repeated errors, weak auditability, and unsafe decisions.
  We propose the interaction-native knowledge harness (InKH), an architecture for financial LLM agents that absorbs complexity into the system. InKH converts user, market, portfolio, and tool events into structured operational knowledge. It uses passive knowledge injection to assemble a bounded working context buffer before the main model step, temporal graph memory for low-latency retrieval, a wiki audit surface for human-readable governance, and background extraction with maturity, decay, and write-time invalidation.
  We evaluate InKH on a reproducible controlled synthetic benchmark with 24 random seeds, 4 rounds, 80 episodes per round, and 6 baselines, producing 46,080 baseline-conditioned evaluations. InKH achieves mean task quality of 0.815 at 900 ms latency. Compared with agent-driven wiki-walk memory, it reduces latency by 82.95 percent, token cost by 82.29 percent, and stale-knowledge usage by 96.58 percent, while improving quality by 0.108 and traceability by 0.461. Compared with a temporal-graph system without invalidation, it improves quality by 0.050 and reduces stale-memory usage by 96.58 percent with comparable serving cost.
  The results support a design thesis for financial AI: adoption happens when complexity is absorbed by the system rather than transferred to the user. The benchmark validates architecture-level behavior, not live trading performance.

AI.tldr: 提出InKH架构，通过被动知识注入、时序图记忆和wiki审计面，将复杂性从用户转移到系统，在金融AI任务中显著降低延迟、成本和陈旧知识使用，同时提升任务质量。
AI.motivation: 现有金融AI代理失败的主要原因在于将复杂性转嫁给用户：用户需要重复陈述目标、风险偏好、投资组合背景等信息，而代理则会遗忘上下文。在市场分析、跟单交易审查和交易准备等任务中，被遗忘的上下文和过时的记忆会导致延迟、重复错误、审计能力弱和不安全决策。
AI.method: 提出交互原生知识挖掘(InKH)架构，包含四个核心组件：(1)被动知识注入，在主模型步骤前组装有限工作上下文缓冲区；(2)时序图记忆用于低延迟检索；(3)wiki审计面提供人类可读的治理；(4)后台提取机制，包含成熟度、衰减和写入时失效功能。该架构将用户、市场、投资组合和工具事件转化为结构化操作知识。
AI.result: 在可复现的受控合成基准测试上评估（24个随机种子，4轮，每轮80个回合，6个基线，共46,080次评估）：InKH在900ms延迟下实现0.815的平均任务质量。与代理驱动的wiki-walk记忆相比：延迟降低82.95%，token成本降低82.29%，陈旧知识使用减少96.58%，质量提升0.108，可追溯性提升0.461。与无失效机制的时序图系统相比：质量提升0.050，陈旧记忆使用减少96.58%，服务成本相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持金融AI的设计论点：当复杂性被系统吸收而非转移给用户时，采用才会发生。基准测试验证了架构级别的行为，而非实盘交易性能。研究为金融AI代理的设计提供了新思路，即通过系统架构主动承担复杂性来提升用户体验和决策质量。

title: CryoProt: A Protein Pretraining Framework with Cross-Box Interactions on Cryo-EM Density Maps
summary: Despite the growing availability of cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) density maps, effectively leveraging them for protein representation remains challenging. First, current methods lack a general-purpose protein pretraining framework tailored for cryo-EM density maps, designed for protein-related property prediction. Second, existing approaches typically partition density maps into local box regions and model them independently, overlooking interactions across boxes which are essential for capturing global structural context in cryo-EM density map. To address these challenges, we propose CryoProt, a protein pretraining framework designed for cryo-EM density maps. CryoProt introduces a Map Encoder based on multi-head latent attention (MLA), where box-level representations interact through a shared latent space, enabling explicit modeling of cross-box dependencies within the density map. Furthermore, we adopt a multi-task pretraining strategy to learn generalizable representations that can be effectively transferred to diverse downstream tasks, such as protein flexibility prediction, where cryo-EM density maps are not required and can be inferred implicitly by the pretrained model. Experimental results demonstrate that CryoProt consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving up to 12% improvement over the best-performing baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling cross-box interactions in cryo-EM data. The source code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CryoProt.

AI.tldr: 提出了CryoProt，一个针对冷冻电镜密度图的蛋白质预训练框架，通过多头潜在注意力机制显式建模跨盒子依赖关系，在多个基准测试中比现有最优方法提升高达12%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏针对冷冻电镜密度图的通用蛋白质预训练框架；且通常将密度图划分为局部盒子区域独立建模，忽略了跨盒子相互作用，而这些作用对于捕获全局结构背景至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了CryoProt框架，引入基于多头潜在注意力(MLA)的图编码器，通过共享潜在空间使盒子级表示相互作用，显式建模密度图内的跨盒子依赖关系；采用多任务预训练策略学习可泛化的表示，可迁移到多样化下游任务。
AI.result: CryoProt在多个基准测试中一致优于现有最先进方法，相比表现最佳的基线方法实现了高达12%的性能提升，验证了在冷冻电镜数据中建模跨盒子相互作用的重要性。
AI.conclusion: CryoProt成功解决了冷冻电镜密度图中跨盒子依赖关系建模的问题，为蛋白质相关性质预测提供了有效的预训练框架，源代码已公开发布。

title: Physically-Constrained Mamba-SDE for Remaining Useful Life Prediction under Irregular Observations
summary: Accurate Remaining Useful Life prediction is critical for industrial predictive maintenance. However, real-world deployment is challenging due to the irregular nature of sensor observations, characterized by asynchronous sampling, burst missingness, and temporal jitter. Compounding this issue, purely data-driven models often generate physically implausible degradation trajectories that violate the irreversible nature of damage accumulation. To address this, we propose PC-MambaSDE, a unified continuous-time framework for robust RUL prediction under irregular observations. Specifically, we design a Mask-Aware Continuous Mamba Encoder that explicitly leverages observation masks to extract context-rich control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Physics-Guided Latent SDE with parametrically rectified hybrid drift, superimposing a global physical bias to enforce monotonic degradation even amid severe observation gaps. Additionally, we formulate RUL prediction as a boundary value problem via a Terminal Degradation Penalty, which decouples a Health Index dimension and applies a penalty loss to guide trajectories toward the failure state. Theoretically, we prove that our variational objective is mathematically equivalent to minimizing the KL divergence via Girsanov's theorem, and we guarantee the global asymptotic stability of the learned dynamics through Lyapunov analysis. To enable rigorous evaluation, we develop a Hybrid Irregularity Generation Scheme that simulates realistic industrial imperfections. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that PC-MambaSDE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under extreme observation scarcity, validating the efficacy of embedding physical priors into continuous-time latent dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出PC-MambaSDE框架，通过结合掩码感知连续Mamba编码器和物理引导潜在SDE，解决了不规则传感器观测下的剩余使用寿命预测问题，确保退化轨迹的单调性和物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 工业预测性维护中，剩余使用寿命预测面临两大挑战：(1) 传感器观测的不规则性，包括异步采样、突发缺失和时间抖动；(2) 纯数据驱动模型常产生违反损伤累积不可逆性的物理不合理退化轨迹。
AI.method: 提出PC-MambaSDE统一连续时间框架：设计掩码感知连续Mamba编码器显式利用观测掩码提取控制信号；引入物理引导潜在SDE，通过参数校正混合漂移强制单调退化；将RUL预测建模为边界值问题，使用终端退化惩罚解耦健康指数维度并引导轨迹趋向失效状态。
AI.result: 理论上证明了变分目标等价于通过Girsanov定理最小化KL散度，并通过Lyapunov分析保证学习动力学的全局渐近稳定性。在公共基准数据集上的实验表明，PC-MambaSDE显著优于最先进方法，尤其在极端观测稀缺情况下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验嵌入连续时间潜在动力学的方法在处理不规则观测的RUL预测任务中具有显著优势，为工业预测性维护提供了更鲁棒和物理可解释的解决方案。

title: Optimal-Point Variance Reduction For Bayesian Optimization With Regret Guarantee
summary: This paper studies a one-step lookahead Bayesian optimization (BO) method and its theoretical guarantee. Although the empirical effectiveness of one-step lookahead BO methods, such as entropy search, has been studied extensively, they often rely on computationally intractable approximations, and their regret guarantees remain underdeveloped. Thus, this paper proposes a one-step lookahead BO method called optimal-point variance reduction (OVR), which requires only posterior sampling and Monte Carlo approximations. We obtain a uniform error bound over an input domain for the Monte Carlo estimation in OVR. Furthermore, we show that the regularized OVR, with the slight modification to promote exploration, achieves a vanishing Bayesian expected simple regret upper bound. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of OVR through numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为最优点方差减少（OVR）的一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法，仅需后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似即可实现，并证明了其贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界趋于零。
AI.motivation: 尽管熵搜索等一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法在实践中表现有效，但它们通常依赖于计算上难以处理的近似，且其遗憾保证理论尚不完善。
AI.method: 提出OVR方法，仅使用后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似；获得了蒙特卡洛估计在输入域上的均匀误差界；对OVR进行正则化改进以促进探索。
AI.result: 证明了正则化OVR方法的贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界趋于零；通过数值实验验证了OVR的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OVR方法提供了一种计算可行且具有理论保证的一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方案，填补了现有方法在理论分析方面的空白。

title: Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance: A Human-Centric Perspective on User-Generated Content Evaluation
comment: Published as a main conference paper at ACL 2026
summary: Traditional Video Quality Assessment (VQA) focuses narrowly on aesthetic fidelity, overlooking the complex social dynamics that define quality in User-Generated Content (UGC). In this work, we propose a paradigm shift from signal-centric metrics to human-centric resonance assessment. We introduce CASTER (Community-Aware Assessment of Social Textual Engagement and Resonance), a new task that evaluates whether a UGC item achieves positive community resonance based on its multimodal attributes rather than visual quality alone. To address this, we present MEDEA (Multimodal Engagement-Driven Evaluation Architecture), which introduces a novel Social Chain-of-Thought (Social-CoT) mechanism. Unlike traditional logical CoT, Social-CoT performs multimodal perspective-taking, instantiating diverse viewer personas to simulate collective cognitive and emotional reactions (i.e., the "community mind") before deriving a quality judgment. MEDEA is trained via a two-stage approach involving supervised fine-tuning and process-supervised reinforcement learning with Social Alignment Reward to ensure reasoning paths are grounded in authentic human social cognition. To support this task, we release CASTER-Bench, a comprehensive human-annotated benchmark covering diverse UGC categories. Experiments demonstrate that MEDEA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on CASTER-Bench while providing interpretable and empathetic reasoning paths that align with real community feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CASTER任务和MEDEA框架，从传统的信号中心化视频质量评估转向以人为中心的社区共鸣评估，通过Social-CoT机制模拟多样化的观众视角，实现了对UGC内容社会认可度的准确预测。
AI.motivation: 传统的视频质量评估(VQA)方法过于关注美学保真度，忽视了定义用户生成内容(UGC)质量的复杂社会动态。UGC的质量不仅取决于视觉质量，更取决于其是否能够获得社区的积极共鸣，这需要一种范式的转变：从信号中心化指标转向以人为中心的共鸣评估。
AI.method: 提出了MEDEA（多模态参与驱动评估架构），引入了新颖的社会链式思维(Social-CoT)机制。与传统逻辑CoT不同，Social-CoT执行多模态视角转换，实例化多样化的观众角色来模拟集体认知和情感反应（即"社区思维"），然后再得出质量判断。MEDEA通过两阶段方法训练：监督微调和带有社会对齐奖励的过程监督强化学习，确保推理路径基于真实的人类社会认知。同时发布了CASTER-Bench基准数据集。
AI.result: MEDEA在CASTER-Bench上显著优于最先进的基线方法，同时提供了可解释和富有同理心的推理路径，这些路径与真实的社区反馈相一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过从信号中心化指标转向以人为中心的共鸣评估，并利用Social-CoT机制模拟社区集体认知，MEDEA成功实现了对UGC内容社会认可度的准确评估，为UGC质量评估领域提供了新的研究方向和方法论基础。

title: UME: A Unified Meta-Generalization Framework for Cross-Domain ETA
summary: Accurate Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction on checkout page is crucial in instant logistics for enhancing user satisfaction, optimizing dispatching, and controlling operational costs. In international on-demand delivery platforms, where ETA data originates from diverse countries or regions with different patterns, multi-domain modeling is of great importance and has been widely adopted. However, existing methods still face three critical challenges in real-world deployment. First, current multi-domain models struggle to generalize to completely unseen domains, failing to achieve zero-shot prediction during the initial cold-start phase. Second, cross-domain feature spaces are often assumed to be consistent, whereas new domains commonly suffer from structural missingness of offline (statistical) features due to the lack of historical data. Third, such feature missingness often compels industrial systems to model mature and cold-start domains separately, hindering knowledge transfer and increasing maintenance overhead. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{UME}, a \textbf{U}nified \textbf{M}eta-generalization framework for \textbf{E}TA. Specifically, UME integrates a unified dual-branch architecture with a novel meta-learning mechanism that employs a hypernetwork-based meta learner. By leveraging domain-level knowledge and instance-level context, the meta learner empowers three meta modules to dynamically modulate feature gating, expert attention, and final prediction, capturing cross-domain correlations and facilitating intra-domain adaptation. A knowledge distillation strategy is further introduce to enhance performance. UME has now been deployed in Meituan-keeta delivery platform (the largest international food delivery platform in China). Extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests demonstrate that UME significantly outperforms existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UME框架，通过元学习和双分支架构解决国际即时配送平台中多域ETA预测的冷启动、特征缺失和系统割裂三大挑战，在美团Keeta平台成功部署并显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在国际即时配送平台中，多域ETA预测面临三大实际挑战：1)现有模型无法泛化到全新域，导致冷启动阶段零样本预测失败；2)新域因缺乏历史数据导致离线特征结构性缺失，而现有方法假设跨域特征空间一致；3)特征缺失迫使成熟域与冷启动域分开建模，阻碍知识迁移并增加维护成本。
AI.method: 提出UME（统一元泛化框架），包含统一双分支架构和基于超网络的元学习机制。元学习器利用域级知识和实例级上下文，动态调制三个元模块：特征门控、专家注意力和最终预测，实现跨域关联捕获和域内适应。同时引入知识蒸馏策略提升性能。
AI.result: UME已部署于美团Keeta平台（中国最大国际外卖平台）。大量离线实验和在线A/B测试表明，UME显著优于现有基线方法，有效解决了多域建模中的零样本泛化、特征缺失和知识迁移问题。
AI.conclusion: UME框架成功统一了成熟域和冷启动域的ETA预测建模，通过元学习机制实现了跨域知识迁移和零样本泛化能力，为国际即时物流平台提供了实用的多域建模解决方案，具有显著的工业应用价值。

title: Bayesian Spectral Emotion Transition Discovery from Multi-Annotator Disagreement
summary: Emotions evolve through the dynamics of conversation, and understanding their transition structure is foundational to applications ranging from mental-health screening to dialogue systems. However, existing studies typically compress multi-rater judgments into a single hard label by majority voting, discarding the uncertainty signal needed to understand turn-to-turn transitions. In this article, we propose Bayesian Spectral Emotion Transition Discovery (BSETD), a two-stage framework that discovers emotion-transition structure from multi-rater soft labels. In the first stage, a hierarchical Dirichlet-Multinomial posterior is constructed through the outer product of soft labels, equipping each cell of the K x K transition matrix with a credible interval and Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) false discovery rate (FDR)-controlled significance. In the second stage, the symmetrized graph Laplacian is spectrally decomposed to separate a low-frequency (inertia) component from a high-frequency (contagion) component. On EmotionLines, BSETD simultaneously recovers the signatures of two distinct affective spaces: the Plutchik-adjacent transitions disgust to anger (log2 lift +0.94) and anger to disgust (+0.86) are over-represented, while the Russell-valence-reversed transitions joy to anger (-0.90) and anger to joy (-0.89) are under-represented. A five-source cross-corpus validation yields pairwise Pearson correlations in 0.91-0.98 within English, 0.79-0.85 against Chinese M3ED, and 0.979 between the human hard labels and the LLM virtual soft labels on the same utterance set, demonstrating that a pipeline preserving annotator uncertainty bridges the computational study of emotion dynamics with established psychological theory.

AI.tldr: 提出BSETD框架，通过保留多标注者软标签中的不确定性信息，发现情绪转换结构，验证了其与心理理论的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常通过多数投票将多标注者判断压缩为单一硬标签，丢弃了理解轮次间转换所需的不确定性信号。理解情绪转换结构对心理健康筛查和对话系统等应用至关重要。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯谱情绪转换发现（BSETD）两阶段框架：第一阶段通过软标签外积构建层次Dirichlet-Multinomial后验，为K×K转换矩阵的每个单元格提供置信区间和Benjamini-Hochberg FDR控制的显著性；第二阶段对对称化图拉普拉斯矩阵进行谱分解，分离低频（惯性）和高频（传染）成分。
AI.result: 在EmotionLines数据集上，BSETD恢复了两个不同情感空间的特征：与Plutchik相邻的转换（厌恶→愤怒+0.94，愤怒→厌恶+0.86）过度呈现；与Russell效价相反的转换（喜悦→愤怒-0.90，愤怒→喜悦-0.89）呈现不足。五源跨语料验证中，英语内部成对Pearson相关达0.91-0.98，与中文M3ED相关为0.79-0.85，人类硬标签与LLM虚拟软标签间相关为0.979。
AI.conclusion: 保留标注者不确定性的流水线方法成功连接了情绪动力学的计算研究与已确立的心理学理论。

title: Profiling Privacy Preservation Against Gradient Inversion Attacks in Tabular Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple data holders to train machine learning models collaboratively without centralizing raw data, making it useful in privacy sensitive domains such as healthcare and institutional data sharing. FL keeps data local to clients while communicating only model updates, such as gradients or model deltas. Nevertheless, these updates can expose private client data through gradient inversion attacks (GIAs). We study this risk for tabular FL under an honest-but-curious server threat model across FL protocols, client batch sizes, training stages, attacker assumptions, model architectures, and binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression tasks. We use MIMIC-IV and complementary benchmark datasets. Our evaluation distinguishes numerical and categorical recovery, baseline recoverability, feature level recovery, and exact match rate (EMR). We evaluate FedSGD gradients and FedAvg model deltas with an exposure aligned protocol, comparing attacked models after matched client data exposure rather than matched communication rounds. We compare multilayer perceptron (MLP), ResNet, and FT-Transformer models, and isolate architecture effects through an MLP grid over width, depth, activation, normalization, and dropout. The results show that small client batches and updates representing few distinct records are most vulnerable. Larger local batches and stronger aggregation reduce reconstruction but do not eliminate leakage. FT-Transformer is consistently harder to invert than one-hot baselines, while reconstructability also varies substantially within the MLP family. These findings identify architecture as a practical privacy variable in tabular FL. We also show that aggregate reconstruction accuracy can overstate complete record recovery in sparse data, making EMR and baseline comparisons essential.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了表格数据联邦学习中的梯度反演攻击风险，发现小批量客户端更新最易受攻击，FT-Transformer架构比传统模型更难被反演，模型架构是影响隐私泄露的重要实践变量。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽然避免了原始数据集中化，但模型更新（如梯度或模型增量）可能通过梯度反演攻击泄露隐私数据。现有研究缺乏对表格数据联邦学习在各种条件下的系统性隐私风险评估，特别是在医疗等隐私敏感领域的实际威胁程度尚不明确。
AI.method: 在诚实但好奇的服务器威胁模型下，系统评估表格数据联邦学习的梯度反演攻击风险。评估维度包括：不同联邦协议（FedSGD、FedAvg）、客户端批大小、训练阶段、攻击者假设、模型架构（MLP、ResNet、FT-Transformer）以及多种任务类型（二分类、多分类、回归）。使用MIMIC-IV和基准数据集，采用暴露对齐协议比较模型，评估指标包括数值和类别恢复、基线可恢复性、特征级恢复和精确匹配率（EMR）。
AI.result: 小客户端批次和代表少量不同记录的更新最易受攻击。较大的本地批次和更强的聚合可减少重建但不能消除泄露。FT-Transformer始终比one-hot基线更难反演，MLP家族内部的重建难度也存在显著差异。聚合重建准确率可能夸大稀疏数据中的完整记录恢复程度，EMR和基线比较至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 模型架构是表格联邦学习中实用的隐私变量，架构选择应纳入隐私考量。现有评估指标（如聚合重建准确率）可能高估实际隐私风险，需要采用更严格的指标（EMR和基线比较）进行准确评估。FT-Transformer等现代架构提供了一定的隐私保护优势。

title: SMH-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Environment-Grounded Reasoning and Action in Smart Homes
summary: Smart homes are evolving toward complex state-dependent living environments, requiring Large Language Models (LLMs) to reason over user intent, preferences, and multi-device interactions. However, existing smart-home benchmarks often focus on static instruction-to-API mapping or limited simulations, failing to evaluate whether LLMs can reason, interact, and act reliably in realistic household scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce SMH-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs in smart-home environments. Built upon HomeEnv, an executable and verifiable smart-home simulator, SMH-Bench contains 1,100 high-quality tasks spanning 7 categories and 22 fine-grained subcategories. It further stratifies tasks across simple, medium and complex homes, ranging from small apartments to dense multi-room environments with 135 devices. Experiments show that although frontier LLMs achieve strong performance on explicit control and query tasks, they still exhibit significant weaknesses in automation task scheduling, ambiguity handling and personalized reasoning, especially as home complexity increases. We hope SMH-Bench will facilitate the development of more reliable, context-aware, and practically deployable smart-home agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SMH-Bench，一个基于HomeEnv模拟器构建的智能家居基准测试，包含1,100个任务，旨在评估LLMs在真实家居场景中的推理、交互和执行能力，揭示了现有模型在自动化调度、歧义处理和个性化推理方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有智能家居基准测试主要关注静态的指令到API映射或受限模拟环境，无法有效评估LLMs在真实家居场景中推理用户意图、偏好和多设备交互的能力。随着智能家居向复杂的状态依赖型环境演进，迫切需要一个综合基准来评估LLMs在实际家庭环境中的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建SMH-Bench基准测试，基于可执行、可验证的HomeEnv智能家居模拟器。该基准包含1,100个高质量任务，涵盖7个类别和22个细粒度子类别，并在简单、中等和复杂三种家庭环境中进行分层（从小型公寓到包含135个设备的多房间密集环境）。
AI.result: 前沿LLMs在显式控制和查询任务上表现优异，但在自动化任务调度、歧义处理和个性化推理方面仍存在显著弱点，且随着家庭复杂度增加，性能下降更为明显。
AI.conclusion: SMH-Bench为开发更可靠、具备上下文感知能力且实际可部署的智能家居智能体提供了有效评估工具，有望推动该领域的进一步发展。

title: Data Enrichment for Symbolic Regression Using Diffusion Models
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) offers a route to scientific discovery by converting observations into interpretable governing equations. However, despite its promise, its reliability degrades sharply when spatiotemporal measurements are sparse, noisy, or physically incomplete, as commonly occurring in practice. Data enrichment (DE) has been shown to be able to mitigate this limitation, yet additional samples can mislead equation discovery unless they preserve the physical structure of the target system. Such implication of DE requires narrow domain expertise as well as technical fluidity, highly limiting its practical usefulness. In this study, we introduce a physics-guided latent diffusion framework for DE for down the line SR models. The proposed framework combines a variational autoencoder, a conditional latent diffusion model, and a physics-informed residual corrector to complete sparse observations with synthetic fields constrained by governing relations. We evaluate the approach on heat conduction, incompressible Navier-Stokes flow, and a moving single-mass Newtonian gravitational potential, using GPLearn, DEAP, and PySR as downstream SR backends. Our results reveal that physics-corrected enrichment consistently improves recovery in sparse regimes across physical dynamics and SR models. These results show that generative enrichment can strengthen equation discovery without additional domain expertise.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于物理引导的潜在扩散数据增强框架，通过结合变分自编码器、条件潜在扩散模型和物理信息残差校正器生成符合物理约束的合成数据，有效解决了稀疏、噪声或不完整时空测量下符号回归可靠性下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 符号回归在科学发现中具有将观测数据转换为可解释控制方程的潜力，但在实际应用中，当时空测量数据稀疏、含噪或物理上不完整时，其可靠性会急剧下降。虽然数据增强可以缓解这一限制，但额外的样本必须保持目标系统的物理结构，否则会误导方程发现。现有的数据增强方法需要狭窄的领域专业知识和专业技能，严重限制了其实用性。
AI.method: 提出了一个物理引导的潜在扩散框架用于数据增强，该框架结合了三个关键组件：变分自编码器（VAE）、条件潜在扩散模型和物理信息残差校正器。该框架通过受控制关系约束的合成场来补全稀疏观测数据，确保生成的数据符合物理规律。研究在热传导、不可压缩Navier-Stokes流动和移动单质量牛顿重力势三个物理系统上进行验证，并使用GPLearn、DEAP和PySR作为下游符号回归后端。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，物理校正的数据增强在稀疏数据环境下能够持续提高方程恢复率，这一效果在不同的物理动力学系统和符号回归模型中均得到验证。物理引导的生成式增强可以有效提升方程发现能力，而无需额外的领域专业知识。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了生成式数据增强可以在不需要额外领域专业知识的情况下强化方程发现能力。所提出的框架成功地将物理约束融入数据生成过程，为解决符号回归在实际应用中面临的数据质量问题提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案。

title: VET: A Framework for Analyzing AI Discourse
summary: Public discourse on AI has become polarized; exaggerated positions on AI in traditional and social media threaten the development of AI Literacy among the general public. In this article, I introduce the VET Framework, a method for categorizing AI discourse along the dimensions of valence, effectiveness, and trajectory. I show how this framework can be used to identify, compare, and critique prevalent narratives of AI Hype, AI Doom, AI Denial, and AI Normalcy. Using VET, I analyze how each of these four stances exaggerates some aspects of the current state and/or likely evolution of AI, and illustrate how the VET framework can serve as an AI Literacy tool by supporting the ``vetting'' of polarized AI discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VET框架（效价-有效性-轨迹），用于对AI公共话语进行分类分析，以应对AI公共讨论的极化问题，帮助公众识别和批判AI炒作、AI末日论、AI否认和AI常态化这四种主流叙事，从而提升AI素养。
AI.motivation: 当前AI公共话语呈现极化趋势，传统和社交媒体中关于AI的夸大立场威胁着公众AI素养的发展，需要一种系统方法来识别和批判这些极化叙事。
AI.method: 引入VET框架，从效价（valence，情感倾向）、有效性（effectiveness，论证可靠性）和轨迹（trajectory，发展路径）三个维度对AI话语进行分类；识别四种主流叙事类型：AI炒作、AI末日论、AI否认和AI常态化，并分析每种立场如何夸大AI现状或未来演进的某些方面。
AI.result: VET框架能够有效识别、比较和批判AI话语中的四种主流叙事，揭示每种叙事的夸大特征；该框架可以作为AI素养工具，支持对极化AI话语进行"审查"（vetting），帮助公众更理性地理解AI。
AI.conclusion: VET框架为应对AI公共话语极化提供了实用的分析工具，能够提升公众的批判性思维能力，促进更理性和平衡的AI讨论，从而支持AI素养的发展。

title: Trust Functions: Near-Lossless Weak-to-Strong Generalization by Learning When to Trust the Weak Teacher
summary: Weak-to-strong generalization studies how to improve a strong student using supervision from a weaker teacher when reliable labels are scarce. We view this primarily as a data selection problem, where the key challenge is to identify which weak labels are reliable enough to serve as a training signal. To address this, we introduce trust functions that assign each weak label a scalar trust score and use these scores to filter weak supervision. Across several domains, including world knowledge, quantitative reasoning, and strategy games, trust filtering yields students that match and sometimes surpass ground-truth supervision, achieving near-lossless weak-to-strong generalization. Moreover, trust functions enable an iterative weak-to-strong chain that compounds gains by training a student and reusing it as the next teacher, amplifying the gains. There are several mechanisms to which advantage of trust functions can be attributed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信任函数对弱标签进行评分和筛选，实现接近无损的弱到强泛化，并通过迭代链式训练持续放大性能提升。
AI.motivation: 在可靠标签稀缺的场景下，如何利用较弱的教师模型监督来提升更强的学生模型性能，其核心挑战在于识别哪些弱标签足够可靠以作为训练信号。
AI.method: 引入信任函数为每个弱标签分配标量信任分数，基于这些分数过滤弱监督信号；支持迭代式弱到强训练链，将训练后的学生模型作为下一轮的教师模型以累积增益。
AI.result: 在世界知识、定量推理和策略游戏等多个领域，信任过滤使学生模型达到甚至超越真实标签监督的性能，实现接近无损的弱到强泛化；迭代链式训练可持续放大性能收益。
AI.conclusion: 信任函数为弱到强泛化提供了有效的数据选择机制，通过过滤不可靠的弱监督并支持迭代训练，能够在多个领域实现强学生模型的有效提升。

title: AutoMedBench: Towards Medical AutoResearch with Agentic AI Models
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly expected to support end-to-end medical-AI research workflows, moving beyond isolated prediction tasks or short-form clinical question answering. However, existing medical agent benchmarks primarily evaluate final outputs, providing limited visibility into agent behavior within the research process. To address this gap, we present AutoMedBench, a workflow-aware benchmark for autonomous medical-AI research across diverse medical imaging and multimodal inference tasks, organizing agent execution into a unified five-stage workflow (S1-S5): Plan, Setup, Validate, Inference, and Submit. It comprises long-horizon tasks with each run averaging 33 agent turns, spanning five research tracks: segmentation, image enhancement, visual question answering (VQA), report generation, and lesion detection. Each task is evaluated under two difficulty tiers, Lite and Standard, which use the same data and metrics but differ in the amount of task-brief scaffolding, and each run is scored using both final task performance and S1-S5 stage scores, enabling stage-level analysis from the initial task brief to the final submitted artifact. Across thousands of recorded runs, stage-level scoring reveals that Validate is the weakest workflow stage on average, whereas Setup is the strongest, suggesting that current agents are better at making pipelines executable than at verifying their reliability. Post-run error analysis further shows that verification and submission failures dominate tagged errors, accounting for 37.7% and 38.1% of fired codes respectively, whereas task-understanding errors are rare at 0.9%, and runs with one fired error code have a 48% lower overall score than runs with no error code on average.

AI.tldr: 提出了AutoMedBench，一个工作流感知的医疗AI研究基准测试，包含五阶段工作流（计划、设置、验证、推理、提交），覆盖五类任务和两个难度等级。通过对数千次运行的分析发现，验证阶段是最薄弱环节，验证和提交错误最为常见，而有错误运行的得分比无错误运行低48%。
AI.motivation: 现有的医疗智能体基准测试主要评估最终输出，对智能体在研究过程中的行为缺乏可见性。随着自主智能体被期望支持端到端的医疗AI研究工作流，需要一个能够评估工作流过程的基准测试来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建AutoMedBench基准测试，将智能体执行组织为统一的五阶段工作流（S1-S5）：计划、设置、验证、推理和提交。包含长视野任务（平均33个智能体轮次），覆盖五个研究赛道：分割、图像增强、视觉问答、报告生成和病灶检测。每个任务设置两个难度等级（Lite和Standard），使用相同数据和指标但任务简报脚手架程度不同。采用最终任务性能和阶段得分双重评分机制。
AI.result: 对数千次运行进行阶段级评分分析，发现验证阶段平均而言是最薄弱的工作流阶段，而设置阶段最强。验证和提交失败占主导地位，分别占触发错误的37.7%和38.1%，任务理解错误仅占0.9%。存在一个错误代码的运行比无错误代码的运行平均得分低48%。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体在使流水线可执行方面比验证其可靠性方面表现更好。工作流阶段的细粒度评估揭示了智能体在验证和提交阶段的薄弱环节，为未来改进医疗AI研究智能体提供了明确方向。

title: Beyond Task-Agnostic: Task-Aware Grouping for Communication-Efficient Multi-Task MoE Inference
summary: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity via conditional computation, but distributed inference suffers from cross-GPU expert communication and routing-induced load imbalance. Existing placement methods reduce this cost by co-locating frequently co-activated experts; however, they derive a single deployment plan from globally aggregated routing traces, thereby averaging away the heterogeneous, task-specific co-activation patterns that actually drive communication in multi-task serving. We observe that expert co-activation is strongly task-conditioned: pairs tightly coupled in one task family are often uncorrelated in another, so effective deployment should group experts by task-aware co-activation rather than by a task-agnostic average. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Task-Aware Coactivation Grouping} (TACG), a deployment-time framework that uses family-specific dispatch and co-activation traces to derive per-expert task-family preferences, reweights the co-activation graph so that intra-family locality dominates grouping, and assigns each expert to a primary GPU under exact capacity constraints. To keep the static placement robust under online workload skew, we further introduce \emph{Generic Expert Shared Replication} (GESR), a lightweight companion that identifies generic experts with consistently central co-activation profiles, replicates them across a small set of secondary GPUs, and applies locality- and load-aware selection at serving time. Experiments on three representative open-source MoE models demonstrate that our framework reduces the average communication cost by 31.39\% over the baseline, while preserving an average Jain fairness index of 0.9975. This advantage persists even under severe distribution shifts in the inference data, consistently outperforming strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多任务场景下MoE模型分布式推理的通信开销问题，提出了任务感知共激活分组（TACG）框架和通用专家共享复制（GESR）策略，在三种开源MoE模型上实现了31.39%的通信成本降低，同时保持了0.9975的高公平性指数。
AI.motivation: 稀疏激活的混合专家模型通过条件计算扩展容量，但分布式推理面临跨GPU专家通信和路由导致的负载不平衡问题。现有放置方法通过共定位频繁共激活的专家来降低成本，但它们从全局聚合的路由轨迹推导单一部署方案，忽略了多任务服务中实际驱动通信的异构、任务特定的共激活模式。研究者观察到专家共激活具有强烈的任务条件性：在一个任务家族中紧密耦合的专家对在另一个任务中往往不相关，因此有效的部署应该按任务感知的共激活而非任务无关的平均值进行分组。
AI.method: 本文提出两个核心方法：(1) 任务感知共激活分组（TACG）：一个部署时框架，使用家族特定的调度和共激活轨迹推导每个专家的任务家族偏好，重新加权共激活图使家族内局部性主导分组，并在精确容量约束下将每个专家分配到主GPU；(2) 通用专家共享复制（GESR）：一个轻量级伴随策略，识别具有一致中心共激活配置文件的通用专家，将它们复制到少量次级GPU上，并在服务时应用局部性和负载感知选择，以保持静态放置在在线工作负载倾斜下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在三个代表性开源MoE模型上的实验表明，该框架相比基线将平均通信成本降低了31.39%，同时保持了平均0.9975的Jain公平性指数。即使在推理数据存在严重分布偏移的情况下，这种优势依然存在，持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 任务感知的专家放置策略能够有效捕获多任务场景下的异构共激活模式，结合通用专家的动态复制机制，显著降低了MoE模型分布式推理的通信开销并实现了负载均衡，为实际部署提供了实用且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Algorithmic algorithm development with LLMs: A Case Study on LLM-Usage for Contraction Order Optimization in Tensor Networks
comment: Submitted to the proceedings of the deRSE26 conference
summary: We consider LLM-based algorithm development through a case study on contractionorder optimisation for tensor networks with OpenEvolve. We pay particular attention to the choice of the LLM as well as design choices such as evaluation metric and test instances. Our results highlight both the promise of verifier-guided evolutionary coding agents for algorithm development/improvement and the continuing importance of evaluation, validation, and interpretation -- and corresponding challenges -- by the human scientist.

AI.tldr: 本文通过OpenEvolve工具研究LLM在张量网络收缩顺序优化算法开发中的应用，发现验证引导的进化编码代理在算法开发方面具有潜力，但人类科学家的评估、验证和解释工作仍然至关重要。
AI.motivation: 探索大语言模型(LLM)在算法开发中的应用潜力，特别是针对张量网络收缩顺序优化这一具体问题，以验证LLM是否能有效辅助或改进算法开发过程。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，使用OpenEvolve工具进行LLM驱动的算法开发，重点关注LLM的选择、评估指标的设计以及测试实例的选择等关键设计决策。
AI.result: 研究表明验证引导的进化编码代理在算法开发和改进方面展现出潜力；同时强调了人类科学家在评估、验证和解释环节的持续重要性，以及这些环节所面临的挑战。
AI.conclusion: LLM在算法开发中具有应用价值，但不能完全替代人类专家的判断。人类科学家的评估、验证和解释能力仍然是算法开发过程中不可或缺的组成部分，同时也面临着相应的挑战。

title: MedGym:A Unified Continuous-Time Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical treatment recommendation poses several challenges to reinforcement learning (RL): patient physiology evolves in continuous time, measurements and interventions are performed at irregular intervals, and treatment effects vary substantially across individuals. Existing RL formulations and simulated environments, however, are based on discrete-time MDP or POMDP abstractions with fixed or pre-specified decision intervals. Thus, it remains difficult to evaluate whether RL methods can handle time-interval-dependent disease progression, personalized treatment response, and safety between consecutive measurement points. To address this gap, we introduce MedGym, a benchmark environment for dynamic treatment recommendation. MedGym models longitudinal patient evolution in a continuous-time framework and constructs a configurable medical RL benchmark from clinical data by using Physics-Informed Neural Networks. The resulting benchmark supports both offline and online RL, and enables direct comparison between discrete-time and continuous-time methods under irregular treatment timing and patient-specific dynamics. Besides, MedGym supports evaluation from clinically important perspectives, including personalization, trajectory-level safety, and the performance gap between model-based offline learning and online deployment. By providing a standardized and configurable benchmark for continuous-time dynamic treatment, MedGym aims to facilitate more realistic and informative evaluation of medical RL methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了MedGym，一个基于物理信息神经网络的连续时间医疗强化学习基准环境，用于解决现有方法无法处理不规则时间间隔和个体化治疗响应的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的医疗治疗推荐强化学习方法主要基于离散时间MDP/POMDP框架，无法有效处理患者生理的连续时间演变、不规则测量和干预间隔，以及个体间显著的治疗效果差异，难以评估RL方法在时间依赖性疾病进展和个性化治疗中的表现。
AI.method: 引入MedGym基准环境，采用连续时间框架建模纵向患者演变，利用物理信息神经网络从临床数据构建可配置的医疗RL基准，支持离线和在线RL，并允许在 irregular治疗时序和患者特异性动态下直接比较离散时间和连续时间方法。
AI.result: MedGym支持从临床重要视角进行评估，包括个性化、轨迹级别安全性、以及基于模型的离线学习与在线部署之间的性能差距，实现了对连续时间动态治疗的标准化和可配置评估。
AI.conclusion: MedGym为医疗强化学习方法的评估提供了更现实和丰富的基准，有助于促进该领域的标准化比较和方法改进。

title: An NLP-Driven Framework for Curriculum-Labor Market Alignment: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction, ESCO-Anchored Semantic Matching, and Multi-Dimensional Gap Quantification
summary: Schema-constrained information extraction from diverse educational and labor-market corpora remains an open challenge in natural language processing because existing pipelines rely primarily on lexical-surface methods that cannot recover implicit competencies, lack grounding in shared taxonomies, and provide no formal measures of extraction reliability or document-level completeness. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a four-stage NLP framework that combines (i) schema-constrained prompting of a two-model frontier-LLM ensemble against a JSON Schema-enforced seven-slot competency formalism, (ii) Sentence-BERT (SBERT) alignment of the extracted records against an eleven-domain ESCO v1.2.1 controlled vocabulary, (iii) a two-tier adjudication protocol that resolves inter-model disagreements, and (iv) a verification mechanism that combines per-slot Cohen's kappa, schema conformance, and document-level completeness audits. The framework is instantiated for a critical application in higher-education quality assurance, namely curriculum-labor market alignment for the ABET-accredited BSc Computer Science program at the United Arab Emirates University. The pipeline extracts 400 competency records from the 85-course 2025-2026 study plan and aligns them, under a five-scope analysis ranging from the computing core to a probability-weighted student trajectory, with 30 job postings (483 requirement clauses) at an SBERT cosine threshold of 0.50. The extractor achieves Cohen's kappa of 0.79 on the skill slot, with 100% schema conformance and 100% document-level completeness. The alignment surfaces interpretable supply-demand gaps of 25.0% in general and transversal skills, 13.8% in algorithms and computational theory, and 12.2% in software engineering and project management, with a near-zero 1.8% gap in artificial intelligence and data science despite 38.6% supply coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个四阶段NLP框架，用于从教育和劳动力市场语料库中进行模式约束的信息提取，并在阿联酋大学计算机科学专业实现了课程与劳动力市场的对齐分析，发现了关键的能力供需差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的信息提取流水线主要依赖词汇-表面方法，无法恢复隐含能力、缺乏共享分类法的支撑，且无法提供提取可靠性或文档级完整性的正式度量，因此模式约束的信息提取仍然是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: 提出四阶段NLP框架：(i) 针对JSON Schema强制七槽能力形式主义的两个前沿LLM集成模型进行模式约束提示；(ii) 使用Sentence-BERT将提取的记录与ESCO v1.2.1受控词汇进行对齐；(iii) 两层裁决协议解决模型间分歧；(iv) 结合Cohen's kappa、模式一致性和文档级完整性审计的验证机制。
AI.result: 从85门课程的2025-2026学习计划中提取400条能力记录，与30个职位发布（483个要求条款）对齐。提取器在技能槽上达到0.79的Cohen's kappa，100%模式一致性和100%文档级完整性。发现供需差距：一般和跨领域能力25.0%、算法和计算理论13.8%、软件工程和项目管理12.2%、人工智能和数据科学仅1.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功应用于ABET认证的计算机科学课程与劳动力市场对齐的高等教育质量保证关键应用，能够识别可解释的供需差距，为课程改革提供了量化依据。

title: OPD+: Rethinking the Advantage Design for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a widely used technique to transfer capabilities from capable teacher language models to the base student models, and can be formulated in a reinforcement learning style objective using student generated rollouts. Yet, despite the divergence reward being dependent on student model likelihood, existing works usually adopt a stop gradient design primarily for stability, which makes the resulting advantage estimation questionable. In this work, we provide a generic optimization framework based on f-divergence between the student and teacher, and mathematically revisit whether such design space is valid. We prove that general stop-gradient operation would lead to biased estimates of the reward objective and corresponding gradient for general divergence functions. We propose OPD+, the corrected version of OPD that demonstrates improved performance over the baseline KL approach and also supports the choice of various f-divergence. We validate our findings on mathematical reasoning and tool-use benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了现有在策略蒸馏（OPD）中广泛使用的停止梯度设计会导致偏差估计，提出了修正版本OPD+，在数学推理和工具使用基准上取得了更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有在策略蒸馏方法为保持稳定性普遍采用停止梯度设计，但散度奖励依赖于学生模型似然，这种设计使得优势估计的正确性受到质疑。本文旨在从数学角度重新审视该设计空间的有效性。
AI.method: 1. 基于学生-教师模型间的f-散度建立通用优化框架；2. 数学证明一般停止梯度操作会导致奖励目标和相应梯度的有偏估计；3. 提出修正版本OPD+，支持多种f-散度函数选择。
AI.result: 在数学推理和工具使用基准上验证，OPD+相比基线KL方法展现出改进的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 现有停止梯度设计存在理论缺陷，OPD+通过修正偏差估计提供了更有效的知识蒸馏方案，同时扩展了散度函数的选择空间。

title: SafeMCP: Proactive Power Regulation for LLM Agent Defense via Environment-Grounded Look-Ahead Reasoning
comment: Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026), Main Conference
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to operate in complex environments, the expansion of their action spaces offers agents unsafe capabilities and underscores the risk of power-seeking. While broad action space and greater environment influence are essential for task fulfillment, they create a fragile risk surface where minor errors or hallucinations are magnified into catastrophic failures. In response, we propose SafeMCP, a {server-side} defense plugin that constrains tool acquisition via predictive reasoning regarding future safety risks. SafeMCP utilizes an internal world model for look-ahead reasoning to implement a two-tier defense: proactive tool filtering to constrain hazardous power expansion and immediate intervention as a fail-safe. To train SafeMCP, we introduce a three-stage pipeline comprising environmental dynamic grounding, safe policy initialization, and reinforcement learning (RL) with dual verifiable rewards. Experiments on PowerSeeking Bench, ToolEmu, and AgentHarm show that SafeMCP achieves a safe equilibrium, effectively mitigating risks while preserving agent utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeMCP，一种服务端防御插件，通过预测性推理约束工具获取，实现了安全与效用的平衡。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型代理通过模型上下文协议（MCP）在复杂环境中运行，其行动空间的扩展带来了不安全的能力，并突显了权力追求的风险。虽然广泛的行动空间和更大的环境影响对任务完成至关重要，但它们创造了一个脆弱的风险面，微小的错误或幻觉会被放大为灾难性失败。
AI.method: 提出SafeMCP，一种服务端防御插件，利用内部世界模型进行前瞻性推理，实施两层防御：主动工具过滤以约束危险的权力扩张，以及作为故障保险的即时干预。训练采用三阶段流程：环境动态基础、安全策略初始化，以及带有双重可验证奖励的强化学习。
AI.result: 在PowerSeeking Bench、ToolEmu和AgentHarm上的实验表明，SafeMCP实现了安全均衡，在保持代理效用的同时有效缓解了风险。
AI.conclusion: SafeMCP成功地在服务端实现了对LLM代理的安全约束，通过前瞻性推理和两层防御机制，在不损害代理实用性的前提下有效降低了权力追求等安全风险。

title: Plausibility Is Not Prediction: Contrastive Evidence for LLM-Based Cellular Perturbation Reasoning
summary: Perturbation experiments are central to understanding cellular mechanisms, but remain costly and sparse, motivating prediction of gene expression responses for unobserved conditions. A promising recent direction leverages large language models (LLMs) as "virtual cell" simulators-using stepwise, knowledge-grounded mechanistic reasoning to infer differential expression-pointing toward an interpretable, knowledge-driven paradigm that transcends purely data-driven approaches. However, we find that plausibility is not prediction: despite producing biologically plausible explanations, these methods fail to capture perturbation-specific effects: systematically overestimating differential expression, often underperforming a simple gene-frequency baseline in aggregate evaluations, and collapsing to chance-level performance at the per-gene level. This reveals a reliance on intrinsic gene response tendencies rather than true perturbation reasoning. We trace this failure to how evidence is presented: existing methods evaluate perturbation-gene pairs in isolation, without exposing how related perturbations differ in their effects on the same gene. To address this limitation, we introduce CORE (Contrastive Organization of Relational Evidence), which reframes prediction as a comparison task by organizing evidence into positive and negative outcomes from related perturbations. Using a biomedical knowledge graph for evidence retrieval, CORE improves calibration and substantially boosts perturbation-specific prediction in both LLM-based and non-LLM settings: for example, on drug-perturbation data, CORE-Reasoning improves Qwen3.5-9B aggregate metrics by up to 28.6%, while on generic perturbation data, CORE-Voting raises macro-per-gene AUROC from chance to 0.703 in average across four cell lines. This highlights contrastive evidence organization as essential to reliable LLM-based perturbation reasoning

AI.tldr: 现有基于大语言模型的细胞扰动预测方法虽然能生成合理的生物学解释，但实际上无法准确预测扰动特异性效应；本文提出CORE方法，通过对比组织相关证据，显著提升了预测性能。
AI.motivation: 扰动实验对理解细胞机制至关重要，但成本高昂且数据稀疏，因此需要预测未观测条件下的基因表达响应。现有的基于大语言模型的"虚拟细胞"模拟器虽然能产生看似合理的生物学解释，但作者发现这些方法无法捕捉扰动特异性效应，系统性地高估差异表达，在基因水平上的性能甚至退化到随机水平，这表明现有方法依赖于基因内在响应倾向而非真正的扰动推理能力。作者追溯其失败原因发现：现有方法孤立地评估扰动-基因对，未能揭示相关扰动对同一基因影响的差异。
AI.method: 本文提出CORE（对比性关系证据组织）方法，将预测任务重新定义为比较任务。该方法利用生物医学知识图谱检索证据，将证据组织为来自相关扰动的正向和负向结果进行对比。这种方法使模型能够区分不同扰动对同一基因的不同影响，从而捕获扰动特异性效应。CORE可在基于LLM和非LLM的设置中应用。
AI.result: 在药物扰动数据上，CORE-Reasoning使Qwen3.5-9B的聚合指标提升高达28.6%；在通用扰动数据上，CORE-Voting将四个细胞系的平均宏观基因水平AUROC从随机水平提升至0.703。实验证明对比性证据组织对可靠的基于LLM的扰动推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 现有基于LLM的扰动预测方法存在根本缺陷：合理解释能力不等同于预测能力，孤立评估方式导致模型无法区分扰动特异性效应。CORE通过对比组织证据解决了这一问题，显著提升了预测的校准性和扰动特异性预测能力，为可靠的LLM扰动推理提供了新的范式。

title: Extreme Low-Bit Inference in Reasoning Models: Failure Modes and Targeted Recovery
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) rely on long reasoning traces, making inference expensive. While low-bit quantization reduces per-token decoding cost, we show that aggressive 2-bit inference can fail to deliver end-to-end speedup because instability in the generation process inflates total token count. Instead of merely lowering answer accuracy, 2-bit quantization often produces much longer traces with repetitive loops, budget exhaustion, delayed commitment, and unclosed reasoning segments. We analyze full reasoning traces of Qwen3 reasoning models across mathematical and commonsense benchmarks and show that accuracy degradation is tightly linked to these process-level failures. To address them, we introduce two lightweight controls: FP16 planning, which gives the 2-bit model a short high-precision outline, and loop rescue, which detects repetitive traces and either commits to an earlier answer or falls back to FP16. On MATH-500, loop rescue improves Qwen3-8B accuracy from 17.2% to 74.2%, while planning plus loop rescue improves Qwen3-32B from 65.0% to 87.2%. Overall, our results show that extreme low-bit reasoning becomes practical when its failures are treated as controllable generation pathologies: with lightweight detection and selective FP16 support, 2-bit inference can recover accuracy while preserving real end-to-end speed. Our code is available at: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/quantized-reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了2位量化推理失败的根本原因在于过程级失败（如重复循环、预算耗尽），并提出了FP16规划和循环救援两种轻量级控制方法，在MATH-500上将准确率从17.2%提升至74.2%，证明了极端低比特推理的实用性。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)依赖长推理链导致推理成本高昂。虽然低比特量化可降低单token解码成本，但本文发现激进的2位量化往往无法实现端到端加速，因为生成过程的不稳定性导致总token数膨胀，产生重复循环、预算耗尽、延迟提交和未闭合推理段等过程级失败，这些失败与准确率下降密切相关。
AI.method: 提出两种轻量级控制方法：1) FP16规划：为2位模型提供简短的高精度大纲；2) 循环救援：检测重复推理轨迹，要么提交早期答案，要么回退到FP16。通过轻量级检测和选择性FP16支持，将2位量化的失败视为可控的生成病理。
AI.result: 在MATH-500基准测试中，循环救援将Qwen3-8B准确率从17.2%提升至74.2%；规划加循环救援将Qwen3-32B准确率从65.0%提升至87.2%。通过分析Qwen3推理模型在数学和常识基准测试上的完整推理轨迹，证明了准确率下降与过程级失败紧密相关。
AI.conclusion: 极端低比特推理在配合轻量级检测和选择性FP16支持时变得实用，能够恢复准确率同时保持真实的端到端速度。通过将2位量化的失败视为可控的生成病理，可以实现高效且准确的低比特推理。

title: Interaction-Limited Safe Continuous-Time RL for Dynamical Medical Treatment
summary: Dynamic medical treatment requires deciding treatment intensity and intervention timing, while patient states evolve continuously and adverse events may occur between clinical interactions. Most existing treatment learning methods assume fixed schedules or enforce safety only at discrete decision points. We propose Interaction-Limited Safe Continuous-Time Reinforcement Learning, a framework that jointly optimizes treatment administration and clinical interaction timing under trajectory-level safety constraints. Our key idea is to reformulate the continuous time treatment problem as an option-based semi-Markov decision process, where each option specifies a continuous-time treatment policy and its duration. We develop a safety-tightening mechanism showing that suitably constructed constraints at interaction times guarantee safety over the full continuous-time trajectory with high probability. We further establish finite-sample guarantees for policy learning from logged treatment trajectories and introduce a practical data-driven conservative surrogate. Experiments show that the proposed adaptive interaction-timing mechanism improves both safety and treatment effectiveness over equidistant interaction schemes across different safe policy optimization methods.

AI.tldr: 提出交互受限的安全连续时间强化学习框架，联合优化治疗实施和临床交互时机，在轨迹级别安全约束下实现动态医疗治疗决策。
AI.motivation: 动态医疗治疗需要同时决定治疗强度和干预时机，而患者状态持续演变且不良事件可能在临床交互之间发生。现有治疗方法大多假设固定时间表或仅在离散决策点强制安全性，无法满足连续时间下的安全需求。
AI.method: 将连续时间治疗问题重新表述为基于选项的半马尔可夫决策过程，其中每个选项指定连续时间治疗策略及其持续时间；开发安全紧缩机制，证明在交互时间构建的约束能以高概率保证整个连续时间轨迹的安全性；引入数据驱动的保守代理方法用于实际学习。
AI.result: 建立了策略学习的有限样本保证；实验表明，所提出的自适应交互时机机制在多种安全策略优化方法上均能提升安全性和治疗有效性，优于等距交互方案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了连续时间下的安全治疗决策，通过自适应交互时机设计在保证轨迹级别安全的同时提升了治疗效果，为动态医疗治疗提供了有效的解决方案。

title: RL-ACRGNet: Reinforcement Learning-Based Chest Radiology Report Generation Network
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Medical imaging interpretation is a foundational pillar of modern clinical diagnostics, yet the manual generation of radiology reports remains a time-consuming process prone to interpretation inconsistencies. Within the field of medical AI, automating these descriptions through deep learning promises to streamline clinical workflows and standardise diagnostic output. However, accurate disease detection and precise report generation remain significant challenges due to limitations in capturing fine-grained visual features and ensuring clinical coherence.
