Under natural structural assumptions, these bounds match the information-theoretic lower bounds in their dominant scaling, up to constants and mild factors. We also introduce Bid-Up, a fixed-grid quantization refinement step that can be alternated with optimal low-rank compensation with guaranteed non-increasing layer-wise reconstruction error. Experiments on Qwen3 language models and DeiT vision transformers show that GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA improves over GPTQ and GPTQ followed by low-rank compensation, with additional gains from refinement loops.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA，一种无需训练的量化算法，通过将低秩校正直接集成到GPTQ量化过程中，显著改善了低位宽量化下的模型质量，并提供了信息论下界与理论误差界保证。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化广泛用于压缩大型神经网络，但激进的低位宽量化会显著降低模型质量。现有方法通过添加低秩校正（W≈Q+LR）来缓解此问题，但缺乏理论基础和高效的训练无关算法。
AI.method: 提出GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA算法，通过适当增强校准Hessian矩阵，将低秩校正直接纳入GPTQ风格的量化过程。特别地，当选择L=V_r（X的前r个右奇异向量）时，用rank-r残差‖X-X_r‖²_F替代GPTQ中通常的‖X‖²_F依赖。同时引入Bid-Up固定网格量化精炼步骤，可与最优低秩补偿交替进行。
AI.result: 建立了该问题的首个信息论下界；证明了层间重构误差界，在自然结构假设下与信息论下界的主导缩放相匹配；实验表明在Qwen3语言模型和DeiT视觉Transformer上，该方法优于标准GPTQ及GPTQ后接低秩补偿的方案，精炼循环可带来额外增益。
AI.conclusion: GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA为低精度+低秩表示提供了理论基础（信息论下界与匹配的误差上界）和实用的训练无关算法，在低位宽量化场景下有效提升了模型质量，为量化神经网络的低秩补偿方法建立了理论框架。

title: Target localization, identification and sensing using latent symmetries
comment: Submitted to SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences
summary: We show that an array of scatterers which has been designed to have latent ("hidden") symmetries can be used as a sensor. We use the capacitance matrix as a canonical model for three-dimensional hybridisation and study how the introduction of an "intruder'' scatterer breaks the latent symmetries. By analysing the degree to which each symmetry is broken, we identify the radius of the intruder and localize its position. This can be achieved using a dictionary-based approach, however Bayesian inference or an artificial neural network (multi-layer perceptron) perform better in the presence of measurement noise. To our knowledge, this is the first time latent symmetries have been exploited successfully for sensing problems. It is also the first time latent symmetries have been observed in a three-dimensional open system that cannot be approximated by a sparse graph.

AI.tldr: 本文首次利用潜在（隐藏）对称性实现了传感应用，通过分析三维系统中“入侵”散射体对潜在对称性的破坏程度，成功实现了对入侵物体半径的识别和位置的定位。
AI.motivation: 探索潜在（隐藏）对称性在实际应用中的价值，特别是开发一种新型传感机制，利用对称性破坏来探测和定位三维开放系统中的未知散射体。
AI.method: 采用电容矩阵作为三维混杂化的规范模型，研究“入侵”散射体如何破坏潜在对称性；通过分析各对称性的破坏程度来识别入侵体的半径并定位其位置；比较了基于字典的方法、贝叶斯推断和人工神经网络（多层感知机）三种方法在有测量噪声情况下的表现。
AI.result: 成功通过分析潜在对称性的破坏程度实现了对入侵散射体半径的识别和位置定位；在存在测量噪声的情况下，贝叶斯推断和人工神经网络（多层感知机）的性能优于基于字典的方法。
AI.conclusion: 这是潜在对称性首次被成功应用于传感问题，也是潜在对称性首次在无法用稀疏图近似的三维开放系统中被观察到，为潜在对称性的实际应用开辟了新方向。

title: Learning-based Directed Graph Abstraction of Combinatorial Spaces for Order-Preserving Search in Mixed-Combinatorial Nonlinear Optimization
comment: Accepted for presentation at 2026, ASME IDETC
summary: Mixed-combinatorial nonlinear programming (MCNLP) problems arise in many engineering design and planning applications, e.g., due to categorical, component, and geometric design choices, as well as joint task and motion planning. Traditional representations of combinatorial spaces, such as integer or binary encoding, often introduce spurious relations, increase dimensionality, and require additional compatibility constraints. Instead, this paper draws on recent developments in robot planning and vehicle/network routing domains that aim to learn search heuristics over combinatorial spaces using graph neural networks (GNNs). More specifically, this paper presents a first-of-its-kind structured abstraction of the combinatorial space by learning a mapping from an undirected fully connected graph of combinations to a directed graph indicating improvement directions using an Edge Field Graph Network (EFGN). To demonstrate the utility of this new way of abstracting the combinatorial space in solving MCNLPs, we adopt a recent optimization framework that purely searches over the non-combinatorial (e.g., continuous) variables and retrieves the best-suited combination for each candidate design by using the abstraction model, akin to a recommender system. The presented direction-aware abstraction model provides a potentially more scalable and interpretable retrieval of combinations compared to the original recommendation system in that framework. For evaluation, the proposed method is integrated with a well-known particle swarm optimization and genetic algorithm solvers on three benchmark nonlinear problems with varying numbers of combinations and variables. Compared to baseline solvers using indexified combinations, the GNN-based recommender consistently achieves better mean optimum values and robustness across multiple runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络（EFGN）的组合空间方向感知抽象方法，用于更高效地求解混合组合非线性规划（MCNLP）问题，在基准测试中相比传统方法取得了更优的求解质量和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: MCNLP问题广泛存在于工程设计与规划中，传统组合空间表示方法（如整数或二进制编码）常引入伪关系、增加维度并需要额外的兼容性约束，导致求解效率低下。作者受机器人规划和车辆/网络路由领域的启发，旨在学习组合空间上的搜索启发式方法以克服这些限制。
AI.method: 提出使用边场图网络（EFGN）学习从组合的无向全连接图到指示改进方向的有向图的映射，构建组合空间的结构化抽象；将该抽象模型集成到现有优化框架中，通过搜索非组合变量并利用抽象模型（类似推荐系统）检索最适合的组合。
AI.result: 在三个具有不同组合数和变量数的基准非线性问题上，将所提方法与粒子群优化和遗传算法结合进行评估；基于GNN的推荐器相比使用索引化组合的基线求解器，在多次运行中始终获得更好的平均最优值和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方向感知抽象模型为MCNLP问题的求解提供了一种更具可扩展性和可解释性的组合检索方法，验证了基于图神经网络抽象组合空间的有效性和优越性。

title: Leaf Spectral Reflectance Prediction Using Multi-Head Attention Neural Networks
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Author-accepted version of the SPIE conference paper
summary: Accurate modeling of leaf spectral reflectance from physiological and biochemical traits is essential for advancing remote sensing applications in plant science and precision agriculture. Widely used radiative transfer models, such as PROSPECT-PRO, rely on generalized trait-reflectance relationships developed from a wide range of species, which may not fully capture the spectral behavior of specific crops like grapevines. In this study, we developed a trait-to-spectra prediction model using a multi-head attention neural network trained on a grapevine-specific dataset that includes 16 leaf traits measured across multiple varieties, growth stages, and years. The model was evaluated using stratified 5-fold cross-validation and achieved an average coefficient of determination (R^2) of 0.84 and normalized root mean squared error (NRMSE) of 1.52 percent, demonstrating high accuracy and generalizability. When compared to PROSPECT-PRO in forward mode, the neural network exhibited lower mean absolute error (MAE), especially in the near-infrared (NIR) and shortwave-infrared (SWIR) regions. These results emphasize the importance of species-specific modeling approaches and show that integrating biochemical and structural traits into data-driven architectures can significantly improve spectral prediction. The proposed model provides a robust framework for generating accurate leaf-level reflectance data, with potential applications in canopy trait retrieval, vineyard monitoring, and remote sensing-driven crop management.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对葡萄藤开发了基于多头注意力神经网络的叶片光谱反射率预测模型，相比通用辐射传输模型PROSPECT-PRO，在NIR和SWIR区域表现出更低的预测误差，强调了物种特异性建模的重要性。
AI.motivation: 广泛使用的辐射传输模型（如PROSPECT-PRO）依赖于从广泛物种范围建立的通用性状-反射率关系，可能无法完全捕捉特定作物（如葡萄藤）的光谱行为，因此需要开发物种特异性的光谱预测模型以提升精准农业应用中的准确性。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于多头注意力神经网络（multi-head attention neural network）的性状到光谱预测模型，使用葡萄藤特异性数据集进行训练，该数据集包含16个叶片性状，涵盖多个品种、生长阶段和年份的测量数据，并采用分层5折交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 模型在分层5折交叉验证中平均决定系数（R²）达到0.84，归一化均方根误差（NRMSE）为1.52%，展现出高精度和良好的泛化能力。与前向模式下的PROSPECT-PRO相比，该神经网络表现出更低的平均绝对误差（MAE），尤其在近红外（NIR）和短波红外（SWIR）区域表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了物种特异性建模方法的重要性，表明将生化和结构性状整合到数据驱动架构中可显著提高光谱预测精度。所提出的模型为生成准确的叶片级反射率数据提供了稳健框架，在冠层性状反演、葡萄园监测和遥感驱动的作物管理中具有潜在应用价值。

title: CEAR: Certified Ensemble Adversarial Robustness in DNNs
comment: This is the preprint of the work accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence (Canadian AI 2026); 19 Pages
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are highly susceptible to adversarial perturbations, leading to extensive research on robustness for safety-critical applications. State-of-the-art empirical defense mechanisms improve the robustness of DNNs through the training phase, but still struggle against adaptive white-box attacks. On the other hand, certified defenses offer provable guarantees of robustness within a specified perturbation bound. These guarantees hold regardless of the level of perturbations, even if the attacker is given full knowledge of the model. In this paper, we propose CEAR, an ensemble-based robust method that utilizes a hybrid of empirical and certified defense mechanisms. CEAR trains each network within the ensemble using varying Gaussian noise and temperatures to obfuscate gradients and logits, making the model more resistant to stronger gradient-based attacks. We then use noisy logits and propose two different voting mechanisms to further improve robustness. Furthermore, we extend randomized smoothing to verify the robustness of ensemble-based classifiers. Our experimental evaluations on MNIST, CIFAR10, and TinyImageNet datasets demonstrate superior certified accuracy on average, increased robustness radius, and decreased transferability compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CEAR，一种结合经验防御和认证防御的集成学习方法，通过高斯噪声和温度变化混淆梯度和logits，并提出两种投票机制和集成分类器认证方法，显著提升了DNN的鲁棒性和认证精度。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络（DNN）极易受到对抗性扰动的攻击。现有的经验防御方法虽能提升鲁棒性，但仍难以抵御自适应白盒攻击；而认证防御虽提供可证明的鲁棒性保证，但仍有改进空间。因此，作者希望结合这两种机制的优势来构建更强的防御方法。
AI.method: 提出CEAR（一种基于集成的鲁棒方法）：1）在集成中训练多个网络，每个网络使用不同的高斯噪声和温度来混淆梯度和logits，增强对基于梯度的强攻击的抵抗力；2）利用噪声logits并提出两种不同的投票机制进一步提升鲁棒性；3）扩展随机平滑技术以验证基于集成分类器的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR10和TinyImageNet数据集上的实验表明，CEAR相较于基线方法具有更优越的平均认证精度、增大的鲁棒半径以及降低的攻击迁移性。
AI.conclusion: CEAR成功地将经验防御与认证防御相结合，通过集成学习框架有效提升了深度神经网络对对抗性攻击的鲁棒性，为安全关键应用提供了更强的保障。

title: UR-JEPA: Uniform Rectifiability as a Regularizer for Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
summary: A central difficulty in training Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) is preventing representation collapse. LeJEPA addresses this by enforcing an isotropic Gaussian target on the embeddings via Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg). This target is in tension with the manifold hypothesis, which expects embeddings to concentrate on a low-dimensional subset of the ambient space. We propose \emph{UR-JEPA}, which targets a uniformly $n$-rectifiable measure of local tangent dimension $n$ at small scales, realized through a Gaussian-kernel smoothed Carleson-type square function $\mathcal{L}^{\text{CGLT}}$, with a complementary Jones $β$-number formulation. On Inet10, UR-JEPA($\mathcal{L}^{\text{CGLT}}$) attains $0.9141 \pm 0.0014$ for a $+0.83$\,pp gain over LeJEPA($\mathcal{L}^{\text{SIGReg}}$) with $\sim 30\%$ lower seed standard deviation; on matched-recipe Galaxy10~SDSS, a single-seed ImageNet-$100$ run, and a $3$-seed EuroSAT remote-sensing run, the two methods lie in the same peak-accuracy band at convergence, with UR-JEPA retaining its lower-seed-variance signature. On EuroSAT the in-domain pair is competitive at $96.0$ to $96.1\%$ with large remote-sensing foundation-model transfer at a $25\times$ smaller backbone. The distinction is geometric: direct visualization of the projector output distribution shows that on all four datasets UR--JEPA($\mathcal{L}^{\text{CGLT}}$) produces a global PCA spectrum with a $4$ to $5$ order-of-magnitude drop at index $\sim 20$ to $25$ out of $D = 32$, while LeJEPA's spectrum is near-flat (top-to-bottom ratio at most $3.6$). Per-dimension marginals are simultaneously near-Gaussian for both methods (mean Shapiro-Wilk $W \in [0.992, 0.996]$) as a Diaconis-Freedman consequence. At matched accuracy the two regularizers therefore yield structurally distinct projected representations.

AI.tldr: UR-JEPA通过引入一致n-可矫正测度目标，解决了LeJEPA中各项同性高斯目标与流形假设的冲突，在多个数据集上实现了更高准确率和更低的种子方差。
AI.motivation: LeJEPA通过Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization强制嵌入服从各向同性高斯分布，防止表示崩溃，但这与流形假设存在冲突——后者期望嵌入集中在低维子集上。作者提出了UR-JEPA，目标是在小尺度上具有局部切线维度n的一致n-可矫正测度，更符合流形假设。
AI.method: UR-JEPA通过高斯核平滑的Carleson型平方函数L^CGLT实现目标测度，并辅以Jones β数公式。这种方法使嵌入分布具有明确的低维几何结构，而非强制为各向同性高斯分布。
AI.result: 在Inet10上，UR-JEPA达到0.9141±0.0014，比LeJEPA提升0.83个百分点，种子标准差降低约30%；在Galaxy10 SDSS、ImageNet-100和EuroSAT上，两种方法收敛时准确率相当，但UR-JEPA保持更低的种子方差。EuroSAT上，UR-JEPA在骨干网络小25倍的情况下达到96.0-96.1%的竞争力准确率。几何上，UR-JEPA的全局PCA谱在索引20-25处（D=32）呈现4-5个数量级的下降，而LeJEPA的谱近乎平坦（顶底比最多3.6）。两种方法的每维边缘分布均接近高斯分布（Shapiro-Wilk W∈[0.992,0.996]）。
AI.conclusion: 在准确率相当的情况下，两种正则化器产生了结构上不同的投影表示：UR-JEPA产生具有低维几何结构的表示，符合流形假设；而LeJEPA产生近乎各向同性的表示。这表明表示学习中的正则化策略会深刻影响学习到的几何性质。

title: Truthful AI Advisors: A Pre-Specified Benchmark for Large Language Model Honesty Under Preference Misalignment
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as advisors whose objective is not aligned with the user's: recommenders optimize for engagement, sales assistants for purchases, negotiation agents for concessions. Whether such advisors stay truthful when honesty conflicts with their own payoff is a core alignment-evaluation question. We turn the canonical Crawford-Sobel cheap-talk model into a pre-specified benchmark for LLM honesty under preference misalignment. Cheap-talk theory predicts neither full revelation nor silence but coarse monotone partitions, with fewer informative intervals as preference conflict grows. A sender observes a state omega in [0,1], wants the receiver's action near omega+b, and sends one costless message to a receiver whose ideal action is omega. The design uses 5 bias levels, 3 prompt frames, a fixed low-temperature setting, and 200 states per cell: 12,000 sender calls. For the positive-bias grid b in {0.01,0.04,0.08,0.12} the exact most-informative partition sizes are 7,4,3,2, with oracle normalized mutual information 0.5294, 0.3268, 0.2205, 0.1829. Running the full design on four instruction-tuned models (GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, Llama-3.3-70B), we find all four over-reveal relative to the most-informative equilibrium by 1.8 to 4.2x: normalized mutual information stays at 0.78-0.94 where the oracle prescribes 0.18-0.53. Informativeness declines with bias as predicted but never approaches the strategic optimum; rather than coarse partitions, models show near-full revelation with a constant upward offset tracking their bias (linear exaggeration). Payoff-maximizing versus honesty framing has negligible effect. A decoder ablation shows the finding is recoverable only when the receiver reads the sender's stated number: an embedding-only decoder mis-reads the same data as near-babbling.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了当LLM作为顾问（如推荐系统、销售助手）且目标与用户不一致时是否诚实，发现四个主流模型过度透露信息（比理论均衡高1.8-4.2倍），表现为近似完全揭示加线性偏移，而非廉价谈话理论预测的粗粒度分区。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地作为顾问部署（推荐系统优化参与度、销售助手优化购买、谈判代理优化让步），其目标与用户利益存在错位。当诚实与模型自身收益冲突时，模型是否保持诚实是一个核心对齐评估问题，需要系统性研究这种偏好错位下的LLM诚实行为。
AI.method: 将经典Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话模型转化为预定义的LLM诚实性基准：发送者观察状态ω∈[0,1]，希望接收者行动接近ω+b，发送一条无成本消息给理想行动为ω的接收者。实验设计包含5个偏好偏差水平、3种提示框架、固定低温度设置、每格200个状态，共12,000次发送者调用。在四个指令微调模型（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite、Llama-3.3-70B）上运行完整实验设计。
AI.result: 对于正偏差网格b∈{0.01,0.04,0.08,0.12}，理论预测的最具信息量分区大小为7,4,3,2，Oracle标准化互信息为0.5294, 0.3268, 0.2205, 0.1829。实验发现四个模型相对于最具信息量均衡过度透露1.8-4.2倍：标准化互信息保持在0.78-0.94，而理论最优值为0.18-0.53。信息量随偏差下降符合预测但从未接近战略最优；模型表现接近完全揭示并带有追踪偏差的固定向上偏移（线性夸大），而非粗粒度分区。收益最大化与诚实框架的影响微乎其微。解码器消融实验显示结果仅在接收者读取发送者陈述数字时可恢复。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在偏好错位情况下未能学习到廉价谈话博弈的理论最优策略，而是表现出准诚实行为——近似完全揭示加线性偏移。这表明模型缺乏战略性信息操纵能力，可能对对齐评估和实际部署有重要启示：模型既非完全诚实也非战略最优，而是表现出一种可预测的次优行为模式。

title: OmniOPD: Logit-Free On-Policy Distillation via Speculative Verification
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own generative trajectories under dense token-level feedback from a stronger teacher, mitigating both the off-policy distribution shift of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and the sparse credit assignment of Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, standard OPD faces two coupled limitations. First, it requires direct access to the teacher's token-level logits, excluding a broad class of capable proprietary models from serving as teachers. Second, the token-level logit signal itself is brittle, depending on a narrow overlap of plausible next tokens between teacher and student, and prone to amplifying degenerate patterns such as repetition loops. In this paper, we introduce OmniOPD, a novel framework that addresses both limitations through a logit-free, chunk-level supervision signal. OmniOPD replaces deterministic logit matching with Monte Carlo rollouts that approximate the teacher's local preferences through a continuous semantic similarity metric over multi-token chunks, and concentrates this supervision via a peak-entropy scheduler that audits the student only at its high-uncertainty reasoning forks. A Dirichlet-Multinomial Bayesian prior and a base-model KL anchor further bound the variance of discrete sampling and prevent policy collapse across unaudited tokens. Across competitive benchmarks, OmniOPD surpasses the standard OPD approach by up to +28.64% on math, confirming that chunk-level semantic verification extracts a more reliable learning signal than token-level logit matching, whose high information density is offset by significant noise and brittleness. Furthermore, when paired with stronger black-box teachers such as Claude-4.5-Haiku and Gemini-2.5-Flash, OmniOPD achieves an additional +9.54% relative on math over its open-weight teacher counterpart, advancing the student past the performance of self-exploratory RL.

AI.tldr: OmniOPD提出了一种无logit的分块级别监督框架，解决了标准On-Policy Distillation无法使用黑盒教师模型和token级别信号脆弱的问题，在数学基准测试上性能提升高达28.64%。
AI.motivation: 标准On-Policy Distillation存在两个耦合的局限性：第一，需要直接访问教师模型的token级别logits，这使得大量强大的专有模型无法作为教师；第二，token级别的logit信号本身脆弱，依赖教师与学生之间合理下一个token的狭窄重叠，且容易放大重复循环等退化模式。
AI.method: OmniOPD提出了一种无logit的分块级别监督信号：使用蒙特卡洛采样近似教师的局部偏好，通过多token块的连续语义相似度度量替代确定性的logit匹配；引入峰值熵调度器，仅在学生模型的高不确定性推理分叉点进行监督；结合Dirichlet-Multinomial贝叶斯先验和基模型KL锚点来约束离散采样的方差并防止策略崩溃。
AI.result: 在竞争性基准测试中，OmniOPD在数学任务上比标准OPD方法提升高达+28.64%；当与Claude-4.5-Haiku和Gemini-2.5-Flash等更强的黑盒教师模型配对时，相比开源权重教师额外获得+9.54%的相对提升，性能超越了自探索强化学习。
AI.conclusion: 分块级别的语义验证比token级别的logit匹配能够提取更可靠的学习信号，后者的高信息密度被显著的噪声和脆弱性所抵消。OmniOPD成功扩展了知识蒸馏的适用范围，使黑盒专有模型能够作为教师模型，推动了学生模型超越自探索强化学习的性能边界。

title: MURMUR: An Efficient Inference System for Long-Form ASR
summary: Long-form automatic speech recognition (ASR) requires both high accuracy and low latency, but existing systems force a trade-off between the two. Chunk-based pipelines process audio in parallel windows for low latency, but lose cross-chunk context and need brittle heuristics to align speakers and timestamps at boundaries. Long-context ASR models resolve everything in a single pass for better accuracy, but are an order of magnitude slower. We propose Murmur, an inference system that overcomes this trade-off by operating at two levels. At the inter-chunk level, we revisit the chunk-based pipeline for modern long-context ASR, treating chunk size as a tunable hyperparameter, and show that intermediate chunk sizes strike a good balance of accuracy and latency. At the intra-chunk level, we exploit attention sparsity through a sliding window KV cache eviction policy applied to both output and speech tokens. On AMI-IHM, Murmur matches single-pass accuracy while reducing latency by 4.2x, with further gains from token eviction at less than 1% relative tcpWER degradation. The code of Murmur is available at https://github.com/uw-syfi/Murmur.

AI.tldr: Murmur通过分层优化策略，在保持长文本语音识别高准确率的同时，实现了4.2倍的延迟降低，突破了现有系统在准确率与延迟之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有长文本自动语音识别系统存在权衡困境：基于分块的流水线方法虽延迟低但牺牲了跨块上下文信息，且需要脆弱的启发式规则来对齐说话人和时间戳；而长上下文ASR模型虽准确率高，但速度慢一个数量级。研究旨在克服这一准确率与延迟之间的根本性矛盾。
AI.method: 提出Murmur推理系统，在两个层面进行优化：(1)块间层面：重新设计适用于现代长上下文ASR的分块流水线，将块大小作为可调超参数，通过中间块大小平衡准确率与延迟；(2)块内层面：通过对输出和语音token应用滑动窗口KV缓存淘汰策略，利用注意力稀疏性。
AI.result: 在AMI-IHM数据集上，Murmur在匹配单次推理准确率的同时，将延迟降低了4.2倍；token淘汰策略进一步带来增益，且tcpWER相对退化小于1%。
AI.conclusion: Murmur成功克服了长文本ASR系统中准确率与延迟的权衡问题，通过分层优化策略实现了接近单次推理的高准确率与显著更低的延迟，为实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures. Code, training scripts, and the full experiment database (results.db) are available at https://github.com/ccapps42/CART
summary:
We present CART (Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer), a parameter-efficient language model that reuses a single shared core block R times across depth. Unlike prior looped transformers that recompute key-value tensors at every iteration, CART computes K and V once from a multi-layer prelude and has the recurrent core cross-attend to those frozen tensors via multi-head latent attention. A learned Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) gate keeps the recurrence stable: its spectral radius settles in a narrow band (rho in [0.79, 0.83]) across all 36 fully-trained configurations.
  We evaluate CART on single consumer GPUs in two stages: a 64-configuration screen at 3,000 steps, then 36 configurations (P=6, R in {6,8,10}, three seeds) trained for 30,500 steps (~1B tokens). Two patterns hold across widths d in {256,512,768,1024}: prelude depth P dominates loop count R, and the Stage-1 ranking of R reverses at full training (R=6 becomes best at d>=512). At the binding d=1024 parameter-parity test, CART does not beat a parameter-matched dense baseline, losing by 1-2% at stored-parameter parity and by ~10% at effective-parameter parity. Diagnostic ablations split the effective-parameter gap into ~5% from weight sharing and a residual ~5% from the heterogeneous prelude/anchor/core/coda framing; the recurrent-core machinery (hyper-connections, LTI gate, loop-index embedding) is individually vestigial. Variable-R inference degrades on both sides of the trained R, a negative result for test-time depth scaling under this recipe.

AI.tldr: 提出了CART（上下文锚定循环Transformer），一种参数高效的语言模型，通过复用单个共享核心块R次来节省参数。核心创新是预计算并冻结KV张量，使用LTI门保持稳定性。但在参数对等测试中未能超越密集基线，损失1-2%（存储参数对等）和约10%（有效参数对等）。
AI.motivation: 现有循环Transformer在每次迭代时都重新计算键值张量，计算效率低下。本文旨在设计一种参数高效的语言模型，通过复用共享核心块来减少参数量，同时保持模型性能和训练稳定性。
AI.method: CART采用多层前奏计算并冻结KV张量，循环核心通过多头潜在注意力机制对这些冻结张量进行交叉注意力。引入可学习的线性时不变（LTI）门来保持循环稳定性，其谱半径在所有配置中稳定在[0.79, 0.83]范围内。模型结构包括：前奏、锚定KV、循环核心、尾声。
AI.result: 在36个完整训练配置中发现：前奏深度P比循环次数R更重要；完整训练时R的排序发生反转（R=6在d≥512时最佳）。在d=1024参数对等测试中，CART未超越参数匹配的密集基线，存储参数对等损失1-2%，有效参数对等损失约10%。消融实验表明有效参数差距来自权重共享（~5%）和异构框架（~5%），循环核心机制（超连接、LTI门、循环索引嵌入）单独来看是冗余的。
AI.conclusion: CART作为一种参数高效架构，虽然实现了稳定训练，但在性能上未能超越密集基线。主要限制在于权重共享和异构结构带来的性能损失，且该方案不支持测试时的深度扩展。研究表明当前的循环核心机制设计需要重新考虑。

title: ProbMoE: Differentiable Probabilistic Routing for Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale by activating only a small subset of experts per token. However, training such models remains challenging because top-$k$ routing is discrete and non-differentiable, requiring gradient estimators for expert selection whose design remains a central open problem. We introduce ProbMoE, a probabilistic routing framework that models expert selection as a distribution over cardinality-constrained expert subsets and formulates routing as probabilistic inference in this discrete subset space. We first propose ProbMoE Exact-$k$ routing, which samples $k$-expert subsets in the forward pass, and the backward pass uses gradients through each expert's exact marginal probability as a tractable surrogate for the true gradient. ProbMoE naturally generalizes to a dynamic-$k$ routing setting, where both training and inference constrain the routing cardinality to the same predefined range, allowing adaptive expert allocation per token. Across benchmarks and model backbones, ProbMoE Exact-$k$ achieves strong performance compared to competitive baselines, with improved expert utilization and routing diversity; ProbMoE Dynamic-$k$ achieves comparable performance with fewer activated experts.

AI.tldr: 提出了ProbMoE，一种概率路由框架，将专家选择建模为受限子集分布，通过概率推理解决MoE训练中top-k路由不可微的问题，支持固定k值和动态k值两种路由设置。
AI.motivation: MoE模型的top-k路由机制是离散且不可微的，需要梯度估计器来处理专家选择，其设计仍是一个核心开放问题。
AI.method: 将专家选择建模为基数受限专家子集上的概率分布，将路由问题转化为离散子集空间的概率推理。提出ProbMoE Exact-k在前向采样k个专家子集，反向传播使用专家的精确边缘概率作为可处理的梯度替代；该方法自然扩展到Dynamic-k设置，在训练和推理中对路由基数约束相同范围。
AI.result: ProbMoE Exact-k相比竞争基线取得强劲性能，提升了专家利用率和路由多样性；ProbMoE Dynamic-k在激活更少专家的情况下达到相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: ProbMoE成功解决了MoE路由的不可微问题，提供了灵活的路由机制，在性能、专家利用率和计算效率方面取得平衡。

title: Fast Generalization after Interpolation via Critically Damped Momentum Optimization
summary: A central problem in machine learning is that models can achieve near-perfect training performance while generalizing substantially less well to unseen examples. This gap is especially acute in high-dimensional, low-sample regimes, where many interpolating solutions exist and optimization must implicitly select among minima with different generalization properties. Following recent theoretical advances on optimization dynamics near the interpolation threshold, we note that the two-regime structure of risk minimization, with loss minimization followed by complexity minimization, motivates a biphasic optimization schedule. We thus theoretically demonstrate that GROKtimizer, a biphasic strategy that combines rapid convergence to interpolation with Critically Damped Momentum (CDM)-based post-interpolation norm minimization, offers a natural solution for selecting low-norm interpolating solutions. Under a local quadratic model of the post-interpolation basin, GROKtimizer provides a quadratic speedup over classical gradient descent, with provable optimality among first-order optimizers. To showcase the applicability of our method, we evaluate GROKtimizer on several synthetic benchmarks common in the classical grokking literature and on various real-world datasets. Finally, we reconcile our findings with the flat-minima hypothesis, highlighting the importance of post-interpolation dynamics in the construction of high-quality, generalizing models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GROKtimizer，一种双阶段优化策略，通过快速收敛到插值解随后进行基于临界阻尼动量（CDM）的范数最小化，在高维低样本场景下实现了二次加速的泛化性能提升。
AI.motivation: 机器学习中模型在训练集上达到近乎完美的性能，但在未见样本上泛化能力较差，这一问题在高维低样本场景下尤为严重。存在许多插值解时，优化过程必须隐式选择具有不同泛化特性的极小值，如何选择具有良好泛化能力的低范数插值解成为核心问题。
AI.method: 提出GROKtimizer双阶段优化策略：第一阶段快速收敛到插值解，第二阶段采用基于临界阻尼动量（CDM）的插值后范数最小化。该方法利用风险最小化的双区域结构（损失最小化后接复杂度最小化），在后插值盆地局部二次模型下提供二次加速，并在一阶优化器中具有可证明的最优性。
AI.result: 在理论上证明了GROKtimizer相比经典梯度下降具有二次加速，且在一阶优化器中具有可证明的最优性。在经典grokking文献中常用的多个合成基准测试和多个真实世界数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。成功选择了低范数插值解。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明插值后动态在构建高质量泛化模型中的重要性，并与平坦极小值假设相协调，为理解优化动态与泛化能力的关系提供了新见解。双阶段优化策略为解决高维低样本场景下的泛化问题提供了有效的理论指导和实践方案。

title: Semi-Supervised Hyperbolic Hierarchical Clustering with Set-Level Structural Priors
summary: Semi-supervised hierarchical clustering aims to learn a tree structure consistent with data patterns and user-provided supervision. Supervision is usually given as leaf-level relations, such as pairwise must-link/cannot-link constraints or triplet-wise must-link-before constraints. Although useful for regulating local sample relations, such supervision does not directly indicate which samples should form coherent subtrees. Consequently, the non-leaf structure of the learned tree may deviate from the hierarchical organization preferred by ground-truth labels. To address this limitation, we propose a semi-supervised hyperbolic hierarchical clustering method with set-level structural priors. The main contribution is to introduce sets as basic modeling units for hierarchy learning. Each set denotes samples expected to cohere within a subtree and is induced from leaf-level supervision together with a learned constraint-consistent similarity structure. These sets act as soft structural priors for subtree-level supervision, allowing supervision to guide non-leaf hierarchy formation beyond local leaf-level relations. Specifically, we first learn constraint-consistent embeddings to obtain a reliable set partition, then construct constraint-induced sets and estimate inter-set similarities to form set-level structural priors. Finally, these priors are incorporated into a hyperbolic hierarchy objective for continuous tree optimization. Experiments on eleven benchmark datasets and ablation studies show that the proposed method consistently improves label consistency over representative hierarchical clustering baselines while also enhancing similarity-based tree quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于集合级结构先验的半监督双曲层次聚类方法，通过引入集合作为基本建模单元，将叶子级监督扩展到子树级监督，从而提高层次结构与真实标签的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的半监督层次聚类方法主要使用叶子级关系（如成对must-link/cannot-link约束或三联must-link-before约束）作为监督信息。虽然这些监督对调节局部样本关系有用，但它们不能直接指示哪些样本应形成连贯的子树，导致学习树的非叶子结构可能偏离真实标签所偏好的层次组织。
AI.method: 提出基于集合级结构先验的半监督双曲层次聚类方法。首先学习约束一致的嵌入以获得可靠的集合划分，然后构建约束诱导的集合并估计集合间相似性以形成集合级结构先验，最后将这些先验整合到双曲层次目标函数中进行连续树优化。集合作为基本建模单元，表示预期在子树内聚合的样本，作为子树级监督的软结构先验。
AI.result: 在十一个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在标签一致性方面始终优于代表性的层次聚类基线方法，同时也提高了基于相似性的树质量。消融研究进一步验证了各组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入集合级结构先验，该方法成功地将监督信息从叶子级关系扩展到子树级监督，能够更好地指导非叶子层次结构的形成，从而学习到与真实标签更一致的层次树结构，为半监督层次聚类提供了新的解决思路。

title: Near-Optimal Pure Machine Unlearning for Smooth Strongly Convex Losses
summary: Machine unlearning is motivated by legal and user-facing requirements to remove the influence of individuals' data from trained models, such as the right to be forgotten. Prior work has developed algorithms and error bounds for unlearning in smooth strongly convex stochastic optimization, but the fundamental statistical cost of unlearning has remained unclear. We nearly resolve this problem by proving upper and lower bounds on the excess population risk of approximate $\varepsilon$-unlearning; our bounds are tight up to a condition-number factor. For mean estimation over the unit ball, our upper and lower bounds match. The optimal rate is the usual statistical error plus an unlearning penalty that interpolates between the retraining-from-scratch rate and an exponentially smaller term as $\varepsilon/d$ grows, where $d$ is the dimension of the model. In particular, when $\varepsilon \gg d$, our $\varepsilon$-unlearning algorithm offers an exponential accuracy improvement over retraining the model from scratch and differentially private baselines. On the other hand, when $\varepsilon \le d$, retraining from scratch is optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文几乎完全解决了近似机器遗忘的基本统计代价问题，证明了超额总体风险的上界和下界在条件数因子内是紧致的。当ε≫d时，ε-遗忘算法比从头重新训练有指数级的精度提升；当ε≤d时，从头重新训练是最优的。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘的需求源于法律和用户层面的要求（如被遗忘权），需要从训练模型中移除个人数据的影响。虽然已有研究为平滑强凸随机优化中的遗忘开发了算法和误差界，但遗忘的基本统计代价仍然不清楚。
AI.method: 通过证明近似ε-遗忘的超额总体风险的上界和下界来分析遗忘的统计代价。这些界在条件数因子内是紧致的。对于单位球上的均值估计，上界和下界完全匹配。分析了遗忘惩罚如何随着ε/d的变化在重新训练率和指数更小的项之间插值。
AI.result: 最优速率是通常的统计误差加上一个遗忘惩罚项。当ε≫d（d是模型维度）时，ε-遗忘算法相比从头重新训练和差分隐私基线有指数级的精度提升。当ε≤d时，从头重新训练是最优的。上界和下界在条件数因子内紧致匹配。
AI.conclusion: 本文几乎完全解决了机器遗忘的基本统计代价问题，揭示了遗忘性能与隐私参数ε和模型维度d之间的关键关系，为实践中选择最优遗忘策略提供了理论指导：在高ε/d比时使用遗忘算法，在低ε/d比时采用重新训练。

title: Rethinking the Role of Positional Encoding: Sliding-Window Transformers without PE Remain Turing Complete
summary: Positional encoding (PE) is widely viewed as necessary for transformers to process ordered sequences: without them, the next-token map appears permutation-invariant in its context tokens. This intuition underlies all prior universality results, which rely on positional information to prove that transformers with chain-of-thought can perform arbitrary computation, i.e., they are Turing complete. We revisit this belief in the regime most relevant to long-form reasoning, where generation proceeds through a finite sliding context window. Our opening perception is that the window mechanism itself (mildly) breaks the permutation symmetry. To distill and precisely capture the degree of this added expressiveness, we introduce an abstract autoregressive model, the HIST model, in which each update depends only on constant-size internal state and the token-count histogram within the current window. We prove that this HIST model is Turing complete by showing that the evolution of the window can reveal the token that has just left the window, which suffices to simulate Turing-complete Post machines. We then construct a sliding-window transformer over a constant-size token alphabet, without PE, and show that it can simulate the HIST model. Our result demonstrates that positional encodings are not indispensable for transformers to perform universal computation: The window sliding itself already breaks permutation symmetry and captures sufficient positional information.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在滑动窗口机制下，无位置编码的Transformer仍可实现通用计算（图灵完备），颠覆了位置编码不可或缺的传统认知。
AI.motivation: 现有理论普遍认为位置编码（PE）对Transformer处理有序序列至关重要，所有先前的通用性证明都依赖位置信息。本文旨在重新审视这一观点，特别是在长形式推理中最相关的滑动上下文窗口生成场景下，探究窗口机制本身是否已打破置换对称性。
AI.method: 1. 提出HIST模型：一种抽象自回归模型，每次更新仅依赖常数大小的内部状态和当前窗口内的token计数直方图；2. 证明HIST模型图灵完备：通过展示窗口演化可揭示刚离开窗口的token，足以模拟图灵完备的Post机器；3. 构造无位置编码的滑动窗口Transformer（常数大小token字母表），证明其可模拟HIST模型。
AI.result: 成功证明无位置编码的滑动窗口Transformer能够模拟HIST模型，进而实现通用计算。窗口滑动机制本身已打破置换对称性，并捕获了足够的位置信息。
AI.conclusion: 位置编码并非Transformer实现通用计算的必要条件；滑动窗口机制本身已打破置换对称性并提供了充分的位置信息，这对理解Transformer的计算能力具有重要意义。

title: TN-SHAP-G: Graph-Structured Tensor Network Surrogates for Shapley Values and Interactions
summary: Shapley values are a widely used tool for attributing importance and interactions among input variables in black-box models, but their computation involves a function defined over an exponentially large space of subsets. We propose TN-SHAP-G, a framework that exploits structure in graph-structured inputs to compute Shapley values and higher-order interaction indices efficiently. Given a predictor and a fixed masking scheme, TN-SHAP-G learns a compact, graph-aligned multilinear surrogate that approximates the masked-input behavior, represented as a tensor network whose topology mirrors the input graph. Once trained from a small number of oracle queries, the surrogate enables deterministic recovery of first- and higher-order Shapley indices via the multilinear extension, without additional model queries or Monte Carlo variance. Experiments on molecular benchmarks show that the learned factorization closely matches exact Shapley values on small graphs and scales efficiently to larger graphs where sampling-based methods become infeasible.

AI.tldr: 提出了TN-SHAP-G框架，通过学习与输入图结构对齐的张量网络代理模型，实现了图结构输入中Shapley值和高阶交互指数的高效精确计算。
AI.motivation: Shapley值是黑盒模型中归因变量重要性和交互作用的广泛使用工具，但其计算需要在指数级大的子集空间上进行函数求值，导致计算复杂度极高。现有的采样方法存在方差问题，且在大规模图上难以应用。
AI.method: 提出TN-SHAP-G框架：给定预测器和固定掩码方案，学习一个紧凑的、与图对齐的多线性代理模型，表示为拓扑结构与输入图镜像对应的张量网络。训练完成后，通过多线性扩展确定性地恢复一阶和高阶Shapley指数，无需额外的模型查询或蒙特卡洛采样。
AI.result: 在分子基准测试上的实验表明，学习到的因子化模型在小图上与精确Shapley值高度吻合，并能高效扩展到更大的图结构，而此时基于采样的方法已不可行。
AI.conclusion: TN-SHAP-G成功利用图结构输入的拓扑信息构建张量网络代理，在保证计算精度的同时显著提高了Shapley值计算的可扩展性，为复杂图结构模型的可解释性分析提供了有效的解决方案。

title: CRePE: Convolution-aware Relative Importance in Post-training Pruning with Efficient Search
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in practice incurs substantial memory and computational costs. Post-training pruning (PTP) is an effective approach to reducing these costs by removing weights without additional training. Among existing methods, RIA introduces relative importance scores normalized by row and column sums, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy. However, RIA considers only 1D cross-shaped (row/column) directional information and assigns equal weight to row and column contributions. In this paper, we propose \textbf{CRePE}, which incorporates 2D local neighborhood context and adaptive coefficients into Relative Importance scoring. CRePE consistently outperforms existing PTP methods across diverse models and sparsity settings. However, identifying optimal adaptive coefficients via perplexity (PPL)-based hill climbing requires numerous PPL evaluations and approximately 11 hours of search time. To address this, we propose \textbf{PHO} (Proxy-based Hyperparameter Optimization), which eliminates the need for repeated PPL measurements and reduces the search time to approximately 20 minutes. Furthermore, the optimal hyperparameter configuration found by PHO on one model transfers well to other models, demonstrating strong generalization. Finally, we verify that CRePE can be orthogonally combined with existing techniques including Channel Permutation, non-uniform sparsity allocation, and re-pruning methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRePE方法，通过引入2D局部邻域上下文和自适应系数改进相对重要性评分，显著提升LLM剪枝性能；同时提出PHO方法将超参数搜索时间从11小时缩短至20分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练剪枝方法RIA仅考虑1D十字形（行/列）方向信息，且对行和列贡献赋予相同权重，存在信息利用不充分和权重分配不灵活的局限性。需要更精细的重要性评估方法来提升剪枝效果。
AI.method: 1) CRePE：在相对重要性评分中引入2D局部邻域上下文和自适应系数；2) PHO：基于代理的超参数优化方法，避免重复的困惑度(PPL)测量；3) 验证CRePE与通道置换、非均匀稀疏度分配、重剪枝等现有技术的正交组合能力。
AI.result: CRePE在不同模型和稀疏度设置下持续优于现有PTP方法；PHO将超参数搜索时间从约11小时缩短至约20分钟；PHO在某一模型上找到的最优超参数配置能良好迁移至其他模型，展现强泛化能力；CRePE可与多种现有技术有效组合。
AI.conclusion: CRePE通过更全面的信息利用和自适应权重机制提升了后训练剪枝性能，PHO实现了高效的超参数优化，两者结合为LLM部署成本降低提供了实用有效的解决方案，具有良好的通用性和可扩展性。

title: Flexible Online Representation Learning Based on Similarity Matching
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Originally accepted to IJCNN 2023 but not presented owing to visa issues
summary: Sparse high-dimensional representations are conducive to uncovering nontrivial structures in unsupervised exploration of data. Such a representation can deal with the dense connectivity in graphs relevant to community detection problems. However, sparse high-dimensional representations are capable of doing more, including manifold tiling and feature learning. Conventional algorithms optimize in the space of computationally intractable completely positive matrices or relax the problem to the space of doubly nonnegative matrices that scale with sample size in a way rendering them impractical for large data sets. Some of these methods also impose a row sum constraint, such as double stochasticity. Row sum constraints have the added advantage of being shift-invariant, in the context of manifold tiling. Constraints on the row sum of output similarity matrices require nontrivial online learning rules. Addressing these needs, we propose a versatile online biologically plausible learning algorithm capable of learning sparse shift-invariant representations, useful for clustering, manifold tiling, or sparse coding, depending on the data structure.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通用的在线生物学合理学习算法，用于学习稀疏平移不变表示，适用于聚类、流形铺砌或稀疏编码。
AI.motivation: 稀疏高维表示有助于无监督数据探索中发现非平凡结构，包括社区检测、流形铺砌和特征学习。现有方法在完全正矩阵空间优化计算困难，或松弛到双非负矩阵空间但随样本规模扩展导致难以处理大规模数据集。此外，行和约束（如双随机性）具有平移不变性的优势，但需要对输出相似矩阵行和施加约束，这需要非平凡的在线学习规则。
AI.method: 提出一种通用的在线生物学合理学习算法，能够学习稀疏平移不变表示。该方法根据数据结构的不同，可灵活应用于聚类、流形铺砌或稀疏编码任务。
AI.result: 该算法能够有效学习稀疏平移不变表示，根据数据结构的不同可适用于聚类、流形铺砌或稀疏编码。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的在线生物学合理学习算法成功解决了现有方法在大规模数据集上的可扩展性问题，同时实现了稀疏平移不变表示的学习，具有广泛的应用潜力。

title: Everywhere Learning: Artificial Intelligence with Pointwise Constraints
summary: Everywhere learning is a new paradigm whereby Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are trained to satisfy loss constraints with probability one over the data distribution. This is in contrast to the standard paradigm of training AI systems to minimize average losses. We develop an approximate duality theory to substantiate a generalization analysis that establishes the proximity between solutions of empirical and statistical everywhere learning problems. Our results show that dual variables reweigh the data distribution towards points in which loss constraints are more difficult to satisfy and that generalization is controlled by the mismatch between the concentration of mass of the data distribution and the concentration of mass on points where constraints are more difficult to satisfy. We further show that we can control generalization with a sparse L1 penalty on constraint relaxations. We illustrate the merits of everywhere learning with an experiment in agentic classification for language model tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型AI学习范式——“处处学习”，其通过概率1满足损失约束来替代传统的平均损失最小化，并利用近似对偶理论分析了其泛化性能，同时指出通过稀疏L1惩罚可有效控制泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统AI训练范式通过最小化平均损失进行优化，而在某些高风险或安全关键的应用中，需要以高概率（概率为1）满足特定的损失约束。针对这一需求，作者提出“处处学习”范式，以确保模型在数据分布上几乎处处满足约束。
AI.method: 作者发展了近似对偶理论，用于建立经验处处学习问题与统计处处学习问题解之间接近程度的泛化分析。该方法引入对偶变量对数据分布进行重新加权，重点关注约束难以满足的数据点；同时，通过在约束松弛上施加稀疏L1惩罚来控制泛化性能。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，对偶变量会重新加权数据分布，使其更关注约束难以满足的数据点；泛化性能由数据分布质量集中度与约束难点质量集中度之间的不匹配程度所控制；施加稀疏L1惩罚能够有效控制泛化误差。实验在语言模型任务的代理分类中验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 处处学习范式为需要高可靠性约束的AI系统提供了新的理论基础和实践路径。通过对偶理论分析与稀疏L1正则化，可以在理论上保障泛化性能，并在实验中展示了其在语言模型代理任务中的优势。

title: GJDNet: Robust Graph Neural Networks via Joint Disentangled Learning Against Adversarial Attacks
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, which inherently invert connectivity patterns by introducing disassortative edges in assortative graphs and assortative edges in disassortative graphs. This structural inversion creates structure-feature mismatches that disrupt neighborhood aggregation across different graph types. However, we find that existing defenses are limited, as they either treat neighborhoods as monolithic under fixed assortativity assumptions or rely on standard softmax classifiers that fail to account for perturbation-induced representation shifts. To further exploit this observation, we adopt a robustness perspective that jointly disentangles node representations and decision spaces, isolating perturbation effects while enforcing well-separated decision regions. Based on this principle, we propose Graph Joint Disentanglement Network (GJDNet), a unified framework for robust node classification across diverse graph assortativity regimes. GJDNet enhances robustness at both representation and decision levels: it employs feature-driven soft structural disentanglement with skewness-aware neighbor filtering to suppress perturbation-induced structure-feature mismatches, and introduces a Spherical Decision Boundary (SDB) to promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation in the embedding space, thereby stabilizing decision boundaries under perturbations. Theoretical analysis provides insights into the effectiveness of the proposed disentangled representation and decision mechanisms, while extensive experiments demonstrate that GJDNet consistently achieves strong robustness across graphs with different connectivity regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出GJDNet框架，通过解耦节点表示与决策空间来防御图神经网络的对抗攻击，在表示层面使用特征驱动的软结构解耦和偏度感知邻居过滤，在决策层面引入球形决策边界，实现跨不同图同质性机制的鲁棒节点分类。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络易受对抗攻击，攻击通过在同配图中引入异配边、在异配图中引入同配边来翻转连接模式，造成结构-特征不匹配从而破坏邻域聚合。现有防御方法存在局限：要么在同质性假设下将邻域视为单一整体，要么依赖标准softmax分类器无法处理扰动引起的表示偏移。
AI.method: 提出图联合解耦网络(GJDNet)统一框架，在表示层面采用特征驱动的软结构解耦与偏度感知邻居过滤来抑制扰动引起的结构-特征不匹配；在决策层面引入球形决策边界(SDB)促进嵌入空间中的类内紧凑性和类间分离性，从而稳定扰动下的决策边界。该框架联合解耦节点表示与决策空间，隔离扰动影响的同时强制执行分离良好的决策区域。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了解耦表示与决策机制的有效性；大量实验表明GJDNet在不同连接模式的图上均能持续实现强鲁棒性，验证了该方法在多样化图同质性机制下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GJDNet成功从鲁棒性视角联合解耦节点表示和决策空间，在表示层面和决策层面同时增强鲁棒性，为跨不同图同质性机制的鲁棒节点分类提供了有效解决方案，理论分析与实验结果均支持该方法的有效性。

title: MomentKV: Closing the Directional Gap in KV Cache Eviction for Long-Context Inference
summary: Autoregressive decoding in Transformer-based language models relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length and becomes the primary bottleneck for long-context inference. KV cache eviction addresses this by retaining a fixed-size subset of key-value pairs and discarding the rest. We identify that a primary source of output degradation is not the residual attention mass on evicted tokens, which existing methods already minimize, but a directional mismatch between the retained and evicted token sets. Specifically, the evicted tokens in practice are often near-orthogonal to the retained ones. Thus, even a small evicted mass could have an oversized impact on the resulting direction distribution and amplify into substantial output error. This reveals a fundamental limit in existing strategies. To address this, we propose MomentKV, which maintains compact, small-size moment statistics over the evicted token set, including a count, key mean, value mean, and value-key covariance. During eviction, the moment statistics is leveraged to identify tokens already well aligned with and captured by the accumulated summary, keeping the evicted set geometrically regular. During inference, they yield a closed-form first-order approximation of the evicted attention output, forming a mutually reinforcing loop between selective eviction and accurate correction. On LongBench and RULER with LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Instruct, MomentKV outperforms all baselines at every cache budget, with the largest gains under aggressive compression.

AI.tldr: MomentKV提出通过维护轻量级矩统计量来解决KV缓存淘汰中的方向不匹配问题，在保持几何正则性的同时实现高精度的一阶近似校正，在长文本推理任务中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存淘汰方法主要关注最小化被淘汰token的残差注意力质量，但作者发现输出退化的主要来源是被保留token集与被淘汰token集之间的方向不匹配。被淘汰token通常与保留token近乎正交，即使很小的淘汰质量也会对结果方向分布产生过大影响，从而导致显著的输出误差。
AI.method: 提出MomentKV方法，维护紧凑的矩统计量（包括计数、键均值、值均值和值-键协方差）来总结被淘汰token集。在淘汰阶段，利用矩统计量识别已被累积摘要良好捕获的token，保持被淘汰集的几何正则性；在推理阶段，通过闭式一阶近似计算被淘汰注意力的输出，形成选择性淘汰与精确校正之间的相互增强循环。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER基准测试上，使用LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct模型，MomentKV在所有缓存预算设置下均优于所有基线方法，在激进压缩场景下获得最大性能提升。
AI.conclusion: MomentKV通过矩统计量有效解决了KV缓存淘汰中的方向不匹配问题，实现了淘汰策略与校正机制的协同优化，为长上下文推理提供了更高效的内存解决方案，特别是在低缓存预算场景下优势显著。

title: RobustModelMaker: Coupling Bootstrap Stability Selection with Leakage-Safe Nested Cross-Validation for Scientific Machine Learning
summary: Small-to-medium scientific datasets place machine learning pipelines under two compounding pressures. Single-run feature selection produces feature sets that change substantially under small perturbations of the training data, and any procedure that uses the same data for selection, tuning, and evaluation produces optimistically biased performance estimates. The two failure modes are routinely treated as separable, but in the regimes where scientific data live, they interact: an unstable selection inflates the variance of an already-optimistic score, and standard remedies for one rarely address the other. RobustModelMaker is a Python framework that couples bootstrap stability selection with strict nested cross-validation, performs all preprocessing and selection inside each fold, and produces a stability-tested feature subset together with a leakage-safe performance estimate. The framework supports nine algorithms across binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression. Behaviour is verified by a deterministic test suite spanning unit, performance, and reproducibility checks on three real scientific datasets comparing to three alternative selectors (ANOVA F-test, recursive feature elimination with cross-validation, and Boruta) on both predictive score and a Jaccard measure of selection stability. RobustModelMaker is competitive in score with the best alternative selector on each dataset, and occupies a position on the joint score-stability frontier that none of the alternatives match across all three task types. Two example applications, ovarian cancer biomarker discovery from the PLCO Trial and critical-temperature regression on the UCI Superconductivity Data, illustrate how the framework is used in practice and what trade-offs become visible when stability is treated as a first-class deliverable rather than an emergent property.

AI.tldr: RobustModelMaker是一个Python框架，通过结合引导稳定性选择和严格嵌套交叉验证，解决了中小型科学数据集中特征选择不稳定和性能评估偏差的问题，在预测性能和特征选择稳定性之间实现了最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 中小型科学数据集上的机器学习流程面临两个相互作用的挑战：1）特征选择在训练数据小扰动下变化剧烈，稳定性差；2）同一数据集用于选择、调优和评估会导致性能估计偏乐观。现有方法通常将这两个问题分开处理，但在科学数据场景下它们相互影响——不稳定的选择会放大已经偏乐观的分数方差，而对单一问题的补救措施很少能同时解决另一个问题。
AI.method: 提出了RobustModelMaker框架，核心方法包括：1）将引导稳定性选择与严格嵌套交叉验证相结合；2）在每个交叉验证折叠内部执行所有预处理和特征选择操作，防止数据泄露；3）生成经过稳定性测试的特征子集和无泄露的性能估计。框架支持9种算法，涵盖二分类、多分类和回归任务，并通过确定性测试套件验证了其性能。
AI.result: 在三个真实科学数据集上与三种替代选择器（ANOVA F检验、递归特征消除和Boruta）进行比较，结果显示：RobustModelMaker在每个数据集上的预测分数与最佳替代选择器相当，在预测分数-稳定性的联合前沿上达到了其他方法无法匹敌的位置。在卵巢癌生物标志物发现和超导临界温度回归两个实际应用中验证了框架的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 当将稳定性视为一等交付成果而非涌现属性时，RobustModelMaker框架能够有效平衡预测性能和特征选择稳定性，为科学数据集上的机器学习应用提供了更可靠的解决方案，揭示了稳定性与性能之间的权衡关系。

title: Uncertainty-Calibrated Diffusion for Reliable 3D Molecular Graph Generation
summary: Bayesian inference provides a principled framework for modeling epistemic uncertainty in neural networks by treating predictions as distributions rather than deterministic values. Meanwhile, diffusion-based models for 3D molecular graph generation operate on fragile geometric structures governed by strict chemical constraints, making inference highly sensitive to uncertainty miscalibration. A largely overlooked issue is that epistemic uncertainty arising from the learned denoiser interacts with the aleatoric uncertainty intentionally injected during reverse diffusion, leading to systematic variance inflation and a mismatch between the true distribution and the simulated distribution. This effect is particularly detrimental for high-precision molecular generation, where even small deviations can violate chemical validity. In this work, we provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of how epistemic uncertainty propagates through diffusion inference and degrades sampling quality. Building on this investigation, we propose UCD (Uncertainty-Calibrated Diffusion), a simple yet effective method that calibrates the reverse diffusion process to account for epistemic uncertainty. Extensive experiments on standard 3D molecular benchmarks demonstrate that UCD consistently improves sampling quality across diverse baseline methods, establishing new state-of-the-art performance for 3D molecular diffusion. The code is available at https://github.com/jiuguaiwf/UCD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UCD方法，通过校准逆向扩散过程中的认知不确定性，解决了3D分子图生成中因不确定性失准导致的采样质量下降问题，实现了新的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 在3D分子图生成的扩散模型中，去噪器产生的认知不确定性与逆向扩散中注入的偶然不确定性相互作用，导致系统性方差膨胀和分布失配。这一问题在需要高精度的分子生成任务中尤为严重，因为微小偏差即可破坏化学有效性，但现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.method: 首先从理论和实证角度分析了认知不确定性如何在扩散推理过程中传播并降低采样质量。基于此分析，提出了UCD（Uncertainty-Calibrated Diffusion）方法，通过校准逆向扩散过程来考虑认知不确定性。
AI.result: 在标准3D分子基准测试上的大量实验表明，UCD在多种基线方法上持续改善采样质量，建立了3D分子扩散模型的新SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了认知不确定性对扩散模型推理的重要影响，提供的理论分析和实证研究为未来研究提供了基础，提出的UCD方法简单有效，能显著提升3D分子生成的质量和可靠性。

title: Estimating Mutual Information between Time Series and Temporal Event Sequences Across Diverse Analysis Tasks
summary: Pairwise dependence measures such as correlation and causality are fundamental to temporal data mining, yet there is still no principled and robust way to quantify dependence between heterogeneous data types, especially between continuous time series and discrete temporal event sequences. Existing approaches rely on ad hoc transformations or mutual-information estimators that are highly sensitive to quantization, repeated values, and event redundancy, leading to biased or unstable results in practice. We propose a nonparametric mutual information estimator that directly measures the dependence between time series and event sequences without data transformation, learning, or ad hoc discretization. Our method models the continuous-discrete duality of real-world time series to handle quantization and repeated-value artifacts and introduces a latent event clustering strategy to mitigate bias from event co-occurrence and redundancy. Together, these yield a robust and unified framework that bridges discrete and continuous mutual information. We evaluate the proposed estimator on four representative tasks: discrete-continuous time-delayed mutual information for causality analysis, global and local temporal repetition discovery, discrete covariate selection for time series forecasting, and continuous feature selection for classification. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show consistent improvements over existing methods in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability, positioning our approach as a general-purpose dependence operator for heterogeneous temporal data, similar to Pearson correlation for homogeneous time series. Code available at: https://github.com/HaojiHu/Multimodal-Temporal-Data-Quantification

AI.tldr: 提出了一种非参数互信息估计器，直接测量连续时间序列与离散事件序列之间的依赖关系，无需数据变换或离散化，在多个任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在量化连续时间序列与离散事件序列之间的依赖关系时，依赖临时变换或互信息估计器，对量化、重复值和事件冗余高度敏感，导致实际应用中出现偏差或不稳定的结果。
AI.method: 提出一种非参数互信息估计器，通过建模现实时间序列的连续-离散二重性来处理量化和重复值伪影，并引入潜在事件聚类策略来减轻事件共现和冗余引起的偏差，构建了统一框架。
AI.result: 在四个代表性任务（离散-连续时滞互信息因果分析、全局和局部时间重复发现、时间序列预测的离散协变量选择、分类的连续特征选择）上，使用合成和真实数据集进行实验，在准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性方面均一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为异构时间数据提供了一种通用的依赖性算子，类似于同构时间序列的皮尔逊相关，能够稳健地量化连续时间序列与离散事件序列之间的依赖关系。

title: FedMTFI: Feature Importance Based Optimized Multi Teacher Knowledge Distillation in Heterogeneous Federated Learning Environment
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a decentralized approach that enables collaborative model training without exposing raw data. Instead of transferring sensitive data, it allows devices to share only model weights, keeping personal data locally and secure. However, in real world settings, the data held by devices is often not evenly distributed and devices mostly differ in computing power and memory capacity. These differences make FL harder to maintain consistent performance across the system. To address these issues, we propose FedMTFI, a novel architecture that combines multi-teacher knowledge distillation (MTKD) with feature importance to improve the FL process in heterogeneous environments. In FedMTFI, clients are clustered based on similar hardware and model types. Each cluster trains a specific model on not independently and identically distributed (non-IID) data. Within a cluster, every client updates that model using only its own local private data. The server then aggregates the locally trained models in each cluster using FedAvg to form multiple prototype models. Then these prototypes serve as teacher models to train a global generalized student model using MTKD. What makes FedMTFI more unique is the integration of Shapley values (SHAP) to emphasize important features during distillation, which enhances both accuracy and interpretability. Experimental results show that FedMTFI achieves higher accuracy than traditional FL algorithms and performs more effectively under non-IID data conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FedMTFI框架，通过结合多教师知识蒸馏和特征重要性分析（SHAP），有效解决了联邦学习在异构环境下的性能问题，在非独立同分布数据条件下实现了更高的准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在实际应用中面临两大挑战：一是设备间数据分布不均匀（非独立同分布），二是设备的计算能力和内存容量存在差异。这些异构性问题使得联邦学习难以在系统中保持一致的性能，需要一种能够适应异构环境的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出FedMTFI架构，该方法包含以下关键步骤：（1）根据硬件和模型类型的相似性对客户端进行聚类；（2）每个聚类在非独立同分布数据上训练特定的模型，客户端仅使用本地私有数据更新模型；（3）服务器使用FedAvg聚合每个聚类中的本地训练模型，形成多个原型模型；（4）将这些原型作为教师模型，使用多教师知识蒸馏（MTKD）训练全局泛化的学生模型；（5）创新性地整合Shapley值（SHAP）来强调蒸馏过程中的重要特征，提升准确性和可解释性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FedMTFI相比传统联邦学习算法实现了更高的准确率，并且在非独立同分布数据条件下表现更加有效，证明了该方法在异构环境下的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: FedMTFI成功地将多教师知识蒸馏与特征重要性分析相结合，为联邦学习在异构环境下的应用提供了有效的解决方案，不仅提高了模型准确性，还增强了模型的可解释性，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: IMWM: Intuition Models Complement World Models for Latent Planning
summary: Planning with a learned latent world model is a promising route to control from raw pixels, but a strong world model alone is not enough. We show this experimentally: even with a perfect world model (operationalized by replacing the learned forward predictor with an idealized rollout of the true environment dynamics), a finite-budget sample-based planner still fails on some tasks, indicating that the bottleneck can lie in search rather than in world-model accuracy. Motivated by this gap, we propose IMWM (Intuition Model + World Model), which pairs the world model with an intuition model trained from demonstrations to recognize promising actions. The two models collaborate through three lightweight components: (i) Retrieval Initialization, which initializes the planner's action proposal from a retrieved demonstration; (ii) Hybrid Cost, which combines the intuition score with the world-model rollout cost; and (iii) a Reliability Gate, which adjusts how much the planner trusts intuition in each setting. Across four pixel-based goal-reaching tasks (Two-Room, Reacher, Push-T, and OGBench-Cube), IMWM has higher mean success than the world-model-only planner on all four, with the largest gains on Two-Room (99.2%, +11.5 percentage points) and OGBench-Cube (94.7%, +28.5 percentage points).

AI.tldr: 本文发现即使拥有完美的世界模型，有限预算的采样规划器仍会失败，瓶颈在于搜索过程而非模型准确性。提出IMWM方法，将世界模型与从演示中学习的直觉模型配对，通过检索初始化、混合成本和可靠性门控三个组件实现模型协作，在四个像素目标任务上显著提升了成功率。
AI.motivation: 研究人员发现，在基于像素的强化学习控制任务中，即使使用完美世界模型（用真实环境动力学替代学习的前向预测器），有限预算的采样规划器仍会在某些任务上失败。这表明系统瓶颈在于搜索过程而非世界模型的准确性，从而激励了改进搜索过程的研究。
AI.method: 提出IMWM（Intuition Model + World Model）框架，将世界模型与从演示中学习的直觉模型配对。包含三个轻量级组件：（i）检索初始化：从检索的演示中初始化规划器的动作提议；（ii）混合成本：将直觉分数与世界模型滚动成本结合；（iii）可靠性门控：调整规划器在每个设置中对直觉的信任程度。
AI.result: 在四个基于像素的目标达成任务（Two-Room、Reacher、Push-T和OGBench-Cube）上，IMWM在所有任务上的平均成功率均高于仅使用世界模型的规划器。其中Two-Room提升最大（99.2%，+11.5个百分点），OGBench-Cube提升最显著（94.7%，+28.5个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 证明了世界模型准确性不是规划成功的唯一决定因素，搜索过程的质量同样关键。通过将直觉模型与世界模型结合，可以有效引导采样规划器关注有希望的动作空间区域，显著提升规划性能，特别是在复杂任务上效果更为突出。

title: E4GEN: Event-level Explainable Extreme-Enhanced Time-series Generation
summary: Generating realistic time series is essential for scientific research and real-world applications. However, existing methods often emphasize overall distributional fidelity while failing to faithfully capture extreme events. To advance existing research, we propose E4GEN, an explainable diffusion framework for extreme event-aware time-series generation. E4GEN provides systematic insights into when, what, and how to control extreme-event generation through three key components. First, E-Activator learns the dataset-adaptive extreme-control signal activation step during the denoising process without interfering with regular temporal components, including trend and seasonality. Second, E-Predictor determines what control signal to enforce through Self-Driven Semantic Prediction, where each sample derives its own control signal by inferring latent extreme-event information during generation. It also includes a novel Data-Conditioned Training, Noise-Initiated Sampling mechanism to address the issue of unavailable training labels. Third, E-Control specifies how to control extreme-event generation through a trainable Extreme Control Network, which transforms the semantic control signal into layer-wise signals and injects it into the denoising process. We evaluate E4GEN on six datasets with 17 metrics, and extensive experiments show that E4GEN outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple dimensions, including overall fidelity, extreme-event fidelity, and downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了E4GEN，一个可解释的扩散模型框架，用于生成具有极端事件感知能力的时间序列数据，解决了现有方法无法忠实捕捉极端事件的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列生成方法通常强调整体分布保真度，但无法忠实捕捉极端事件，而这些极端事件对科学研究和实际应用至关重要。
AI.method: E4GEN包含三个核心组件：1) E-Activator学习数据集自适应的极端控制信号激活步骤，在不干扰常规时间成分（趋势和季节性）的情况下工作；2) E-Predictor通过自驱动语义预测确定控制信号内容，采用数据条件训练和噪声初始化采样机制解决训练标签不可用的问题；3) E-Control通过可训练的极端控制网络将语义控制信号转换为层级信号并注入去噪过程。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上使用17个指标进行评估，实验结果表明E4GEN在整体保真度、极端事件保真度和下游效用等多个维度上均优于最先进的模型。
AI.conclusion: E4GEN成功实现了对极端事件生成的系统性控制（何时、什么、如何控制），为时间序列生成领域提供了一个能够同时保证整体质量和极端事件保真度的有效解决方案。

title: Gate the Filter, Not the Message: Node-Channel Mixtures for Pre-Propagation GNNs
summary: Pre-propagation graph neural networks (PPGNNs) push all graph-dependent computation into a preprocessing step and train only on the resulting dense hop features, which makes them highly scalable. A puzzle in this regime is that more complex hop aggregators do not reliably outperform simpler ones: on many benchmarks, a plain MLP-based aggregator matches or beats hop-attention variants. We revisit this behavior from a graph-filter perspective. Over a precomputed diffusion basis, existing PPGNNs differ mainly in how filter coefficients are shared across nodes and feature channels, rather than simply in raw aggregator capacity. MLP-based architectures learn channel-dependent filters that are largely shared across nodes, while hop-attention-based architectures learn node-dependent mixtures that are largely shared across channels. This reveals a missing regime in standard PPGNN designs: joint node- and channel-adaptive filtering under the pre-propagation computational contract. We propose FilterMoE, a mixture-of-experts PPGNN in which a small bank of learnable Chebyshev filter experts is routed jointly over nodes and channels by a 3D gating tensor. Across eleven homophilic and heterophilic benchmarks, FilterMoE outperforms strong PPGNN baselines on nine datasets and ranks first on all three large-scale benchmarks, improving the average test score by 1.53 points. These results establish joint node-channel filter routing as a robust alternative to dataset-specific hop-aggregator selection.

AI.tldr: 本文发现现有预传播图神经网络(PPGNN)在节点和通道自适应滤波方面存在不足，提出了基于专家混合的FilterMoE模型，通过联合节点和通道的滤波器路由机制，在11个基准数据集中的9个上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有PPGNN方法中，复杂的hop聚合器并不总能超越简单方法，MLP聚合器常与hop-attention变体性能相当甚至更优。从图滤波视角分析发现，现有PPGNN主要在滤波系数如何在节点和特征通道间共享上存在差异，而非简单的聚合器容量差异。MLP学习跨节点共享的通道相关滤波器，hop-attention学习跨通道共享的节点相关混合，缺乏联合节点和通道自适应滤波机制。
AI.method: 提出FilterMoE，一种专家混合(MoE)预传播图神经网络。方法的核心是设计一个小型可学习Chebyshev滤波器专家库，通过3D门控张量在节点和通道维度上进行联合路由。该架构在预传播计算约束下实现了联合节点-通道自适应滤波。
AI.result: 在11个同质性和异质性基准数据集上，FilterMoE在9个数据集上超越了强大的PPGNN基线方法，在所有三个大规模基准数据集上排名第一，平均测试分数提升1.53个点。
AI.conclusion: 联合节点-通道滤波器路由是一种稳健的方法，可替代针对特定数据集选择hop聚合器的传统做法，为PPGNN设计提供了新的方向。

title: Quantifying the Energy Floor: Direct Measurement and Replay Buffer Bias in SAC-Based HVAC Control on sbsim
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Presented at AI-DEEDS 2026 Workshop, ACM Sustainability Week, Banff, Canada (non-archival)
summary: We quantify the energy floor -- the minimum achievable cost given action space constraints -- for Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) HVAC control on the sbsim calibrated building simulator. Through minimum-action experiments, we directly measure this floor at USD 35.51/day, dominated by continuous electrical loads (USD 35.44, 99.8%) with negligible gas consumption. The standard SAC baseline, initialized with schedule-policy replay buffer transitions, converges to USD 37.18/day, 4.7% above the floor. We identify buffer initialization as the dominant source of sub-optimality in this scenario: training from an empty buffer reduces cost to USD 35.57/day, eliminating 96% of the gap. Expanding the supply water temperature range by 10 K yields negligible additional savings (USD 0.03/day), and further expansion triggers physical constraint violations. We additionally uncover a discount factor coupling (gamma_eff = 0.891) shrinking the effective planning horizon from 8.3 h to 46 min -- a benchmark-wide issue warranting audit. Systematic ablation across planning horizon, reward weights, and observation enrichment confirms all pre-filled-buffer configurations cluster within 0.7% (USD 37.18--USD 37.42), demonstrating that equipment minimum power -- not algorithmic design -- imposes the binding constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了SAC建筑能耗控制的性能极限（USD 35.51/天），发现经验回放缓冲区初始化是次优性的主要来源；使用空缓冲区训练可消除96%的性能差距。设备最小功率而非算法设计是最终瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 量化软演员-评论家（SAC）算法在HVAC控制任务中的能耗下限（energy floor），识别阻碍算法达到最优性能的主要因素，为强化学习在建筑能源管理中的实际应用提供理论边界和改进方向。
AI.method: 在sbsim校准建筑模拟器上，通过最小动作实验直接测量能耗下限；对比标准SAC基线（使用调度策略回放缓冲区初始化）与空缓冲区初始化的性能差异；系统性地消融实验分析规划时域、奖励权重、观测丰富度等因素；发现并分析折扣因子耦合问题。
AI.result: 能耗下限为USD 35.51/天，其中99.8%来自持续电力负荷。标准SAC基线收敛至USD 37.18/天（比下限高4.7%）。空缓冲区训练将成本降至USD 35.57/天，消除96%差距。扩大供水温度范围仅节省USD 0.03/天。发现折扣因子耦合（γ_eff=0.891）将有效规划时域从8.3小时缩短至46分钟。所有预填充缓冲区配置性能差异在0.7%以内。
AI.conclusion: 经验回放缓冲区初始化是HVAC控制场景中次优性的主导来源。设备最小功率限制——而非算法设计——构成了性能的最终约束。折扣因子耦合问题是基准测试范围的系统性问题，值得进一步审计。研究结果为SAC在实际建筑控制中的应用提供了明确的性能边界和优化方向。

title: DOT-MoE: Differentiable Optimal Transport for MoEfication
summary: The scaling of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven significant performance gains but created substantial challenges in inference efficiency. While Mixture of Experts (MoEs) architectures address this by decoupling model size from inference cost, training MoEs from scratch is often unstable and compute intensive. Conversion of pre-trained dense models into sparse MoEs has emerged as an alternative solution; however, existing methods typically rely on heuristic neuron clustering or random splitting to partition the Feed-Forward Network (FFN) into experts. In this work, we propose DOT-MoE, a novel framework that formulates the decomposition of dense layers as a Differentiable Optimal Transport (DOT) problem. Instead of static heuristics, we model neuron assignment as a balanced transport problem, utilizing differentiable Sinkhorn-Knopp iterations to enforce strict expert capacity constraints. Furthermore, we utilize Straight-Through Estimators (STE) to jointly learn the discrete neuron-to-expert assignment and the token-to-expert routing policy end-to-end. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures and benchmarks demonstrate that DOT-MoE significantly outperforms structured pruning, heuristic clustering, and random-split baselines, retaining 90% of the original dense model's performance while reducing active parameters by 50%.

AI.tldr: 提出DOT-MoE框架，通过可微最优传输问题将预训练稠密模型转换为稀疏MoE架构，在减少50%激活参数的同时保留90%原始性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型规模扩展带来显著的推理效率挑战。虽然MoE架构通过解耦模型规模与推理成本缓解了该问题，但从零训练MoE不稳定且计算密集。现有的将稠密模型转换为稀疏MoE的方法依赖于启发式神经元聚类或随机分割来划分FFN，缺乏理论指导且效果有限。
AI.method: 提出DOT-MoE框架，将稠密层分解建模为可微最优传输问题。使用可微Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代来强制执行严格的专家容量约束，而非依赖静态启发式方法。通过直通估计器（STE）端到端联合学习离散神经元-专家分配和令牌-专家路由策略。
AI.result: 在多个架构和基准测试上的广泛实验表明，DOT-MoE显著优于结构化剪枝、启发式聚类和随机分割基线方法。该方法在减少50%激活参数的同时，保留了原始稠密模型90%的性能。
AI.conclusion: DOT-MoE通过将神经元分配建模为平衡传输问题，成功实现了预训练稠密模型向稀疏MoE架构的高效转换，为解决LLM推理效率问题提供了有效的解决方案。

title: ATLAS: Agentic Test-time Learning-to-Allocate Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling has become a major way to improve large language model reasoning, but its orchestration has remained designer-engineered: a fixed sample budget, a fixed refinement loop, a fixed scoring rule, or a fixed search policy decides how compute is spent, leaving the model in charge of solving but not of orchestration. We introduce ATLAS, an agentic test-time scaling framework in which an LLM orchestrator owns the control loop end-to-end. Through a single action, explore, which dispatches a fresh independent solver on the original problem, the orchestrator decides whether to gather more evidence, when to stop, and how to synthesize the final answer; the action space is extensible, with each explore call optionally specifying solver, reasoning effort, or prompting strategy. We evaluate ATLAS on four benchmarks covering scientific question answering, code generation, and multimodal reasoning under a Claude Sonnet 4.6 backbone, where it reaches 56.00% on HLE-Verified, 82.29% on LiveCodeBench, 85.75% on GPQA-Diamond, and 23.71% on BabyVision while using far fewer API calls than fixed-workflow baselines. A multi-model extension, ATLAS-MM, that exposes solver choice as an additional action dimension further improves HLE-Verified to 60.00% and LiveCodeBench to 85.63%, with consistent gains on GPQA-Diamond and BabyVision. Ablations replacing the orchestrator's direct synthesis with a separate integrator degrade or fail to improve accuracy on three of four benchmarks, consistent with the role of stateful evidence management in producing the gains.

AI.tldr: ATLAS框架让LLM自主编排测试时扩展过程，通过"探索"动作动态分配计算资源，在多个基准上显著提升性能并大幅减少API调用次数。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法的编排流程（采样预算、细化循环、评分规则、搜索策略）都是人工预设的固定流程，模型仅负责求解而无法自主控制计算资源的分配，这种固定工作流限制了模型推理能力的充分发挥。
AI.method: 提出ATLAS框架，引入LLM编排器端到端控制整个循环。核心是单一"探索"动作——派遣独立求解器处理原始问题，编排器自主决定是否收集更多证据、何时停止以及如何综合最终答案。动作空间可扩展，可指定求解器、推理力度或提示策略。多模型扩展ATLAS-MM进一步将求解器选择作为额外动作维度。
AI.result: 在Claude Sonnet 4.6上评估：ATLAS达到HLE-Verified 56.00%、LiveCodeBench 82.29%、GPQA-Diamond 85.75%、BabyVision 23.71%，且API调用次数远少于固定工作流基线。ATLAS-MM进一步提升至HLE-Verified 60.00%和LiveCodeBench 85.63%。消融实验表明，用独立整合器替代编排器直接综合会在四个基准中的三个导致准确率下降或无改善。
AI.conclusion: 让模型自主编排测试时扩展过程比固定工作流更高效、更有效，有状态证据管理在性能提升中起关键作用，验证了LLM编排器端到端控制范式的优越性。

title: RDA: Reward Design Agent for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning has enabled the acquisition of impressive robotic skills, but typically requires hand-crafted reward functions that are slow to design and difficult to align with human intentions. Recent work, such as Eureka, automates reward design by using an LLM to iteratively generate and refine reward code from task descriptions. However, they rely on coarse feedback signals such as success rate, which provide little semantic insight into the learned behavior. As a result, their trained policies achieve the final goal but are frequently poorly aligned with task instructions. We introduce the Reward Design Agent (RDA), a VLM-based agentic framework that injects semantic understanding into reward design. RDA decomposes tasks, visually evaluates trajectories, summarizes failure modes, and iteratively revises reward code to better align with task instructions. Across 12 tabletop manipulation tasks from ManiSkill and 4 whole-body manipulation tasks from HumanoidBench, RDA produces policies substantially more instruction-aligned than those of other baselines, while achieving comparable task success rates. Videos and the generated reward code are available on https://nitinkamra1992.github.io/reward-design-agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RDA框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）将语义理解引入强化学习的奖励设计过程，解决了现有方法（如Eureka）仅依赖粗粒度反馈信号导致的策略与任务指令对齐不足问题，显著提升了策略与指令的对齐度。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在机器人技能学习方面取得了显著进展，但通常需要手工设计奖励函数，这一过程耗时且难以与人类意图对齐。现有自动化奖励设计方法（如Eureka）依赖成功率等粗粒度反馈信号，缺乏对学习行为的语义理解，导致训练的策略虽能达成目标但常与任务指令对齐不佳。
AI.method: 引入了奖励设计智能体（RDA），这是一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体框架。RDA将任务分解、视觉评估轨迹、总结失败模式，并迭代修订奖励代码，以更好地与任务指令对齐，从而将语义理解注入奖励设计过程。
AI.result: 在来自ManiSkill的12个桌面操作任务和来自HumanoidBench的4个全身操作任务上，RDA生成的策略在任务成功率与其他基线相当的情况下，其与任务指令的对齐程度显著优于其他基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RDA通过将视觉语言模型的语义理解能力融入奖励设计循环，有效解决了自动化奖励设计中策略与任务指令对齐不佳的问题，为机器人学习提供了更加符合人类意图的奖励设计新范式。

title: CANARY: Zero-Label Detection of Fine-Tuning Contamination in Language Models
summary: Adversaries can implant latent harmful behavior by poisoning as few as 1% of fine-tuning examples. The contamination is invisible to every output-level defense: harmful behavior lies dormant in the model's hidden-state geometry and does not appear in generated text until contamination exceeds 7.5%. We introduce CANARY (Contamination Auditor via Neural Activation Representation Yield), a zero-label checkpoint auditor that detects this hidden shift directly from two forward passes over an unlabeled prompt set. CANARY projects the hidden-state difference through a Sparse Autoencoder, filtering style noise to isolate meaningful semantic drift. It achieves AUROC = 1.000 at 1% contamination (95% CI = [0.997, 1.000]; Cohen's d = 3.28) across four model architectures and two training paradigms, 7.5x below where any output-level method fires, with zero false positives on benign fine-tuning and full robustness to style-matching and gradient-noise adaptive attacks. The same SAE feature basis drives a complete governance pipeline: SAE-filtered amplification surfaces latent harm at a 5x higher rate than standard generation; score-ranked prompts yield 4.2x red-teaming lift; and suppressing a handful of contamination-specific features at inference time reduces harm from 70% to 10% with no perplexity penalty. CANARY is the first zero-label framework to detect, verify, prioritize, and remediate supply-chain contamination from hidden states alone.

AI.tldr: 提出CANARY，首个无需标签的检查点审计框架，通过分析隐藏状态几何结构检测低至1%的微调数据投毒攻击，实现AUROC=1.000的完美检测性能，并支持潜在危害放大、红队测试优先级排序和推理时特征抑制等完整治理流程。
AI.motivation: adversaries可通过对少至1%的微调样本进行投毒来植入潜在有害行为，且这种污染对现有输出级防御方法不可见——有害行为潜伏在模型的隐藏状态几何结构中，直到污染超过7.5%才会出现在生成文本中。这揭示了现有防御方法的盲区，需要开发能直接检测隐藏状态变化的新方法。
AI.method: CANARY是一种零标签检查点审计器，通过两次前向传播处理未标记提示集，利用稀疏自编码器(SAE)投影隐藏状态差异，过滤风格噪声以隔离有意义的语义漂移。SAE特征基同时支撑完整治理管道：SAE过滤的放大、评分排序的提示生成、以及在推理时抑制特定特征。
AI.result: 在四种模型架构和两种训练范式上实现AUROC=1.000（95% CI=[0.997,1.000]，Cohen's d=3.28），检测阈值比任何输出级方法低7.5倍；在良性微调上零误报；对风格匹配和梯度噪声自适应攻击完全鲁棒。SAE过滤放大使潜在危害浮现率提高5倍；评分排序提示带来4.2倍红队测试提升；抑制少量污染特定特征将危害从70%降至10%且无困惑度损失。
AI.conclusion: CANARY是首个零标签框架，能够仅从隐藏状态检测、验证、优先排序和修复供应链污染，填补了现有输出级防御方法在低污染率场景下的空白，为AI供应链安全提供了全新的技术路径。

title: Two-Fidelity Best-Action Identification for Stochastic Minimax Tree
summary: We study fixed-confidence best-action identification (BAI) in stochastic minimax trees. This problem is increasingly relevant in modern AI planning, where deep minimax search and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with language model long rollouts face a fundamental tradeoff: heuristic evaluations are cheap but biased, while accurate rollouts are reliable but prohibitively expensive. We propose 2FFS, a two-fidelity tree-search algorithm that brings multi-fidelity flat bandit ideas into trees. The algorithm combines minimax-style fast expansion with MCTS-style stochastic sampling, adaptively deciding when to exploit cheap biased evaluations and when to invoke expensive accurate evaluations for local certification. We prove fixed-confidence correctness, establish finite stopping for exact identification, and give a polynomial-depth cost upper bound for general-depth trees. Across numerical stochastic-tree experiments, 2FFS uses substantially fewer samples and computational operations comparing to existing BAI-MCTS baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出2FFS算法，一种用于随机极大极小树固定置信度最佳动作识别的双保真树搜索方法，通过自适应结合廉价但有偏的启发式评估与昂贵但准确的推演，在保证正确性的前提下显著降低采样和计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现代AI规划中的深度极大极小搜索与蒙特卡洛树搜索面临基本权衡：启发式评估成本低但有偏差，准确推演可靠但代价过高。需要在固定置信度下高效识别最佳动作，降低计算成本。
AI.method: 提出2FFS（双保真树搜索）算法，将多保真平坦老虎机思想引入树结构。算法结合极大极小式快速扩展与MCTS式随机采样，自适应决策何时利用廉价有偏评估、何时调用昂贵准确评估进行局部认证。
AI.result: 证明了固定置信度正确性、建立了精确识别的有限停止性，并给出一般深度树的多项式深度成本上界。在随机树数值实验中，相比现有BAI-MCTS基线，2FFS使用显著更少的样本和计算操作。
AI.conclusion: 2FFS成功地将多保真方法从平坦老虎机推广到树结构，在理论保证（正确性、有限停止、多项式深度成本上界）与实际性能（显著降低样本和计算开销）两方面均优于现有方法，为AI规划中的计算资源分配提供了有效解决方案。

title: Decentralized Instruction Tuning: Conflict-Aware Splitting and Weight Merging
comment: 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication at ICML 2026
summary: Instruction tuning aligns large language models, including multimodal ones, with diverse user intents, but scaling to heterogeneous mixtures is hindered by gradient interference and bandwidth-heavy synchronization. We ask whether these two bottlenecks can be addressed jointly by training parts of the mixture independently and reconciling them once in parameter space. We develop a local quadratic theory inside a shared flat basin that yields three results: weight merging produces a curvature-weighted variance reduction; PCA-aligned conflict splitting maximizes this gain along high-curvature directions; and merging additionally acts as spectral filtering with implicit norm regularization. These results directly motivate MERIT, a decentralized merge-ready instruction-tuning pipeline that estimates dataset-level gradient conflicts, partitions the mixture along the top PCA conflict axes, fine-tunes each partition independently with no inter-partition communication, and merges once via token-weighted averaging. On Qwen2.5-VL-3B with 136 Vision-FLAN tasks, MERIT improves the 8-benchmark average from 54.3 (joint training) to 57.0. The same recipe scales to a 7B model on a 1.6M-example, 176-source mixture -- matching or exceeding centralized joint training with minimal cost overhead -- and transfers to text-only FLAN. Our code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/merit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MERIT，一种去中心化的合并式指令微调框架，通过将异构数据集划分为独立训练的子集并进行一次性参数合并，有效解决了多模态大模型指令微调中的梯度冲突和通信瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模语言模型（包括多模态模型）指令微调在处理异构数据混合时面临两大挑战：不同数据集间的梯度干扰会降低训练效果，而联合训练需要大量的带宽进行同步通信。作者思考能否通过独立训练数据混合的各部分，然后在参数空间中进行一次性合并来同时解决这两个瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者提出了局部二次理论，证明了在共享平坦盆地内，权重合并可以产生曲率加权的方差减少效果，且基于PCA对齐的冲突分割能最大化此收益。基于此理论，MERIT流程首先估计数据集级别的梯度冲突，然后沿顶部PCA冲突轴对混合数据进行划分，各分区独立进行微调（无分区间通信），最后通过Token加权平均进行一次性合并。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B模型上使用136个Vision-FLAN任务进行测试，MERIT将8个基准测试的平均分从联合训练的54.3提升至57.0。该方法成功扩展至7B模型和包含160万样本、176个来源的数据集，在最小开销下匹配或超越了中心化联合训练的性能，并能迁移至纯文本FLAN任务。
AI.conclusion: MERIT证明了去中心化训练与参数合并策略能够有效解决指令微调中的梯度干扰和通信开销问题，为大规模异构数据集的模型训练提供了一种高效、可扩展且性能优越的解决方案。

title: Fair Finetuning Mitigates Distribution Inference Attacks
summary: Machine learning models trained on sensitive data can inadvertently leak population-level information about their training distributions -- a threat known as distribution inference attack (DIA). An adversary with black-box access can infer sensitive demographic properties, such as subgroup proportions, without observing any training data directly. While defenses such as differential privacy and property unlearning have been proposed, the link between fairness constraints and distributional leakage remains unexplored. We propose Fair Fine-tuning (FFt): a trained model is fine-tuned on samples from the complementary distribution under an Equalized Odds (EO) constraint. We provide a complete theoretical characterization, proving the tight bound $\text{Adv}(\mathcal{A},M_f) \le Δ_{\text{EO}} \cdot W$, where $W$ quantifies how distinguishable the two training distributions are by their sensitive-attribute composition. We also establish a necessary condition for FFt to reduce adversarial advantage and prove tightness of the bound. We evaluate across six datasets spanning tabular (ACS Income, COMPAS, German Credit), image (UTKFaces), and NLP (Bias in Bios) modalities. Rehearsal-based FFt consistently reduces the adversarial accuracy gap below the detection threshold $τ!=!0.1$ across all settings; on ACS Income, the gap falls from $\sim!15%$ to under $4%$. Our work provides the first formal bound connecting a model's measured EO disparity directly to its adversarial advantage in the DIA game, opening a new avenue for unified fairness-and-privacy defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fair Fine-tuning (FFt)方法，通过在互补分布样本上进行Equalized Odds约束微调，首次建立模型公平性差异与分布推理攻击优势之间的理论界限，有效防御敏感信息泄露。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在敏感数据上训练时会无意泄露训练分布的群体层面信息，存在分布推理攻击(DIA)威胁。现有防御方法（差分隐私、属性遗忘）未探索公平性约束与分布泄露之间的联系。
AI.method: 提出Fair Fine-tuning (FFt)：在Equalized Odds (EO)约束下，使用互补分布样本对已训练模型进行微调。提供完整理论分析，证明对抗优势的上界为Adv(A,Mf) ≤ ΔEO · W，其中W量化两个训练分布在敏感属性组成上的可区分性。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上评估（表格、图像、NLP模态）。基于排练的FFt在所有设置中将对抗准确率差距降至检测阈值τ=0.1以下；在ACS Income上，差距从~15%降至4%以下。
AI.conclusion: 首次建立模型的EO差异与DIA游戏中对抗优势的正式界限连接，为统一公平性与隐私防御开辟新途径。

title: A Note on Stability for Orthogonalized Matrix Momentum with Client Sampling
summary: We study finite-sample generalization for a client-sampled distributed optimization scheme with matrix-valued parameters and orthogonalized momentum updates. The central quantity is the gap between the population and empirical objectives at the returned model when only a subset of clients participates in each round. Under independent heterogeneous client data, unequal local sample counts, and fixed aggregation weights, we derive a finite-round upper-tail guarantee from a coupled-neighbor stability recursion and a weighted concentration step. The bound keeps the client-selection counts through the amplification factor \(Y_i(\mathcal C)\); in the uniform full-participation full-batch regime, it yields \(\widetilde{\mathcal O}(n^{-1}+n^{-1/2})\) scaling whenever the horizon-dependent amplification terms are controlled. The matrix-orthogonalization rule is required to be Lipschitz along paired trajectories, a condition satisfied by regularized polar-type maps and normalized finite-step Newton--Schulz orthogonalizers. For the unregularized matrix sign, the same argument requires coupled spectral separation, whereas Gaussian smoothing gives a finite-round smoothed variant. A one-dimensional counterexample shows why a gap, smoothing, or regularity condition is necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有矩阵参数和正交化动量更新的客户端采样分布式优化方案的有限样本泛化界，给出了在异构数据和不均衡样本下的泛化误差上界，并指出了正交化规则需满足的光滑性条件。
AI.motivation: 在联邦学习等分布式优化场景中，客户端采样、矩阵参数（如神经网络权重矩阵）和正交化动量更新被广泛应用。然而，针对这种复杂设置下的有限样本泛化保证仍然缺失。本文旨在填补这一空白，量化客户端采样带来的泛化误差。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于耦合邻域稳定性递归和加权集中步骤的分析框架。核心思路是通过稳定性分析刻画相邻训练轨迹的差异，结合客户端采样带来的集中不等式，推导泛化误差上界。分析针对矩阵正交化规则提出了沿配对轨迹的Lipschitz条件。
AI.result: 在独立异构客户端数据、不均衡本地样本数和固定聚合权重下，推导出了有限轮次的泛化误差上界。该界通过放大因子保留客户端选择计数，在均匀全参与全批处理情形下达到 $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(n^{-1}+n^{-1/2})$ 的收敛率。该条件可被正则化极化映射和归一化Newton-Schulz正交化器满足。对于非正则化矩阵符号函数，需要耦合谱分离条件，高斯平滑可提供光滑变体。一维反例表明缺少额外条件时该界可能失效。
AI.conclusion: 本文为客户端采样下矩阵参数分布式优化的泛化分析提供了理论保证，揭示了正交化规则需满足的关键条件（光滑性或谱分离），并通过反例说明了这些条件的必要性，为实际算法设计提供了理论指导。

title: Shortcut to Nowhere: Demystifying Deep Spurious Regression
summary: Real-world regression often exhibits shortcuts: attributes that are spuriously correlated with continuous targets in training, yet unreliable under deployment shifts; regressing targets using such shortcuts may fail catastrophically at test time. Existing studies on spurious correlations focus primarily on classification, where labels are categorical and groups are naturally defined. However, many real-world tasks require continuous prediction, where hard label boundaries or discrete group-label pairs do not exist.
